lhe ri 0 yame+erdi 0 potsho/ 0za40 /daliya ri 'a jaglu dbyapa 'i ba'/da pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/ riri ngh+ru po/ ci 73ོ ོ /ci krodwo sgo rīrī 1 rdo9|cingukhoXdadedeci / tshosnye dze7lke/zhurī/lko— / 3/tsho( tsho7miṭ+wāṃñcā k+shi byudz+waṭāhosdidze39rdo/sdi༄ rnye9 byerisnyewarī—sdune+e sngenge ༵ tsar+sā ) cirdo 3kholkemi tswane+e)ri rdzo/r+sha 7geci—༷༷ 3 4tsaphi )khri kyā—4cho)rkad+ku 7 (༵ ngh+ru ༵ —dzoci neji stsegeci

ngakar chagagrub mtha' rnam gzhag 'khrul spoju gangor lnga'idzi dbyangs/ ( 1 )grub mtha'i rtsam bshad le'u dang po spyi bshad/ (26)grub mthalirnam bshad len gnyis pa med mtha' dgag pa/ (77〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u gsum pa grangs can ser skya'i rtag mtha' dgag mi (109〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u bzhi ba tshangs sogs bzhi'i rtag mtha' das/ga pa/ (134〉grub mthalirnam bshad le'u lnga ba khyab 'jug pa dang dpyod pa bzho rtag mtha' dgag pa/ (151〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u drug pa dbang phyug pa dang bye rig gi rtag mtha' dgag pa/ (177〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u bdun pa gcer bu ba'i rtag mtha' dgag pa/ (219〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u brgyad pa bye smrali'adod tshul bstan pa/ (2me6〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u dgu ba mdo sde pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/ (298〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u ngacu ba rnam rig pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/ (344〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u bcu gcig pa dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/ (544〉grub mtha'i rnam bshad lelu bcu gnyis pa dbu ma thal 'gyur ba' 'dz+wad tshul bstan pa/ (792)grub mtha'i rnam bshad la'u bcu gsum pa 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i dogs gcod/ — (954)

༄tsho/ /grub mtha' rnam gzhag 'khrul spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs/gdul bya'i khams bzhin gsang gsum brtan g.yo'i gar//rab bsgyur mtha' yas zab rgyas chos kyi sgo//mang phye rten 'byung gtam gyis kun mkhyen lam//ston mdzad shāka seng brgyud par bcas phyag 'tshal//zla bral mkhyen rab ral gri'i rno dang lhan cig stong ba'i mkhar gdengs mi shes dgra/ /thugs rje'i spyan dang 'dzum ldan mchu sgros legs bshad 'chad la lhan cig 'gro la bzhad/ /chos mdzod gang bsnams de dang lhan cig rnal 'byor dran par gang de brjed min 'dri/ /rgyal kun yab gcig gnyis kye khyod kyis bdag blo ngag mchog lhan cig rnam bkra mdzod/ /'o mtsho las 'ongs shel dkar lhun pos dbang sngon zur phud ngom/ /zla rgyas zhal las dkyus ring 'dren byed ut+pal sngon po'i mda'/ /'phangs pas sems rmongs spubs grol rnam dpyod ches bkra'i pad+ma 'bum/ /khyod kyi rjes chags mchu dang lhan cig bzhad par mdzod cig tshangs sras ma/ /'di na mdo sngags zab rgyas nyin mtshan res tsam gyis/ /spyod tshe thub bstan ma lusri nyams len rnam sad 'od/ /'byin mdzod blo bzang rgyal ba snga phyi sras 1

bcas sog/sa// /thub dbang zhal skyin rnams la mi gus dpyod ldan su/ /rigs grur de da dpon mkhas bsten ngal ba brgyas/ /grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son sngon med pa'i/ /legs bshad rin chen rnyed 'di dpyod ldan rnamastse / /dga' bzhin kun mkhyen lam gsal sgron me zungs/bstsa na dang ston pa lta bas phyi nang gnyis/ /bkar btags lta dang sgom pa srid dza 'i gnyen/ /mtha' gnyis spangs spyod bral 'bras brtag 'ango/ga bsta na/ /ston pa skyon zad gnyis bzlog gzhan gyi phyir/ /skyabs 'gros mim/ dang ston pa gcig 'dod 'khrul/ /bdag lta'i zhen yul sgrub 'gog phyi nang gnyis/ /dang po mngon lkog dbang gis chad rtag smra/ /bdertedangoku 'do— 'gogadangosasmradangosanyid med phyi nangalazhenayin ra cha) / / don smra sems tsam pa/ /ston sogs phal cher rang sder 'dren gus mang / /rang rang mtha' bral rtog btags gong mas 'gog /'og ma 'og ma'i lta ba'ang gong ma'i stegs/ /gzhan rnams mthar lhung mtha' bral klu'i zhabs lugs/ zhes grub mtha' spyi'i rnam bzhag skabs te dang po'o//༈che lo dpag med dus su ser skya yis/ /grangs can gzhung brtsams de'i bdag rnam dbye la/ /sgro btags mi 'dras mu stegs lugs mang gyes/ /'ga' zhig gdod nas ston sog/sa tha dad 'chad/ /la lar kun ston drang srong mchod 'os 'dod/ /mchod spyin gnyis rim 'dir byung grangane can snga/ /gzhan sde phyi ba mu stegs byed sogs ming / /nyer lnga bshad kyang 'dir gsal mi 'dra khyim/ /lngar 'khrul rang sder mi mtshungs grangaX ma bkag /chad smra gcig dang rtag smra bcu gcig grags/ /phur

bu 'jig rten mig dang 'jug stobs ston/ /tshur mdzes chad smra med smrartemur bu ba/ /rgyang pan sogs so rang bzhin rgyur smra 'khrul/ /rgyu 'bras lha sogs mi 'dod 'dod bshad phyir/ /snga phyi gtan med 'gro gsum tsam sogs 'khrul/ /rtog ge snyoms 'jug 'dod gdung phan rlom gyis / /mthong min rjes 'gro med pas rgyu 'bras med/ /lus sems tsam bdag zhig phyir snga phyi med/ /sems lus tha dad la brten rgyud gcig min/ /'byung las sems skye myang 'das dngos po med/ /mngon sum tshad ma rjes dpag tshad min 'khrul/ /sems phyir de sngon song grub g.yo drana'ang phyir/ /goms gsal rjes 'gros kun mkhyen rgyu 'bras grub/ /de med mngon min rjes dpag bkag phyir yang / zhes chad mtha' rnam par bkag pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /༈ser skya mchod 'os dbang phyug chu klung ston/ /grangs can rang ba'i/na rgyur smra ser skya sogs/ /dbye ngo ser skya mngon gsal lha med pa/ /grangs can lhar bcas rnam 'gyur chu klung lugs/ /mngon sum tshad ma / dbang po'i 'jug pa gnyis/ /rang don 'bre' bdun gzhan don rnam gsal gnyis/ /dbang phyug rgyud dang sum cu ba sogs lung / /yon tan bya byed min dang rtag dngos shes/ /za bo'i bdag yod spyi glor gnas mi gnas/ /shes rig skyes bu bdag sogs nyer bzhi bem/ /rtsa ba byed po rtag gcig yu la dang khyab/ /mi gsal yon ta na mnyam 'dod gnas lugs sogs/ /de las chen po shel 'dra gnyis 'dres 'jal/ /yo na tan snying stobs rdul mun bde sdug sogs/ /blo las nga rgya'/dzigasum skyedzi 3

dang po las/ /de tsam lnga skyed de lngas 'byung ba lnga / /gnyis pas las blo'i dbang po lnga lnga yid/ /gsum pa de gnyis 'jug byed mu bzhi'i phyir/ / nyer lnga gtso bdag la sdud shin tu 'khrul/ /spyi bdag bderna dngos gzhan rdzun skye ba'i tshul/ /sngar yod gsal 'gyur 'jig pa thim mam zhi/ /sna tshogs gtso tsam las min sems med phyir/ /byin med mi rtsom skyes bus min mi shes/ /rang bzhin ngor gnas yon tan de gsum gyis/ /skye sa/nas 'jig cing rgyu yoda'ang rim phyir 'bras/ /bsam gzugs mngon shes gtsor lta'i lam sogs kyis/ /'ba' zhig rang bzhin bdag gnas thar ba gnyis/ /mtshan nyid lnga bcu 'ching thar gsum gsum sogs/ /yod kyang skye na don med thug med 'gyur/ /skyed byed rtag dang ma nyams 'bras ldog 'gal/ /bem phyir mi myong khyab phyir cha med 'gal/ /rtag phyir shes min rtag la 'ching grol ci/ zhes ser skya ba dang grangs can dag gis sgro btags pa'i rtag mtha' bsal ba'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /༈tshangs sogs ston dang bram ze rig byed sogs/ /tshangs pa pad sgong las skyes dus ming bdun/ /zhal bzhi lus cha bzhi las rig byed bzhi/ /mi rigs bzhi skyes 'jig rten byed pa po/ /rig byed rang byung a shwa me bhā mchog /rtag zhi ston pa brda sprod sgra byed ming / /sna tshogs gzhir byed sgra yi tshangs pa smra/ /oṃ ring dngos kun rang bzhin cha med rtag /bden 'jug rab rib kyis bslad sna tshogs snang / /phyi nang sbyin sreg lam dang 'dzag bde thar/ /tshad ma rig byed kho na la la'i gnyis/ /tshangs sogs ston dang rig byed mthar smra sogs/ /khyab phra shes rtag skyes 4 —

bu nyi ma'i mdog /mun 'das kho nas snod bcud 'ching sogs byed/ /gser mdog mthong tshe de char thim pa grol/ tshangs sogs ston dang rig byed gsang ba pa/ /bdud rtsi thigs lung shes rig rtag pa'i bdag /cha med ngo bo nyid mid bden grub 'dod/ /rigs bzhi mid 'gyur ming sring kun spyad 'gyur/ /'tsho ba chos yin dmyal ba'i rgyu gang sogs/ zhes tshangs pa pa dang brda sprod pa dang rig byed mtha' ba dang gsang ba pa bzhis sgro btags pa'i rtag mtha' tshad bsal gyi skabs te bzhi ba'o/ /༈nor lha zla ba gzhon nu ma len ston/ /khyab 'jug pa dang zla ba glu'i chos smra/ /rtog phan yal ga mtshan mo lnga sogs lung / /khyab 'jug bud med mang bskor sgo ldan gnas/ /nyi sogs mchog nga bram ze lus kyis byed/ /ngo bo gnyis las zhi bsgom thar ba thob/ /ma zhi'i nya dang rus sbal phag rgod dang / /mi yi seng ge mi'u thung dga' byed gnyis/ /nag pa sangs rgyas rigs ldan 'jug pa bcus/ /bton dang btegs mnan bsad bslus mgrin bcu bsad/ /rigs bcad don byas sdig sbyangs semarushaṃ ca na btul/ /byed po bdag dang las dus rang bzhin dang / /yon tan nyams pa'i stong ba rgyu 'bras dang / /rlung yig sogs sgom thar 'dod 'khor mtha' 'dod/ /rgyal dpog pa ston spyod pa rgyal dpog pa/ /bdag ni blo dang shes rig rtag rdzas sogs/ /dri ma skyes bu'i rang bzhin kun mkhyen med/ /mtho ris thar 'doda'ang byas shugs zhe brgyad rgyu/ /rwa ba'i/ za/nga gsum mgo gnyis lag pa bdun/ /gsum bcing khyu mchog nga ro rig byed khyad/ /gsum mam bdun bdun mar gyis —mchod sbyin 'dod/ /5

mngon sum rjes dpag nyer 'jal sgra byung dang / /ldan go dngos med ces bya'i tshad ma drug /kha cig rig srid ma dmigs grags snyam sogs/ /kun la khyab phyir bros 'gal 'jug bcu rdzun/ /spangs rtogs mthar 'gros nyes zad kun mkhyen 'grub/ ces khyab 'jug pa dang dpyod pa ba dag gis sgro btags pa'i rtag mtha' tshad bsal gyi skabs te lnga ba'o/ /༈khya/ ba drang srong rkang mig la sogs ston/ /dbang phyug ye srid pa sogs dbye na gsum/ /sgra bsgrags sme brtsegs rgyud lung tshad ma 'dra/ /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad ldan ti ser gnas/ /sdod sogs 'chol phyir skye 'jig byed por grub/ /byed po bdag sogs lam drug khams dang sngags/ /'do da pa bdag dang zhi ba'i de nyid lnga/ /de ni gsum gnas sbyor gtong bcu gnyis mdud/ /bzhi ba'i ye shes thar ba'i go 'phang smra/ /rlung sbyor drag po'i dbang dang 'dzag bde lam/ /tha snyad 'gal bas bye brag pa sogs min/ /ston pa 'ug pa gzegs zan rkang mig pa/ /gzegs zan rkang mig 'ug phrug lung tsam pa'ang / /dbye ngo bye brag pa dang rig pa can/ /don drug tshad ma bzhis 'jal mngon sum ni/ /dbang don phrad 'brel drug bem bye brag pa/ /de phrad khyad par 'dzin rtog rig pa can/ /rjes dpagachigasum gsum lhag ldan yas dag sogs / /lnga ldan gzhan don nyer 'jal 'dra bas sgrub/ /sgra byung zhi rgyud 'jig rten mig mdo lung / /rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi bye brag /'du ba tshig gi don drug bden dngos gzhi/ /'byung bzhi yid mkha' phyogs bdag dus dgu rdzas/ /lnga bzhi ma khyab khyab rdzas bzhi sogs bzhi/ /gzhan 6

rtag yon tan cha gnyis las mi rtag /za bo byed po ma byas rtag shes min/ / khyab dang bya med bdag 'dod khyab phra rim/ /yid ni rtag dngos rtog bcas yul can blo/ /bzhi ldan yon tan nyer bzhi nyer lnga yang / /las lnga'o cha dari+o cha ca na sogs gzhan rdzas/ /gsum las don gzhan spyi yin khyad par brgyad/ /khyad zhugs bye brag 'du ba 'brel ba gnyis/ /snod bcud phra rab suladang dbang phyug gis/ /khrus sogs chos yin 'khor ba yon tan 'du/ /thar ba brjo da med yon tan 'du 'bral bdag /de nyid rtogs pa thar rgyu thar bar 'khrul/ /dbang phyug dga' sdug rgyu dang sdig spyod 'gyur/ /'dod ltos nus med kun khyab cha med 'aspro—/la / /rtag phyir rtag tu skye 'am gtan mi skye/ zhes/ dbang phyug pa dang bye rib/ gnyis dang gsum gyis 'dod pa'i rtag mtha' bsal ba'i skabs te drug pa'o myu/ rgyal ba dem pa khyu mchog ldong riṭaṭa ston/ /za byed mchod 'os gcer bu kun tu rgyu/ /srog ni lus tshad rtag bdag skyes bu 'gro/ /mngon sum rtog ba/caṭari/ rtog med spyi gsal 'jal/ /tshul gsum mi 'thad rjes dpag tshul gcig pa/ /rgyas byed skar ma'i bstan bcos la sos/sa lung / /srog dang srog min zag pa spangs pa sdom/ /bcing thar 'gro 'ong dgu 'amyo/ srog za0/ sdom/ /nges/ rga 'ching las sdig bsod thar ba dgu/ /kun kyang rdzas dang rnam grangs rtag mi rtag/ /dus gsum rdzas drug srog can drug gam dgu/ /sdom lnga ngartul zhugs/ lnga dang ye shes lnga/ /spyod pa bcu gsum laca/ 'dod thar ba gzugs/ /'gro lnga lus lnga dbang bo gcig —7

’ldan sogs/ /'ching ba sum brgya drug cu las tshe sogs/ /ma brtsam/sa lu nga ma bstan dang nyal sogs phyir/ /kun mkhyen med dang shing sos/sa semayoldan sgrub/ /ltar snang mang yang gnad chung 'dir mi spro/ /rdzas dang rnam grangs phan tshun gcig med 'jig /thar ba gzugs phyir las zad don med 'gyur/ /che chung 'gyur na mi rtag tshul gciga'ang 'ag la/zhes kun tu rgyu dag gis sgro btags pa'i rtag mtha' tshad bsal gyi skabs te ba dun pa'o/ /༈rang sde bye smra mdo sems dbu ma ba/ /bzhir nges 'dir ni grub mtha' lngar min gsungs/ /'di bzhi theg dman theg chen sde tshul gnyisa'ang / /theg gsum la sdud gsum 'dod lngar dbye 'khrul/ /nyan thos sde gnyis kun gzhi nyon yid dang / /chos kyi bdag med sa bcu sku gsum sogs/ /theg chen sngon bkar mi 'dod phyis 'dod gras/sa/ /༈bye brag bshad mtsho gtso bor smra phyir dang / /rdzas kyi bye brag smra bas bye smra ba/ /gyes tshul gnyis sogs yod smra phal chen dang / /gnas brtan mang bkur sde bdun lnga gsum gsum/ /yang na phal chen sde brgyad gnas brtan bcu/ /de kun bye smra'i sde dang sde gnyis 'gal/ /'dus tsam lakyichung theg chen bshad phyir yang / /mang bkur sde lngas brjod med bdag smra yang / /gsum ldan bdag med kun mtshungs de gzhan min/ /ngaden gnyis phung khams skye mched 'gro lnga zas/ /zag bcas zag med 'dus byas ma byas gsum/ /nam mkha' snang mun phra rdul cha reg min/ / mngon rjes tshad ma lam lnga byang chub sogasdo// /phyin drug dge 'dun nyi shu 8

zhugs 'bras brgyad/ /bcu gnyis mdzad pa cha gnyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /lhag med gsum gar bem rig rgyun chad 'bras/ /bcom dang gzhig pasangablo 'dor mi 'dor chos/ /rim bzhin kun rdzob bden dang don dam bden/ /gsum phyir sde bdun bka' dang lung 'du byed/ /mngon sum dbang yid rnal 'byora'ang rang rig med/ /rgyu 'bras dus mnyam rnam par rig min gzugs/ /dbang shes rnam med gzhi lnga dngos po rdzas/ /gzugs phung de min sangs rgyas mi slob chos/ /thun mong min mang legs ldan gzhung sogs ltos/ zhes rtag pa'i mtha' bkag nas dus gsum rdzas kyi bye brag tu smra ba'i skabs te brgyad pa'o/ /༈mdo sde tshad mar smra bas mdo sde ba/ /dbye ngo lung rigs rjes 'brangarnam pa'i gsum/ /bden gnyis bden par don byed nus/ mi nus/ /phung khams skye mched 'dus byas ma byas ga'i// /bya0 phyogs rnam thar mthar gnas brtse sogs lam/ /zhugs gnas rang rgyal gnyis dang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dngos rnams skad cig sde bdun bka/'a min byas/ /mngon pa mdo 'dul nang gnas rang spyi 'chad/ /lung ni tshigs gzugs phra rdul cha yod med/ /rig min gzugs med gzugs can tshad mar min/ /ma byas dngos med 'du byed be+em med btags/ /dbang shes rnam ldan lugs gsum gzung rnam mnyam/ /grangs mnyam rim 'dzin sna tshos/sa gcig rnams 'dod/ /lung rigs sde'i lus/sa rgyu 'bras dus mi mnyam/ /spangs rtogs mi nyams lus shes yan lag nong / /mngon sum dbang yid rnal 'byor rang rigs bzhi/ /mngon su/ma snang yul mi 9

rtag bdag mid shugs/ /byang 'phags mnyam bzhag chos gzugs gnyis sangs rgyas/ zhes rtag pa'i bdag dang rdzas bkag nas mdo sde tshad mar smra ba'i skabs te dgu ba'o/ / ༈ 'khor lo dang po'i don bzhin don smra dang / /bar mtha'i lugs bzhin dbu sems gnyis bzhag phyir/ /grub mtha' bzhi yang thub dgongs mchog dmana'ang bzhed/ /khyad par theg chen mdo dang sngabanas kyis bsdus/ /re re'ang mkhas rnams dbu sems lugs su bkral/ /rgyal bas lung bstan shing rta che gnyis kyis/ /byams mgon 'jam dbyangs drin gyis dgongs 'grel dang / /blo gros mi zad mdo bzhin dbu sems srol/ /gsar phye bzhir grags mi 'thad gsum rung bzhad/ /phak+ṣ-ir cher rgya che'i lam mthun zab la min/ /༈khams gsum rnam rig nyid dang sems tsam du/ /smra bas rnam rig pa dang sems tsam pa/ /dbye ba lung rigs rjes 'brang rnam bden rdzun/ /legs phye nges don gzhan gnyis drang ba'i don/ /drang nges rton rigs daswongs ldem bzhi bzhis 'byed/ /dang po drang don lung dang phyi rol don/ /med phyir don snang la dgongs de gzhug ched/ /bar ba theg chen zab mdo sgra bzhin min/ /mtshan nyid gsum gyi ngo bo nyid med par/ /dgengs phyir sgra bzhin mi rung skur 'debs 'ugyur/ /de ltar ma skyes sogs phyir ma skyes/ sos/sa/ /skye med chos bzod rang gzhan sogs brgyad kyi/ /gabung 'dzin rang mtshan rgyu 'bras mtshan mtshon sogs/ /bya byed la dgongs de bshad chos grags kyang / /snga mas khams ni nus nges bden 10

grub phyir/ /theg gsum dzags nges rigs chad thos sogs kyis/ /zhugs kyang skyo sogs nges 'byung gtan mi skye/ /phyi mas mi rtag thabs yod de shes yod/ / ston dang don gnyer srid phyir theg gciga'ang 'grub/ /kun btags bden grub sgro 'dogs gzhan gnyis po/ /bden med skur 'debs zlog pa dbu ma'i lam/ /dngos kun bden na byed po'ang kun rdzob tu/ /yod ces bshad ci bden gnyis yod tshul gnyis/ /dang po dbu sems yod med rtsod sa dang / /gnyis pa kun nyon slong rung tha snyad gzhi/ /yin min kun rdzob don dam yod gsu/ngas tsam/ rdzas btagasa'ang gnyis phyir dngos po rdzun grub 'khrul/ /btags cha kun btags yongs chad rnam grangs gnyis/ /med dang ma skyes kun rdzob rim bzhin 'jog /'khrul gzhi 'khrul ba gzhan dbang dag ma dag /rim bzhin mi rtog ye shes nyon mongs rnams/ /bdag gnyis btagre/sa pas stong pa yongs grub ste/ /bdag med gnyis dang re re'ang nyi shu sos/sa/ /sgras brjod don thob sgrub pa don dam gsum/ /snod bcud chags 'jig gnas sogs cha 'dra yang / /'dod pa so drug gnas rigs bco brgyad gzugs/ /ri dbyibaṭage sogs min nges pa'i las 'das/ so gas/ /phung sogs dbye tshul dge sogs mi 'dra yang / /shes byar bden/ gnyis ngo bo gcig sdog dbye/ /kun nyon skye rung dmigre/sa pa kun rdzob bden/ /rnam grangs tha snyad bden sogs dbye na gsum/ /rnam dag lam dmis/sa mthar thug don dam bden/ /rnam grangs chos nyid de nyid sogs dbye zin/ /mngon lkog dbang gis tshad mar mngon rjes gnyis/ /ma ngon 11

sum bzhi dang dbang mngon 'og ma 'khrul/ /snga rol de blo med phyir de'i bdag 'gal/ /de ming mang phyir don gcig bdag mang 'gal/ /ming don gcig 'jug ma nges bdag 'dres 'gal/ /tshol bzhis butsal bzhin med phyir der de mad/ /lhan cig dmigs pa nges phyir de gzhan min/ /phra rdul bskor tshe shar ngos nub phyogs la/ /mi blta cha bcas bltas na rags mi 'gyur/ /phra rab yin kyang bye smra'i min ci 'gal/ /mang pos bkag phyir dbu sems de 'dod 'khrul/ /mnyam bzhag ngor med dngos gcig yid mang phyir/ /de yid 'ong dang mi 'ong sbyor snang sogs/ /rmi sogs mtshungs phyir don med sems tsam bden/ /don rtog zhen gzhi med pas rtog med la/ /der snang 'khrul bas de dang rdzos gzhan khegs/ /rten phyir 'di bsal kun rtog brgya sogs ldog /'jug pa'i shes par rags snang rtsod pa'i gzhi/ /rtsod tshul bden mi bden nam yod me da dam/ /rmongs pas ma bslad bslad pas bden rdzun rtsod/ /dbu sems bden rdzun yod dang dngos sogs min/ /rnam bden la gsum sgo nga phyed tshal dang / /gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam sna tshogs gnyis med rim/ /shes pa'i gzung 'dzin tha dad bram ze 'dod/ /gzung pa'i grangs snyed rnam 'ardod shākya blo/ /sna tshogs shes rnam gcig 'dod chos grags zhabaṭatrī / /rnam rdzun la gnyis rgyal la gnyis snang dri/ /yod dang med pas dri bcas dri med grags/ — /rnam rdzun phyi don yul byas tshad 'bras lo/ /mi 'thad phyi don grub na sems tsam ci/ /rtog ngor zer na rnam bden la mtshungs 'khrul/ /chos kun sems yin zer ba'ang mi 'thad 12

rtsing / /skyon yon 'khor 'das gcig 'gyur skyon sogs mang / /sems tsam rdon ci rmi lam mir snang ba/ /sems yin mi smra de min gzhan min bzhin/ /snang grags sems min sems las rdzas gzhan min/ /kun gzhi ma bsgrib lung ma bstan pa'i sems/ /phra ba lko ga byur sa bon thams cad pa/ /nyon yid der dmigs ngar sems khyad par can / /rnam shes tshogs brgyad sku mched rjes 'brang 'dod/ /ma bshad rtog gnyis cig car min sogs phyi ra/ /brgyad min tshogs drug sde bdun rjes 'brang lugs/ /sgom thabs yid byed dmigs par mkhas dgos phyir/ /yi da byed dngos gzhi bdun dang gzhan bzhi bcu/ /dmigs pa mtshan ma'o bzhi dang sum cu gnyis/ /bsdus na gnyis sam sems dgu'ang lnga spong sogs/ /bcu gnyis bzhi sogs sa dang phar phyin khyad/ /brgya phrag bcu gnyis mig sogs gnas gyur dang / /sku bzhi lnga sogs bcu gnyis 'phrin las sogs/ /'byed gnyis rgyan dang dgongs 'grel sogs las bshad / /phyi don sogs chos bdag rags pa bkag rinas chos kyi bdag med sgrub pa'i rnam rig pa'i skabs te bcu ba'o/ /༈mtha' bral dbus smra ngo bo nyid med pas/ dbu ma pa dang ngo bo nyid med pa/ /dbye ba thal rang gnyis dang gzhan ming tsam/ /tha snyad du ya nga yod min med mtha' dang / /bden dngos rtag mtha' bkag nas rten 'byung chos/ /dbu mar 'dod ma tshungs gnyis ka dbu ma pa/ /phra mo'i mtha' kun bral de thal 'gyur lugs/ /byung rim thub rjes bzhi brgya'i dus na klus/ /theg chen spyan drangs dbu mar bkral srol phye/ /13

dgu brgyar sems tsam srol phye thogs med kyis/ /rtsa ba sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur bkral/ /bha byas skyon bzung dbu ma rang rgyud phye/ /zla bas legs pakag thun mong min pardzabasgrubs/ /de rjes zhi 'tshos rang rgyud gnyis pa byas/ /ci yang med dang gzhan stong rtag bdag smra/ /bden gnyis mi 'dod lugs med tshad grub med/ /la sogs mthar lhung dbu mar rlobyari kyang min/ /khyad par zla ba'i lugs rlom kun mkhyen la/ /kun tu dgrar 'dzin khyod la 'gal 'khrul mang / /thams cad mkhyen yang ji snyed mi mkhyen 'gal/ /de med zad spyod lugs ngan dbu mar 'khrul/ /don dam rten 'byung tshugs thub grub ches 'gal/ /las 'bras 'dod dang rnam smin gtan med 'gal/ /ma zhig las kyis 'bras bskyed dus mnyam 'khrul/ /bskal bar mi 'jig las dang dbu ma 'gal/ /rang lugs zab rgyas mi 'dod dbu ma 'gal/ /ma dpyad dbye gzhir dpyad don dbye ba 'gal/ /stong min thar lam zhi sgo gnyis med 'gal/ /ci yang ma bsgom stong nyid bsgom pa 'gal/ /de gzhan tsam gyis gzhan skye khas len dang / /bdag 'dod tsam gyis bdag skye mi 'dod 'gal/ /bskal mang skyukanas kun bslab kyang 'bras dus na/ /ji snyed gcig kyang mi shes lam rim 'khrul/ /lhag med gzugs rig gtan med sku bzhi 'gal/ /ma ngon rjes gnyis 'dod tshad ma mi 'dod 'gal/ /sgrub byed yod dang tshad grub dngos med 'gal/ /ma 'dres stobs thob 'khor ba'i rdzogs sangs 'gal/ /'jig lta'i zhen yul sgrub dang 'gog pa 'gal/ /bdag med phra rags lta gnyis yul gcig 'gal/ /kun gzhi yod dang phyi 14

don 'dod pa 'gal/ /don dam rigs grub mnyam bzhag yul med 'gal/ /rnal 'byor mngon min bdag med mngon gyur 'gal/ /'khor rtsa gsum dang zhi sgo gcig pa 'gal/ /de 'gog bstan brucos t+pa—/nga de'e lugs yin 'gal/ /'thad pa bral yang rung dang rigs pa 'gal/ /gzhi kun med dang khyad gzhi gdags gzhi 'gal/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang tshogs lam slar 'jug 'gal/ /shes sgrib kun zad 'pho 'gyur bag chags 'gal/ /brjod bral kha byang sgom ngan khyod 'khrul rgyu/ /rang rgyud rtags sam rang dbang rtags gcig phyir/ /༈tshul gsum chos can mthun snang rang dbang gis/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed rtags 'god rang rgyud pa/ /mdo sde rnal 'byor dbu ma rang rgyud gnyis/ /snga mas phyi rol don sgrub phyi mas 'gog /rang mtshan gyis grub mtshan nyid gsum bzhed kyang / /bden med la dgongs de dang de med gsungs/ /stong gzhi bden btags cha dang des stong ba/ /rim bzhin gzhan dbang kun btags yongs grub ste/ /rang dbang min phyir btags phyir gnas lugs phyir/ /sdud po mi gcig mi rtogs theg chen don/ /yod phyir dman mdor chos kyi bdag med min/ /thag 'khyil sbrul 'jigs myugs 'dzin blos bsal bzhin/ /bdag med rtogs pas rmongs 'joms gnas lugs min/ /don dam phyi rol med gsungs sems gcig bu/ /gnas lus sogs gsungs rnam pa'o sems tsam sgras/ /byed po 'gog phyir gzung med mdo don min/ /dbang shes rnam ldan gzung 'dzin rgyu 'bras rim/ /dmag sogs gzhan 'dus btags yod rigs mthun 15

rdul/ /bsags pa'ang rdzas yod re re'ang dmigs rkyen rung / /zla ba gcig brten zla gnyis snang pa sogs/ /phyi rol med na mi skye skur 'debs 'gyur/ /yul snang med phyir yul can rang rig min/ /bden na rigs ngor yod dgos bden grub phyir/ /der yod bden grub mi dgos chos nyid bzhin/ /rigs shes rnyed don yod kyang des dpyad bzod/ /bden par bzod dgos bden grub la dpyad phyir/ /rigs shes dpyad bzod bden grub 'dir dgag bya/ /rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos mthun dpe sga phyir/ /phal cher dgag rtags 'gal zla dmigs 'god dper/ /dbang po yin phyir mig ni don dam par/ /gzugs la mi blta rna dbang bzhin sogs 'god/ /shes byar bden gnyis dam pa zad med blo/ /don ni nges rnyed mi bslu'i phyir bden pa'o/ /sgrib phyir kun rdzob de ngor bden pas gzhan/ /snang ltar don byed nus dang mi nus chos/ /tha snyad bden phyir kun rdzob yang log dbye/ /dang po dngos rnams gnyis pa gzugs brnyan sorga/sa/ /mngon rjes gnyis dang mngon sum gsum bzhi rim/ /rigs nges sgrib gnyis zad dang rdzogs byang mnyam/ /sku gsum gsang gsum ma 'dres sum brgya so gas/ /dus/ gsum nyon sgrib shes grib bden 'dzin skor/ /nyan rang lam mthun khyad par dus 'bras kyis/ /rang rgyud dzi/ nyiṭar par rnam bden rdzun mthun gnyis/ /dang po zhi 'tsho yab sras nam pa dngos/ /gnyis pa rnam pa dngos med seng ge bzang / /rnam rdzum dri bcas dang mthun dze tā ri/ /rnam rdzun dri med dang mthun kaspa la/ / 'bum sogs nges don don dam ma sbyar mdo/ /gnyis par mchungs kyang 16

drang don dgongs 'grel 'u/gas/ /mtsham/ nyid gsurnga / gyi tshu'/ 'dra phyi don med/ /rgyan stug dgongs 'grel lang gshegs mdo sogs don/ /gtso phal cha gnyis rim bzhin dbu sems lugs/ /gnod med blo'i snang bzhag min dgag byar mthun/ /lang gshegs yab sras mjal ba las gsungs phyir/ /phal cher 'brel zla ma dmigs rtags 'god dper/ /bden pa'i gcig dang du ma dang bral phyir/ /gzugs sogs bden med gzugs brnyan bzhin bden na/ /gnyis po der nges khyab grub phyogs chos/ de'i/ /gcig min cha bcas du min gcig med phyir/ /rdo rje gzegs ma yod med skye 'gog dang / /mu bzhi skye 'gog rten 'brel rtags rnams/ gtso/ /gang zag bdag med bden gnyis rnam bzhag mthun/ /shes sgrib phra rags bden 'dzin gzung 'dzin sogs/ /bden rnam bcu drug gnyis stong bden med rnams/ /nyan rang theg chen lam gyi rtogs rigs khyad/ /mthong sgom mnyam rjes khyad par gnyis ka mthun/ zhes dngos po bden grub kyi mtha' rnams bsal nas dbu mar sgrub pa rang rgyud kyi skabs te bcu gcig pa'o/ /༈rang rgyud mi bzhed phyi rgol khas blangs la/ /'gal brjod thadze+e'agyur gtso phyir thal 'gyur ba/ /thal 'gyur snang tsam mi gnas dbu mar grags/ /dbye ba phyi mo phyogs 'dzin mi 'dzin gsum/ /gzhung ni zab mdo rigs tshogs bzhi brgya ba/ /spyod 'jug mdo btus gnyis dang lam sgron sogs/ /bden pa gnyis ston mdo rim drang nges te/ /gzhan du drang dgos gnas tshul der nges phyir/ /sgras zina'ang mi rung drang dang 17

sgras zin don/ /grub kyang gnas lugs min pas drang tshul gnyis/ /tho ga mtha' drang don bar ba nges don mdo/ /lang gshegs dgongs 'gril rgyan stug mdo tshan lngas/ /byed po gzhan med stong nyid la dgongs nas / /sems tsam phyi don med dang snying po rtag /kun gzhi yod dang gzhan dbang yongs grub bden/ /mthar thug theg gsum ston lnga drang don bsgrub/ /'khor 'das snang grags ji lta ji snyed kun/ /ma brtags lhan skyes 'jig rten tha snyad du/ /'jog phyir rtog pas phar min yul steng nas/ /grub dang rdzas yod rang mtshan rang ngos grub/ /bden grub ngo bos grub sogs dgag byar gcig /rang ngos med dang ming rtog phar btags 'dir/ /bya byed kun 'jog mtha' bral dbu ma ste/ /'di las rags phra gang byas rtag chad mtha'/ /gang zag chos steng bdag gnyis der med gnyis/ /bdag med gnyis bzhed chos bdag rdo rje yi/ /gzegs ma la sogs bzhis 'gog gang zag bdag /lnga bdun gyis 'gog gnyis ka'ang rten 'brel gyis/ /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis dang rgyu med las/ /skye ba min phyir rang bzhin skye ba med/ /bdag 'a sa skye na don med thug med 'gyur/ /gang de de min rgyu 'bras rtag mthong 'gyur/ /'jig rten ma thong 'gal bya byed kun gcig 'gyur/ /gzhan las skye na me las mun 'byung zhing / /rgyu dang rgyu min kun las kun 'byung 'gyur—/ /gzhan phyir rgyud gcig mi rung pre+o/ nas bzhin/ /dus mnyam de med gzhan las gzhan skye ci/ /snga phyi— gzhan 'gog ldog phung gceg sogs 'khrul/ /mtha' bzhi mi 'dod gzhan skye 'jig rten du'ang / /med par bshad phyir 18

'dir 'dod spyon pa'i gar/ /bdag gzhan re re'i min phyir gnyis skye'ang khegs / /rgyu med skye na 'bad pa don med cing / /mthong dang 'gal la kun las kun skye'ang 'gyur/ /gzhan las skye na yod med gnyis min grang / /yod la ci dgos med la bya byed bral/ /gnyis yin des bsal gnyis bral la des ci/ /dngos po bden par rgyu yis bskyed min te/ /sa/cig gis gcig min du mas gcig mi skyed/ /gcig gis du min du mas du ma'ang min/ /gcig ji/sa bang/cig bskyed bsgrub phyir gzhan rung phyi ra/ /'dir ni dgag bya'i khyad par mi sbyor 'khrul/ /rten 'byung min pa'i chos ni 'dir med la/ /ten 'byung phrad ltos brten nas grub tsam phyir/ /chos kun tshugs thub rang ngos grub rnams min/ /zab rgyas mtha' gnyis sel 'di rigs pa'i rgyal/ /de phyir don dam tshugari shrī thub nam mkha' za/ /sus kyang tshad grub tshugs thub don ma byas/ /rang dbang bdag med phung min de gzhan min/ /phung po'i rten mi na phung por brten pa'ang min/ /phung dang mi ldan dbyibs min tshopo/sa min phyir/ /shing rta bzhin te chos rnams kun la sbya ra/ /skabs 'gar tshul gsum mthun snang tshad grub dang / /rtags tsamyo/ bzhed kyang rang dbang tshad min phyir/ /rang rgyud mi 'dod lugs 'dir rang rgyud 'khrul/ /da bye gzhi shes byar dbye ngo bden pa ga/nyis/ /mang min nyung na mi 'du de ra grangs nges/ /gnas lugs mi rung ku na gyis mngon sogs phyir/ /bden sa/nyis ngo bo dbyer med ldog pas 'byed/ /mtshan nyid rigs shes tha snyad blo gang la/ /don dam tha snyad dpyod song des rnyed rim/ /don dang dam 19

pa'ang bden phyir don dam bden/ /sgrib phyir kun rdzob ngor bden kunangardzob bden/ /don dam dbye ba gnyis bzhi bcu drug sogs/ /skye 'phags blo gnyis yul bcas rnam grangs gzhan/ /dbu ma rang lugs kun rdzob yang log min/ /'jig rten shes ngor mi dang gzugs brnyan sogos/ /bdesadang mi bden yang dag log pa tsam/ /tha snyad rigs shis sngon grogs thabasathabs byung / /dgos pa lta kun bzlog dang spang blang phyir/ /gnas skabs gsum par stong min spros bral 'khrul/ /dang por las 'bras sogs kyis bsod min bzlog /bar du mi rtag sogs kyis bdag gnyis bzlog /tha mar de nyid mngon du gyur rim gyis/ /lta kun dri bcas 'joms par mdo sngags bzhed/ /sgom rim lnga yod mkhas pa'i gsung la ltos/ /stong nyid ji bzhin tha snyad 'jog mtshams dka'/ /bden gnyis gang las nyams phung mthar ltung phyir/ /'di gnyis nye ring mi rigs zung 'brel gces/ /mtshan nyid gsum mtshungs rang bzhin gzhan dbang la/ /byis par kun btags rgyal la yongs grub bzhed/ /rang mtshan tha snyad du yang mi bzhed phyir/ /khyad par thun mong min pa brgyad sogs mang / /tha snyad dpyod blos mi khegs mi 'grub phyir/ /phyi don yod dang kun gzhi med par bzhed/ /dngos 'dzin thar min de nyon bdag med mtshungs/ /ma bslad med dang gsar rtogs mi rung phyir/ /byis shes kun 'khrul bcadagashes tshad mar grub/ /tshor ba yid mngon bcu drug mngon gyur kyang / /'phags pa min phyir rtog pa'i yid mngon dang / /bden rnam bcu drug mngon gyur so skye bzhed/ /stong la lhag mthong sbyor lam dus mnyam dang / /20

zhig pa dngos phyi ra bcu drug mngon sum gyis/ /sbyor lama'ang mi sleb dus gsum dngos por bzhed/ /bskyed phyir zhig dngos las 'gag mang song yang / /thob rgyun chud mi za meda'ang 'brardog bu 'byin/ /zhig dngos smras tsam dpyad min bum dngos bzhin/ /dus song ngag rtsub ma zhig lhan skyes la/ /snang na sngon —byas mtha' dag mi dran ci/ /ma dpyad min phyir rang rgyud rang rig min/ /ltos tshe mngon sum yul yim/ yul can min/ /'gog bden chos dbyings 'phags rnams bden med gzigs / /phung zad mi rung tshor 'du 'jig bshad phyir/ /lhag bcas lhag med 'khrul snang zad ma zad/ /bag chags shes sgrib nyon mid+ngha sne ma riga'ang bzhed/ /nyon mongs ma zad shes sgrib spong mi rtsom/ /snang bas yod mtha' stong bas med mtha' sel/ /de sogs thun mong min mang dbu mar ltos/ /mngon rjes nyer 'jal lung gi tshad ma bzhir/ /b.rishid spyang gzhal bya'i dbang gis mngon rjes gnyis/ /rtags min 'dzin stangs yul gyur mngon sum par/ slu med shes pa mngon sum tshad mar sa zhed/ /dbye ngo dbang mngon yid mngon rnal 'byor mngon/ /rtags brten lkog yul slu med rjes dpag ste/ /lkog gyur dpe dang shin tu lkog 'jal ba'i/ /rjes dpag nyer 'jal lung gi tshad mar bzhed/ /'dzin stangs yul la spes 'dren der tshad ma/ /gzhan gyis gnod bral de la mi slu'i phyir/ /'khrul yang tshad mar mi 'gal mi slu 'i don/ /skabs stobs mang bshad kun rdzob la yang bshad/ /de phyir rdzas kyi sgra bzhin gcig la min/ /mngon mtho nges legs sgrub byed dadi shes gnyis/ /shes rab sngon 'akro dad pas 21ci

snod rung byed/ /shes rab grol rgyu mi rtog don sgrub phyir/ /dmana'abring mchog gi skyes bu'i lam rim du/ /chos tshul kun 'dus don gnyis las brtsams phyir/ /'bring las nyan rang gnyis dang de dag lam/ /chen por theg theg pa bzhi min 'dir/ /nyan rang rtogs mthun sa brgyad dus 'bras dbye/ /rtsa brtan be+ems bskyed phar phyin yal ga rgyas/ /tshogs sbyor yon tan rtags sgom ngo bos 'byed/ /sa bcu mnyam bzhag dbyer med sbyor rjes kyi/ /yon tan mdzad sogs bcu gnyis gong nas tho/nga / /re re'ang nges tshig dbye ba yon tan rten/ /rnam smin ltas gnyis spang gnyen brgyad kyis bshad/ /'bras bu mnyam rjes res min ngo bo gcig /sems kyi rgyu ba rnam rtog kun zhi bas/ /gnas brtan bzhengs min rjes thob bya ba'ang mdzad/ /chos dbyings gzigs ngor spros pa kun log kyang / /ma btags ji snyed skyu ru ra bzhin mkhyen/ /sku gcig sku gnyis gsum bzhi lngar bzhed phyir/ /thub la rgya che mi mnga' gzhan ngor 'khrul/ /glo bur rang bzhin rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /ye shes chos sku sde tshan nyer gcig sogs/ /lnga ldan snang ba mi sdud longs spyod rdzogs/ /bzo dang skye ba byang chub sprul sku gsum/ /snyan 'jeb drug cu'i dbyangs kyis mkha' kun 'gengs / /gsang gsum rol ba kun khyab skal bas mthong / /skad cig bskal bar bzlog dang ba spu rer/ /brtan g.yordzobakod kyang mkha' bzhin che chung min/ /stobs bcu gzhan dang ma 'dres bco brgyad sogs/ /rmad byung yon tan ma lus rgyal rnams kyis/ / brjod la zhugs kyang mi rdzogs mkha'i mtha' bzhin/ /gang 'dul lhun 22

grub 'phrin las rtag tu ston/ zhes mtha' kun bsal te dbu ma chen por sgrub pa thal 'gyur ba'i skabs te bcu gnyis pa'o/ /༈mdo sngags gnyis kas nyon sgrib kun zad nus/ /yul mchog bstan kyang yul can mchog sbas bzhin/ /dri gtso bstan kyang gnyen po ca/chog sbas phyir/ /shes sgrib chung phra sngags las mdos mi nus/ /de phyir spang gnyen sbas pa mgo mtshungs 'khrul/ /thabs zab mang phyir lam ‘ra'ang myur bul che/ /lus ngag yid gsum rags phra shin tu phra/ /sbya ngas phyir theg dang mdo rgyud gong nas gong / /'og mar gzhan gnyis bshad kyang gsum pa ni/ /dgongs gzhir rung yang mdo rgyud 'og mar min/ /bla med spyi dang rgyud rgyal dag na gsal/ /skal ldan grub dbang bye bas rtser gshegs shul/ /dus gsurma rgyal ba'i gsang lam mchog tu grub/ /ces mdo sngags kyi khyad par phye nas gsang chen mchog tu sgrub pa'i skabs te bcu gsum pa'o/ // —'dir smras pa/ 'jam mgon mkhyen gzi las 'ongs k+ṣ-isprukhrul mun bral/ /dbyangs can lha mos smras bzhin snyan 'jeb 'grigs/ /thub dbang gsung bzhin thog mtha' bar du'ang dge /'dzam gling rgyan mchog lugs kun 'dus bzhin brling / /'ga' zhig ma bslab long bas mthar bgrod 'dod/ /la la blo dman byi bas glang khur len/ /phal tshar spyangs tsam ri phran btegs pas snyems/ /thub bstan nor 'dzin kun 'derwa/sa kurma su/ /mkhas 'a sa ches mkhas 'phags bod mang pos kyang / /thugs ngor zab rgyas thag mkhan rkang pa bzhin/ /res kyis ma bde snang stong 23

thung 'brel lam/ /ma rnyed lung rigs 'khar bas ci yang btsal rngong gzhan mkhas mang klu dbang stong gis rol/ /phan dang bde ba'i rin chen 'phyur bus gang / /dgag sgrub rlabs 'khrug grub mtha'i mtshor bgrodangaslad/ /ded dpon mkhas rnams/ gru'angs ci yang 'dzug /rigs pa'i glu rdzings dman 'khrul dang po'i rgyud/ /brdungs khari sa tshul zhig 'gas kyang grub mtha'i mtshor/ /phyin snyems dregs skyungs lugs gnyi sa kun mthong phyir/ /grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol kho bos phyen/ /blo bzang mes byin rang lugs lam gsum 'babs/ /rnam dpyod lha chen ral 'ongs rtog ge yis/ /bshung bslad nor lha 'i rkang dri bkrus chab kyis/ /rmongs 'khrul dug can rgyu tshogs dag gyur cig /rin chen khur lci mtsho chen ska rags g.yo/ /nyi zla'i sgron 'degs zun po gnas de srid/ /'dis kyang gsar bshad khur lci grags snyan g.yo/ /legs bshad sgron mes sa gsum snang byed shog /chos dbyings gshis dang dpo/na mchog gsum gyi mthus/ /'gro rnams rdzu 'phrul bzhin du sa rim bgrod/ /nya rgyas zla ltar yon tan kun rdzogs nas/ /nyi ma brgyas gsal kun mkhyen myur thob shog /ces grub pa'i mtha' rnam par bzhag pa 'a/khrul spo nga sa/rdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bzang gsal ba'i rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snga mo nas mang thos gser spa/ nga chos rje ga ṇa ma tis snyan tshig me tog gsar b.ru/ bskul zhing / dus phyis yongs kyi bshes gnyen chen po mkhas mchog/ lcang rwa slob dpon pa 'phags pa rin chen gyis khams chapa/ mdo nas ja g.yu kha btags kyi rten bcas chab shog tshigs su bcad 24

pa'i rnyo/ nas/ stag lo'i dgag lan 'byams rgyas dgos zhes bskul ba'i bka' ngo dang / khyad par rang blo goms pa'i slad du mkhan chen rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag po rin po che las sdom gsum sogs chos kyi bka' drin thob cing / 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin po che rngu /ba sras bzhi dang / paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba/ rdo rje 'chang smin grol chos kyi rgyal po/ sra da rdo rje 'chang / sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang blo gros sogs dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing rje bla ma'i mdo sngags rnams la nges shes rnyed cing / 'phags bod kyi grub mtha'i gzhung dang / khyad par sher sgron/tshad chen rtsa 'grel/ dus 'khor sogs gzhung lugs chen po rnams la brten gsung rab dang grub mtha' rab 'byams smra ba7'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes tshig nyung don gsal rgyas 'dril du/ dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i nyin/gangs can gyi bya rgod phung bo gnyis pa/ dpa' bo mkha'i 'gro'i 'du gnas ri bo dge 'phel gyi gar 'dug theg mchog rol mtsho gsang sngags bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas sbyar ba la/ slar yang phri sdon cung zad byas pa 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /maṅga lo// // 25

grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u dang po spyo bshad/naca/ sgar swas+t+ya/ bla ma dang lhas/ pa'i lha rje btsun mkhyen pa'i rgater dka ra ser rnam gsu/ma dbyer med pa'i zhabs/ la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /thugs rje gzhan las phul gyur rgyal ba kun gyis pad dkar ltar bsngags nyi ma'i gnyen/ /gtsor gyur sangs rgyas kun dang 'gro ba'i skyabs dngos spangs rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /mchog zung ponatad rabs bdun dang rgyal sras brgyad sogs theg gsum dge 'dun sde/ /phun tshogs ma lus 'byung gnas mchog gsum dbang gi rgyal po dus kun gtsug na mdzes/ /rab mdzes rin chen lhun por rgyu skar batre+o//da ltar mtshan dpes rab spras mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i sku/ /rab snyan glu dbyangs ma lus phang 'gro'i dbyangs su 'gug ltar gsung dbyangs re la'ang yan lag drug cus spras/ /rab yangs mkha' la snod bcud kun bzhin dmigs bral thugs la ma lus chos kun ches bkra ba'i/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba yongs kyi yab gcig 'jam mgon gnyis kye byang chub bar du snyi nga dbus bzhugs/ /mang mang rgyal kun bskyed yum dbyangs can kye// /dung dung snying nas dad pa 'di dgongs la/ /myur myur byon nas mgrin pa'i 'o ma tsho ru/ /'grig 'grig snyan 'gyur legs bshad glur longs shig /thub bstan bdag po rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /lngadzha26

brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo bo yab sras sogs/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa'i/ /rgya bod ded dpon mchog rnams 'gro ba'i mig /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab kun 'dus blo gter nyi ma brgya las ches gsal mkhas/ /byams brtse lhag bsam bzang pos mtshan snyan tsam gyis 'gro 'dren rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /phyogs bcur thub bstan rgyas par mdzad pa'i grags dkar gdugs mdzes sri da zhi'i gtsug na 'khor/ /rgyal dbang tog gi spyan sngar smon bzhin legs grub rgyal ba gnyis pa snying dbus bzhugs/ /kun mkhyen rgyal tshab 'dzam gling mkhas grub kyi/ /gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen dge legs dpal la sogs/ /sras mchog rnams dang 'khrungs rabs nyin byed kyi/ /bstan 'di'i pad tshal bzhad rnams skye dgu'i mgon/ /mkhyen brtse nus par srid zhi'i khams na mtshungs pa ma rnyed rgyal ba kun gyi tog /'chad rtsod rtsom la dbyangs can mkhyen gter la sogs gcig tu byas na'ang dper dka' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang gzugs phyag na pad+ma blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po che/ /sprul pa'i rabs bcas zhabs sen lha mi'i gtsug rgyan khyod la snying nas 'dud/ /phyogs res spros min lung rtogs thub pa'i bstan/ /rdzogs par 'grel zhi nga rang blo'i kun gsal mar/ /chos kun snang byed rgyal bstan bcu gnyis bdag /su ma cu las lhag bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs dngos/ /rgya bod dran dbang bye ba'i lung rigs kyi/ /rlabs phreng mang dkrigs phyi nang grub mtha'i mtsho'i/ /mthar son legs bshad dbang rgyal bshad sgrub kyi/ /rgyal mtshan rtser sten dgos 'dod char 'bebs sbyin/ /la la nges bral 27

zer sgros bsgrigs dang gzhan dag tshig don gnyis ka dman/ /kha cig tshig 'grig don 'khrul gyur dang phal cher mkhas kyang skabs 'gar 'khyams/ /de sogs mkhas blun 'khyog po'i lugs mang rīmāthong tshe tshul 'dir ma lus par/ /gsal byed nyi 'od 'phro ba'i rgyu brgyas 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa spro bar gyur / /de la 'dir shing rta chen po klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ rgya mtsho gcika gnas gnya' shing bu ga dang / /rus sbal mgrin phrad pas kyang ngan 'gro las/ /mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis/ /dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /ces dang / rje bla mas kyang / dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da re tsam zhig yin/ /rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /tshul 'di bsam nas 'jig rten bya ba kun/ /sbun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor khyab par can rang gzhan gyi don gang sgrub na'ang 'ong ba 'di rnyed dus/ dud ragro dang 'jig rten phal ba'i bya ba tsam las khyad ma byung na/ rten khyad par can thob pa'i snying po ma lon pa yin cing / yid bzhin gyi nor bu zan kham gcig dang brjes pa lta bu yin pas/ de ltar ma song bar snying po zhig len dgos shing / de yang 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi don la zhugs pa zhig dgos la/ de yang shes rab brgya pa las/ mthong dang ma mthong yon tan 'di/ /kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab yin/ /de ltar gnyis ka sgrub pa'i phyir/ /dang por 'bad de shes rab bskyed/ ces 28

gsungs pa ltar darngas su mthong ba dang ma mthong ba'i yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba shes rab yin pas de bskyed dgos te/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas/ /bcom ldan khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod/ /skyon mi mnga' la yon tan ldan/zhes dang / lha las phul byung gi bstod par/ bdag ni sangs rgyas phyogs mi 'dzin/ / ser skya sogs la mi sdang yang / /gang zhig rigs par ldan pa'i tshig /de nyid ston par yongs su 'dzin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i skyon yon rig pa'ang shes rab la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /de la rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i khyad par shes dgos te/ de ma shes na de'i skyon yon 'di zhes mi shes pa'i phyir te/ mchod sbyin dang lhas sbyin gyi khyad par ma shes par de gnyis kyi bzang ngan mi shes pa bzhin no/ /de'i phyir lang gshegs las/ blo gros chen po de ltar grub pa'i mtha'i tshul dang / bstan pa'i mtshan nyid la khyod dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan dag gis brtson par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas 'dir rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'i rnam bzhag 'chad pa la klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don gsum/ dang po la/ mchod brjod dang / nyan par bskul zhing rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gser 'od las/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha mo dbyangs can ma chen mo bdag gis kyang dge slong chos smra ba de'i tshig brgyan pa'i slad du slob pa nye bar bsgrub par bgyi/ gzungs kyang stsal par bgyi/ sogs dang bram ze shangs kus/ dri za'i bu mo mngon bstod nyid kyi rnam thar phul byung rnams/ /29

gang gi yid la dran byed de la ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ zhes dang / mkhas grub chen po argyas kyang snyan dngarga/sa rgyal po 'khor lo 'di/ /de don lo phyed brten nas 'phel/ /rten byed rta dbyangs dang mtshungs par/ yustomi ring bar ster bar byed ces dang / grub dbang dge slo nga yid kyi shing rtas kyang / klag pa tsam gyis de'i 'bras bu/ /gzhung ni brgya rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'dod na nyin re zhing / /shu lo ka ni brgya rnamyo/sa rtsom/ zhes bsngags brjod chen po du ma bshad pa ltar/ ngag gi dngos grub stsol nga 'i ched du chos smra ba pos rang gi lhag pa'i lha lha mo dbyangasdosdo can ma la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na ma grwar swa snri zhes pa'o/ /don ni na maḥphyag 'tshal swa raḥdabyangs ba tī ldan ma la bar rkyen sa ka ma byin par rnam dbye bzhi ba de byin te mtshams sbyar bas/ na masnyar swabh+yo zhes pa 'grub ste/ 'di'i gzungs sngags mang po 'a/sa kyang de ltar byung la/ yang ra/ ka byin na swa — ni swas+t+ya 'grub bo/ lha mo 'di'i ngo bo ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ yumyori sher phyin ma yin la/ rnam pa ni sna tshogs su ston te/ rgyal ba gong ma'i gsung las/ tsa mu r+bhe sogs ming brgya mtshan stong ma/ zhes gsungs pa ltar tshangs ma khyab 'jug ma dbang mo gshin rje'i lcam tsa muṇ+ḍi dri za dam bu ra'i chung ma dbyangs can ma lha klu gnod sbyi na sogs 'jig ten pa du ma'i rnam pa dang / sangs rgyas byang sems skyes bu zung bzhi dkyil 'a/wor gyi 'khor la sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa mtha' yas pa'i rnam pa ston cing / gnas kyang mtsho 'gram brag ri ri phug sogs sna tshogs la gnas nas gdul bya thams cad kyi don thams cad sgrub par bshad pa'i phyir te/30

kaudi nus gshin rje'i sring mor lus ston cing / /rtag tu dar goru / sngo ma/ po bsnams/ /mdzes dang mi mdzes lus ston cing / zhes pa nas / 'jig rten mthun paṭā gzugs ston cing / /zhes dang / yang de nyid kyis/ phyag 'tshal bstsam ldan dbyangs can mchog /zung bzhi ya brgyad dbyangs can mchog /nas/ ha ri tshig 'chang dbyangs can mchu+og /ma mo kun mchog dbyangs can mchog /tshogs bdag lha mo dbyangs can mchog /gnod sbyin kun kyang dbyangs can mchog /ces dang / gnas kyang slob dpon kau di nur+sā / /bar 'ga' ri dang brag la gnas// /bar 'aspashe' phug dang chu bo'i 'gram/ /nas/ /rtag tu lha mo de mchod na/ /thams cad dus su 'jig rten skyong / zhes dang / sems can gang dag ci 'dod pa/ /de kun bas ma pa myur du skongs/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/rmongs zhen gyis bstod pa dang mi 'dra la/ dkon mchog tā lar 'jig rten pa ra bshad pa yang des shes par gyis/de nas gdul bya'i khams bzhin gsang gsum brtan g.yo'i gar/ /rab bsgyur mtha' yas zab rgyas chos kyi sgo/ /myo/nga phye rten 'byung gtam gyis kun mkhyen lam/ /ston mdzad shāka seng ba rgyud par bcas phyag 'tshal/ zhes sho lo ka gcig gis ston pa 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal te/'di ni mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍis/ shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni/ /nges par bstan pa'ang de yi sgo/ /zhes bstan bcoru/ rtsom pa la sbo/ lta bu ni shis brjod dang / phyag dang / dngos po nges bstan sa/sum gang rung byaṭatrī nas 'jug par bshad pa las/ 'dir phyag 'tshal ba gtso bor byas la shis 31

brjod dang dngos po nges bstan du'ang don gyis 'gro ste/ srustan bcos kyi lus dang mthun par rang gi ston pa'i khyad par dang / bstan pa dang gzhi lam 'bras gsum kun tshang bar bstan pa'i sgo nas bston cing / shugs la 'gro ba kun la'ang khyod lta bu'i dngos po de mdzod cig ces 'dod don zhu zhingacide shis brjod du song bas so/ /dngos su mi gsal yang bsam pas 'grub pa mang lte/ dpal chos kyi grags pas/ ma ba rjod na yang 'dod pas khyab/ ces gsungs pas so/ /dngos po nges bstan la lus yin min gnyis yod pas/ de yin kyang bstan bcos kyi lus mdor bstan min pas skabs/ su ma babs par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /dgos pa ni/ 'grel ba don gsal las/ 'phags pa byams pa rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthum/ par rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs ltar skyes bu dam pa'i mdzad pa dang / mthun pa dang / lha las phul byung gi bstod par/ snying nas dad dmyo/ ji ltar dga' ba dang / /the tshom gyis/ sam gzhan gyi ngor yang rung / /gang zhig thub dbang la ni phyag byed pa/ /des ni lha yi bde sogs phul byung thob/ /ces dang / mdo las/ skyabs/ song bsod nams/ gzugs yod na/ /stong gsum 'di yang snod du chung / zhes gsungs pa ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa'i ched dang /rgya chen rol pa las/ bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni myur du byang chub mchog reg 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom pa la bsnyen bkur byas pas smon pa dang bsam pa grub pa'i lo rgyus dang / mu stegs rlung zhagasardzo 32

grub pas sangs rgyadī 'khor bcas kyi yon tan gang yang mi shes kyang / dge slong gi chos gos kyi tshal bu ske la bzung bas/ gnon sbyin 'byung bo du mas gtse ma nus par bshad pa ltar/ chos mthun gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bsam pa 'grub cing / bar chad mi 'byung ba'i dgos pa sogs shin tu mang ste/ 'di dag la tshig tsam ma yin par go ba legs par chags nas lan re dad na'ang phan yon mtha' klas te/ mtshan tsam brjod pa'i phan yon de snyed re bshad pas so/ /ji skad du sangs rgyas thams5 cad kyi yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab par 'jug pa'i mdo las/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba yang rung ste gnod sems kyi sems dang ldan pa 'am/ dad pa'i sems dang ldan pa'ang rung / gang dag gis de la sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'am/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po zhes bya ba'am/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i sgra thos pa de dag dge ba'i rna ba'i dbang po rnam par dag par 'gyur/ zhes dang /yang mdo de nyid las/ 'jam dpal sems can rnams kyiṭa4 de bzhin gshegs pa la dmigs pa yid la byed pa ji snyed 'byung ba de snyed kyi bskal par sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags dang / gatri/na rje'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i rgyun chad cing ldog ste/ 'jam dpal de ltar de bzhin gshe5sa pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la dmigs pa'i yon tan gyi mtha' yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sa/nas pa 33

rnacha/sa kyis kyang bskal ba bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dpag tu med pa dag gis kyang rtogs par mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yang yid la byed pa don chen por zungs shig /de la re zhig rgyal ba rnams kyis dang por thugs bskyed pa dang / badz+ra du bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab par tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang / mthar sangs rgyas pa thams cad gdul bya'i don kho na yin la/ gdul bya de rnams kyang khams dang bsam pa sna tshogs pa yin pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa gcig tho/ na rtag tu bstan kyang thul bar mi nus la/ gdul bya rang rang gi khams dang /bsam pa de dag dang bstun nas sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid tshul yang tsho dgongs nas/ sngon byang sems kyi dus nas chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpas sems can gang dang gang gi gzugs dang / kha dog dang spyod lam ji lta bu gang dang gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba de dang de lta bu'i gzugs dang / kha dog dang spyod lam gyis 'dul bar gyur cig /ces smon lam btab nas/ de sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba rnam/sa ni sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis 'dul te/ smon lam de las byung bas smon lam gyis sangs rgyas shes bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar smon lam gyi dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum 'grub pa yin te/ gsum gyi khyad par la sku'i gsang ba ni/ gdul bya rang rang gi skal ba bzhin ma thong ba yin te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dang ye shes kyi yul la 'jug pa las/ 'jam dpal kha dog dang / spyod r+ṣa/ma dang / dbyibs gang dang gang kho nas sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ba 'jam dpal 34

di bzhin gshegs pa kha dog dang / spyo da lam dang / dbyibs de dang de kho na sems can rnams kyis mthong ngo / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin cing /gdul byas sku'i kha dog mthong tshul yang du mar snang ba ni/ mdo de las/'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi kha dog tu mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che baiḍūr+ya'i kha dog tu/kha cig gis ni nor bu rin po che an rnyil gyi kha dog tu/ zhes sogs kyis kha dog sna tshogs su mthong bar bshad cing / dbyibs dang sku tshad kyang tha dad par snang tshul ni/ mdo de nyid las/ 'jam dpal 'khor 'di nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'dom do tsam 'phags par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni rgyang grags tsam du 'phags/ kha cig gis mi rgyang grags gnyis tsam du 'phags/ kha cig gis ni sku dpag tshad tsam du 'phags par shes so/ zhes sogs dang / spyod lam sna tshogs par snang tshul yang de nyid las/ 'jam dpal spyod pa gang dang gang gis sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la 'dzud cing 'dul bar gyur pa'i spyod pa de dang de la de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par sems can rnams kyis shes so/ zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'di la 'khor 'di nyid kyi nang na kha cig gis ni rab tu byung bar mngon par phyogs shing khyim nas mngon par 'byung bar shes so/ kha cig gis ni rab tu byung zhing dka' ba mngon par spyod par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi snying po la gshegs par shes so/ zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /gsung gi gsang ba yang / gsung gcig nyid du gsung mod kyi/ /du ma nyid du so 35

sor go /zhes pa ltar gdul bya rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par thos kyang rnam rtog gis mi g.yo ba gcig yin te/ mdo las/ 'jam dpal chos bsta na pa gang dang gang gis sems can rnams yongs su smin par —'gyur ba'i chos de dang de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa ston par sems can skyirnams kyis shes so/ zhes dang / kha cig gis ni bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sbyin pa'i gtam ston par shes so/ /'khor de nyid kyi nang nas kha cig gis ni bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la tshul khrims kyi gtam ston par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni bzod pa'i gtam/ kha cig gis ni brtson 'aspus kyi gtam/ zhes sogs kyis chos sna tshogs pa ston pa shes tshul bshad do/ /thugs kyi gsang ba rnam rtog thams cad zhi nas kun slong gi rtog pha mi dgos par mdzad pa lhun grub tu ston pa yin te/ mdo de nyid las/'jam dpal spyod pa gang gis sems can de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i — bstan pa la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i spyod pa de dang de la de bzhin gshegs —pa bzhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa thams cad lhun gyis grub cing / rnam pa ra mi rtog par 'gyur ro/ zhes pa nas/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad skye zhing 'phel te shin tu rgyas pa nyid du 'gyur yang / de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog rnam par mi rtog ste/ 'on kyang lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi rtog par de mdzad pa de lta bu de 'byung ngo / zhes sogs so/ /der ma zad brtan pa snod dang / g.yo ba bcud kyi 'gro ba ni tshogs su sgyu 'phrul gyi rol gar gang lī36

gang 'dul du rab tu mtha' yas par bsgyur ba cig yin te/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ nam sems can rnams sangs rgyas/ kyi zhing rgya chen pos 'dul bar gyur pa de na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ 'jam pa ka mya li na di ka ltar reg na bde ba baizur+ya sngon por gyur pa/ shel rab tu gyur pa tsan dan sbrul gyi snying por gyur pa de 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser du gyur pa/ rdo dang gseg ma dang gyo mo med pa mtho dman med pa ngan song log par ltung ba med pa bud med rgyu ba med pa ri nag po med pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa tsher ma dang ngam grog dang g.yang sa med pa rin po che'i shing ljon pa dang /spos kyi shing sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa sprul nas// /sems can de dag yongs su smin par byed do/ zhes gsung ba lta bu snod kyi ri gling ljon pa dang bcas pa dang / yang de nyid las/ nam rajig rten na 'khor longabasgyur ba'i rgyal po gtso bor byed cing / tshul khrims yang dag par 'dzin pa dang / spyod pa tha /tso bor byed pa de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'kho ra lo bsgyur ba'i bkod pa rnams sprul nas sems can gyi don byed do/ /zheṭashaṃ sogs kyis/ de bzhin du tshangs pa brgya byin nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas gang la 'jig rten dga' ba de na byang sems sprul nas sems can gyi don byed par bshad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na'ang rje rin po che'i legs bshad snying po chung ba las/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang ni/ 'di nyid yin phyir mkhas/ pa yis/ 'di las sangs rgyas rjes dran byos/ zhes ma dzad pa 37

rnams las gsung gi mdzad pa mchog yin pa'i rgyu mtshan tshom las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khru zhing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la 'pho min te/ /chos nyid bdin pa bstan pas grol bar mdzad/ ces gsungs pa ltar yin pas chos nyid ston dgos/ de ston dgos tshul yang / 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las stong ba zhi ba skye ba med pa'i tshul/ /mi shes pas ni 'gro ba 'khyams gyur te/ /de dag thugs rje mnga' bas thabs tshul dang / /rigs pa brgya dag gis ni 'dzug par mdzad/ ces dang / legs bshad snying po chung ba las/ khyod kyis ji snyed bka' stsal ba/ /rten 'brel nyid las brtsam ste 'jug /de yang mya ngan 'da' phyir te/ /zhi gyur min mdzad khyod la med/ ces dang / brgya ba las/ lus la lus dbang ji bzhin du/ /gti mug kun la gnas 'gyur te/ zhes nyon mongs thams cad gti nu/ga la brten pa dang / rten cing sprubrel bar 'byung ba ni/ /mthong bas gti mug 'byung mi 'gyur/ zhes sogs ltar yin cing / 'di la zab rgyas 'chad lugs sogs 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /rten 'brel de rtogs pa'i ched du/ lang gshegs las/ ji srid rnam rtog 'jug gi bar/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ ces gsungs pa ltar sems can gyi rnam rtog gi grangs dang mtshungs par theg pa'am 'khridartsabyed re bshad pa yin la/ de bzhin du dkon mchog sgron me las/ 'gro ba spyod pa'i sgo rnams ji snyed pa/ /de snyed tshas kyi sgo la rab zhugs te/ /ni dag kun tu rnam thar sgo dag nas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig rten sems can 'dul/ zhes 'gro 38

ba'i nyon mongs la spyod pa'i sgo ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi chos kyi sgo phye nas ma'akhrid par gsungs la/ de yang nyon mongs kyi spyod pa sna re'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi tho/nyen po cha tshang ba re bsdoms pa chos phung dang / de'i gnyen po dper na zhe sdang shas cher spyad pa'i gnyen por thog mar byamasaci pas de gzhil ba'i sgo gtod nas 'khrid pa la byams pari sgo btod par bshad pa lta bu'i tshul yin pas/ chos phung dang chos kyi sgo don 'dra la/chos phung gi 'dod tshul gzhan rnams ni sgro btags pa yin cing / /grangs yang brgyad khri las mi 'dod pa sogs byung yang / mdo las chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes re mang 'byung la/ nyon mongs kyi spyod pa re'i gnyen po ston dgos pa'i phyir brgyad khri bzhi stong ngam stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir nges te/ mdo sngags du ma'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par sa/sungs/zhes dang / klu sgrub zhabs kyi rim lngar/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ni/ / thub pa chen pos gsungs pa las/ /zhes dang / lha rma bzhis zhus kyi/ rgyud las/ thub pa chen pos chos phung po/ /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi las/zhes dang / dkon mchog sgron me las/ stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gang yin pas/ /rgyal ba gang dag 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi bye brag sgo mo de dag gis/ /bas/myo/ pa ji bzhin 'jig rten sems can 'dul/zhes dang / nyon mongs kyi spyod pa'i sgo ni/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/'jug pa'i sgo 'a di swo sems can rnamyo/ca5 kyi 'dod chags 'a spyod pa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig ngo/ /sems ri can rnams kyis zhe sdang 'a spyod pa yang stong phrag— 39

nyi shu rtsa gcig go /sems can rnams kyis gti mug la spyod pa yang stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig go /sems can rnams kyis cha mnyam la spyod pa yang stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig ste/ sems can gyi spyod pa stong phrag shārgyad cu rtsa bzhi po de dag gis sems can gyi 'jug pa dang 'bab par shes pa dang /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi sgo mang du phye ste/ rigs pa drug cu ba'i 'grel ba las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rkyen nyid 'di ba bstan pa ni/ bden pa gnyis phyin ci ma log par ma thong ba'i rgyu yin pa nyid kyi phyir/ lam po che 'phags pa'i skye bo mtha' dag gshe gas pa'i rjes su gshegs pa dra’si po zla med pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer 'dus byas thams can yongs su spangs par gcig tu mthar thug pa'o/ /de'i phyir de ston pas ston pa bla na med pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad gshegs pas na kun mkhyen gyi lam po che de ston pas ston pa bla na med pa dang / de mkhyen pas mkhyen pa bla na med pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyis phyi rol pa phas kyi ོ/la ba thams ca sne byis pa bslu ba dang 'dra bar thugs su chud pas 'gro ba long ba lag nom byed pa lta bu la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bstan par slob dpon gyis yang dag par gzigs pas smra ba rnams kyi dam pa zhes gsungs so/ zhes par ltar 'gro ba long ba'i tshogs la lam drang po ston pas smra ba bla na med pa/ dpal ldan zla bas/ gzhan la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba larjod par nus pa med pa'itsho phyir ro/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams 40

dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan— pa nyid las de brjod rta4ra nus pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes pa ltar gzhan sde dang thun mong du ma gyur pa/ thub pa'i dbang po nyag gcig gis gsungs par 'gyur ba de ston par mdzad pa la bskal ba bzang po'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong las gtso bor gyur pa/ pad+ma dkar po lta bur bsngags pardzimanyam med zas gtsang gi sras so/ /'dul ba lung las/ shākya seng ge shākya'i rgyal po shākya'i gtso bo de zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phas kyi rgol ba'i ri dwags tham sa cad bdag med pa'i seng ge'i sgras skrag par ma dzad pa de nyi da dang / bstan pa 'i sa/tad rabs bdun mchog zung sogs thun mong gi dase/ 'dun dang / byams 'jam dbyangs sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i dge 'dun dang / de dag las zang rgyas kyi chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal 'gyed pa'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa la sgo gsum gyi gus pas 'dud pas so/ /de ltar ston pa dang bstan 'dzin rnams la spyir bstod nas/ bye brag tu 'dod pa'i lha mgon po 'jam dbyangs gnyis la lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan gyi sgo nas bstod de shis pa sgrub pa ni/ zla bral mkhyen rab ral gri'i rno dang lhan cig stong ba'i mkhar gdengs mi shes dgra/ /thugs rje'i spyan dang 'dzurma ldan mchu sgros legs bshad lhan cig 'gro la bzhad/ chos mdzod gang bsnams de dang lhan cig rnal 'byor dran par gang de bapred min 'dri/ /rgyal kun yab gcig gnyis kye khyod kyis bdag blo ngag mchog lhan cig rnam bkra mdzod/ ces sho lo ka gcig gis so / /de'i 'og tu sgra ston lha mo la rnam 'gyur gyi dpe dang / srid min gyi dpe gzugs can ri 41

rab brtags rnams bsres pa'i rab spel gyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ 'o mtsho las 'ongs shel dkar lhun pos dbang sngon zur phung ngoms/ /zla rgyas zhal las dkyus ring 'dren byed ut+pal sngon po'i mda'/ /'phangs pas sems rmongs sbrubs grol rnam dpyod ches bkra'i pad+ma 'bum/ /khyod kyi rjes chags mchu dang lhan cig bzhad par mdzod cig tshangs sras ma/ zhes sho lo ka gcig go /'di dag bshad na mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris te/tshig sbyor legs shing go sla bas so/ /de'i 'og tu 'di na mdo sngags zab rgyas nyin mtshan res tsam gyis/ / spyod tshe thub bstan ma lus nyams len rnam sad 'od/ 'byin mdzad blo bzang rgyal ba snga phyi sras bcas sogs /thub dbang zhal skyin rnams la mi gus dpyod ldan su/ zhes pa ni/ rgyal ba'e 'byung gnas rgyal ba rgya mtsho las/ zhes pa ltar/ gangs can rgyal ba yongs kyi 'byung gnas 'brom 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gsung las/ bod 'dir sngags la brten nas 'dul ba ca 'byid 'dul ba la brten nas sngags ca 'byid gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sngags gnyis/ nyin mtshan ltar gang zag gcig la dus gcig tu 'ong ba lta ci/ yul gru gcig la'ang dus gcig mi 'ong la/ de bzhin du zab mo'i lta bar rlom nga/'i rnam rtog 'gog pa'i lta ba dang / byang chub sems sbyongs sogs rgya che ba'i lam ya nga nyin mtshan gnyis bzhin du dus gcig tu spyod thabs med par gang zag gcig gis kyang tshe stod 'dul ba spyod tshe sngags 'dor/ tshe mjug sngags spyod tshe rab byung gi rtags tshun chad 'dor/ sra nga gi mgo mjug ma/tho dman bzhin res tsachu zhig spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam sad 'od ni phal ba 'og 42

lke mi/na man chad kyi lha'i 'od dang / gtso bo mi/ skyabs 'gro bdurngo/ ricu ba la sa/ba/nga zhig rnam sad de sangs rgyas/ zhes/ gsungs pa ltar longs spru' chen po rnams kyi 'od de/ de yang 'char nub med par kun tu bkra ba dang /gzhan gyi 'od rang bzhin gyis zil gyis gnon pa dang / dus re re la skal ldan mtha' yas pa smin grol byed pa gsum dang mtshungs pa ra skya/do sngags yongs rdzogs ma lus pa bshad sgrub 'dzin skyong spel ba'i nyamasdo5 len gyi 'ed snang dus kun tu bkra ba dang / nyes bshad kyi phung po rma lus pa rang baṇi/na gyis zil gyis spa/non pa dang dus re re la legs bshad re res kyang mtha' yas nga 'i skal ldan kun smin par byed pa'i bstan pa'i 'od snang chen po 'byin pa po/ sngon rgyal ba dbang po'i tog sos/sa rgyal ba du ma'i spyan sngar bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i smon lam legs par grub cing /dkyil 'khor gyi khyab bdag rgyal ba kun gyi yab tha/cig rje btsun 'jam nga 'i rdo rjes/ mdo sngags kyi zab rgyas yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum chu byin te ma do sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa gtad de bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur la/ rgyal ba ma pham pas 'jig rten na sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu 'ong si dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor los rgyal po zla bzang lta bu 'ong bar dbugs dbyung ba'i blo bzang rgyal ba snga ma sras bcas/ zhes sbrel te/gang zhig gang dang 'brel ba ni/ /ring na 'dug kyang de dang de/ ldes bshad pas so/ /de lta bu'i rje bdag nyid chen po khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa dang / de'i sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab thams cad ma khyen pa dang / 'dzam gling rgyan mchog mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen ba dang /43

'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'jam dbyangs chos rje dang rje thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dum/ grub pa sogs dang / yang rgyal ba snga phyi sras bcas zhes bton pas/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las/ rgyal ba bdun gyis gangs can skyong par bshad pa ltar/ de dag sras dang bcas pa dang sogs sgras gtso bor rigs ldan grags pa'i rnam 'phrul mkhas grub —thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'khrungs rabs spyi dang / khyad par snang mtha'i rnam 'phrul du'ang grags pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan yab sras dang / bdag gi yongs 'dzin mkhas shing grub pari dbang bo bcu phrag gsum lhag sogs rgya bod kyi thub dbang zhal skyin rnams la mi gus pa'i sems ldan su zhig yod de/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi dmigs bu yin pa'i phyir snyam pa'o/ /gnyis pa nyan par bskul 'ing rtsomyo/ par dam bca' ba ni/ de nas/ rigs grur ded dpon mkhas bsnge/ na ngal ba brgyas/ /grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son sngon med pa'i/ /legs bshad rin chen rnyed 'di dpyod ldan rnams/ /dga' bzhin kun mkhyen lam gsal sgron me zungs/ zhes tshigs bcad gcig ste/ nyan par bskul zhing dam bca' ba'i rgyu mtsham dka' ba dang / dkon pa dang dgos pa shin ritu che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ so/ /de yang rje bdag nyid chen pos/de nyid phyir na mi pham chos rje dang / /'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags pa'i/ /gzhung la phyogs re ba dang rags pa res tshim par ma byas kun la zhib tu sbyangs/ zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par rigasangang 'i gru bo cher zhugs/ rang gzhan gyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu—44

phyin pa'i ded dpon yongs 'dzin mkhas pa du ma'i zhabs sen spyi bor bsten te/ thos bsam sgom gsum gang 'os kyi sgo nas ngal ba brgya phrag byas pa ni/ dka' ba spyod pa'i tshur dang / spyir rang gzhan gyi grub ca/tha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu dka' zhing dko na te/ 'phas/sa yul mkhas/ pa'i 'byung gnas de na'ang klu sgrub yab sras dang / jo bo sos/sa nyung shas las med par grags shing / tshad ma pa'i 'grel ba phal cher la'ar rigs pa la 'khrul ba mang bar grags shing grub la/ bod 'dir yang 'chad 'gyur ltar grub mtha' mkhan po phal cher gyis grub mtha'i khungs tsam yang ma mthong zhing / khyad par 'ga' 'chad ma nus la/bcom ral dang / stag tshang ba sogs kyis mang du nor snang bas so/ /de lta na'ang rgyan drug dang khyad par du rje yab sras kyi legs bshad nyi ma lta bu rnams dang / lam khrid 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhal lung gis lam rim gyi sgo phyed cing / dpal gsang 'dus kyi bshad pas mdo sngags yongs kyi slo/ phye ba mthong nas/ grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa'i sngon chad grub mtha' mkhan po gzhan gyis ma thon pa'i phyi nang dang / mdo sems kyi khyad par dang / rang rgyud pa gnyis kyi dang / thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par zung brgyad sogs kyi legs bshad ming don gnyis ka'i rin po che 'di don chen po du ma'i 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir/rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams dga' bzhin spro bzhin du 'dzin par spro rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni 'di nas chos kun mkhyen pa'i bar du bgrod pa'i lam cha tshang gsal zhing / slob dpon dpa' pos/ blo mchog sa gzhi lta bu 45

la/ /dam chos nyi ltar kun nas gsal/ /blo dman khang bu lta bu'i phyir/ /rin chen sgron me tsam 'di bris/ /gsungs pa ltar chig don mtha' yas mang po yod kyang gzhung don gnyis ka 'dzin bde ba sogs dgos pa du ma'i don du sa/zung nyung la rnam dpyod kyi 'od zer mchog tu che ba'i rin po che'i sgron me lta bu 'di zungs shig dang / kho bos 'chad par bya'o/ zhes shugs la khas blangs te dam bcas so/ /'dis dgos sogs bzhi dang / gdul bya rnams bstan par shes sla la/ de 'dra'i khyad par shes pa la phyogs 'dzin spangs dgos la de yon tan yin kyang ha cang chags zhen che ba dang / gzhan gyi lugs la sdang drag pa mi rung zhing / de ltar gyur na don ji lta ba bzhin mi shes par ma zad las sgrib chen pos non par 'gyur ba sogs nyes pa du ma yod de/ zla bas/ rang gi lta la chags dang de bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi lta la 'khrug gang rtog pa nyid/ ces sogs dang / dbu ma snying po las/ phyogs su lhung bas sems gdung bas/ /zhi ba nam yang rtogs mi 'gyur/ zhes dang / ye shes snying po'i bden gnyis las/ /de ltar bden gnyis rnam phye 'dir/ /ci nyes yod dam 'on te med/ /phyogs 'dzin pa yis dkrugs pa'i yid/ /legs par dor la dpyad par gyis/ zhes pa nas/ sdang bas tshig pa khyod la ni/ /dal ba 'byor ba'ang ring bar gsal/ zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las kyang /nyon mongs rmongs dag rnams kyis 'phags la bskur ba dang / /des gsungs chos la brnyas gang de kun zhen ltas byas/ zhes pa nas/ gang zhig chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ ces gsungs pa ltar shin tu 46

mang la/ de ltar na'ang blun po kha cig ltar/ legaṭasmi/ bshad dang nyeṭa shaṃ bshad lakhyad par ci yang med par mi rung ste/ legs bshad bstod nas 'dzin la/ nyes bshad smad nas 'dor yang chab/sa sdang med pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir te/ spel mar bstod par phyogs glang gis kyang / btang rnyo ma sa gnas la gnas pa yang / /ngo mtshar min zhing dga' ba min/ /'jug pa dang ni ldog pa'i phyir/ /de ni ngo mtshar zhes bya ste/ zhes pa'i dgongs pa 'grel chu la du/ ma ti tsi tras/ dam chos rab tu bstod pa dang / /dam chos ma lags smo da mdzad kyang / /dam pa dag dang tha ma la/ /khyod ni chags dang khro mi mnga'/ /dgra bcom pa dang mu stegs la/ /rjes su chas/sa dang khong khro bar/ /khyod kyi thugs ni mi 'gyur na/ zhes gsu ngas pa ltar/ mdo sde tshangs pa'i dra ba las kyang / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong de re 'i/ga khros 'khrugs la rngams te yid mi dga' bar 'gyur bas/ gzhan brjod pa'i don gyi rnam pa tham/sa cad yongs su rdzogs par shes pa'am/ mthong bar 'gyur ba 'di ni gnas med do/ zhes pa nas/ dge slong dag nga la snyan pa brjod la chos dang dge 'dun la yang snyan mi brjod pa na dga' bar yang mi bya'o/ /yid bde bar yang mi bya'o/ /sems ya ya bor yang mi bya'o/ zhes pa nas/ dge slong re zhig dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / yid bde bar gyur pa dad / sem sa ya ya bor gyur pas/ gzhan brjod pa'i don gyi rnam pa thams cad yongs su shes pa'am mthong bar 'gyur ba 'di ni gam/sa med do/ /dge slong das/ de'i phyir nga la snyan pa baji+o da la chos dang dge 'dun la yang snyan pa brjod pa 47

na / yang dag pa la ni yang dag pa nyid du khas blangs par bya la yang dag pa ma yin pa la ni yang dag pa ma yin pa nyid du ste/ zhes gsakho bar gsungs pa dang shes byed gzhan yang mang bas so/ /de lta na gzur gnagane tsam gyis mi chog gi legs bshad nyes bshad 'byed pa'i blo gros kyis legs par dpyad pa zhig dgos te/ gzhan du na blun po chu sna gar khrid du 'gro pa'i phyir te/ bzhi brgya pa las/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar bshad/ /smra bo yon tan rnams gzhan du/ /mi 'gyur nyan pa po la'ang min/ zhes dang / mdo las/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yi gus phyir min/ zhes dang / rigs ldan grags pas kyang de ltar gsungs la/mnyam med jo bo chen pos kyang / klu sgrub lugs kyi bden gnyis bkod pa 'di/ /gser gling rgyal po'i ngor ni byas 'di la/ /gal te deng sang skye bo dad gyur kyang / /legs par brtags la blang bar bya ba yin/ dad pa tsam dang gus pa tsam gyis min/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang rin po che gsum gyi gtam las/ gal te yang dag dam 'cha' tsam zhig gis/ /nges pa rnyed kyang sgrub dang sun 'byin gyi/ / tshad ma'i stobs kyis the tshom ma chod phyir/ /'dam la btab pa'i phur ba bzhin 'gyur bas/ zhes dang / de phyir blo gros phra zhing 'dzangs pa dang / ku sha'i rtse ltar ma gyur de srid du/ /ngoms mi sla bar zhes tshad ma'i stobs kyis the tshom chod dgos par gsungs pas so/ /des na rgyan 48

drug sogs la rtsod pa mang zhing / rang gzhan gyi phyogs phye na chags sdang can yin la bdag la phyi nang gi lugs dang / bye smra dang thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la'ang khyad med pas chags sdang med pa'o snyam pa'i rmongs pa'i rlom sems mi bya ste/ de las sdig che ba med cing / rang blun po dang chos la mi dga' bar gsal bar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes kyang 'doms par byed do/ /de la grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i zhes bshad na/ grub mtha'i tha snyad phyi nang sus bshad/ de'i sgra don ji lta bu snyam na/ grub mtha'i tha snyad ni phyi ba kho nas sgro btags/ ma yin te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis tha snyad de mdzad pa'i phyir te/ lang gshegs las/ blo gros chen po 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzosas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi tshul ni rnam pa gnyis so/ 'di lta ste bstan pa'i tshul dang / grub pa'i mtha' so sor bzhag pa'i tshur lo/ /de la bstan pa'i tshul gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ blo gros chen po chos sna tshogs byi mdo bshad pa ste/ sems can rnams la sems dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du ston pa'o/ /blo gros chen po de la grub pa'i mtha'i tshul gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gang gis rnal 'byor can rnams rang gi sems snang ba'i rnam par rtog pa ldog par byed pa'o/ zhes pa nas/rtog ge ba ngan pa yod pa dang / med pa'i mthar lhung ba rnams kyis ma myang pa de ni/ ngas grub pa'i mthar bshad do/ /nga yi chos tshul rnam gnyis te/ /bstan pa dang ni grub mtha' 'o/ /byis pa rnams la bstan pa bshad/ /rnal 'byor ba la grub mtha' 'o/ zhes so/ /grub mtha'i 49

ming gi rnam grangs/ sa ma ya dang sid+mon+ta dang sirta dang sisgyun+ta dang tan+ta dang kṛtān+d+ra zhes pa rnams yod de/ 'chi med mdzod las/ sa ma ya ni mna' kun spyod/ /dus dang grub mtha' yang dag rig /mi dge sngon lacari/ sdug bsngal sogs/ zhes dang / siji dang an+ta sbyar bas sid+mosto dang sid+dha ni dngos grub dang grub pa sogs la 'jug la/ siji an+ta mtshams sbyar bas sid+mon+ta dang sid+dha ni/ 'chi med mdzod las/ grub pa zin pa rdzogs pa'o/ zhes dang / 'di'i rdzogs pa'i skad dod ni /t+pad+dha ni nges par bskyed pa'ang rung la pa ri ni dzin+da yongs grub tu'ang bsgyur ro/ /an+ta ni rnam bshad rig pa las/ an+ta zad dang 'jug cha dang / /nye dang phyogs dang smad pa la/ zhes dang / gzhan yang dbus dang bar dang nang sogs la'ang 'jug go /tan+t+ra ni 'chi med mdzod las/ tan+t+ra gtso bo grub mtha' dang / thags 'thag pa dang yongs su 'gebs/ zhes dang / sgra gcig don mang las kyang / tan+t+ra bstan bcos rigs rgyud tan+t+ra ste/ /tan+t+ra grub pa'i sman gyi bya ba la/ /tan+d+ra bde ba tan+t+ra stobs ldan te/ /rlung sbyor grub mtha' rnams la tan+t+ra 'o/ zhes de ltar bshad do/ /kṛ tan+t+ra ni 'chi med mdzod las/ kṛ tan+t+ra ni gshin rje dang / /grub mtha' dbang thang mi dge'i las/ zhes so/ /de dag gi don bsdus na/ rnam rtog gi sgro btags pa'i cha gzhan bzlog nas rang gi blo ngor yang dag par grub pa de grub mtha'i don yin te/ sa ma ya'i sa ma yang dag pa dang / a ya rtogs pa la 'jug cing / rtog ge 'bar ba las kyang / sde pa so so'i dam tshig ces bshad pa dang / lang gshegs las/ rang gi sems snang ba'i rnam 50

par rtog pa ldog par byed pa'o/ zhes pa'i don yin no/ /rang gi blo ngor grub pa'i nang tshan yin pas na/ si.a+yaurnya dang sid+dhān+ta 'amyo/ grub mtha' zhes bya la/ de yang byings mdo las ṣirnyu bstan bcos la ste bkra shirutsā la'o/zhes bstan bcos kyi byings las bsgrub pas/ byings kyi sgo nas bstan bcos la'ang 'gro la/ rang gi blo ngor grub pa'i cha de ston pa'i gzhung la'ang grub mtha' zhes bya ste/ grub mtha' brtsams zhes pa lta bu dang /tan+t+ra zhes pa de la'ang bya'o/ /rang gi blos yang dag par nges par byas nas bzhag pa'i don gyi mtha' 'am nang tshan yin pas kṛ tan+t+ra ste grub mtha'i don yin te/ kṛ ta byas pa/ an+ta mtha'a'am nang dang phyogs sogs la 'jug pa'i phyir te/ shes rab sgron me las/ mdzad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel bshad las/ de la mdzad nga/'i mtha' zhes bya ba ni grub pa'i mtha' ste/ bdag nyid chen ngo rnams kyis mdzad pa'i don gyi mtha' nges pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ zhes so/ /des na slob dpon legs ldan gyis mdzad pa'i mtha' dang 'gal zhes pa'ang grub mtha'i 'gyur nor ba yin no//gnyis pa gzhung don la/ phyi nang gi khyad par 'khrul spong dang bcas pa dang / lus kyis mdor bstan yan lag gis rgyas par bshad pa gsum/dang po la/ phyi nang gi khyad par ngos bzung / de la 'khrul ba spangs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bstan dang ston pa lta bas phyi nang gnyis/ zhes smras te/ de la phyi nang gi khyad par ston pa dang bstan pa dang / lta ba gsum —gyi sgo nas 'byed dgos te/ ston pa skyon kun zad cing yon tan lhag ma 51

med par thob pas rten 'brel zab mo'i chos rang dbang du ston rngasnye dang / bstan pa dam pa'i chos 'tshe ba med pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa dang / lta—ba rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag med par zhe nas 'dod pa gsum —sangs rgyas pa'am nang pa kho na'i lugs dang 'di gsum gyi bzlog zla gsum nang ba 'di las phyi rol tu gyutha pa'i gzhan sde'i lugs yin zhwa 'i phyir/ston pa de ltar yin zhing de'i sgo nas phyi nang gnyis bzhag ste/ ston pa de'i stad par shes nas de ston par khas len pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir te/ lha las phul byung gi bstod par/ bdag ni sangs rgyas phyogs mi 'dzin/ /ser skya sogs la mi sdang yang / /gang zhig rigs par ldan pa'i tshig /de nyid ston par yongs su 'dzin/ /zhes ston par 'dzin tshul dang /stad par 'phags bstod las/ bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas/ /bcom ldan khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod/ /skyon mi na nga' la yod tan ldan/ zhes ston par mi 'dzin tshul bshad pa ltar dgos la/ dpal ldan zla bas kyang / rten 'brel zab mo'i chos rang dbang du ston pa gzhan sde'i so skye lta ci smos/ nyan rang byang sems rnams la'ang med par bshad pa'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas pa phur bu ba ser skya ba 'ug phrug pa rkang mig pa dbang phyug pa khyab 'jug pa zla ba pa tshangs pa ba dang mchod 'os pa zhes rang rang gi ston pa de ston par khas len cing /rang de'i rjes 'jug tu khas blangs pa kho nar snang ba'i phyir dang / de dag la ming gi rnam grangs gzhan yang gzhung dang / 'dod tshul sogs kyi btags pa yod kyang des 'dir mi gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na phyi nang 52

gi khyad par ston pas 'byed pa kho na yin kyang / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' so so'i khyad par ni lta bas 'byed pa kho na yin te/ bstan pa dang ston pa gcig spyang grub myo/tha' tha dad pa mi 'gal ba'i phyir te/ rang sde bzhi bzhin do/ /des na stag tshang bas bon pos ma nges zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas pa las phyi rol tu gyur pas phyi rol pa yin kyang / khyod kyi 'dod pa'i chad smra gcig dang / rtag smra sde lnga gang rung ma yin pa du ma yod par 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /bstan pa'i khyad par yang mdo sde rgyan las/ de ni bag chags rtogs dang zhi ba dang / /rab tu rtogs pas rnam par grol bar byed/ ces pa ltar gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis po thams cad gang la'ang dang por thos pa'i sgo nas thar ba'i bag chags dang / bar du bsam pas don rtogs nas nyon mongs phal cher gyi rtse gzhil ba dang /mthar bsgom pas nyon mongs sogs las rim gyis grol bar byed pas na thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin par 'bril ba dang / mi 'tshe ba'i bstan pa dang / bdag med pa grol lam du 'dod pa'i sgo nas phyi nang 'byed thub ste/ rang sde'i grub mtha' bzhi ka khyad par de kho na 'dod la/ gzhan sde rnams khyad par de dag mi 'dod pa'i phyir te/ 'od ldan las/ phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /bslab pa gsum ni rab ston la/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /sangs rgyas gsung du yang da 3ka rtogs/ zhes dang / dpa' bos kyang lung gi don ni bsam pa dang / /sgom dang gus par mnyan pa yis/ /dus gsum cha dbye nyid kyis ni/ /pa stan las gzhan ma mchis pa lags/ zhes dang / gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/53

don med don log don dang ldan/ /thos rtsokha/mosgrub pa lhur len pa/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong / zhes dang / 'di dang mthun par tshigs lhug rnam bshad rigs pa las kyang bshad pa'i phyir/ phyi ba gzhan rnams gzhan la gnod pa kho na yin la/ gcer bu ba gzhan la mi 'tshe bar rlom yang / rang la 'tshe dgos par khas len cing / rang lus kyi srin bu brgyad khri la'ang gnod pas gzhan la'ang gnod pa'i bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ des ma chos rang gzhan gnyis ka la mi 'tshe ba de bzhin gshegs pa kho na'i lugs yin pa'i phyir dang / rang sde gnas ma bu bas kyang brjod du med pa'i gang zag khas len kyang / chos thams/ cad bdag med par 'dod cing / gzhan sde chad smra rnams kyis kyang bdag rtag par 'dod pa sha stag yin pa'i phyir te/ bzhi brgya ba las/ tshos ni mdor na mi 'tshe bar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /stong nyid mya ngan 'das par te/ /'dir ni de gnyis 'ba' zhig go /zhes dang / gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ zhes so/ /lta ba ya nga gang zag gi bdag med par lta ba dang / 'dus byas mi rtag sogs phyag rgya bzhir lta bu'i lta ba khas len mi len gyi sgo nas phyi nang 'byed dgos te/ phyi nang gi lta ba mi 'dra bar mkhas pas gsungs pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rig byed grub mtha' rnal 'byor rnams/ /dbang phyug sogs kyis byas pa dang / /sangs rgyas pa yi sngags rgyud la/ /stong ba nyid la khyad par yod/ ces dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi dri med 'odartelas/ de bzhin du khams dang dbang po la sogs pa rnal 'byor spyo da padzha54 —
