grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u gsum nga grangs cam/ ser skya'i rtag mtha' dgag pa/ gnyis pa rtag mtha' dgag pa la/ grangs ser gnyis dang / tshangs brda rig byed mtha' gsang bzhi'i dang / khyab 'jug dpyod pa ba gnyis kyi dang / 'i/ bye rig gsum gyi dang / zad byed pa'i rtag mtha' 'gos/ pa lnga/dang po la 'dod pa brjod de dgag pa gnyis / dang po la/ ston pa ming dbye ba 'dod tshul bzhi/ dang po ni/ ser skya mchod 'os dbang phyug chu klung ston/ zhes pa'i don khyad par 'phags bstod 'grel ba las/ de yang bskal ba dang po'i tshe ser skya zhes bya ba'i dra nga srong zhig byung ste/ de ni grangs can gyi bstan bcos rtsom par byed pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i drang srong ser skya dang / sngar ltar kun tu rgyu dag gi gzhung ltar na drang srong mchod 'os kyang yin la/ 'on kyang 'di ba la mchod 'os par ma grags pas phyi ba byings —kyis mi 'dod dam snyam mod kyang / 'di dag bshad tshod las/ gnas tshod gang la'ang dka' bar bstan pa'i ched du bkod pa yin pas shes par gyis/ dbang phyug yang 'chad 'gyur ltar grangs can phyi mas ston par 'dzin cing ༈ lha des rjes su bzung nas dbang phyu ga nag po'i rgyude susaucu ba dang / drug cu ba sogs rtsom pa'i ston 109

pa chu klung rnams ston pa'o//gnyis pa ni/ grangs/ can rang bzhin rgyur smra ser skya sogs/ zhes smras la/ slob dpono bo ti bha tras/ 'di dngos po 'byung ba'i rgyu grangs nges pa smra bas na grangs can te zhes dang / legs ldan gyis/ grangs kyis 'jug pa'am/ grangs yongs su shes pa'i grangs can te/ 'e/sa gsungs pa ltar gyi grangs can dang / spyi'am sngar ltar rang bzhin rgyur smra bas rang bzhin rgyur smra dang / slob dpon shes rab go chas/ de'i slob ma ming ser skya pa zhes bya ste/ ser skya'i bu yin pas na ser skya pa zhes gsungs pas dang / gtso bo mthong dka' ba rgyur smra bas gtso bo pa sogs so // gsum pa ni/ dbye ngo ser skya mngon gsal lha med pa/ /grangs can lhar bcas rnam 'gyur chu klung lugs/ zhes pa dang / 'dir cung zad dpyad na gzhung du mar ser skya pa dang / grangs can pa tha dad du bshad snang ste/ zhi 'tshos/ nus pa ma lus dang ldan pa'i/ /gtso bo nyid ni 'ba' zhig las/ zhes pa nas/ de yang yin zhes ser skya smra/zhes dang / de'i dka' 'grel las/ ser skya pa rnams na re/ zhes pa nas/ 'ba' zhig las zhes bya ba'i tshig ni/ dbang phyug dang bcas pa'i grangs can kyi brtags pa'i dbang phyug la sogs pa bsal ba'i don du'o/ /zhes dbang phyug mi 'dod pa'i ser skya pa bshad cing / le'u gsum par/de ltar rang bzhin dbang phyug dag ces sogs dang / dka' 'grel las/de ltar raju+o bzhin dbang phyug dag /ces bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ de 11 0

la grangs can kha cig ni gtso bo 'ba' zhig las 'bras bu tha dad pa 'di dag 'jug pa ma yin te/ de ni sems pa med pa nyid kyi phyirdoro/ /zhes dang / ye shes kun btus las/ ser skya pa rnams stongs pa'i tshul/ /grangs can smra rnams yon tan med/ ces dang / 'grel ba ltar na 'di'i grangs can pas kyang dbang phyug lhar mi 'dod par bshad cing / grub chen sman zhabs kyis bdag gi rnam grangs sum cu ba las/ dus las byung ba dang / 'dod rgyal dang / gnam gyis bskos pa dang gyi na bzhi ni grangs can gyi 'dod pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor dang tshad ma dang dag pa dang / ma dag pa bzhi ni ser skya ba'i 'dod pa yin no/ /zhes dang /'o da ldan las/ gang dag grangs can dang ser skya la sogs pa'i bstan bcos de kho na nyid yin pa'i blos zhes bshad cing / 'on kyang mi 'gal ba ni/ legs ldan sogs kyis rtsa bar ser skya zhes par 'grel bar grangs can du bshad pa'i phyir/ dper na zhi 'tshos/ ser skya smra zhes pa'i 'grel bar/ ka ma la shrī las/ zhes ser skya pa ste grangs can rnams smra bar byed do/ /zhes gsu ngas pa lta bu shin tu mang zhing / 'jug 'grel sogs kyis kyang shes pas so/ /des na 'dir dbye ngo la gnyis te/ 'dod tshu'/ phal cher mthun yang / drang srosde ser skya tsam gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sngon gyi grangs can ni legs ldan ltar 'bras bu rgyu dus nas yod par rkyenasnyi gyis mngon par gsal bar smra ba'i dang / tshad ma'i de nyid rtsa 'grelo dang kun btus ltar/ gtso bo tsam las byung gi lha dbang phyug sogs kyi blo g.yo ba sngon du song ba mi 'dod pas grangs can lha med pa dang / 'di phyin chad nas 111

grang sa gtso bor bshad pas grangs can/ tshad ma'i de nyid rtsa 'grel ltar/rgyu 'bras rang bzhin gcig kyang rnam 'gyur tha dad du 'gro ba ni/ lha chem/ dbang phyug gi blos byin gyis rlabs par 'dod pa'i grangs can phyi ma ni/ston pa chu klung phyin chad nas/ byung bas/ de'i lugs yin no/ /lo ts+tsha pa shes rab rin chen na re/ 'di dbang phyug pa ma yin te/ gtso bo bden zhen gyi 'dod pas so zer ba la ma khyab cing / mi 'thad de/ zhi 'tsho yab sras kyis 'di grangs can pa dang / dbang phyug pa gnyis kar bshad pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re 'di'i tshig gi don drug 'dod zer ba'ang dpyad na snying po med do/ /bye brag pa la 'khrul bar zad pas so/ /bzhi pa la gzhi sbyi pam 'bras gsum las/ dang po la/ ser skya pa'i 'dod tshul/ grangs can lhar bcas kyi 'dod lugs gnyis/ dang po la tshad ma dang / gzhal bya'i shes bya gnyis/ dang po la/ sgras brjod kyi mngon rjes lung chad ma gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ mngon sum tshad ma dbang po'i 'jug pa gnyis/zhes pa ni tshad ma kun btus las/ ser skya pa rnams ni rna ba la sogs pa'i 'jug pa mngon sum du 'dod/ ces gsungs pa ltar mngon sum tshad ma ni yid dbang po'i 'jug pa la 'dod la/ yid kyi 'jug pa ni rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur tha dad med par 'dogs byed do/ /yid kyis dbang po byin gyis brlabs tshul gnyis te/ tsho kha cig yid dang dbang po lhan cig tu yul la 'jug pa'i don du 'dod la gzhan dag yid kyi don te/ dbang pos bzung rjes su yid kyis reg /de'i rjes blos zhen par 'dod do/ /dbang po'i 'jug pa ni/ — rang gi yul nye na de'i rnam par 112

'gyur bar 'dod/ dbang po'i 'jug pa la 'dod tshul gnyis te/ rkyen bcas rkyen med gnyis so/ /rkyen bcas ni lcags sregs pa na me dang rdzas gcig min kyang gcig par snang ba ltar sems pa can gyis yul myong ba na yul dang 'dres pas yul myong ba'i ngo bo min kyang myong ba'i ngo bor snang ba'i skabs dang rkyen med ni sems pa can sgron me'i 'od yul gsal bar byed kyi yul dang 'dres par snang ba min pa'i skabs so/ /gzhan yang grangs can spyi'i rna ba dang / pags pa dang / mig lce/ sna la yid kyis brlabs nas sgra sogs la zhen cing lta bar bshad do/ /chu klung sogs khyad par kha cig dbang shes kyis yul 'dzin pa'i sems kyi 'jug pa lnga ba mchog gi 'jug pa zhes pa bslu med kyi bya ba nyid dbang po'i 'jug par 'dod do/ /grangs can snga ma na re/ bde sogs kyi rang bzhin gcig dang cha med yin la/ de tsam lnga dang bde sogs gsum bsdoms nas dbang pos 'dzin la rang rang gi dbyibs 'dzin pas dbang yul so sor 'dod/ phyi ma grangs can phung byed ma rdum pa na re/ de tsam lnga'i rang bzhin bde sogs la tha dad yod pas dbang po'i yul so sor 'dod de /slob dpon phyogs glang gis/ du mar 'dzin phyir grangs can gyi/ /bye brag kha cig mi 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang don 'brel bdun gzhan don rnam gsal gnyis/ zhes pa ni/ kun btus las 'brel ba mngon sum pa cig las lhag pa grub spro ni rjes su dpag pa'o/ zhes zer ro/ /yang smras pa/ 'brel ba bdun du bstan pa dang / /rjes su dpag pa gnyis nyid dang / /de sngon song ba'i rjes 113

dpag ni/ /gsum ste zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'brel ba bdun yod de/ lugs gnyis kyi dpe gnyis gnyis kyi mtshon par byed de rgyal po dang bran nam/ gtso bo dang skyes bu lta bu nor dang nor bdag gi 'brel ba dang / 'o zho 'am gtso bo dang chen po lta bu rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gyi dang / shing rta dang yan lag gam snying stobs sogs dang de tsam lta bu rgyu 'bras kyi dang / rdza mkhan dang bum pa 'am skyes bu dang gtso bo lta bu rgyun dang rgyun can gyi dang / yal ga dang shing ngam/ de tsam dang 'byung ba chen po lta bu yan lag dang yan lag can gyi dang / ngur ba dang ngur ma lta bu'am rang bzhin snying stobs sogs lta bu dang lhan cig spyod pa'i dang /sbrul dang sre mong ngam yan lag dang / yan lag can gyi snying stobs sogs gcig gis gcig la gnod pa lta bu gnod bya gnod byed kyi 'brel ba ste 'brel ba bdun gyi snga ma 'jig rten lugs kyi dpe phyi ma chos kyi dper —'dod yang rjes dpag gnyis te khyad par mthong ba dang spyir mthong ba'o/ /spyir mthong ba la rgyu las 'bras bu rtogs pa snga ma can dang / 'bras bu las rgyu dpog pa lhag ldan te rang don 'brel ba bdun gyi dang / gzhan don rjes dpag ni yan lag lnga ldan dang thal 'gyur gnyis 'dod de/kun btus gzhan le'u las/ ser skya pa na re gzhan la bstan par bya ba'i don du rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis te/ rnam par ’na pa dang /gsal te 'ongs pa'o zhes so/ /'di dag gnyis sogs 'gog tshul kun btus ltar/ gsum pa ni dbang phyug sgyud dang sum cu ba sogs lung / zhes pa'i don ni/ ka shis/ dbang phyug nag po'i bshad pa zhes gsungaru/ pa 114

ltar/ dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud dang / rgyud drug cu ba/ gser bdun cu ba/ gzhung lugs sum cu ba/ legs ldan ltar mtshan nyid lnga bcu ba sogaṭashaṃ yid rjechos kyi lu nga tshad mar 'dod/ gnyis pa la/ 'di'i shes bya thams cad ni bem shes gnyis su bshad pa dang / rgyu sogs mu banir bshad pa dang / bden pa gnyis su bshad pa dang / skye tshul dang 'ji ga tshul bshad pa lnga las/ dang po la/ shes pa bshad pa dang bem po bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid bshad pa/ dbye ba bshad pa/ rnam grangs bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ yon tan bya byed min dang rtag dngos shes/ /za bo'i bdag yod ces smras te/ bdag de ni khyad par du ma dang ldan te don rnyed pas na shes pa'i ngo bo/ rtsom pa med pa'i phyir mi skye ba'i chos can dang / skye ba dang nyams pa med pas rtag pa dang / bde sdug la longs spyod pa'i za pa po/ sa gsu ma du 'gro ba thams cad la khyab pas khyab pa dang / snying stobs sogs kyi mtshan nyid can min pas yon tan ma yin pa/ rtsom pa med pa'i phyir mi skye ba'i chos can dang byed pa med pa/ yul la longs spyod pa'i phyir yul can cha shas dang bral b.ri phyir gcig bu/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i phyir mtha' med pa'i mtshan nyid can yin pa'i phyir te/ legs ldan gyis/ de ni bdag ste shes pa yod pa las tha dad du dzos gyur pa/ ma skyes pa rtag pa/ ma byas pa gsum ba'o/ /gtsa bo khyab pa byed pa med pa yon tan gsum las bzlog pa mi skye ba'i chos can no/ /skyon rnyed pas na shes pa yod pa zhes pa nas/ mtha' mad pa ste 'di dag ni skyes bu'i mtshan nyid yin no/ zhes gsungs pa'i 115

phyir/ des na/ yon tan bya byed min dang rtag dngos shes/ /za po'i bdag yod ces smras te/ 'grel bshad las/ shes pa zhes bya ba ni grangs can gyi gzhung las skyes bu zhes bya ba yin te/ zhes gsungs/'jug par yang / za po rtag dngos byed po min pa'i bdag /yon tan bya med mu stegs rnams kyis brtags/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyi glor gnas mi gnas/ zhes pa bdag de la dbye na/ 'ching ba ma grol bar du spyi'i glor gnas pa'am ldan pa'i bdag dang / grol tshe spyi 'a mi gnas/ pa bdag yan gar ba 'ba' zhig pa ste gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ lo chen sher rin gyis/ spyi glor gnas pa kho nar bshad pa 'khrul bar soms so/ /gsum pa/ de'i ming gi rnam grangs 'chad par shes rig skyes bu bdag so gas zhes pa'i don ni/ dbu tshad mang ltar 'gro ba rnams su sbyor bas/ myong ba po dang / sems pa can dang / yul rtogs pas shes pa dang / gsal bas rig pa dang / rtog ge 'bar ba las/ grangs can dang bye brag pa dag gi gzhung las rgyun du 'gro ba'am 'byung po thams cad kyi brtags par bya ba yin pa'i phyir bdag ce'o/ zhes dang / mtshan nyid lnga bcu la zhing zhes bya la/ de shes pas zhing shes dang / sgra sbyor bam gnyis ltar skyes bu dang sogs kyi shes pa po sogs 'don la/ des na shes pa dang rig pa la bdag gcig dgos la blo la bem pos khyab pas blo min dgos so/ /bdag shes rig yin pa des nyer lnga po bem rig gnyis su 'du ste / 'dis mig sogs chos can/ gzhan don byed de/ 'dus bsags yin pa'i phyir/ dper na ma la cha bzhin zhos/ rtags sbyor 'god 116

pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ ma brjod na yang 'dod pas khyab/ /bdag gi gdon bzhin bsgrub byar 'dod/ ces gsungs so/ /sogs khongs nas shes bya nyer gsum bton nas/ de las gzhan bdag yin par bsam pas nyer bzhi po 'dus bsags yin pas bem po yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyer bzhi bem/ zhes smras pa lhag ma nyer bzhi bem por 'dod do/ /gnyis pa la/ mu bzhir bshad nas/ de la 'khru' ba dgag pa ni/ rtsa ba byed po rtag gcig yul dang khyab/ /mi gsal yon tan mnyam 'dod gnas luganu/ sogs/ /de las chen po shel 'dra gnyis 'dres 'jal/ /yon tan snying stobs rdul mun bde sdug sogs/ /blo las nga rgyal gsum skye dang po las/ /de tsam lnga skyed de lngas 'byung ba lnga/ /gnyis pas las blo'i dbang po lnga lnga yid/ /gsum pa de gnyis 'jug byed/ ces sogs kyi don ni/ rgyu kho na yin pa'i rtsa ba'i rang bzhin ni/dbu ma snying po las/ rang bzhin gang zhig rtog pa med/ /yon tan gsum dang bskyed bdag nyid/ ces gsungs pa ltar las sogs byed pa po dang / ma skyes pas rtag pa dang / cha med pas gcig pu/ sems dang rtogs pa med pas yul yul can gnyis las yul kho na rgyu 'bras sogs snod bcud kun la khyab pa/ 'grel bshad ltar drang srong ser skya sogs la'ang mngon du ma gyur pa rdul mun snying stobs te yon tan gsum mnyam pa'i shes bya gcig la 'dod de/ rtospu ge 'bar ba las/ rang bzhin yod de sems dang ldan pa min pa'o/ /de yang ma skyes pa/ rtag pa byed pa pos longs spyod par bya ba gcig pu khyab pa yon tan gsum la sogs pa dang ldan pa'o 117

zhes so/ /de mi gsal tshul ni/ tarki dzo la las/ de nyid ni mi garu/la ba ste/ kha dog dang tshad dang / dbyibs la sogs pa'i bye bras/ riṭa// lha dang lha min dang / mi la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang mngom suca/ du ma gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / 'grel bshad las/ gtso bo de rdzi nga bram ze ser skya'i mngon sum yang ma yin te/ de dag gi gzhung laṭari bram ze ser skyas tshangs pa skye ba ni mthong gi/ /de'i gtso bo de ni ma mthong ngo / /zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ /zhes so/ /rtsa ba'i rang bzhin rang bzhin gzhan dang mi 'dra ste/ 'grel bshad las/ snying stobs dang rdul dang / mun pa de dag cha mnyam pa nyid dang mtshungs pa dang gcig tu gyur cing / gang yang rung ba 'ga' zhig shas che bar mi dmigs pa de ni gtso bo zhes bya'o/ zhes so/ /ming gi rnam grangs gnas lugs dang / sogs sgras don dam bden pa dang / gtso bo dang rang bzhin sogs rnam nges dar ṭika las bshad do/ /khyad par rnams la tshad yod pa'i phyir dang / khyad par rjes su 'gro bar mthong ba'i phyir dang / nus pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i phyiraskedang / rgyu 'bras dbyer yod pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten gsum rnam par dbyer med pa'i phyir na gtso bo yod do/ /ji skad du/ khyad par tshad phyir rjes 'gro'i phyir/ /nus pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i phyir/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu dbyer yod pa'i/ /rang bzhin sna tshogs dbyer med phyir/ /mi gsal ba yi rgyu sdod do/ /zhes so/ /de mi gsal ba'i rgyu mtshan yang brgyad yod de/ ji skad du/ ha cang nye phyir ring phyir dang / /cha phra'i phyir dang sgrib phyir dang / /zil gnon phyir dang 'dres phyir dang / /dbang po—118

nyams phyir yid med phyir/ zhes so/ /rang bzhin de la lhag ma nyer gsum dngos brgyud ci rigs byas nas byung ste/ tshad ma'i de nyi da dka' 'grel las/ngh+rurab tu byung zhes bya ba ni/ dngos dang brgyud pas bskyed ces pa'i don te/ 'di ltar de dag gi tha snyad ni/ dang por gtso bo las blo skye'o/ /blo las kyang nga rgyal lo/ /nga rgyal las sgra dang reg bya dang /ro dang gzugs dang / dri'i bdag nyid de tsam lnga dang / dbang po bcu gcig skye ste/ blo'i dbang po lnga ni/ rna ba dang pags pa dang / mig dang lce dang / sna'i mtshan nyid can no/ /las kyi dbang po lnga ni/ ngag dang lag pa dang rkang pa dang / rkub dang / 'doms so/ /bcu gcig pa ni yid do/ /de tsam lngas 'byung ba lnga bskyed do/ /sgra las nam mkha' 'o/ /reg las rlung ngo / /gzugs las me'o/ /ro las chu'o/ /dri las sa'o/ zhes bya ste/ ji skad du/ dbang phyug nag pos/ rang bzhin las chen de las nga rgyal te/ /de las tshogs ni rnam pa bcu drug go/ /bcu drug po ni de dag rnams las kyang / /lnga bo rnams las 'byung ba chen po lnga/ zhes bshad do/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'dir bshad pa/ mu bzhi'i phyir/ /nyer lngapyigatso bdag la sdud shin tu 'khrul/ zhes pa ni/ shes bya nyer lnga po de mu bzhir gnas te/ rang bzhin kho na yin pa dang / rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gnyis ka yin pa/ rnam 'gyur kho na yin pa/ rang bzhin rnam 'gyur gnyis ka ma yin pa/bzhir 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ rtsa ba'i rang bzhin dang po dang / chen po dang nga rgyal dang / de tsam lnga ni gnyis pa dang dbang po bcu gcig / 3— kā 119

'byung ba lnga dang bcu drug ni gsum pa dang / skyes bu ni bzhi pa yin pa'i ’ phyir te/ dbang phyug nag pos/ rtsa ba'i rang bzhin rnam par 'gyur min la/ /chen po so gas bdun rang bzhin rnam 'gyur zhing / /bcu drug po ni rnam par 'gyur ba ste/ /skyes bu rang bzhin ma yin rnam 'gyur min/zhes so/ /'jug 'grel las/ ni zhes bya ba ni nges par gzung ba'i tshig ste/ rnam 'gyur kho na yin gyi rang bzhin ni ma yin no/ /zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /zhes dang / 'grel bshad brtul zhugs 'a sa/ bcu drug po de dag ni 'gyur ba 'ba' zhig yin gyi/ rang bzhin ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs dbu tshad kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rang tshig kyang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ lo chen sher rin gyis/ shes bya nyer lnga po gtso bo dang bdag gnyis su 'dod pa 'khrul bar shes ldan rnams kyis mkhyen pa gyis/ 'di ni 'bras bu rnams kyi'ang ngo bor gyur pa'i rang bzhin yod kyang / 'bras bu de rang bzhin yin mi dgos par ma shes pas nongs so/de dag las blo ni/ ka shrīs/ de la chen po zhes bya ba ni blo la ba rjod do/ /blo yang 'di bum pa'o/ /snam bu'o zhes yu'/ nges pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ /zhes dang / legs ldan gyis/ chen po ni rtog pa'i mtshan nyid dang / don thams cad la khyab par thamaso cad kyi mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi bem po shel gyi me long lta bu zhig go/ /dbu ma snying po las/ yid las snying stobs skyes pa can/ /skyes bu'i gezugs brnyan 'byung ba'am/ 5tsho /de bzhin yongs su gyur nas ni/ /blo 'jug pa yi rjes su byed/ ces snying stobs gsal ba'i bdag nyid can yid kyi don rtogs 120

pha na/ rtogs pa'i gzugs brnyan skyes/ bu la 'byung ba ni chu dwangs pa'i nang gi zla gzugs lta bu 'am/ blo shel dwangs pa lta bu la phyi'i lul dang /nang rig pa'i rgyatsa/zugs brnyan gnyis phrad pa'am 'byung ba ni yul 'jal bar 'dod pa'i phyir te/ tarki dz+wa la las/ yang blos don rtogs pa'i rjes su yang byed las me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du yongs su 'gyur ba yin gyi zhes sos/sa so/ /yang legs ldan gyis/ blo dang yid dang ngar 'dzin pa gsum ni nang gi byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nang gi byed pa gsum gyi dang po blo yin no/ /rtsa ba'i rang bzhin gyi ngo bor ldan pa'i yo/na tan gsum gyi rnam grangs ni/ rdul mun snying stobs gsum dang de bzhin du rim bzhin zhe sdang rmongs pa chags pa gsum dang —/ tshor ba sdug bsngal btang snyoms bde ba gsum dang / 'di'i tshor ba gsum gyi btang snyoms ni gzhan gnyis kyi shugs bstan byed na ma gtogs rgya gzhung gang na'ang mi snang / rang bzhin sa/sum zhes bya ba la/ de gsum rang bzhin gyi ngo bor yod pas 'bras bu nang gi bde sdug yod par 'dod de/ sbyor ba ni/shes rab sgron me las/ rang bzhin rgyur 'dod pa de dag na re/ nang gi bye brag rnams kyi rgyu ni/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang / gti mug yin par nges te/ de dang ldan pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten na gang zhig sa/nga dang ldan par gyur pa de ni/ de'i rgyu yin par shes te/ dper na tsan dan gyi zhog ma dang / gyo mo dang / 'khar ba'i snod dang / gser gyi rgyan bzhin no zhes so/ /de'i bde ba ni snying stobs yin te/ grangs gzhung 'a sa/rangs dang mgu dang kun dga' dang / /bde dang zhi ba'i sems nyid 121

dag /lan 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /de dag snying stobs yon tagarna/ zhes so/ sdug bsngal ni rdul gyi yin te/ de nyid las/ mi dga' ba dang yongs gdud dang / /mya ngan 'dod dang mi bzod dag /gang du snang ba'i gtan tshigs kyis/ /de dag rdul gyi rtags su 'dod/ ces so/ /gti mug ni mun pa yin te/ de nyid las/ rmongs dang de bzhin gti mug dang / /bag med gnyid dang g.yel ba dag /lan 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /de dag mun pa'i yon tan no/ /zhes so/ legs ldan dang ka shīs bshad pa ltar/ nga rgyal ni skal ba dang ldan pa'am mdzes pa'o sogs su ngar 'dzin pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal te/ blo las de 'dra'i nga rgyal gsum skye ste/ snying stobs shas che ba'i nga rgyal las dbang po bcu gcig skye/ legs ldan ltar/ mig sogs lnga chos can/ blo'i dbang po yin te/ rang gi don rtogs pa'i phyir ram blo sngon du btang nas 'jug pa'i phyir ram sgor gyur pa de nas skyes bu'i don rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ngag sogs ni chos can/ las dbang zhes bya ste/ bya ba sngon du btang nas sam skyes bu'i bya ba la nye bar gnas pa'i phyir/ yid chos can/las blo gnyis ka'i dbang bo zhes bya ste/ sems dang mtshungs bar ldan pas blo'i dang / bya ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i phyir las kyi dbang por bshad pa'i phyir/ mun pa shas che ba'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i nga rgyal las sgra de tsam sogs lnga dang / de lngas mkha' sogs 'byung ba skye zhing / rdul las gyur pa'i g.yo ba shas che ba'i nga rgyal gyi de gnyis kas 'jug pa pyed —de/ de gsum gyi dpe rim bzhin/ bram ze mo bu bcu gcig pa dang /122

dmangs mo las thā lnga btsas pa dang / de gnyis kyi khyo bram ze gcig gis ༄gyis pa gsum lta bu yin par 'grel bas bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ spyi bdag bden dngos gzhan rdzun/ zhes pa'i don ni/ shes bya nyer lnga'i rtsa ba'i spyi dang bdag gnyis bden grub kyi dngos po dang / gzhan gnyis rdzun grub yin te/ dartsam rgyan rang 'grel las/ drang srong chen po ser skyas smras pa/ yon tan rnams kyi rang bzhin mchog /mthong ba'i lam du 'gro ma yin/ /mthong ba'i lam du gang gyur te/ /sgyu ma lta bur shin tu gsog /ces so/ /lung 'dis mi gsal ba'i shes bya don dam dang /gsa'/ ba'i shes bya kun rdzob tu bayad pa'i shugs kyi shes bya thams cad gsal mi gsal gnyis su 'ang 'du la/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/rgyu dang ldan pa dang mi rtag pa dang / thams cad la ma khyab pa dang / byed pa dang bcas pa rnam pa du ma dmigs pa dang brten pa dang / 'gro ba dang cha bcas dang / gzhan gyur pa'i khyad par dgu bo'i rnam can ni gsal ba dang / bablog pa dgu ni mi gsal ba'i don yin pa'i phyir te/dbang phyug nag pos/ rgyu ldan mi rtag ma khyab pa/ /byed ces du ma rten pa 'gro/ /cha shas dang bcas gzhan dbang gsal/ /bzlog pa dang ni mi gsal ba'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi ba ni/ skye ba'i tshul/ sngar yod gsal 'gyur/ zhes pa grangs can lugs gnyis ka'i skye ba'i tshul 'bras bu sngar yod pa dang / rgyu dang ngo bo gcig pa zhigasngar mi gsal ba gsal bar byung ba skye bar grangs can kha cig 'dod la/ la la zho lta bu de 'o ma'i dus su 'o ma'i ngo bor gnas pa rkyen gyis zhor 'gyur ba lta bu'i rnam par 'gyur 123

bar 'dod pa'i lugs gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ dang po ni shes rab sgron me las/ de ma skyes pa ni bden mod kyi 'on kyang gsal bar byed do/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bshad las/ grangs can dag la grub mtha' smra ba mang du yod pa dag nas gsal bar smras pa dag na re/ zhes rma nas/'on kyang gsal bar byed do zhes bya ba ni/ snga na yod pa nyid rkyem/ gyis gsal bar byed do/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa'i tshul yang / grangs can gzhung las/ zho gang yin pa de 'o ma/ /'o ma gang yin pa de zho zhes/ /drag po len gyi bshad pa ste/ /de bzhin 'bigs byed gnas pa'ang 'chad/ ces dang / tshad ma'i de nyid dka' 'grel las/ gang gi phyir sbrul 'khyil ba la sogs pa bzhin du chos can la sogs pa'i ngo bor 'gyur bar 'gro bas chen po la sogs pa de dag gi rgyu yin no zhes bstan la/chen po la sogs pa de dag kyang gtso bo de yongs su 'gyur ba'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'bras bu nyid du bstan no/ /yongs su 'gyur ba yang dngos po gcig la gnas nga/'i phyir/ tha mi dad kyang 'gal ba med do/zhes pa 'dis ngo bo dor ma dor dang / phyogs gcig gam thams cad nas 'gyur brtags na de'i lan/ de nyid las/ ci ste yang chos gzhan rnam par gnas pa la chos gzhan log pas chos gzhan skye ba na yongs su 'gyur bar brjod kyi/ rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni ma yin no/ /snyam du sems na zhes pa 'dis/ chos gzhan las don gzhan yin min brtags nas bkag /de'i lan de nyid las/ gal te de dang 'brel ba'i chos gnyis skye ba dang 'jig pas de yongs su 'gyur bar bzhag gi gzhan ni ma 124

yin no/ /zhes pa 'dis yod med gang la 'bre'/ brtags nas bkag /med pa mi skyed pa'i phyir dang / skye bo rnams kyi rgyu so sor len pa'i phyer dang / thams cad ma skye ba'i phyir dang / nus pa ni nus pa byed pa'i phyer dang / rgyu yod pa'i phyir 'bras bu ni skye ba'i snga rol rgyu dus nas yod ces gtan tshigs gsum gyis sgrub par ka shrīs bshad do/ /de yang sangs rgyas pa ltar rgyu 'bras ngo bo tha dad ma yin par ngo bo gcig yin te/ yon tan gsum gyi ngo bo dbyer med pa'i phyir/ de skad du yon tan gsum dang dbye ba med ces so/ /lnga ba ni/ 'jig pa thim mam zhi/ zhes pa ni/ ka shrīs/ de 'di ltar 'jig pa'i dus na 'byung ba rnams ni de tsam la thim mo/ /de tsam ni dbang po lnga la'o/ /dbang po ni nga rgyal la'o/ /nga rgyal ni blo la'o/ /blo ni gtso bo la thim ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'jig pa ni gsal ba de dang de rang gi rang bzhin la thim pa'am/ de'i ngang du zhi bar gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa lhar bcas grangs can lugs ni/ sna tshogs gtso tsam las min semasamed phyir/rke /byin med mi rtsom skyes bus min mi shes/ /rang bzhin ngor gnas yon tan de gsum gyis/ /skye gnas 'jig cing rgyu yoda'ang rim phyir 'bras/ zhes bya ba ldo /da bcud tha dad cing sna tshogs pa 'di ni gtso bo 'ba' zhig las byung ba ma yin te/de la ni sems pa med pa'i phyir/ sems pa med par byin gyis brlob pa po med cing de med par rang gi 'bras bu rtsom par byed pa ma mthong la/ skyes bu'ang byin gyis brlob pa por mi rung ste/ de'i tshe mi shes pa'i phyir/des na lha sbyin gcig pu byed po min la rdza mkhan 'ba' zhig kyang bum pa 125

byed po ma yin pa'i phyir te/ ka shrīs/ de la grangs can kha cig ni gtso bo 'ba' zhig 'bras bu tha dad pa 'di dag 'jug pa ma yin te/ zhes pa nas/ de lta bas na dbang phyug nyid gtso bo la ltos nas 'bras bu tha dad pa'i byed po nyid yin gyi/ 'ba' zhig ni ma yin no/ lha sbyin la sogs pa gcig pu skyed par byed pa'ang ma yin la/ rdza mkhan 'ba' zhig gis kyang bum pa ma yin no/ zhes so/ /rgyu rang bzhin dang dbang phyug gnyis rtag tu yod kyang / rim gyis 'bras bu thams cad la 'jug tshul yod de/dbang phyug gi lhan cig byed pa gtso bo la yod pa'i yon tan gsum gyi nang tshan rdul shas cher 'phel ba dang ldan tshe dbang phyug skye dgu rnams kyi 'byin pa'i rgyu yin te/ rdul ni 'byin pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du gang gi tshe snying stobs shas cher dang ldan tshe/ de 'jig rten gnas pa'i rgyu yin te/ snying stobs ni gnas pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gang gi tshe mun pa shas cher 'phel ba dang ldan tshe/ de snod bcud kyi 'jig pa'i dang nyams pa'i rgyu yin te/ mun pa ni 'jig pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu de gsum dang dbang phyug dus rtag tu gnas kyang / 'bras bu skye gnas 'jig gsum rim gyis byed de/ rgyu rdul sos/sa gsum cha shas che ba rim gyis 'byung ba'i phyir zer te/ zhi 'tshos/ ci ste gtso bo'i ngo bo ni/ /tshul gsum nyid du rnam par gnas/ /de la dbang phyug 'di rdul dang / /sdon na 'byin pa'i rgyu yin no/ /zhes pa nas/ de ltar rdul dang snying stobs sos/sa/ /dngos rnams 'di yis lhan cig byed/ rim pa kho nar 'byung 'gyur te/ /de phyir 'bras bu rim byed yin/ zhes dab/4 grangs can gzhung 126

las/ skye ba dang ldan rdul la brten/ /snying stobs 'phel ba gnas pa yin/ /mun pa reg tshe phye dgu 'jig /skye med 'byin gnas 'jig pa'i rgyu/ /gsum gyi rang bzhin/ yon tan ni/ /gsum gyi bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes so/ /sa/nyis pa lam ni/ bsam gzugs mngotsha shes gtsor lta'i lam sogs kyis/ zhes pa 'jug 'grel ltar bsam gzugs brgyad dang / mngon shes la brten nas de kho na nyid du 'dod pa'i gtsa bo dang bdag sgom pa dang / gtso bo dang bdag gcig gis gcig rang min pa'i tshul gyis stong ba'i gzhan stong sgom pa sogs thar lam yin zer/legs ldan gyis rang bzhin gang zhig rtog pa med/ /yon tan sa/sum dang skyed bdag nyid/ de las bablog pas skyes bu nyid/ /'di dag rtag tu ba sgom par bya/ zhes dang / bdag kyang gzhan la rang banin gzham// /de ltar de nyid rma tho nga nga yi/ /byed dang bya ba ldong/ pa yi/ /skyes bu gril ba yin zhes brjod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa thar ba dang de'i lam gyi khyad par skyon yon sogs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'ba' zhig rang bzhim/ bdag sa/nas thar ba gnyis/ zhe sa pa grangs can sa/zhung las/ skyes bu mthong ba'i don du dang / /de bzhin gtso bo 'ba' zhig do na/ /zha long bzhin du rga/nyis ka'i papreng / /'brel ba de yi 'a/yer bar byas// zhes pa ltar/ rang bzhin long ba rkang can lta bu dang / skyes bu zha bo miji/ can lta bu gcig tu 'khrul ba dang 'dzin pa'i tshe 'khor bar — 'khor la/ nam zhig bsam gtan la brten pa'i mngon shes kyirtswakyi bdag dang rang bzhin phan tshun gzhun du rtogs tshe rang bzhen gyis gsal ba 127

rnams mi sprul zhing / bdag la mi 'gro bar bdag 'ba' zhig pa de thar bar grangs can kha cig 'dod la/ yang grangs can la la ni/ bdag kyang skyes bu 'di'i min la/ skyes bu 'di yang bdag gi ma yin no zhes de kho na nyid mthong bas rang bzhin gyi skyes bu'i don byas zin nas/ skyes bu las rang bzhin grol ba thar bar 'dod pa'i tshul gnyis yod de/ dang po ni/legs ldan gyis/ rang bzhin kyang gzhan la bdag kyang gzhan no zhes de kho na nyid mthong ba zhes pa ma/sa/ rang bzhin la sogs pa'i 'ching ba las skyes bu thar ba yin no/ /zhes bya ba ni grangs can pa kha cig yin no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa'i tshul yang de nyid kyis/ yang kha cig ni rang gi grub pa'i mtha'i dbye bas zhes pa nas/ des na bdag gi don byas pa yin zhing / skyes bu la thams cad kyi rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ skyes bu las rang bzhin grol ba yin no/ /zhes dang / grangs can gyi gzhung gser bdu na cu ba las/ rang bzhin sna tshogs rten can ni/ /'khor dang 'ching dang thar bar 'gyur/ zhes rang bzhin la 'khor 'das gnyis bshad pas so/ /'di yang kho bo'i rnam dpyod kyis legs par phye bar dpyod ldan rnams kyis shes par gyis/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshan nyid lnga bcuga'aching thar gsum gsum sogs/ zhes pa/ spyir 'di ba'i lam gyi skyonarteyon bsdus nas mtshan nyid lnga bcur bshad de/ legs ldan gyis/ rang ba'i/na 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ni lnga bcu ste/ 'di lta ste /mgu ba mi/ dgu'o/ /grub pa ni brgyad do/ /nus pa ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad 4do/ /phyin ci log ni lnga ste/ de ltar lnga bcu'o/ /zhes so/ /de la rangarte128

bzhin las 'bras bu thob kyi/ skyes bus ma yin par shes nas dga' ba ni chu zhes bya la/ de bzhin du nyer len las de ltar shes pa chu rgyun dang /dus kyi de ltar shes pa chu bo dang / bskul pas de ltar ni char 'babs pa dang / skyon rmothong thar bar dga' ba ni legs rgal/ bsrung ba'i skyon dang thar ba mthong ba ni mig bzang / dbang po mthong ba 'od can/ 'tshe mthong thar dga' lus mchog dgu ni yongs su mnyes pa'i phyir mgu ba zhes bya ste/ legs ldan gyis/ mgu ba dgu yin te yongs su mnyes pa zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go /zhes so/ ye shes las skyes pa'i grub pa ni brgyad de/dpyad pa'i shes pa ni sgrol ba'o/ /thos sogs kyis shes pa ni legs sgro la/sgra don bla ma las rnyed pa'i de ni sgrol ba'i mthar phyin/ tsha gra/nga bsgrog thabs kyi de dga' ba/ nang gi nad bablog thabs bla mas rnyed pa ni rab dga'/ 'byung ba dang mi mi min sogs kyis bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rtsod sogs zlog pa bla ma dang / rang gang rung gis shes nas grub pa de mgu bar gyur pa dang / tshangs spyod shes pa ni nyams dga' dang / bla ma sogs kyi bsnyen bkur sogs shes pa ni rtag dga' ste brgyad po de yin pa'i phyir te/ legs ldan gyis/ ye shes las skyes pa'i grub pa ni brgyad de grub pa'i phyir dang bsgrub pa'i phyir na grub pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de dag ni lam gyi yon tan gyi khyad par yin la/ lhag ma nus pa dang phyin ci log rnacha/sa ni skyon te/ 'on pa sogs dbang po bcu gcig la gnod pa'i nus pa bcu sacig dang / mgu ba dgu'i mi mthun phyogs range bzhin yongs su zin kyang thar bar mi dga' ba'i chu min pa sogs dgu dang / grub pa 129

brgyad kyi bzlog zla sgrol ba po min pa sogs brgyad dang / nus ba nyerangabargyad dang mun pa rmongs pa rmongs chen shiske tu mun pa shin tu smag tu gyur pa lnga ni phyin ci log lnga ste/ rim bzhin gzhan min la gzhan du dang /ligs min la yang dag par sgrub pa dang / bde min 'a/ bde bar nga rgyal ba dang / mi nus pa la de ltar dang / mi bzod pa bzod par yid ches pa rnams su 'dod do/ /slob dpon 'igs ldan gyis/ skyes bu 'ching ba rnam pa gsum gyi bcings pa las thar ba rnam pa gsum 'byung ba ni thar ba zhes bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rang bzhin 'ching ba/ 'gyur ba'i 'ching ba nor gyi 'ching ba gsum dang / de gsum las grol ba'i thar ba gsum dang / sogs sgras de nyid nyi shu lnga shes na/ zhes sogs ltar gyi khyad nga ra yang 'dod ces so/ /gnyis pa de dgag pa la/ skye tshul 'gal ba dang / 'jal sogs mi rung ba dang / 'ching grol mi rung ba gsum las/ dang po ni yod kyang skye na don med thug med 'gyur/ /skyed byed rtag dang ma nyams 'bras ldog 'gal/ zhes pa 'bras bu rgyu dus na yo da kyang skye zer ba de chos can/ skye ba don med par thal/ yod pa'i phyir/de la ma khyab na de chos can/ khyod kyi skye ba thug pa med par thal/ skyes zin slar yang skye ba'i phyir/ ji skad du zla ba'i zhabs kyis/ skyes zin slar yang skye bar yongs su rtog par 'gyur na ni/ /myu gu la sogs rnams kyi skye ba 'dir rnyed mi 'gyur zhing / /sa bon srid mthar thug par rab turdzoskye ba nyid du 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas dpal ldan sangs rgyas bskyangs mirig pa'i ral gri chen po'o/ — /de nyid snang ba'i rab byed las kyang /rwa30

—rang gi bdag nyid skyed pa med/ /grub pa yin na dbyer med phyir/ /bdag nyid skyed pa byed med de/ /'di ltar bdog nyid sgrub na yang / /de tshe des skyed ci zhig yod/ ces gsungs so/ /rang bzhin choṭari can/'bras bu mi skyed mer thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyis byas pa'i 'bras bu nyer gsum ldog mi rung bar thal/ de dag skyed byed rgyu tshogs tshang ba khyod rtag tu ma nyams par gnas pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / spyi rtag pa cha med kun la khyab pa'i ngo bor 'bras bu kun yod pa dang / de'i 'bras bu ldog pa sogs kyi grangs can lugs 'di chos can/'gal 'du dang ngo mtshar ba'i lugs yin par thal/ nu gro dha'i sa bon chung ngu'i nang na n+ya gro dha chen po de yod pa dang / zas kyi nang phyi sas khyab nas yod pa sogs bem po yin pa'i 'di'o snyam pa'i rnam rtog can dang /skyes bu rtag pa 'gyur ba med par lha mi dang dud 'gro sogs dang rigs bzhi 'dres par thal ba dang / thar ba med par thal ba sogs kyis gnod nga/'i phyiro te/ dbu ma snying po las/ n+ya gro bha yi sa bon gyi/ /nang na yod pa'i rgyu gro snya/ /bud med skyes pa 'grogs la bu/ /rnga yi nang na sgra gnas dang / /zas kyi nang na phyi sari/ sogs/ /shing la 'bar yod mi mthong zhes/ /gang zhig mngon sum spong byed pa/ /de ni bden smra ji ltar yin/ zhes dang / de ltar grangs can de nyid ni/ /sngon dang phyi mar 'gal ba dang / /rigs pa dang ni mi ldan la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi blo ṣ+pe'ajug /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bem phyir mi myong khyab phyir cha med 'gal/ /zhes pa blo chos can/ bde sduke sogs mi myong bar thal/131

bem po yin pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin dang skyes bu chos can/ cha med ma yin par thal/ kun la khyab pa'i phyir te/ rtog ge 'bar ba las lha dang lha min dang mi dang / dud 'gro'i 'gro ba rnams kyi so so'i 'u sa re re la'ang skyes bu gnas shing / skyes bu de thams cad kyang / thams cad la khyab pa yin no zhes zer la/ zhes sogs dang / ka shīs/ gtso bo dang skyes bu de dag ni/ lha yul dang sa steng dang bar snang thams cad du khyab pa nyid kyis 'jug pa zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ rtag phyir shes min rtag la 'ching grol ci/ zhes pa gzhan yang / skyes bu las rang bzhin grol mi srid par thal/ rang bzhin cha med gcig yin la/ skyes bu mang po min pas gcig las grol kyang thams cad las grol dka' ba'i phyir/ dper na dpon po mang bo'i thun mong gi dpya bya de dpon gcig las grol kyang gzhan las mi grol ba bzhin no/ /dbu ma snying po las/ 'di yi ldog pa rigs min te/ /mang po dag gis thun mong phyir/ /ji ltar rje gcig shi gyur kyang / /tshogs pa dag gi bran bzhin 'dod/ ces so/ /skyes bu chos can/ shes pa ma yin par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ri de chos can/'ching ba dang grol ba ci zhig 'gyur te mi srid par thal/ khyod bcings ma bcing gi ngo bo la khyad par med par cha med kyi rtag par gnas pa'i phyir/grangs can chos can/ phyin ci log gi grub mtha' gang yin gyi gnyen por dpal mgon klu hūṃb yab sras kyi rigs pa yang dag re gnas par thal/khyod kyi rtag mtha'i ri4bo gang dang gang spros kyang / de stong bar bsil byed kyi gnam lcags du ma re gnas pa'i phyir/ dper na karnas 'phang mdung 132

spa gyen du 'greng ba bum pa lta bu la 'phangs pas skra gyen du 'greng sbrul du ngasgyur tshe/ mdung de mkha' lding dang / byi lar byas tshe de 'ug pa sogs byas te gang bsgyur gyi gnyen por gyur nas mthar bsad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ ji skad du dbu ma snying po las/ de ltar na yang spros gyur nas/ /rang gi lugs kyi skyon sped kyang / /smras pa'i skyon rnams med min te/ /gyen du skra 'greng bum 'dra bzhin/ zhes so/ /smras pa/ ser skya'i lugs ngan ljon pa la 'khyud pa'i/ /chur lhung spros pa'i 'khri shing yal ga la/ /mu stegs lta ngan lo ma phang phung can/ /lung rigs ral gri rnon pos 'di na bcad/ /grangs ser khyad par byung rim rnam dbye sogs/ /gang yang mi shes grangs can 'gog 'dod pa'i/ /bod rgan mang po'i lung rigs mun pa'i mda'/ /'phang tshul de 'dra shes ldan bzhad gad rgyu/ /mkhas par grags kyang rang bzhin smra ba dang / /rang bzhin rgyur smra gcig 'dzin nyer lnga'i chos/ /rgyu 'bras la sdud mi shes mdog gnagapa'i/ /bya rog shi ba'i phung po khyod su zhig /'phags yul mkhas mchog bye ba'i lugs bzang gi /rin chen sna tshogs sbyar ba'i sgyu rtsal las /thub gzhung sde snod bcu gnyis khyim gsal ba'i/ /a ho blo gros 'od stong ldan 'di rnyed/ ces grub pa'i mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa 'khrul spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kun mkhyen lam bzang gsal ba'i sgron me'i rnam bshad las/ grangs can dang ser skya pa dag gi rtag mtha' bsal ba'i le'u gsum pa'i rnam bshad byas zin to// pa 133

grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u bzhi ba tshangs sogs bzhi'i rtag mtha' dgag pa/gnyis pa la 'dod pa 'god/ de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/tshangs pa pa dang / brda sprod pa dang / rig byed mtha' ba dang / gsang ba pa'i 'dod tshul bzhi las/ dang po la/ ston pa rnam grangs thub mtha' gsum las/ dang po ni/ tshangs sogs ston dang / zhes pa/ tshangs pa dang sogs sgras skye dgu'i bdag po sogs ston par bya/ gnyis pa ni/bramyo/ ze rig byed sogs/ zhes pa/ tshangs pa'i skad dod prasma ṇa zur chag pa'i bram ze yin gyi/ de min pa'i brah+ma ṇa zur chag pa'i bram ze kun 'dir byas na ha cang thal bas bram ze ste tshangs pa'i bu'o/ ye shes kun btus las/ tshangs pa 'dod pa bram ze rnams/ zhes pa dang / 'grel bar/bskal ba dang po'i tshe phyi rol tu dga' ba thob pa'am/ tshangs pa'i bur khas len pa rnam sa ni bram ze ste/ de rnams ri thams cad tshangs pa'i sbrul bar 'dod pa zhes so/ /rig byed pa'ang mang po yod cing / bye brag pa sa/nyis yod par yang byang chub bzang pos bshad sgra bshad 'og tu'o/ /'di dag ni spyir tshangs pa 'i lugs yin/ bye brag so sor 'og tu 'chad do/ /gsum pa ni/ tshangs pa pad sgong las skyes dus ming bdun/ /zhal bzhi lus cha bzhi las rig byed bzhi/ /mi rigs bzhi skyes 'jig 134

ten byed pa po/ /rig byed rang byung a shwa me dh+wa mchog /ces pa tshangs pa dbang phyug gi blos sprul pa'i sgo nga dang / yang khyab 'jug gi lte ba'i pad+ma dang / yang kun btus 'grel bar/ gzhan yang mu stegs bye brag pa gang dag 'di skad ces/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gi rdul phra rab rnams zhes pa nas/ me'i dbus su tshangs pa'i sgo nga chen po 'od 'bar zhing gsal ba gnas pa/ de smin cing brdol ba las 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i mngal las byung ba/ pad+ma la 'dug pa/ gdong bzhi pa zhig byung ste/ des 'jig rten thams cad spul pa'o/ zhes zer ba yang tshangs pa 'dod pa ste/ zhes gsungs nga ltar/ dbang phyug gi sa po na chur 'phangs pa las tshangs pa gser sgong dang / pad+ma'i ma ngal nas pad+ma'i gdan dang bcas te skyes pas skye gnas gsum byung la/ spyir mngom/ brjodaskelas ming mang po bshad kyang / dus bdun la ming bdun byung bar 'dod de/ de'i gzhung las/ 'di ltar 'di bskal ba gzhan la ni skal ldan zhes bya/ dang po la ni rang byung zhes bya/ gnyis pa la tshangs pa zhes bya/gsum pa la skye dgu'i bdag po zhes bya/ bzhi ba la pad+ma'i skye gnas canazheṭasu bya/ lnga ba la ni gdong bzhi pa zhes bya/ drug ba la ni mes po zhesar+shabya/ /bdun pa la gser misnying po can zhes bya'o/ /skye dgu'i bdag po byung nas ni 'jig rten gyi ma brgyad bskyed do/ /de nas nyi ma'i mas ṣ+kalha thams cad bskyed do/ /sbyin byed ma'i maru/ ni lha min bskyed do/ /klu'i mas ni klu rnams bskyed do/ /nam mkha' lding gi cashaṃ rngag ni nam mkha' lding rnams so/ /tshangs pa'i kha nas ni bram ze rnams so/ /dpung pa4135

la/sa ni rgyal rigs rnams so/ /brla dag las ni rje'u rigs skyed do/ /rkang pa'i mthil dag las ni dmangs rigs rnams so/ /zhes sogs dang /dus 'khor dang snyan ngag ltar/ zhal ras bzhi las rig byed bzhi dang /lus kyi cha kha dpung brla rkang mthil bzhi las mi rigs bzhi skyes pas 'jig rten byed pa po/ rig byed ni sus kyang ma byas pa'i rang byung nam mkha' lta bu dang / der bshad pa'i rta'i mchod sbyin nam bsang mchod las lhag pa'i mtho ris dang tshangs pa sgrub thabs med skad de/ a shwa rta dang / me dh+wa mchod sbyin te/ rwa 'gyur las bsang mchod du bsgyur yang kha cig ni a shwa ma dang e dh+wa byas nas de ltar bshad do/ /'di sham bha la'i yul gyi tshangs pa pa'i 'dod tshul du snang / rta'i mchod sbyin byed tshul dpyod pa pa dang 'dra la/ rig byed las/ de bzhin du me la skyes bu dang / rta dang ba lang dang ra rnams bsreg cing bsad par bya'o/ /yang na de dag dbugs bsub la bsad par bya ste sems med par bya'o/ /yang na mes bskor ba'i dkyil du tsha bas gdung bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / rta dab/ gi mchod sbyin la rta re re la khab lnga brgya lnga— brgya btsugs pa bzhin du zug gzer dang ldan par byas nas sbyin bsreg bya'o/ /zhes rjes su gnang ba yod ces dang / legs ldan gyis/ rig byed las smras pa phal cher ni 'brel med pa'i ngag kyal ba mang du brjod pa yang yin/ gsungs pa ltar/rig byed las/ lha tshangs pas khyod bskyed do/ /tha skar gyi bu ni dpung ba yin no/ /rgyal ni lag pa yin no/ /me lha mchod pa'i khas ni khyod blangs lo/ zhes/ sbyin spedag la bstod pa dang / de bzhin du gnyis kyis 136

tshangs pa'i glu len par byed de/ de'i glu las 'di lta ra/ tshangs pa de ni rgya cher gtsang bar byed/ swa te he he he ho ho ho/ hā hā hā ā+ogyi zhi/ gtso bo min pa lus kun tu sna tshogs lha de tsā tsā tsā/ ā hā ā hā ā hā hā hā hā ā ā hā hā hā/ legs ldan gyis zhes sogs don med pa'i tshig nyi tshe 'byung /zhes so/ /yang rtog ge 'bar ba las/ skye dgu'i bdag po gsal ba zhes bya ba de'i kha las skyes so / zhes sogs ltar tshangs pa'i kha las skye dgu'i bdag po skyes/ des mchod sbyin byed par tshangs pa spyan drangs te phebs bsur bu mo rnams btang bas de de dag la chags nas khu ba shor ba mer bsregs pa'i dbus su thub pa ngan spong dang / armi ra skyes/ de'i lhag ma dur ba'i nang du lus pa las drang srong a tri byung zhing / rig byed lung las/ snyan ngag ri la snyan ngag byas/ /srid srung ri la srid rig byas/ /skal ldan gyi ni phug ron can/ /nges brjod aṣ+ka ra bas byas/ zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs dang / 'phags bstod 'grel ba ltar/ ri bo snyan pa dang / skal ldan phug par drang srong i tis snyan tshig gi rig byed dang / srid srung gi rig byed nyi ma 'i rgyud byas/ ri bo nges par mngon brjod dang / yang mchod sbyin ngan spong dang aṣ+ka ra gnyis kyis byas zhes 'byung la/ yang de dag gis bton pa tsam yin pa'i phyir byed pa po mi dran pa'i phyir ma byas zer zhing / yang la la tshangs pa thog ma nas gdong bzhi can gser sgong las skyes zer/ yang kha cig 'apāgs bstod las/lha chen thig le mchog ma la/ /chags pa skyes pas gdongapho bzhi byung / /mi gsungs pa ltar de nas byung zer ba sogs mi 'dra ba mang du rig byed la rke 137

yod par gsal lo/ /gnyis pa la'ang ston ༵ ming 'dod tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ rtag zhi ston pa zhes pa/ gangs can sgra bsgyur yongs kyi phyi mo thon mi'i gsung las/ gang gi ming gzhi sngon gsungs pa/ /rtag zhi pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes pa ltar tshangs pa rtag zhi ba dang / sogs sgras dbang po sogs ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ brda sprod sgra byed ming /tshe/sa pa byā ka ra ṇa brda sprod pa'am/ lung ston pa dang / sgra byed pa sogs ming dza / /gsum pa la gzhi lam 'bras gsum tshad ma dang bzhi la sa/dang po mi// sna tshogs gzhir byed sgra yi tshangs pa smra/ /oṃ ring dngos kun rang bzhin cha med rtag /bden 'jug rab rib kyis bslad sna tshogs snang / zhes pa tshad ma'i de nyid las/ skye 'jig med par yang dag gnas/ /sgra'i rang bzhin tshangs pa mchog /gang de yongs su gyur pa ni/ /dngos po'i 'gro 'di rab shes bya/ zhes gsungs pa sna tshogs kyis dngos po thams cad skye gzhi 'am/ dngos por gyur pa'i sgra'i tshangs pa zhes bya ba thog mar skye ba dang tha ma 'jig pa med pas rtag pa rigs pas dpyad bzod gcig yod par 'dod de/ de yang tshangs pa'i gzhung las/ thog mtha' med pa'i tshangs pa ni/ /sgra yi de nyid yi ge gang / /gang la 'gro ba'i tha snyad 'byung / /don gyi dngos po yod gyur pa/ zhes so/ /de yang phyogs dang dus kyi cha med pa dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin a u ma gsum gyi bdag nyid ye ge oṃ zhes bya'o/ /de skad du rig byed las/tshangs pa dang ni nor lha yis/ /glur blang gsang ba oṃ zhes bya/ /tshangs pa'i mi ge de nyid ni/ /ye shes ku na la khyab pa yin/ /de ni tshad gsum 138

gsal ba yin / zhes sogs dang / yang la lar a a mu lam ste yi ge phyed dang bzhir yang bshad pas oṃ ring po yang 'dod/ yul la sgra de dngos dbang gis bden par 'jug la/ /phyi nang thams cad de gcig pu'i rang bzhin du don dam par gnas kyang / rab rib can gyis nam mkha' stong bar skra shad 'dzag snang ltar ma rig pa'i rab rib kyis blo'i mig bslad pa dag la sngon po sogs gzung 'dzin sna tshogs su rlom nas 'dzin zer te/ji skad du rig byed las/ ji ltar nam mkha' dag pa la/ rab rib kyis bslad skye bo yis/ /rab rib sna tshogs dag ngag ni/ /ldan pa bzhin du mngon par rlom/ /de ltar bdud rtsi 'gyur med pa'i/ /tshangs pa 'di ni ma rig pas/ /rnyog pa bzhin du 'gyur ba ste/ /tha dad dngos por rnam par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sgra'i rjes 'jug ma gtogs pa/ /shes de 'jig rten na yod min/ /shes pa thams cad sgra dang ni/ /ldan pa bzhin du skye ba yin/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa lam ni/ phyi nang sbyin sreg lam dang / zhes pa/ rgyugs kyi mchod sbyin sogs phyi'i dang / nang bud med lha ga'i thab tu khams 'dzag pa'i sbyin sreg byed pa lam gyi mchog tu 'dod de/ phyi'i de ni rig byed kyi gzhung las/ bar gyi dus la babs pa na/ /byol song drug gam bdun sbyar bya/ zhes sogs dpyod pa ba dang cha 'dra yang / tshangs pa gti mug spyod par bshad pas nang gi sbyin sreg khams 'dzag dus kyi rtog pa rags pa log pa'i snang pa stong sang nge la gtso bor lam du byed par snang ste/ rig byed las/ dbang pos shin tu mi rigs pa'i/ /ye shes nyi ma pa yi gzhung / /dga' ba tsam du rigs pa 139

ni/ /legs ldan smra ba'e sgrub pa po/ /nus can dang 'dus rab bskyod do/ /nus can dung can tha ma yi/ /bde ba gang du tshangs de nyid/ /bde ba de ni thar bar bshapa /sdug bsngale rnams dang phrad med pas/ /de la bde ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /dga' ba tshangs pa'i tshul yin te/ /de yang thar bar mngon par brjod/ /gang gang cung zad tsam snang ba/ de de tshangs pa zhes bshad do/ /semasar+ghaṃ tshangs pa nyid gnas kyis/ /de las gzhan du 'gyur ba med/ /gadza gis chags bcas sims kyis kyang / /mya ngan las 'das thob byed pa'i/ /dga' ba'i lta ba gcig pu las/ /lta ba gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /chos dang chos ma yin pa spangs/ /bden dang badzun pa gnyis spangs na/ /spang bya gang yin de spangs pa/ zhes so/ /de'i chos dang chos ma yin pa spangs/zhes pa ltar/ de dus kyi stong snang la chos nyid yin snyam pa dang / 'di yin gyi ngos bzung med par sems had po stong nyid kyi lta bar 'dod pa rnams ni 'di'i grub mtha' mdog ma 'gyur ba kho na'o/ /des na rje bdag nyid chen pos gsungs pa dus 'khor las kyang had lta de bkag snang ba 'og tu 'chad do/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dzag bde thar/ — zhes pa de 'dra'i bde stong had had de thar bar 'dod de/ de de kho na nyid dang /thar lam dang / thar ba rnams su 'dod pa'i phyir te/ci de nyid las/bde ba gang de tshangs de nyid/ ces de nyid dang / mya ngan 'das pa thob byed pa'i/ /dga' ba'i lta ba zhes thar lam dang / de yang thar bar—mngon par brjod/ ceṭashaṃ dang / bde ba gang de thar ba nyid/ ces thararte140

bar yang bshad/ yang rig byed las/ tshangs pa nyid ni 'jig rten 'byin/ /skye dgu sdud pa drag po ste/ /skyes bu nyid na btang snyoms so/ /rang byung gnas skabs gsum du 'dod/ /ces pa ltar de nyid gsum kyang 'dod de/ 'phags pa lhas/ 'di rnaspras de nyid rnam gsum gnas/ zhes so/ /brtul zhugs kyi khyad par dpyod pa ba'i skabs su 'chad do/ /bzhi ba ni/ tshad ma rig byed kho na la las gnyis/ zhes pa brda sprod pa phal cher mngon sum la 'khrul snang can mang la/ rjes dpag yang rigs pa bzang ngan gyis gzhan du 'gyur bas na rig byed kho na radzo byung gi tshad mar 'dod/ ston pa la la ste bri tra ha ri ni rig byed mi bslu ba yang rjes dpag la brten dgos pas mngon rjes kyi tshad ma gnyis kyang 'dod do/ /gsum pa rig byed mtha' ba la ston pa/ rnam grangs dbye ba grub mtha' bzhi las/ dang po ni/ tshangs sogs ston dang / zhes pa rig byed pa rnams tshangs pa rig byed 'chad pa por 'dod pa tsam mthun pas/ 'dir yang tshangs pa sogs ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ri ga byed mthar smra sogs/ zhes pa legs ldan gyi ltar rig byed rnams kyi mthar son par smra bas na ris/ byed kyi mthar smra dang / sogs sgras kun btus las/ bdag yod bram ze mchog rnams so/ zhes pa rtsa 'grel ltar/bram ze rnams las kho bo cag mchog go/ /zhes smra bas bram ze mchog smra ba dag go/ /gsum pa ni/ khyab phra zhes pas dbye ba'ang 'chad pas/slob dpon byang chub bzang pos/ de stobu'i dbang bo lnga dang nye bar ldan ya'i bdas 'dod pa dang / gzhun yang / — skra rte 'bum gyi tshad tsam 141

dang / shel sgong dag pa lta bu'i bdag mthe bong cha dang po tsam mam/yungs 'bru tsam mam/ ri rab tsam bstan par mi nus pa thams cad khyab pa'am/ lus med par rtogs pa rnams kyang bdag yod 'dod zlo zhes bsdu bar bya'o/ /zhes bram ze mchog smra'i dbye bar bdag che chung 'dod pa gnyis bshad do/ /bzhi ba ni/ khyab phra shes rtag skyes bu nyi ma'i mdog /mun 'das kho nas snod bcud 'ching sogs byed/ /gser mdog mthong tshe de char thim pa grol/ zhes pa/ skyes bu ni lus can tha5/sa cad dbang phyug gcig pu ba dang / 'gro ba rnams la khyab pa/nyams pa med pas rtag pa/ mya ngan las 'das pas tshangs pa/ phul du byung bas mchog /thog ma dang tha ma med pas 'chi ba med pa/ dmigs pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir gnas pa/ 'jig pa'i sngon rol nas yod pa'am/ gnyed log pa las gzhan pa'am/ skyong bar byed pa'am/ 'gengs par byed pas na skyese/ bu ste khyad par brgyad dang ldan pa/ nyi ma'i mdog can/ khams gsum du grags pa'i mun pa de las gzhan pa ste 'das pa gcig 'do da de/ ji skad du dbu ma snying po las/ gcig pu kun khyab rtag pa ste/ /tshangs mchog 'chi ba med pa'i gnas/ zhes dang / rig byed las/ skyes bu drang srong chen po nyi ma'i mdog /mun pa las gzhan gyur pa de rig na/ /'chi ba med par 'gyur te bdag gis rtogs/ /skye med gams 'gro ba la lam gzhan med/ ces dang / rtog ge 'bar ba las / 'jig pa'i sngon rol nas yod pa'am/ gnyid log pa las gzhan yin pa'i phyi ra skyes bu'am/ skyong bar byed pa'am/ 'gengs par byed 142

bas na skyes bu 'o/ /zhes so/ /nyi ma ni 'od sna tshogasacan/ dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ba bla dang / lungs pa dang / phug ron dang /btsod dang / ka pi dza la'i kha dog can yin pa ltar/ skyes bu'ang lha thams cad kyi bdag nyid dam/ dbang phyug chen po'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ kha dog de dang ldan te/ zla ba'i bdag nyid dkar po me lhadang zla ba gnyis las ni chu mdog /nor lha dag si/ dmar po dang / drag po dang bde byed kyi bdag nyid las ni dkar dmar dbang po las ni dug gshin sde las ni yungs mdog /gshin rje dang chu lha las ni rdul dang yungs mdog /karka nyid kyi nu/ smukyu/ po// sna tshogs kyi lha yin pas myu ra ba/dbang phyug yin pas/ tshangs pa'i mdog tu 'dod la/ legari smu ldan gyis/ma ti zhes bya ba rtag tu 'gro ba ste/ 'byung po thams cad rtag tu 'dir 'gro ba'am/ 'byung bo thams cad la rtag tu 'dis 'gro bas bdag go zhes gsungs pa/ lhuti 'am 'byung po zhes pa ni 'dir snod bcud gnyis ka la bya ste/ de thams cad 'byung sa dang thim sa gnyis ka yin zer 'dod pa'o/ /de skad du 'ang / byung gyuri 'byung dang byung ba dag /thams cad skyes bu 'dir 'dod de/ /de ni phyi nang ring ba dang / /de ni nye dang de las byed/ ces dang / rtog ge 'bar ba las/ steng gi phyogs ni 'di'i mgo bo'o/ /'og gi phyogs ni rkang pa'o/ /nam mkha' ni lto ba'o/ /phyogs rnams ni lag pa'o/ /gza' dang rgyu skar rnams ni skra'o/ /ri bo rnams ni brang ngo / /ri'i phreng ba ni rus ba'o/ /chu klung rnams ni rtsa'i dra ba'o/ /nags tshal rnams ni spudang sen mo'o/ /rgyab 143

ni mtho ris kyi 'jig rten no/ /dbral pa ni tshangs pa'o/ /chos dadzochos min pa ni smin ma gnyis so/ /khro gnyer ni 'chi bdag go /nyi zla gnyis ni mig go /zhes sogs dang de bzhin du dbugs 'byung rngub rlung / ri phran so lce dbyangs can ma/ oṃ dang ba sha tha'i yi ge gnyis mchu/ mig phye btsum dus/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs ni skyes pa bud med/ 'jig rten dang de min pa ni nu bar/ sor mo rnams ri'i bar/ pus mo gnyis gser 'ba' gnyis/ rje ngar gnyis tha skar bu gnyis skad smad ni nyin zhag mje rmig ni dbang po dga' ba'i rang bzhin skyed rgu'i bdag po rkang pa khyab 'jug dang de bzhin du thams cad la 'jug par bshad do/ /ji skad du/rig byed pas ma bkag sgrib med lha de gcig pu gnas/ /skyes bu de yis kun la khyab cing rgyas/ /phra ba bas kyang phra zhing che bas che/ zhes sogs dang / yang de nyid las/ lus lus med pa'i lus la ni/ /kun tu gnas med gnas pa ni/ /chen po gtso bo'i bdag nyid de/ /shes na mkhas pa mya ngan med/ ces dang / de bzhin du g.yo ba de yin mi g.yo de/ /ring tha de yin nye ba de/ /nang yang cirdo yin thams cad kyi/ /gnyis ka de yin phyi rol nyid/ ces so/ /gzhan yang / 'ching grol gyi bdag bum pa la chags na/ ma chags pa'i nam mkha' lta bu dang / tshad ma'i de nyid le'u drug pa las/ dbang phyug chos mtshungs skyes bu ni/ /'jig rten rgyur ni rtog par byed/ ces pa ltar/ dbang rgyug bzhin du snod 'byung lke'ajis/ gnas gsum gyi rgyu byed par khas len pa tsam 'dra yang /dedza 'grel ba las 'di tsam zhig ni khyad par yin te/ dbang phyug rgyur smra 144

ba rnams kyis ni dbang phyug las tha dad pa gzhan yang bdag la sogs pa dang / 'du mal la sogs pa rgyur 'dod la/ skyes bu rgyur smra ba rnams kyis ni skyesartsobu kho na rgyur 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skyes bu de kho nas snod bcud skye gnas 'jig gsum dang / 'gro ba 'ching ba dang /sogs kyi sgras sgrol bachodang / bde sdug che chung sna tshogs byed par 'dod de/ dper na ba las ba thag dang / chu shel las chu dang / lhug ma las yal ga bzhin skyes bu'ang skye ldan kun gyi rgyu yin no/ /ji skad du/ dar gyi srin bus/ smal ma bzhin/ /chu shel nor bu'i chu bzhin dang / /rgya gro yan lag gzugs rgyu bzhin/ /de ni lus can kun gyi rgyuta zhes so/ /'di'i lam ni bsam gtan la brten nas de 'dra'i bdag sgoms la/ skyes bu de mthong na gdol ba dang bram ze mnyam pa dang / sdig dang bsod nams mnyam pa sogs 'dod pa yin te/ dbu ma snying poho las/ des na bdud rtsi skyes bu nyid/ /ma rtogs bdud rtsi yod mi rigs/ /gcig pu kun gyi rtag pa ste/ /tshangs mchog 1spru ba med pa'i gnas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis goms byas na/ /desha nga srid len mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /spyir skyes bu de nyid mdog grol ba'i rtags su gser mdog mthong nas/ de rjes de'i char jim pa ni grolī ba'am thar pa yin te/ ji skad du/ byed po dbang phyug gser mdog tu/ /gang gis mthong zhing lta ba de/ /sdig dang bsod nams las 'das nas/ /mchog tu zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ zhes so/ /'dir rig sgyed la shin tu bsngags pas der ma bshad pa ni med par 'dod de/ rig byed las ni— gang mi smra/ /rig 145

byed las ni gang mi snang / /thams cad med par brjod bya ste/ /rig byed 'dru ba'i thos pa med/ ces so/ /bzhi ba la ston pa/ ming lung grub mtha' bzhi las/ dang po ni/tshangs sogs ston dang / zhes pa sla/ gnyis pa ni/ rig byed gsang ba pa/ zhes gnyis med lta ba pa dang / rig byed gsang ba pa dang / rna.oṃshes tshangs smra ba rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ bdud rtsi thig lung zhes pa tshangs pas gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi thig/ pa gsang pa zhes bya ba sogs kyi rig byed ni lung tshad ma'o/ /bzhi ba ni/ shes rig rtag pa'i bdag /cha med ngo bo nyid med bdin grub 'dod/ ces pa sa la sogs pa 'byung ba'i bdag tu gyur pa'i shes pa gcig pu ngo bo rtag pa gcig yod de/ de ni bdag kyang yin no zhes zer/ ji skad du/ sa dang me chu la sogs pa/ /de shes rtag pa'i 'jug pa 'di/ /de bdag can nyid bdag yin zhes/ /gzhan dag kyang ni smra bar byed/ ces so/ /sgrub byed ni/gang dag snang par gyur pa sa la sogarwa pa shes pa la ma gtogs pa'i gzung ba'i don med de/ yan lag canasku snga rdul phra rab rnams med pa'i phyir/shugs kyis sa sogs 'di dag rnam par shes pa la snang ba'i ngo bo kho nar rig par byed de/ ji skad du/ gzung ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i/ /'di ni cung zad yod min te/ /de phyir 'di dag thams cad dheni/ /rnam shes 'gyur bar yang dag snang / zhes dang / dbu ma rgyan rang 'grel du bdud rtsi thig pa gsang pa'i lung drangs par/ rnam rig tsam ni rtag tu rnam par dag /rtag tu rnamanepar grol phyir sangs rgyas yin/ /blangs 146

dang 'dor ba med ces rab brtags pa/ /tshangs pa mya ngan med par rtag gnas byos/ zhes dang / de'i don yang / dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel bshad las/ rnam rig tsam zhes bya ba ni/ bdag ces bya ba la ltos par bya ste/ gsang ba smra ba de dag ni srog chags thams cad la rnam par shes pa'i rang pazhin 'gro ba thams cad la khyab pa rtag pa gcig pu kho na'i bdag gcig yod par 'dod de/ rtag tu rnam par dag ces bya ba rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni ma rig pa'i gnyid dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ 'di thams cad ni don dam par na mi rtag pa 'dod chags la sdogs pa glo bur ba yin par rig par bya'o/ /blang dang dor ba med ces bya ba ni/ 'di la ma gtogs pa'i 'dod pa'am dor bar bya ba'am len pa'am blang bar bya ba med pa'i phyir/ tshangs pa zhes bya ba ni bdag gi rang bzhin yin no/ /zhes sogs bshad pas mes bor ma byed cig /gnyis pa de dag dgag pa ni/ rigs bzhi med 'gyur zhes pa/ mi rigs bzhi mi rung bar thal/ thams cad tshangs pa'e luṭashaṃ gcib/ la sa skyes pa'i phyir/ dper na ljon pa ba/cig gi stod smad ga/nga nas blangs yang shing rigs tha dad min pa bzhin ma khyab na u dum pa ra'i ljon pa gcig gi stod smad gang nas blangs pa'ang u dum pa ra'i shing du rigs mi gcig par thal ba dang / shing rigs gcig pa'i nags cha la med par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs bzhir ma gtogs pa'i khyi sogs shang nas skyes/ gzhan yang rdzogs ldan nas gnyis ldan yan chad du rigs zad pas so/ /de skad du don dam bsnyen pa las pha gcig la ni nges par 147

bu ni bzhir 'gyur te/ /bu de rnams la nges par rigaṅge ni gcig yinaneno/ /de ltar skye bo rnams kyi skyed byed dam pa gcig /rigs la rnam pa bzhi ste rigs pa yod ma yin/ /ji ltar u dum pa ra'i shing la skyes pa'i 'bras bu ni/ zhes pa nas/ gdong ba dang ni dpung ba brla dang rkang pa las/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dmangs rigs skye bar 'gyur/ /phyugs dang tha ma las skyes de yi gang nas byung / zhes so/ /de la bram ze rnams na re/ 'o na 'jig rten bram ze kha las skyes/ rgyal rigs dpung ba/ rje'u rigs brla las/ dmangs rigs rkang pa las skyes par grags pa'i don ni ji ltar 'dod zer na/ kha las chos/ ston pas dang / dpung pas 'khrug pas dang / brla yi stobs kyis don mthun 'gro bas dang /gzhan gyi rkang pa'i rtsa bar bsten nas rim bzhin grags par 'dod de/de nyid las/ kha las chos ni ston par byed pa grags pa yin/ /de phyir bram ze rnams ni kha las skyes par 'gyur/ /rgyal rigs rnams ni dpung bas 'khrug par byed pa ste/ /dpung ba de dag las ni de rnams skye bar 'gyur/ /brla yi stobs kyis skye bo rje rigs mgron por byed/ /de phyir de rnams de las skyes par 'gyur ba'o/ /rkang pa'i rtsa bar bsten par byed par grags pa yin/ /de phyir rkang pa las ni dmangs rigs skye bar 'gyur/ zhes so/ /ming sring kun spyad 'gyur/ zhes pa/ rigs bzhi so so'i ming sring kun spyad par thal/ bram ze pho mo kun zhal dang / de bzhin du gzhan gsum yang skye ba gcig nas byung ba'i phyir/ 'dod na gla —klo'i 'jug par 'gyur bas chos nyams par 'gyur/ ji skad du de nyidatso148

tre las/ bram ze mo yang gnas de nyid las yin nam ci/ /gal te 'a de dag skye gnas gcig las skye bar 'gyur/ /ming po dang ni sring mo bag ma'i rigs ma yin/ /gal te yod na kla klo'i rtogs pa'i 'jug par 'gyur/ sogs so/ /'tshe ba chos yin dmyal ba'i rgyu gang sogs/ zhes pa dmyal ba'i rgyu med par thal/ phyugs sogs gsod pa'i 'tshe ba chos yin pa'i phyir te/ sogs sgras skyes bu nyi ma'i mdog sogs 'gog /phal cher rtag gcig rang dbang can bkag pas khegs la/ bdag de chos can/ chem po ma yin par thal/ phra mo yin pa'i phyir/ gcig ma yin par thal/ du mar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ji skad du/ gal te phra yin 'di ni 'di che min/ /sogs so/ /'ching grol gnyis mi 'thad par thal/ de gnyis ka la bdag cha med gcig las med pa'i phyir/ sogs so/ /rig byed chos can/ tshangs pa'i kha las ma skyes par thal/ rang byung yin pa'i phyir/ skyes bu dmangs rigs sogs kun gyis 'don par thal/ kun la khyab pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir te/ don dam bsnyen pa las/ gal te rang byung yin na kha las ma skyes te/ gal te thams cad khyab na kun gyis 'don par 'gyur zhes so/ /smras pa/ tshangs sgras rtag bdag ma shes mes po ru/ /ngos bzung tshig don la rmongs smyon pa'i gar/ /byas pa'i yi ge rkang rjes nyes byed kyi/ /g.yang khar 'phyan la shes ldan tshogs rnams 'jigs/ /snod bcud byed po tshangs yig chos kun la/ /khyab pa'i skyes bu gcig 'dod smig rgyu'i chu'i/ /khyad par rgya rngams 'jal 'dod gzhan sde 'ga'i/ /blo ngan skyon ldan dbu ma'i lam 'dir gsal/ /rngonya lha

chos dbyings kun gsal mi mthong log rtospu gi /rmongs pa'i mun ngor rta sa/ bdag skrar 'dzag pa'i/ /rab rib skyed pa'i bag nyal nad gyi sman/ /zla bral bdud rtsisdiri bum bzang deng 'dir grub/ ces grub pa'i mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa 'khyol spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kun mkhyen lam bzang gsal ba'i sgron me'i rnam bshad las tshangs sogs bzhi'i rtag mtha' bsal ba'i le'u bzhi ba'i rnam bshad byas na to/ /

grub mtha'i rnam bshad me'u lnga ba khyabu 'jug pa dang dasprud pa ba'i rtag maba' dgag nga5gsum pa la 'dod pa dgod/ de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/khyab 'jug pa'i dang / spyod pa ba'i 'dod tshul gnyis las/ dang po la ston pa ming lung grub mtha' bzhi las/ dang po ni nor lha zla ba gzhon nu ma len ston/ zhes bya ba ni rig byed las/ skal ldan nor lha 'di ni zhes pa ltar/ nor lha sred med bu sogs ming shin tu mang ba'i khyab 'jug dang / ye shes kun bturi sdo las/ zla ba'i grub mtha' ba rtag tu/ /'phrog po la ni gus sa/zhol ba/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma zla ba dang /phyis kyi ston pa gzho'e / nu ma len la sogs ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/khyab 'jug pa dang zla ba glu'i chos smra/ zhes pa khyab 'jug ston par 'dzin phas khyab 'jug pa dang / byang chub bzang pos/ gang dag bla ma zla ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa de dag ni zla ba'i grub mtha' ba ste zhes pa ltar/ zla ba ba'am/ zla ba'i grub mtha' pa dang / 'grel chen ltar khyab 'jug gis gru'i chos mang po smra bas glu'i chos smra ba ste/ slob dpon snang bral gyis/nor lha yis/ glur blangs gsang ba oṃ zhes bya/ zhes so/ /des na bslu chos dang / klu chos zer ba rnams ma dag pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rtog phan yal ga mtshan mo lnga sogs lung / zhes pa rtog pa la phan pa'i yal ga151

dang / zhag lnga ba'am/ mtshan mo lnga ba'am/ rtag chad dang g.yul gyi las ston pa'i tshig sogs lung ngo / /bzhi ba la/ lha'i khyad par dang /de'i chos kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ lha khyab 'jug de'i gnas dang /'khor gyi khyad par ni/ khyab 'jug bud med mang bskor sgo ldan gnas/zhes pa smras te/ slob dpon shes rab go chas/ de nas khyab 'jug gis bsam pa/ nga'i chung ma'i tshogs khri drug stong grong khyer sgo ldan na gnas kyi/ zhes pa ltar/ gtso bor grong khyer sgo ldan na rgyal po dmyal ba las bud med stong phrag drug cu/ rgyal po byis pa'i btsun mo gser mdog ma rnams 'phrog pa'i bud med mang po dang lhan cig gnas par legs ldan ltar 'dod do/ /de nga rgyal gyis khas len pa'i khyad par ni/ nyi sogs mchog nga bram ze lus kyis byed/ ces bya ste/ de mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas nyi ma zla ba sogs brtan g.yo'i mchog gang yin pa de dang de nga yin zer te/ 'grel bshad sogs su khyab 'jug gis smras pa drangs par/nyi ma'i nang na nga khyab 'jug /skar nang 'od ldan zla ba dang / /rlung nang nga ni 'od zer ldan/ /snang ba'i nang na nyi ma yin/ /rig byed nang na snyan tshig dang / /lha nang nga ni brgya byin yin/ zhes pa nas/ ri yi nang na ri rab nga / /nga ni yi ge'i nang na a/ zhes smras so/ /bram ze'i lus kyis sbyin byed dang za ba sogs kyang 'dod de/ ji skad du nga ni me chu rlung yang yin/ /nga ni sbyin byed za ba po/ /nga ni zas dang skye dgu'i bdag /bram ze'i lus su nga gnas nas/ /za byed sbyin pa byed pa po/15pyes dang / gang dag lha gzhan dad byed cing / /dad ldan brtson

par byed pa dag /de dag nga la ku na snya'i bu/ /bya ba sngon du 'gro bas bsten/ zhes so/ /ngo bo'i khyad par ni/ ngo bo gnyis las zhi bsgom thar ba thob/ /ces pa/ legs ldan gyis/ khyab 'jug gi ngo bo nyid ni gnyis yin no/ /lha rdzas kyi ngo bo dang / sa steng gi ngo bo can yin no/ /de la lha rdzas ni zhi ba gcig pu'o/ zhis pa ltar/ de'i ngo bo zhi ma zhi gnyis/ las zhi ba yod rmad sogs las 'das pa sgom na thar ba spro ba par 'dod de/ ji skad du/ gang mthong dul yang yang srid du/ /'byung bar mi 'gyur gang yin pa/ /de ni yod min med ma yin/ /yod min med pa min pa'ang min/ zhes so/ /ngo bo ma zhi ba'i khyad par ni/ ma zhi'i nya dang rus sbal phag rgod dang / /mi yi seng ge mi'u thung dga' byed gnyis/ /nag pa sangs rgyas rigs ldan 'jug pa bcus/ /bton dang btegs mnan bsad bslus mgrin bcu bsad/ /rigs bcad don byas sdig sbyangs sems can btul/ zhes smras te/ sa steng gi ngo bo ma zhi ba'i 'jug pa bcur grags te/ gang zhig gang dang 'brel ba ni/ /ring na 'dug kyang de dang de/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshig rkang gong 'og sbrel nas bshad na/ nya yi gzugs kyis sngon rig byed bzhi dmod pa'i dbang gis rgya mtshor nub pa bton pa dang / rus sbal gzugs kyis 'jig rten bteg nas rgyun du gnas pa dang / phag rgod gzugs kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten ma—ne chad mnan pa dang / mi'i seng ge'i seng ge'i mgo can gzugs kyis lha min gyi rgyal po 'gro skyob gser can bsad pa dang / mi'u thung du sprul nas lha min stobs ldan la gom pa gsum gyi sa sgang zhes bslus lha53

pa dang / ra ma'am dga' byed gsum kyi dang po rgyal po shing rta bcu ba'i bu ra ma ṇa'am dga' byed du sprul nas lasku mgrim bcu bsad pa dang / dza mā da a smri'i bu ra ma ṇa ste dga' byed du sprul nas rgyal po srid sgrub sogs —bsad nas rgyal rigs bcad pa dang / nag pas rtsod dus su chu bo bzhi phyogs kun tu drangs shing bstan pa sogs sems can gyi don byas sangs rgyas shākya thub tu sprul nas sdig pa spyangs/ rigs ldan bram ze'i bu karki rtse zhes bya ba ma 'ongs pa na 'byung bas/ sem/sa can mang po btul ba'i 'jug pa bcur 'dod cing / dang po gsum la 'thad ldan med kyang ngo mtshar ched du byas pa'i gtam rgyud rnying ba la brten la/ gzhan rnams drang srong gdug pas ngo mtshar che che 'dra khyab 'jug gi yon tan du byas par dus 'khor las bshad do/ /rig byed las/ nya dang rus sbal phag pa dang / /seng ge'i mgo can mi'u thung dang / /ra mo ra ma khyab 'jug dang / /sangs rgyas ka la pi can bcu/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi dang po ni/ byed po bdag dang las dus rang bzhen dang / /yon tan nyams pa'i stong ba rgyu 'bras dang / zhes pa 'grel bshad las/ srid med kyi bu rgyud 'dod pa dag kyang / 'gro ba skye ba'i rgyu ni sred med kyi yin par rtog par byed de/ zhes dang / bha ra ta'i gtam rgyud chen po las/ khyab 'jug sna tshogs ston pa dag gi tshe na/ srid sgrub la sogs pas 'jig rten ma lus pa khyab najug gi las kyi khongs su gdod mthong ngobyu/ zhes pa ltar 'gro ba byed pa po dang / yang 'grel chen ltaranerdul phran rtag pa/ snod bcud kyi byed pa po dang / rtag pa cha med pa'i 15 — —

bdag dang / dge mi dge'i las dadz+wa/ dzas yod kyi dus rtag dngonodang / sa sogs kyi rang bzhin dang / snying stobs sogs yon tan dang /dngos po nyams pa'i stong ba dang / bskyed bya skyed byed sogs kyi rgyu 'bras dag tshangs pa pa'i 'dod pa dang bcas par 'dod de/ 'grel chen las/'dir de'i nang du 'dus pa'i khyab 'jug gi 'dod pa 'di lta ste/ zhes sogs so/ gnyis pa lam ni/ rlung yig sogs sgom zhes pa yi ge oṃ tshad gsum dang ldan pa dang / 'pho ba rlung sogs rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa bsgom na khyab 'jug gis grol ba'i dngos grub ster bar 'dod de/ ji skad du/ dbang po dag dang dbang don dag /rus sbal yan lag bzhin bsdus la/ /dran pa'i yi ge oṃ brjod na/ /de gus rjes su grol bar 'gyur/ zhes dang / 'pho dang bsam gtan rlung 'byung 'jug /gzung bar bya dang rtag pa dang / /ting 'dzin shes bya rnal 'byor gyi/ /yan lag drug tu brjod pa yin/ zhes sogs dang / gang gis khyab 'jug yon tan rnams/ /rtag tu bsgoms pas bde thob 'gyur/ zhes dang / skal ldan nor lha 'di ni thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs/ /'gro ba thams cad lhar 'dren thar ba sbyin par byed/ ces dang / kun btus las/ snying ga'i pad+mar rlung gis ni/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas bsgom par byed/ ces so/ / gsum pa ni/ thar 'dod 'khor mtha' 'dod/ ces pa 'dis kyang 'khor ba nyams pa'i thar ba'am/ 'khor ba nyams pa'i stong ba 'dod pas 'khor ba re nig pa'i mtha' can du 'dod do/ ji skad du/ skye dgu thar 155

bar bkod nas 'khor ba stong bar byid/ ces so/ /gnyis pa la ston pa ming grub mtha' gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyal dpog pa ston/ zhes pa khyab 'jug pa dang / rgyal dpog pa sogs ston par 'dod/ gnyis pa ni spyod pa rgyal dpog pa/ zhes pa spyod pa pa dang /rgyal dpog pa sogs so/ /gsum pa la bdag gi khyad par/ chos kyi khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag ni blo dang shes rig rtag rdzas sogs/zhes pa bdag ni grangs can ltar ma yin par blo'i ngo bo dang sems pa can dbang phyug pa ltar bem po ma yin par shes rig gi rang bzhin sangs rgyas pa ltar mi rtag pa ma yin par rtag pa'i ngo bo rgyang pan ltar lus semar+sā dbyer med ma yin par lus las yan gar ba'i rdzas yod/ rig pa can pa bzhin du rjes su 'gro ldog med pa ltar min par/ bde sdug so so'i dus kyi myong ba bo'i rnam grangs dang / gnas skabs mi rtag kyang skyes bu'i ngo bo la ldog pa dang cha sogs dbyer med par 'dod de/ dper na sbrul 'khyil ba dang brkyangs pa'i gnas skabs ldog pa tha dad kyang ngo bo sbrul yin pa mi ldog pa bzhin no/ /ji skad du/ tshad chen le'u brgyad pa las/ gzhan dag bdag ni ldog pa dang / /rjes 'gro bdag nyid can gyis ni/ /sems pa'i ngo bo nyid du 'dod/ /sems pa blo yi mtshan nyid can/ /dber na sbrul 'khyil gnas skabs na/ zhes sogs dang / gzhon nu ma lem/ gyis/ de phyir gnyis ka dor nas ni/ /ldog dang rjes dpag bdag nyid can / /skyes bu zhig ni khas blang bya/ /'khyil ba sogs la sbrul bzhin no/ /zhes so// /'phags bstod rtsa 'grel sogs layokyang bshad mod/ tshad chen 156

rtsa 'grel shin tu rgyas pas der ltos/ sogs sgras gtan tshigs yang bstan te/ bdag ni yod de/ ngo shes pa yod pa'i phyir dang / dran pa yod pa'i phyir sogs du ma bkod pas des bdag med 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas pa la gnod la/ /de skad du tshad chen las rnam pa de lta'i skyes bu 'di/ /ngo shes pa ni yod pa'i phyir/ /rtogs par 'gyur te 'di nyid kyis/ /bdag med pa la shin tu gnod/ ces sogs so/ /gnyis pa la rig byed tshad mar bshad nas spyi'i don dang / bye brag gi don gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rig byed las/ rig byed las ni gang mi smra/ zhes sogs dang /grangs can pa dang / bye brag pa dang / gcer pu pa dang / med par smra ba dang/ sangs rgyas pa la sogs pa rnams kyi lung ni brdzun yin te/skyes bus byas pa'i phyir rig byed ni rang byung ma byas pa chos dang / don dang thar ba dang / 'dod pa ste/ sde bzhi po mtha' dag 'byung ba 'di lung tshad ma yin no/ /ji skad du/ chags sogs rkyen gyis nyams pa'i phyir/ /skyes bu'i tshig ni brdzun nyid yin/ /rig byed skyes bus ma byas phyir/ /des na tshad mar gzung bar bya/ zhes dang / byed po mi dran par 'dod phyir/ /rig byed skyes bus ma byas la/ /brgyud nas 'ongs pa ma chad phyir/ /lung zhes bya bar bstan pa yin/ zhes so/ /'o na 'dir rigs pas brtags na 'thad dka' ba snang bas ji ltar snyam na/rig byed las bshad pa sun dbyung bar mi bya ste/ rjes dpag gis dpyad pa ni long ba nyam nga'i lam la rgyu ba dang 'dra ba'i phyir te/ ji skad du/snying dang shes pa can gyi chos/ /yan lag dang bcas rig gso ba/ /157

gnang ba'i grub pa bzhi bo 'di/ /gtan tshigs dag gis gzhig mi bya/ /long ba rkang pa'i tshod dpags kyis/ /nyam nga'i lam du rgyugs pa ltar/ /rjes su dpag pa gtsor 'dzin rnams/ /kung bar dka' ba ma yin no/ zhes so/ /spyir 'khrul ba bzlog pa las/ tshangs par gyur na ga/zi brjid che/ /dbang phyug thob na mthu stobs che/ /brgya byin khyab 'ju ga de bzhin te/ /klu dang gnod sbyin sman rnams bde/ /de phyir de dag thob pa'i thabs/ /gang dag sna tshogs yod pa dag /bya ba sla ba ci smos te/ /dka' ba dag kyang bya ba'i 'os/ zhes pa ltar lha de dag bde 'gro sgrub thabs rig byed las bshad pa rnams sla na smos ci dgos dka' na'ang sgrub par bya la/ sgrub thabs yang de nyid las/ me lnga bsten nas tshangs pa sgrub/ /dbyug gu gsum las dbang phyug che/ /bya ba'i dka' thub gtogs 'dod rigs/ /khyi yi brtul zhugs smin drug 'khor/ zhes nga / ltar rgyang pan lta/ bu re gnyisari min pa 'do da do/ /gnyis pa la 'bras bu'i khyad par/ de thob byed kyi lam/ 'jal byed tshad ma gsum las/dang po ni/ dri ma skyes bu'i rang bzhin kun mkhyen med/ /mtho ris thar 'dod 'ang de+os pa rnam 'grel las bshad pa ltar dri ma shes rig gi skyes bu'i rang bzhin la zhugs pa'i tshul gyis rten pa'i phyir skyon zad kun mkhyen med pa'i bden sdepa'i ngaspu/ yang med la/ mtho ris kyi tshangs pa lta bu'i khyad par ngan 'gro lase grol ba'i thar ba'am/ grol bar smra la/ 'bras bu de wo/ na las gzhan mi 'dod de/ /ji skad du/ sangs rgyas gsung yang tshad ma mi na/ /byas pa'i phyir na gzhan yin no/ tre /rdzogs pa'i sangagergyas 158

'o kun mkhyen min/ /skyes bu yin phyir gzhan yin no/ /zhes/ so/ /spyir 'di dag gis shing sogs sems ldan du 'dod pa dang / kun mkhyen med par 'dod tshul dag ni gcer bu pa'i ston pa rgyal ba dartsa/ pa'i lugs gzhir bzhag yin pas 'og tu 'chad la/ 'di pas rang gi ston pa rgyal dpos pa kun mkhyen du 'dod de/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ dze mi ni la sogs pa khyod kyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'dod pas ma nges pa yin no/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na'ang chos gcig kyang ma lu' par mkhyen pa'i kun mkhyen med de/ go ṭa bya mtha' yas pa' phyir dang / shes byed gzhan yod na thug med du 'gyur ba sogs kyi phyir 'jig rten na mi dang mu stegs la'ang de 'dra'i kun mkhyen med zer te/ spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis/ shes bya mtha' yas kun mkhyen min/ /shes byed gzhan yod thug pa med/ ces pa nas/ 'jig rtedzo/ dag na mi rnams dang / /mu stegs byed la'ang kun mkhyen med/ ces so/ /gnyis pa ni byas shugs zhe brgyad rgyu/ /rwa bzhi rkang gsum mgo gnyiru/ lag pa bdun/ /gsum ba cings khyu mchog nga ro rig byed khyad/ /gsum mam bdun bdu na mar gyi mchod sbyin 'dod/ ces so/ /byas pa'i shugs zhe brgyad bram ze dbang du bya ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ legs ldan gyis/ byas pa'i shugs zhe brgyad kyis bram ze dbang du byas pa yin no/ /zhes rgyas par brjod do//zhes pa nas/ khur bas mchod sbyin byas pa zhes bya ba de lta bu zhes so/ /spyir 'di'i mchod sbyin gyi dbye ba ni/ 'grel ba ltar/ zla mthong gi ring zla ba bzhi bzhi'i dang / zla ba drug drug phyugs 'dogs pa'i dang / rmi /na 'o 159

ma'i mchod sbyin deng / lo —brgya pargya zhing me mchodahāpa 'dod rme spyo da par byed par bshad/ cho ga'i khyad par/ rig byed las/ shiyorbarjod bstod dang cho ga'o/ zhes pa/ sa zhi bar gyur cig sos/sa shis pa sogs mang yang / zla ba bzhi bzhi dang / zla ba drug gi tshe tsu gas 'dogs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi phyugs rnams kha 'dogs shing / de ya nga byol so nga bcings tshulañcayang / bar gyi dus la babs pa na/ /byol song drug gam bdun sbyar bya/ /rta yi gsang ma'i tshig yin no/ /nyung na byol song gsum gyis so/ /re re la'ang grong gi mi/ /byol song bcu drug bcu drug sbyin/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod sdong gzugs/ /bar du bcu dang bdun sbyin bya/ /skyes bu'ang byol song du bsams nas/ /bramaze la ni bram ze bsad/ /rgyal rigs la ni rgyal rigs bsad/ /ma ru dag la rje'u rigs te/ /dka' thub dag la dmangs rigs so/ zhes dang / 'grel bshad ltar gso ba zhes bya ba'i mchod sbyin che/ ma dang bu sring sogs lhan cig gcer bur phyung nas/ phyugs bzhin rkang bzhi sa la btsugs nas/rtsa za ba ltar dang / mngal sgor lces ldeg /gshang sgor snom/ 'khrigs pa lhag par spyad la/ ba lang la rgan gzhon dang / ma sogs khyad med pa ltar byed cing / ba lang gi brtul zhugs blangs pa des lo gcig tu de ltar byed do/ /se 'u dra min gyi mchod sbyin la chang 'thung ba dang /gaṭā/na yang nang gi mchod sbyin ni/ go tam me ni bud med de/ /de yi nyer gnas thab khung yin/ /der skyes pa ni du ba yin/ /de na zhugs pa soke/ ba'o/ /de yi khu ba me stag yin/ /de lta bu yi me de la / /skyes 160

bu lha yi sa bon bsreg /sbyin sreg de laso skyes bu 'byung / /de skyes 'tsho bar 'gyur ba yin/ zhes de 'dra'i mchod sbyin med par ma tho ris gang yang mi thob ste/4 bu med pa la mtho ris med/ ces so/ /de lta bu'i ngo tsha zhing skyug bro ba kyang ste yi ges mi langs la/ de 'dre'i cho ga brda sna tshogs kyis sbas nas bshad pa ni/ rig byed las/ rwa ni bzhi'o/ /de'i rkang pa ni gsum mo/ /mgo bo ni gnyis so lag pa ni bdun no/ /de'i phyir gsum nas bcings na khyu mcho ga 'di ni nga ro 'don no/ /zhes sbras so/ /rwa bzhi ni/ snyan ngag /mchod sbyin srid srung nges brjod bzhi'o/ r+sha/snyan ngag gis me la thostod pa ra dang por zhugs pa ste/ dper na lha'i nang na mchog tu gyur pa lta bu 'di byed po lo ma can shing shun can sogs so/ /de bzhin du mchod sbyin gyi rig byed la zhugs pa las kyi gtso bo ste/ dper na mchod sbyin la khyod 'dod do sogs te/ dzasnya la dang ka na sogs so/ /mchod sbyin 'du byas pa'i phyir rwa gsum pa la 'jug par byed pa ni sdeb sbyor glur lem/ pa ste/ dper na me tshu ra spyon so ga/sa te/'di'i byed po ni/ phal la sogs so/ /las sgrub pa'i phyir rwa bzhi ba nges brjod la 'jug ste/ dper na lha spra mdzes ma dag la mngon par brtson par gyi sa/ zhes sogs/ lta bu'o/ /rkang pa gsum ni dus gsum ste/ dus tho rangs dus su thod pa brgyad du khur ba brgyad ba'/ga nas/yi ge brgyad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyis nor lha brgyad la 'bul/ de bzhin du drag po bcu gcig la thod pa bcu gcig gis/ gsum gsang sngags kyi sdeb sbyor sgos dus gnyis pa nyin byed dang / nyi ma bcu gnyis la yi ge bcu 161

gnyis pa'i sdeb sbyor gyis thod pa bcu gnyis su thun gsum par mchod ces pa'o/ /(rme nga ma me gsum ni rkang pa gsum ste sbyin sreg byas pa'i me'am/grong ba'i me'am/ lho phyogs kyi me'o/ /don du sgril na rkang pa gsum ni/mchod bstod gzhan la sbyar na dus gsum dang mchodasasbyin la sbyar na me gsum mo/ /legs ldan gyis/ mgo gnyis ni/ mchod sbyin byed pa dang / de'i chung ma'o/ /zhes phyi nang gi sbyin sreg la sbyar ba dang /legs ldan gyis/ yang mgo gnyis ni yi ge oṃ dang / dbyangs kyi stebi sbyo mi zhes bya'o/ /zhes 'don chog la sbyar ba'i tshul lo/ /lag pa bdun ni sdeb sbyor bdun de/ yi ge drug pa'i dang / bdun pa'i dang / brgyad pa'i dang / yi ge dgu ba'i dang / bcu ba'i dang / bcu gcig pa'i dang /bcu gnyis pa'i sdeb sbyor bdun no/ /gsum ni snying mgrin mgo gsum dang / khyu mchog ni yi ge oṃ dang / nga ro'adon pa ni dbyangs byed pa'i don de/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gsum nas bcings zhes bya ba ni/snying ga mgrin pa mgo bo nas te/ ngag khyu mchog yi ge oṃ 'di'o/ /'jig rten pa rnams kyi mchog yin pas na khyu mchog /nga ro 'don zhes bya ba ni/gang du sgra byed do zhes pa'i tha— tshig go/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu rig byed kyi khyad par rtog btags mang po dang / mchod sbyin gyi cho ga'i khyed par yang sngar bshad pa ltar shis brjod sogs gsum dang / zas bdun lce bdun drang srong bdun/ khyim bdun/ nyin zhag bdun du lan bdun mchod pa dang / skye gnas bdun du mar gyis tshim par byed pa zhes bdun tshad bdun gyi sgo nas bshad de/ bil pa dang / ba la sha dang / a shā6 162

dang / u dugab ra dang / a/rka dang sha mi dang / seng ldeng ste zas—bdun dang sreg rdzas dang / ga ya tri dang akhri ga dang / a nu thu pa dang / bri hi ta dang / saṅgati dang dri thru ba dang / dza ga ti stesdeb sbyor—bdun ni lce bdun dang / dbang po dang gsal ba dang / sde can dang bden ldan dang / gser can dang phyogs can dang / ka shu na dang sa la ga ste drang srong bdun dang / ang dh+wa phyu dang sbyin sreg dang me bstan pa dang / byams pa rlung lha dang / mnyam sgrol dang / tshangs/ pa dang mthong ston te nyin zhag bdun zhes bya ba dang / snga dro phyi dro sbyin sreg bya ba dang /snod du btso ba dang / 'dod pa brgyad dang / dbang du byed pa zhes bya bas lan bdun du mchod pa dang / sa dang rdo dang shing datso/ lcags dang blug gzar dang / chu dang pad+ma'i 'dab ma ste snod bdun du dang /khyod mar gyi chu yi dbang bskur bar byed pa dag yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du rig byed las/ mi khyod kyi zas ni bdun no/ /lce ni bdun no/ /drang srong ni bdun no/ /khyim ni bdun no/ /nyin zhag bdun du lan bdun khyod mchod do/ /skye gnas bdun du khyod mar gyis tshim sa par bya'o/ /sāhā/ zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ mngon sum rjes dpag nyer 'jal sgra byung dang / /don go dngos med ces bya'ikhatshad ma drug /kha cig rig srid ma dmigs grags snyam sogs/ zhes pa/ 3 dbu ma snying po las/mngon surme rjes su dpag pa dang / /sgra las byung dang nyer 'jal ba/ /don gyi go dang dngos med pas/ /gtan tshigs bsgrub bya sgrub par byed/ces sa/sungs pa ltar/ mngon sum tshad ma dang / rjes dpag tshad ma 163
