grub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u bdun pa — gcer bu ba'i rtag mtha' dgag pa/lnga ba zad byed pa'i rtag mtha' 'gog pa la 'dod pa brjod pa de sun dbyung pa'o/ /dang po la/ de dngos dang / dgos chung gzhan ma bshad tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ ston pa/ rnam grangs/ dbye ba/ grub mtha' bzhi/ dang po ni/ rgyal ba dam pa khyu mchog ldong ris ston/ zhes pa/ 'di'i gzhung las/ thar ba yin par rgyal bas bshad/ ces dang /bo rnyi bha tras/ de dag ni lha chen po rgyal ba mnyes par byas pas kyang thar ba sbyin pa 'dod pas na rgyal ba'i gzugs brnyan rnams la mchod pa dang phyag la sogs pa bya ba'i phyir/ dad pas 'bad de bzhol ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba dam pa dang / sngar bshad pa ltar drang srong mchod 'os kyis phyi ba'i grub mtha' thams cad byas par 'dod pa'i drang srong mchod 'os dang /khyad par 'phags bstod 'grel ba las/ de yang khyu mchog dang 'phel ba la sogs pa gcer bu zad byed kyi ston pa nyi shu rtsa lnga 'di skad ston cing smra'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar khyu mchog dang / 'phel ba'am ldong ris nyer lnga ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ zad byedamachod 'os gcer bu kun tu rgyu/ zhes pa/ ye shes kun btus 'grel ba las/ gang dag rang gi skra nyin bzhin du zad par phyis pas thar bar 'dod pa ni zad byed pa ste/ zhes 219

pa ltar zad byed pa dang / 'grel chen las/ mchod 'os pa rnams kyis /thar ba'i don du brjod do/ zhes gsungs pa ltar drang srong mchod 'os la ston par 'dzin pas mchod 'os pa ste/ ser skya ba bzhin no/ /'doms dkris tsam yang med pas gcer bu ba dang / phyogs gos can dang / mkha' gos can zhes bya ste/ phyogs dang mkha' las gos gzhan med pas so/ /ldom bu byed pas kun tu rgyu dang / gzhan yang 'tsho ba ste srog bdag tu smra bas 'tsho ba pa ste/ srog gi skad dod dzi wa ni 'tsho ba la 'jug ste/ sgra sbyor bam gnyis las/ dzi wa ni ji srid du lus 'tsho ba de tsam du srog ces bya ba'i bdag de lus la gnas la/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang na lus 'tsho tsam las yo byad sogs dngos po mi 'dzin pas 'tsho ba pa'o de bzhin du gcer bu la ngo tshar mi 'dzin pas 'dzem med pa dang thal ba pa sogs rnam grangs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dbye na srog can gyi sde dgur 'dod pa dang / drug tu 'dod pa gnyis te 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi ba grub mtha' la/ bdag dang 'jal byed tshad ma dang / gzhal bya tshig don gyi khyad par gsum/ dang po ni/ srog ni lus tshad rtag bdag skyes bu 'gro/ zhes pa/ srog bdag tu 'dod la/ lus te srog can rang gi gzugs kyi tshad tsam pa jos rtag la rnam grangs mi rtag pa sems pa'i bdag nyid can du 'dod de/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ gcer bu lus kyi tshad bzhin du/ /srog ni zhum dang rgyas par smra/ zhes dang /'phags pa lhas/ la la'i skyes bu'i lus tsam zhig /ces dang / 'phags bstod 'grel/ wānyas/ lus/ kyi tshad bzhi na du zhes bya ba ni/ lus de gzugs —— 27 —5

kyi tshad yin pas na lus kyi tshad bzhin du de ldan pa yin la/ de yang phra ba la ni shin tu phra ba yin la/ chen po la ni chen po yin no/ /srog ces bya ba de lus thams cad la khyab pa yin la/ lus de ni de'i za ma tog bzhin du gnas so/ — /des na 'di zhum par gyur na zhum par 'gyur la/ 'di rgyas par gyur na de rgyas par 'gyur ro zhis dang / tshad ma'i de nyid las/ rgyal dpog pa bzhin rgyal ba yang / /rdzas dang rnam grangs ngo bo yis/ /ldog dang rjes 'gro'i bdag nyid can/ /skyes bu shes pa'i mtshan nyid smra/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar/ de dag ni 'di skad du/ bdag ni sems kyi mtshan nyid kho na yin te/ de yang rdzas kyi ngo bos gnas skabs can tha mi dad pa'i phyir rjes su 'gro ba'i bdag nyid la rnam grangs kyi ngo bo nyid ni gnas skabs re re la tha dad pa'i phyir log pa'i bdag nyid yin par smra 'o/ zhes dang / 'grel chen las kyang / srog ni lus kyi tshad de srid par dpag tu med par srog nyid rtag pa thar ba 'gyur ba dang / zhes so/ /bdag de'i rnam grangs ni/ srog dang / 'tsho ba dang / gso ba dang / bdag dang / skyes bu dang / 'gro ba dang / gang zag sogs yin te/ 'phags bstod 'grel ba las/ de ni srog dang 'tsho ba dang bdag ces bya ba yin no/ zhes ther te/ srog gam skye ba'am gso ba'am gang zag gam skyis bu zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs so/ zhes dang / dus 'khor las 'gro ba lngar bshad pa sogs las shes so/ /gnyis pa tshad ma la gsum las/ dang po ni/ mngon sum rtog bcas rtog med spyi gsal 'jal/ zhes pa mngon sum ni gnyis te/ spyi lha21

'jal ba'i rtog bral dang gsadze+eb 'jal ba'i rtog bcas gnyis te/ dpyogapa ba dang / 'di gnyis kyi tshad ma'i bskor phal cher 'dra ste/ 'di gnyis kas yul re re'ang nor bu gzi 'bar bzhin du rnam pa sna tshogs can nu 'dod de/ dbu ma rgyad rang 'grel las/ rgyal ba dang rgyal dpog pa rnams kyi ltar na yang / nor bu gzi yi bdag nyid ltar/ dngos po kun ces lta ba la/ zhes dang / zad byed pa rang gi gzhung las kyang / du ma'i ngo bo'i dngos po la/ /brjod par 'dod pas ngo bor 'dod/ /ci ga car rim gyis tshul gnyis las/ /tshig gi bya ba gzhan med do/ /dper na khra bo'i kha dog la/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin kha dog 'dzin/ /de bzhin dngos la'ang sna tshogs phyir/ /tha dad tha dad min par rtog /ces dang / dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel bshad las/ zad byed pa rnams kyi lugs ni/ dngos po rnams nor bu gzi bzhin du du ma'i ngo bo kho na yin te/ rtog pa po'i bye brag gis dngos po 'gal la ngo bo rnam pa sna tshogs su dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshul gsuyomi 'thad rjes dpag tshul gcig pa/ zhes pa/ de sgrub la tshul gsum yod kyang mi 'thad pa mang bas na/ gzhan mtha' khegs pas tshul ba/cig pa 'thad par 'dod de/ shes bya thams cad yod de dmigs pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu la mthun dpe med rjes su 'gro ldog med la phyogs chos kyang gzhan du mi 'thad par 'dus pas so snyam du bsam pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyas byed skar ma'i bstan bcos la sogs lung /zhes pa/ rgyas byed skar ma'i bstan bcos dang / rtsis kyi bstan bcosacho22lha

sna tshogs sogs ston pa mchod 'os sogs tshad ldan gyi ngag ni lung tshad mar 'dod/ /gsum pa gzhal bya'i tshis/ don la/ gzhi lam 'bras bu sgrub byed dang bcas pa gsum/ dang po la/ tshig gi don dgu dang rdzas dang rnam grangs kyi khyad par dang / dus rdzas srog can gyi rnam bzhag gsum las/dang po la/ shasnya la'i mchod 'os lugs dang / 'phags yul gyi mchod 'os lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ srog dang sros/ min zag pa spangs pa sdom/ /bcing thar 'gro 'ong dgu'am zhes pa/ 'di'i lugs la/ shes bya tharma sa cad tshig gi don dgu par grangs nges par 'dod de/ don dgus shes bya la grangs nges sgrub par 'dod pas so/ /'grel chen rwa 'gyur las/ gnas 'gyur dgu ldan zhes pa ni/ zhes dang / shong dpang 'gyur las/ tshis/ dgus sgrub dang / zhes pa/ zhes gsungs pa ni/pā da zhes pa tshig dang gnas sogs la 'jug pas 'gyur khyad tsam mo/ /tshig gi don dgu ni srog ldan dang / srog can min pa dang / dge mi dge'i las zag pa dang / 'chad 'argyur gyi sdom pa dang / nyer spyod spong ba dang / 'chad 'gyur gyi lta ba'i mdud pa'am 'ching ba dang / 'chad 'gyur gyi thar ba dang / 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu 'gro ba dang / pha rol nas 'dir 'ong ba dang dgur 'dod de/ 'grel chen las/ tshig dgus sgrub dwang / zhes pa ni/ srog dang srog min pa dang / zag pa dang / sdom pa dang / spangs pa dang / bcings pa dang / thar ba dang /'gro ba dang / 'ong ba'o/ zhes so/ rwa 'gyur las/ srog dang srog med pa zhes pa 'gyur 'di las legs so/ — /'di dag ngos 'dzin thun mong 223

du 'chad do// gnyis pa ni/ srog zag sdom/ /nges rga 'ching las sdig bsodathar—ba dgu/ zhes bam̐/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gcer bu pa dag gis yongs su btags pa'i tshig gi don dgu ste/ srog dang / zag pa dang /sdom pa dang / nges par rga ba dang / 'ching ba dang / las dang /sdig pa dang / bsod nams dang thar ba zhes bya ba dag go /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rdzas dang rnam grangs kyi khyad par ni/ kun kyang rdzas dang rnam grangs rtag mi rtag /ces pa/ srog lta bu'i tshig gi don phal cher gyi rdzas dang rnam grangs gnyis gcig dang tha dad pa'i tshul yod de/de gnyis yul dus rang bzhin tha mi dad pas de'i sgo nas rdzas gcig dang /grangs dang / ming dang / don nam 'bras bu'i tha dad yin pas/ /de'i sgo nas rnam grangs tha dad par bzhag pa'i phyir/ dper na gzugs dang bum pa rdzas gcig kyang / rnam grangs kyis tha dad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ tshad chen las/ yul dang dus dang rang bzhin dag /tha dad med phyir gcig tu brjod/ /grangs dang mtshan nyid ming dang don/ /tha dad phyir na tha dad brjod/ ces dang / gzhan las kyang / yul dang dus dang rang bzhin tha mi dad pa'i phyir/ chos dang chos can tha mi dad pa yin no/ /grangs dang ming dang mtshan nyid dang / 'bras bu tha dad pa'i phyir tha dad de/ 'di lta ste dper na gzugs la sogs pa rnams bum pa —lta bu'o/ zhes so/ /don ni rdzas ni grangs gcig dang ldan la rnam grangs ni grangs du ma can yin la/ bum gzugs sogs la sbyar na/224

bum pa las gzugs la sogs pa dag yul dus rang bzhin tha mi dad de/bum pa'i yul dang rang bzhin gang yin de nyid gzugs sogs kyi yang yin pas so/ /grangs sogs kyis ni bum pa las de dag tha dad pa yin te/bum pa ni gcig yin la/ gzugs sogs mang po yin pas grangs tha dad dang / bum sogs rdzas ni rjes su 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid yin la/ gzugs sogs rnam grangs ni ldog pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas mtshan nyid tha dad pa dang / bum pas chu len la gzugs sogs dmar po yin no/ zhes don nam 'bras bu tha dad pa yin pas so/ /tshad chen las/ gzugs sogs rnams dang bum pa zhes/ /grangs dang ming gi rnam dbye dang / /'bras bu dang ni rjes 'jug ldog /mtshan nyid dang ni don nam dbye/ /rdzas dang rnam grangs dag gis yin/ zhes so/ /bum pa gzugs gnyis ltar/sems pa can dag gi rdzas dang / bde sdug sogs kyi rnams grangs sogs la yang sbyar tshul mtshungs te/ tshad chen dka' 'grel las/ de bzhin du sems pa can gyi bdag nyid kyi bdag gi rdzas dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba la sogs pa rnam grangs dag la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ zhes so/ /des na rdzas dang grangs can kun gyi rdzas ni mi 'jug pa'am mi ldog par rjes su 'gro bas rtag la/ rnam grangs ni rjes su 'gro bar med par ldog pa'i sgo nas mi rtag pa'o/ /ji skad du/ 'grel las/ zad byed pa'i grub pa'i mtha' smra ba la/ rdzas dang rnam grangs dag gis rtag pa dang mi rtag pa'i tha snyad du 'gyur ro/ zhes dang / 'di rnams kyi nang nas/srog dang / dus dang / nam mkha' na mi rtag pa'o/ zhesadang / de'i 225

rjes la 'gyur mang tso gang zlag dang / bsod nams dat+pā / sdig pangani mi rtag pa'o/ zhes sogs sa/sungs pa ltar na/ gang zag dang bdag la nyad par cher snang bar mngon yang 4 dbu tshad gzhan la mi gsal lo/ /gsumyo/ pa ni/ dus gsum rdzas drug srog can drug gam dgu/ zhe sa pa/ 'das ma 'ong da ltar dumu rtag pa rdzas yod gsum dang / rdzas ni drug ste/ 'grel chen las/ rdzas ni drug ste/ zhes pa ni/ srog dang / gang zas/ dang / dus dang / nam mkha' dang / bsod nams dang / sdig pa'o/ zhes so/ /srog can ni ka la ba'i zad byed pha rnams drug tu 'dod de/ 'grel las/ srog ni drug gi lus la cha shas so/ zhes pa ni/sa'i lus la cha shas dang / chu'i lus la cha shas dang / me'i lusdo/ la cha shas dang / rlung gi lus la cha shas dang / nags kyi bdag po'i lus la cha shas dang / 'bras bu'i lus la cha shas so/ zhes so/ /nags kyi bdag po ljon shing yin la/ rwa 'gyur las/ sa'i luṭasdo la cung zad ces sogs cha shas cung zad du bsgyur yang don gcig la/ kha cig 'bras bu'i lus zhes thar ba'i lus la 'chad pa ma dag pas/ nas sogs 'bru rnams semasa'i ldan du sgrub 'dod snang bas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan 'di srog can thams cad 'di drug tu bshad pa min gyi yong sa la sems med du grags pa la sems ldan drug byed 'dod pas so/ /'di'i thad la tha snyad myo/ gtogs zadabyed gnyis/ chari thun par sems so/ /'phags yul gyi zad byed pa rnams ni srog can gyi sde dgu ba'i tha snyad byed de/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ de la srogacican gyi sde dgu ste/ sa dang chu dang shing dang me dang rlung dang srin bu dang /226 ci —rdzo —ci

sdo / ga ma dang / bung ba dang / mi zhes bya ba dag go zhes so/ /des na 'a di sa kyaju+o srog can la 'di dgu kho nar 'dod pa min te/ sems/ med dung grargas sdi 'ga' sems/ ldan du sgrub ched dang / dbang po gcig ldan sogs kyi matsan gzhi tsam bzung ched yin pa'i phyir dang / 'di dgu ca/ yim/ pa'i srog can du ma bshad pas so/ / rtog ge 'bar ba las de dag las sa dang chu dang / shing dang me dang rlung rnams ni dbang po gcig ldan te reg pa'i dab nga po dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /srin bu dang / bung ba dang / dung dang / nya phyisdo/ dang / srin bu pad+ma la sogs pa ni dbang po gnyis ldan te/ reg pa dang ro'i dbang po nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /grog ma dang srin bu me la sogs pa ni dbang po gsum pa ste/ reb/ pa dang /ro dang / sna'i dbang po dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /bung ba dang / sbrang bu mchu ring la sogs pa ni/ dbang po bzhi ba ste/ reg pa dang ro dang sna dang / mig gi dbang po dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /mi dang rkang bzhi ba dang bya la sogs pa ni dbang po lnga ba ste/ reg pa dang ro dang sna dang /mig dang rna ba'i dbad po dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de ltar na de dag ni srog gi tshig si/ don rnam pa dgu'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa lam ni/ sdom lnga brtul zhugs lnga dang ye shes lnga/ /spyod pa bcu sa/sum lam 'dod/ces rma sdom/ ro lnga ni/ gcer bu sogs spyod lam gyi dang mi smra ba sogs ngag gam skad kyi dang / slong spyod sogs yongs 'tshal gyi dang / bsod snyomatra/ rīk+ṇid zos su mi 'dor ba'i dang / sbrang yab sogs nye bar rab gam/sa kyi sdom pa ste lnga'o/ /brtul zhugs lnga ni/ mi 'tshe ba'i dang / 227

kheden smra'i dang / byin pa tsam len pa'i dang / tshangs par spyod pa'i dang / dngos po kun yongs su gtong ba'i brtul zhugs lnga'oṭ+wāṃri /blo gros kyi dang / thos pa'i dang / 'tsham gyi dang / yid kyis yongs su 'tshol ba'i dang mo'i ye shes te ye shes lnga'o/ /'di sogs so so'i ngos 'dzin ṭika chen de nyid snang bar ltos/ spyod pa ni bcu gsum ste/ brtul zhugs lnga dang / sdom pa lnga dang / me lnga bsten pa dang / gang grar 'jug pa sogasalus kyi gsang ba dang / sngags bzla ba sogs ngag gi gsang ba dang / sems kyis 'di pa rang gi lugs kyi thar lam bsgom pa ste spyod pa bcu gsum dang bcas pa 'di dag ni 'di'i lam gyi skor yin no/ /gsum pa 'bras bu sgrub byed dang bcas pa la/ thar ba dang / de dang 'brel ba'i 'gro sogs kyi khyad par dang / de'i bgegs byed 'ching las kyi/ khyad par dang / sgrub byed bshad pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ thar ba gzugs zhes pa 'di'i thar ba gzugs dang / 'gro ba'i nang tshan lnga ba dang /lus kyi nang nas kyang lnga ba/ gnas khams gsum las 'das pa na dbyibs dang kha dog gdugs lta bu kha dog dkar po ku mud kyi mdog can tshad gzhan nas ma bshad kyang 'grel chen 'dir dpag tshad 'bum phrag zhe lnga yod pa dang / gcig las med kyang / kun grol tshe der dbyer med par 'dod de/ rgyal ba dam pas/ kha ba rgya spos me tog mdog /ba zho ba mo mu tig mdog /gdugs bkan bzung ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ /thar ba yin par rgyal bas bshad/ ces dang / 'grel chen las/ grub pa'i mtha' gang du thar ba'i tshad ni 'jig rten gsum gyi steng du gdugs kyi 228

rnam pa dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga bar nges par brjod par byed pa de ni rgyal ba nga/ yi bstan pa'o/ zhes dang / ṭika chen de nyid snang ba las/ 'jig rtem/ gsum las brgal ba na 'jig rten 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i gnas zho 'am ku mu da ltar dkar ba/ srog yod pas dngos po yin zhing 'khor ba las grol bas dngos po med pa gdugs dkar po gyen la bslang pa lta bu/ tshad 'dir bshad pa de tsam dang ldan pa yod la/ zhes dang / slob dpon legs ldan gyis/ thar ba ni las thams cad zad pas 'jig rten thams cad kyi steng na 'dus pa'i gnas 'jig rten 'dus pa zhes bya bar 'gro ste/ zhes sogs shes byed mang bas 'gro ba lnga ba dang lus lnga par 'chad par 'gyur ro/ gzhan yang / rgyal ba dam pas/ la lar srog ni stobs ldan zhing / /la la las ni stobs ldan 'gyur/ zhes sogs kyis 'khor bar 'khor tshe mi shes pa'i dbang gis las stobs che la/ grol tshe ye shes dbang gis srog stobs che ba dang / khams gsum gcig las med la/ de zhig na srid pa gzhan med pas srog chags thams cad gang la gnas nges na 'khor ba'ang rtag pa dang / srog yang rtag par smra ba sogs mang po snang ste ma bris so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'gro lnga lus lnga dbang po gcig ldan sogs/ zhes pa 'gro ba lnga ste/ 'grel chen las/ 'gro ba'i dbye ba lnga ste/ dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / mi dang / lha dang /thar ba'i 'gro ba'o/ zhes so/ /'dis thar ba dang 'gro ba'i gzhi mthun khas blad+ku+os so/ /srog can rnams kyi lus kyi dbye ba lnga ste/ mi sos/sa kham zas can gyi lus dang / lha rnams 'od kyi lus dang / srog gi rangar+sha229

bzhin cam/ nags kyi bdas/ po sogs drug gi lus/ dang —/ yongs su grags pa'i rdzuru/ skyes kyi lus dang / mtha'i thar ba'i lus te lngar bshad pa'i phyir te/ 'grel chen la sa/ gzhan yang / yod pa'i lus lnga zhes/ pa ni/kha zas can gyi lus dang / 'od kyi lus dang / rang bzhin can gyi lus dang / rdzus skyes kyi lus dang / mtha'i lus so/ zhes pa ni/ sro/ga rnarma sa kyi /'o/ zheṭaṭa so/ /'gro ba de dag la dbang po ldan tshul ya nga yod de/ sa sogs dbang po sa/cig ldan nas/ mi sogs lnga ldan du sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /sogs sgras tshig dgu'i khyad par gzhan rnams ston te/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ zag pa ni dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las rnams kyi sa zag par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sdo rma pa ni zag pa 'gos pa nyid de/ las gsar ba mi gsog pa'i phyir ro / /nges paragyiso ba ni sdom rma de nyid dang / zas mi za ba dang / skom mi 'thung ba dang / bar+sha/ma gtan dang / sbyo ra ba la sogs pa dka' thub dang bcas pas ldon nye bar bsags pa'i 'a sa nges par bananas par byed pa ste/ zad pa'i rgyu mi na pa'i phyir ro/ zhes dang / sdig pa ni chos min pa'o/ /bsod nams ni chos so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ 'ching ba su ma brgya drurga/ cu las tshe sogs/ zhes pa/ thar ba thob pa la bgegs byed 'ching ba dang / nyes par smra ba sum brgya dang drug cu 'dod de/ dbu ma snying po'i rang 'grel las/ 'ching ba ni nyes par smra ba sum brgya drug cu rtsa gsum po dag gis brtags pa'i log par lta ba'o/ /zhes dang / yang lta ba brgya rtsa bcur yang bshad de/ de nyid las/ de yang lta ba'i rtsa ba brgya rtsa 230

bcur 'gyur la/ de'i thad kyi dbye ba ni/ sangs rgyas pa dang / 'dzin pa med pa dang / 'tsho ba pa dang / zhes pa nas/ nam mkha' la sems yod si ra lta ba la sogs pa lta ba sum brgya drug cu rtsa gsum po thams cad kyang zhes bshad pa lta bu'o/ /las ni bzhi ste phyis myong 'gyur dang /ming dang / rus dang / tshe'i bar bzhi 'dod pa'i phyir te/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ las ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ phyis myong bar 'gyur ba dang /ming dang / rus pa dang / tshe zhes bya ba dag go /zhes so/ / tshe sogs zhes pas las lhag ma lu sa sogs 'don pa'o/ bzhi ba ni/ ma brtsams lung ma bstan dang nyal sogs phyir/ /kun mkhyen med dang shing sogs sems ldan sgrub/ ces pa/ kun mkhyin med pa dang shing sos/sa sems ldan du sgrub tshul gcer bu pa dang / sbyod pa ba mtshungs la/ rig byed gsum las kyang shing sogs sems ldan du bshad do/ /'jig rten na chos/ kun mkhyen pa med de/ gcig gis kun mkhyen pa mu stegs la'angasamed pa'i phyir dang / gcer bu ba ltar na skar ma'i bstan bcos ma brtsams pa'i phyir dang / dpyod pa ba ltar na mchod sbyin srid srung sogs ma brtsa mas pa'i phyir dang / de nas bshad pa sun 'byin pa'i phyir dang / gnyis kas thun mong du lung ma bstan gyi lta ba bcu bzhi lung ma bstan pa dang /sogs sgras 'khor ba'i thog mtha' ma shes pa sogs du ma sgrub byed du 'god pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma snying po'i kun mkhyen sgrub pa'i le'u'i rang 'egrel las/ gal te 'dir gcer bu rgyu ba rnams lhags te 'di skad du/ gang thamaṭasmu cad mkhyen pa nyid de kho po cag gi 0/zhung las sun 'byin par nus snye231

kyi/ 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin te/ lung du ma bstan pa'i ngo bo bcu bzhi lung du ma bstan pa dang / 'khor ba'i thog ma'i mtha' ma shes pa dang / shin tu mdzes ma bsad pa ma rig pa dang / bram ze'i bu mo mdzes mas skur ba btab pa dang / grong khyer pa tra la bu tra nyams par 'gyur ba lung ma bstan pa dang / zla ba gsum du nas zos pa dang / lhung bzed bkrus pa buzhin du log pa dang / rdo'i 'khrul 'khor 'phari+os pa dang / nong skyong drung du 'ongs pa dang / lhas sbyin rab tu 'byin par byed pa dang / bzang po bsnyen sakur ba 'jog pa dang / lhag spyod dang la ba can dang / lnga sde bsnyen bkur byed pa ma shes pa dang / shing gi phung po'i mdo sde ston par byed pa dang / seng ldeng gi tshal ba zug pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa myong ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa la sun 'byin pa la sogs pa ma bstan pa'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin te/ — tha mal ba'i skyes bu bzhin no/ zhesutshe dang / dpyod pa ba'i 'dod tshul spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis bsdoms su mdzad pa las/ gang phyir kun mkhyen sun 'byin pa/ /kho bo nyid kyang shes ma gyur/ /rdo skyogs 'phen par byed pa yi/ /lha sbyin bsdus bar gyur phyir dang / /glang po'i dbang po 'ong ba yi/ /ma 'ong ba dag shes ma gyur/ ces pa nas/lnga ba dang ni bzang sde'i tshogs/ /da lta ga na 'khod ces 'dri/ /lharnams kyis ni sbran pa'i phyir/ /da ltar byung ba shes ma gyur/ /gang phyir reng byed sgyu rtsal shes/ /shi ba dag kyang lhas bstan pa/ /de phyir 'das pa mi shes pas/ /des na thams cad mkhyen pa min/ /grong khyer 232

'ji5/ par 'gyur ba ni/ /me 'am chus ni ma nges pas/ /the tshom can gyi tshig can ni/ /kun mkhyen min par gsal bar shes/ zhes sogs dang / ngas ni sngon byung ma yin pa'i/ /'phags lam rnying ba thob 'gyur zhes/ /snga phyi 'gal ba'i tshig smra ba/ /ji ltar thams cad mkhyen par rigs/ zhes bya ba gamo kyang gtan tshigs yin te/ de'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin no/ zhes zer ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dus gsum mi mkhyen pa dang / the tshom gyi tshig smras pa dang / gzhan la drisapa dang / sngar med pa'i 'phags lam rnying pa zhes nang 'gal smras pa'i phyir kun mkhyen min no zer ro/ /shing dang sogs sgras bshad cing 'chad 'gyur ltar lhum du dang sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams srog ldan dang se ma r+sha smu ldan du 'dzin la/ sgrub byed ni/ nyal ba ltar dgun dus gnyid log la/ dbyar dus snyo ba'i phyir sogs 'god de/ ljon shing chos can/ sems yo da de/ mthun pa las skyes pa'i phyir/ dper na rta las rta skye la ba lang mi skye ba bzhin/ de chos can/ sems yod de/ rim gyis 'phel ba'i phyir/ dper na rte'u dang gzhon nu dang rgan pa'i gnas skabs ltar/ ljon shing yang myu gu sdong bu sogs nu/sa rim gyis/ 'phel ba yin no/ /dug shing chos can/ sems yod de/ sdang ba'i sems yod nga/'i phyir/ gnod pa 'i bsam pa gang la yod pa ni sdang ba'i sems yin la/ dug shing / ri+o gas kyis kyang gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa'i phyir 'di la sdang sem sa yo da do/ /ljon shing chos can/ sems yod de/ dus su ldan pa la sa skyes pa ri phyir/ dper na rta sogs dpyid dus skye la/ khyi 233

sogs ston ka skye ba bzhin du/ ljon rtsi/nga yang dpyid dang dbyar dus/ skye ba yim/ no/ /de chos can/ sems yod de/ dgun dus gnyid logs pa'i phyir/ de 'a sems yod de/ dbyar dus spyo ba'i phyir/ ji skad du ljon shing tshe'i dbye ba las/ gnyid log pa 'am snyo ba'i dus su skyed do/ zhes byung ste/ dgun gyi dus su ni gnyid lo ga go /dbyar gyi dus su spyo ba yin te/ ji ltar rkyang la sogs pa bzhin no/ zhes so/ :/de skad du/ dbu ma snying po las/ mthun pa las skyes 'phel 'gyur dang / /sdang sems dus ldan skye ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gnyid log spyo ba'i phyir/ /sem sa yod rta sogs bzhin du 'dod/ ces bya bas so/ /'byung ba ni chos/ can/ sems ldan yin te/ dbang po dang ldan pa'i phyir/ dper na mi bzhin/ rtags reg bya can/ nam dbang po gcig ldan yin pas bsgru bas so/ /ljon shing chos can/ se rma sa/ bcas yin te/ dbang po yod pa'i phyir/ mi bzhin zhes spyir bsgrub nas/ dbang po so so nas yod par bsgrub pa ni/ rgun 'bru dang / dra bu sha la sogs pa'i 'khri shing rnams la mig dbang yod de/ —shing gzhan la brten shes pa'i phyir/sman sbrur mgo sogs/ la'ang mig dbang yod de/ nyi ma'i rjes su blta ba'i phyir chu shing sogs la rna dbang yod de/ sprin las 'brug sgra bsgrags pa na 'bras bu 'byung ba'i phyir/ ma du lung ga la sna dbang yod de/ rtsa bar khyi ro rul ba bzhag na 'bras bu/ mang du 'byung ba'i phyir/ skyu ru ra'i shing la lce dbang yod de/ 'o ma blug na mngar bo 'byung bas so /reg na 'a/bu rna pa'i lo ma can la lus dbang yod de/ reg na 'khum pa'i phyir/234

mya’ngan med pa'i shing la yid dbang yod de/ bud med lang tsho la babs sa sa rkang gdub dang bcas pas bsnun na ngo tsha ba ltar 'bras bu rgyas pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ dbu ma snying po las/ sems med pa yi brtan pa la'ang / /sems ni yod par rtog byed pa'i/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel las so/ /jisne/ nga sman sa ma ga dang / thal sbyar ni sems dang bcas payin te/ reg na 'khum ste 'khyil 'dug pa'i phyir/ dpero na srog chags rkang brgya la reg na de ma thag tu 'khyil bar 'gyur ba ltar sman de gnyis kyang nyi 'od kyis phog na rgyas la reg na de ltar du 'khum pa'i phyir/ji skad du/ gal te srog chags rkang brgya ltar/ /reg na 'khum par 'gyur pas na/ /sa ma ga dang thal sbyar ni/ /sems dang bcas par 'dod ce na/ zhes so/ /de bzhin du ljon shing rnams la tshe'i dbye ba dang / nad gso ba sogs yod pas sems bcas yin la/ sems med rdo sogs la gso thabs med pa'i phyir/ sogs smra'o/ /rgyas par dbu tshad dus 'khor la blta 'o/ /gnyis pa dgos chung gzhan ma bshad pa ni/ ltar snang mang yang gnad chung 'dir mi spro/ zhes pa/ sngar gyi lta ngan skabs kyi grub mtha' dang / nyer lngari gzha na rnams 'phags yul mkhas mcho ga rnams kyis kyang dgori ṭa pa chung ba dang / 'khrul gzhi chung ba sogs nas cher ma bshad la/ kla klo'i grub mtha' dus 'khor nas bshad kyang // mkhas pa gzhan gyis ma bshad pas dgos pa chung la/ 'dodarītshul ni rgyu ba bcud dang / mi rgyu ba mtha' dag byed pa po ra h+ma ṇas byed pas/ de mnyes pa las mtho ris dang / ma mnyes pa las dmyal bar skye bar 'dod la/235

de dag gos dkar po gyom zhing / zas dgung chu sogs dus min mtshan mo za ba dang / phyugs ྅sad nas lha de mchod pa sogs bshad 'a// sangs rgyas 'das nas lo brgyad brgya song rjes su byung ba ste/ bsdus rgyud las/byed pas rgyu dang mi rgyu las skyes mtha' dag skyed cing stag gzigacarnams kyi thar ba dag ni rgyu/ /de mnyes pa las mi rnams mtho ris su 'gyur de ni rah+ma ṇa'i nges par bstan pa'o/ zhes gsungs la/ 'jug 'grel ltar/dpal ldan zla ba sogs kyi dus su'ang spong ba dkar po'am/ dge sbyongartedakar po zhes pa'i lugs byung bas/ lta ngan la 'di byung dang 'di mi 'byung zhes su zhig gis smra nus gsung ba lta bu'i 'phags yul gyi grub mtha'—dgag dgos chung ba dag dang / bod 'di na'ang paṇa bon dag ces paṇa—de'i lugs las ston pa dang / grub mtha' gzhan du rang gis khas lenar+shapa dag dang / rgya na lha sbyin lugs kyi hwa shang 'ga' re yod par grags pa lta bu nang ba las gzhan du khas 'che ba dang / nang bar khas len kyang—shāka thugle kyi rjes nas nged kyi chos 'di gsar du byung bar 'dod ces zer ba'i sngags pa khyim bcun gyi gzhi mthun re re gnyis gnyis tsam byung yang /de dag gi lugs rtsa bar ma brjod pa ni/ dgag dgos chung la/ gzhanar+shabod kyi bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gyi mkhas grub so so'i lugs kyang mthong la shes mod kyi/ 'phags yul gyi phyi nang gi grub mtha' chen po dag dang / mdo rgyud du ma dang / byams chos dang / rgyan drug gir+shagazhung dang / de dag gi rjes 'brangs nyi zla lta bu'i mkhas grub chen po—sangs rgyas bskyangs zla grags/ zhi ba lha sogs dang / legs ldan yab—236

sras dang / yi shes snying po lwa pa ba/ zhi ba 'tsho yab sras/ /'phags seng yab sras kyi lugs la tshad thub byas/ gzhan yang grub mtha' kun gyi bshad pa dang man ngag mang ba'i slob dpon byang bzang dze tā ri gnyis dang / be+e tri pa/ paṇa chen lhan skyes rdo rje sogs kyi gzhung gi'ang legs cha blangs te bshad pa na/ 'phagaso yul gyi'ang tshad ma pa kha cig gis cung zad rang gzhan gyi lugs nor ba kha shas dang / bod kyi'ang gzhung 'di dag gang dang yang mi mthun pa'i lugs dag ni/ po su 'dra zhig gis bshad kyang 'khrul ba rtogs sla ba dang / mang du smra sa na bod rnams dgra ru sdang / zhes pa ltar dgag bya che la dgos pa chung bas kho bos rtsa ba 'dir ma bshad do/ /bon ni theg pa rim dgur 'dod de/ rdol bon gshen rab ston pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ mo rtsis sogs byed pa'i phywa gshen/ gshin chog byed pa'i 'dur gshen/ snang gshen lha bon po/ltas ngan dang mthu gtad byed pa'i 'khrul gshen te bod kyi lha 'dre babs nas smra ba'i bon por grags te/ rgyu'i theg pa bzhi dang / 'dul mngon phar phyin 'dra min du bcos te/ dge bsnyen/ bar ma/ dge tshul/ dge slong bzhi'i dod du/ dge bsnyen dang / gtsang ma gtsug phud pa/ drang srong pa/ a dkar ba ste 'bras bu'i theg pa bzhir grags/ 'di bzhi lta spyod gtso bor byed pa'o/ /dgu ba ni lta ba gtso bor spyod pas/ rdzogs rim ni ci yang yid la mi byed cing / lus ngag gi dge ba khyad du gsod pa'i hwa shang gi lugs de 'jin pa ste/ 'di dag rnams kyis sems bzhag pa'i stong hang shar ba de la sems ngo mthong bar byed cing / stong sang nge 237

sacis/ shar phyin lta ba rdzogs rim skyes par 'dod pa gcig yin snang ste /sa/zugs brnyan gsal ba'i me long las/ cir yang mi rtog gang du mi 'dzin par/ /ma bcos gsal la mi rtog ngos bzung med/ /bon dang rdzogs chen ha shang ting 'dzin la/ mchog tu 'dzin pa lhag mthong gzugs brnyan yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ bod byings yang de ltar 'dod pa ma nga bar snang ngo / /gnyis pa de dgag pa ni/ rdzas dang rnam grangs phan tshun gcibo/ med 'jig /thar ba gzugs phyir las zad don med 'gyur/ /che chung 'gyur na mi rtag tshul gcig 'ang 'gal/ zhes —tshig rkang gsum ste de la zad byed pa rnams srog gam bdag sogs tshig don phal cher rdzas dang rnam grengs gnyis ka'i bdag nyid can yin la/ de yangardzirdzas rtag la rnam grangs mi rtag pas/ srog sogs ni mi 'jig kyang 'jig pa can yin par 'dod pa de la/ sems pa can nam bdag de'i bdag nyid gang yin pa'i rdzasdo/ de rnam grangs dang 'brel na/ de sngar yod ma dor ba'i rang gi ngo bo dang 'bril lam sngar gyi ngo bo dor ba dang 'bril ba gang yin/ dang po ltar na sems pa can 'jig bcas ma yin par thal/ snga phyi'i gnas skabs la khyad par 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ dper na nam mkha' bzhin/ phyi ma ltar na rtag pha nyams par thal/ gnas skabs can 'ga' yang zur du med pa'i phyir te/ tshad chen las/ de la'ang rdzas ni rnam grangs dang / /gal te 'brel du 'gyur med na/ /de la khyad par med pa'i phyir/ /de ni 'gyur ba can mi 'aglur/ zhes so/ /de la kho4na re/ sngar rdzas dang khyad por bshad pa ltaro rdzas gcig pas rtags de—238

ma grub ce na/ 'o na de gnyis la 'jigaya 'jig gi ldog pa tha dad rgamed par thal/ de gnyis rang bzhin dbyer med kyi cha med gcig yin pa'i phyir/ dpir na rnam grangs kyi dngos po bzhin/ 'dod na/ de gnyis mtshan nyid tha dad par yang mi 'gyur bas rdzas kyang gcig par thal/ spos dang rnam grangs gnyis don dam par cha ci yang dbyer med pa'i gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ nges par khyad par ldan pa yis/ /rang bzhin dbyer med gcig nyid de/ /de ltar yin na tha dad nyid/ /ji ltar yang ni sgrub dka' ste/ /sogs so/ /'grel bar sbyor ngag mdzad de 'dir thal ba byas so/ /rgyas par bkag ste der blta'o/ /des na khyod kyi 'dod pa ltar gyi bdag med par mngon sum gyis/ grub ste/ skye 'jig kho na'i rang bzhin gyis rnam grangs 'ba' zhig dmigs pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ skye dang 'jig pa'i chos can gyi/ /rnam grangs kho na 'ba' zhig dag /yang dag yod gyur de yi phyir/ /bdag med gsal snang dri ma med/ ces so/ /des na 'di dang dus 'khor ltar rdzas dang— rnam grangs gnyis phan tshun gcig la gcig ngo bo gcig tshul yod med dpyad na med pas de'i lugs kyi rdzas dang rnam grangs kyi khyad par 'jig 'gro bas/ de'i tshe de'i lugs kyi sgro btags phal cher khegs 'gro bar bsams nas rkang pa dang po smras so/ /dus 'khor ltar las zad kyang grol ba'i don med par 'gyur bar thal/ thar ba rdul phra rab bsags pa'i gzugs yin pa'i phyir dang / 'gro ba'i ngo bo las ma 'das pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten gsum brgal nas da ltar grol tshul dpyad na mi—239

rung bas so/ la lar srog stobs dang ldan pa dang la lar stobs dang ldan nas grol tshul yang des khegs la/ srog ni lus tshad bzhin yod na mi rtag par thal/ de ris che la res chung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ srog la bcad du yod par thal/ smon shing dang lag pa sogs bcad tshe dum bu so so la gnas pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub ste/ cha gcig la mi gnas zer na/ shing dum bur byas te/ btsugs tshe cha gnyis ka mi skye bar thal/srog de'i cha gcig las med pa'i phyir/ srog du mar thal ba sogs dus 'khor tshad chen dbu ma snying po'i 'grel ba sogs ltar 'phen no/ /tshul gsum ma tshang ba'i tshul gcig pa'i rtags byed mi rigs par thal/ de la gzhan la don rtogs snyed pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ rtags de bsgrub bya la 'khrul bar 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / de gtan tshigs ltar snang yin no sogs shin tu sgrub sla ste/ tshad chen le'u nyer gnyis pa las/ tshul re'am gnyis gnyis don ldan pa/ /de phyir rtags ltar snang bar 'dod/ces sogs dang / phyogs glang gis/ tshul re re dang gnyis gnyis pa/ /rtags don min par don gyis byas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lung ma bstan gyi lta ba bcu bzhi po mi mkhyin pas kun mkhyen min par smra ba mi 'thad par thal/ de bcu bzhi mkhyen yang bstan na don ma yin chen po skyed par dgongs nas ma gsung pa de thams cad mkhyen pa'i rtags yin pa'i phyir te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ 'jig rten mtha' dang ldan nam zhes/ /zhus na rgyal ba mi gsungs bzhugs/ /gang phyir de ltar zab pa'i chos/ /snod min 'gro la mi gsungs pa/ /de nyid phyir na mkhas 240

rnams kyis/ /kun mkhyen thams cad mkhyen par shes/ zhes so/ /de —bzhin du skyon bstan pa lhag ma rnams kyang mi 'thad par thal/ 'khor ba la thog ma med pas med par mkhyin nas gsungs pa yin cing / de skyon min la/ de bzhin du mdzes ma bsad pa mkhyen yang sems can gyi las yin pa dang de'i 'dzum pa'i rgyu dris pas zhag bdun lon nas brjod par bya bar gsungs pas ma mkhyin pa min la/ lhung bzed dkrus pa bzhin log pa ni rjes 'jug la sems/ mi zhum pa'i gdams pa ston pa dang / zla ba gsum nas rta lnga brgya dad nas dga' ldan du skyes pa dang de bzhin gshegasadzhapa la mchod nas bla med byang chub tu lung bltan pa dang / lhag ma ni dbu ma snying po las/ glang chen gdul bar bya phyir dang / /'gro ba rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /bcos ldan grong khyer gshegs pa yin/ /thub pa bcom ldan mi mkhyen min/ zhes dar / lhas sbyin rdo smyogs 'phang ba ni/ de nyid las/ lhas sbyin gyis skyogs 'phong ba dang / /de yang 'gro la phan phyir te/ /gzhan gyi gnod las grol ba'i phyir/ /che ba'i bdag nyid bstan pa yin/ zhes dang / lhas sbyin rab tu ma byung na 'khor sgyur gyur nas gnod la byung na mi gnod pas rab byung ma bzlog la/ sgyu ma mkhan bzang po la cho 'phrul bstan nas phan btags pa'i ched dang / lhag spyod—'phos pa mkhyen yang / bdag nyid kyi slob dpon gyi tshul yin pas/bdud rtsi bgo 'dod pa dang / byas pa gzo ba dang lha klu sogs dga'ar+shaba'i ched du dri rmad mdzad la/ shing gi phung po lta bu'i mdo sde bstan pa ni/ bsam ngan gyi dge slong drug cu dang / tshe zad pa'i dge slong drug—241

cu dang / 'dod chags che ba'i dge slong drug cu ngan song du skye ba gzigs nas chos bstan nas khyad par can du skyes pa dang / zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal ba zug par bstan pa rnam smin bstan pa'i ched du tshul bstan nas las 'bras la 'god par mdzad pa dang / kun mkhyin la smo da pa rnams kyi yang ming rigs ma bstan kyang lung bstan par mdzad la/ de bzhin du nad pa la nad 'dri ba dang / bram ze sogs kyis gzhan dotsha/ mdzad pa sob/sa gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs mkhas yin te/ rgyas par thabs li mkhas pa'i mdo dang / lang sa/the/gas sogs na ci rigs bshad pa'i phyir/lhag ma 'grel bshad las shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / shing rnams la dbang po yod pa'i sgrub byed rnams kyang ma nges pa nyid yin te/ dbang po med pa rnams la yang sems med bzhin du yul la nye bar dmigs pa 'khrul ba byung ba'i phyir te/ rtog ge 'bar pa las/ ji ltar mig med kyang khab lcags dang nye bar gyur pa las lcags 'byar bar 'gyur ba dang 'khar ba'i snod la rna ba med kyang sgra chen po grags pa ni/ de la sgra snyan 'byung ba dang / dug la sna dang lce med kyang khrag dang dri'i rjes su rgyas par 'gyur zhing / tshwa dang khrag las spu ba 'byung pa dang / dril bu sogs la lus kyi dbang po med kyang sgra'i rgyun 'byung ba dang / byi ba'i dug gis dus tshod shes pa med kyang nam zhod 'byung ba'i tshe rgyas zhing sdang ba ltar/de bzhin du rgun 'bru dang / trapabu sha la sogs pa rnams la mig gi dbang po med kyang rlung gi khams rgyas par gyur pa las 'khri shing steng du 'byung bar 'gyur te/ me'i 'bar ba bzhin no/ /sman sgrul mgo dang / su 243

gar rtsa la sogs pa yang —chusari/ rgyas par 'gyur la nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis 'phog par gyur pa na nang gi chu skamyo/ pa na lus la 'dab r+sha / rgyas pa de nyi ma la mngon par phyogs pa yin te/ pags pa rlon pa ska ma pa bzhin no/ zhes sogs dang / de bzhin du chu shing dang ma du lung ga la sogs pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba dang / bud med lang tsho la babs pa'i rkang par rgya skyegs byugs nas brgyan nas mya ngan med pa'i shing la rkang pa bsnun na 'bras bu dang me tog 'byung ba dang / lang tsho la babs pa'i bud med kyi kha 'ur chang gis bkang ste me tog mi 'byung ba'i ba gu la'i shing la gtor na me tog rnams bzhad de 'byung ba rnams kyang yid dbang yod pa'i rgyu mtshan min gyi mkhyud spyad kyi spyor ba yin par shes/ dper na rims nyin gsum pas btab pa la/ thun mtshams su so phag chags pa'i dum bu re byin pa nyin gsum du byas na zhi bar 'gyur ba bzhin dang / de bzhin du reka nga sa 'khum pa dang nyi ma'i rjes su 'brang ba yang ma nges te/ me la sogs pa reg pa 'i pags pa dang / spu dang 'khrul 'khor dang rgyu skar dang 'khor lo la sogs pa rnams kyis ma nges pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang ljon shing chos can/ sems ldan ma yin te/ skye gnas bzhis ma bsdus pa'i phyir dang /dkyil du bcad kyang bzod pa'i phyir dang / dper na phag dum bzhin/des na bem po yin no/ /dbu ma snying po las/ ljon shing sems dang bcaru pa min/ /skye gnas bzhir ni ma bsdus phyir/ /dkyil du bcad kyang bzod pa'i phyir/ /phag dur+yā bzhin du be+em po yin/ zhes so/ /shing re〈gas chos can/ sems can yin te/ dus su skyes pa'i phyir/ rte'u 243

bzhin dang / de bzhin du chos can dang chos 'dra/ 'phel ba'i phyir rte'u bzhin/ dug shing la la chos can/ sems yod de/ sdang sems yod pa'o phyir/ zer ba'ang ma nges par thal/ de ni rigs mthun pa las —'byung ba'i phyir/ dber na skra dang sen mo dang sen da ba'i tshwa dang /skun sman da'i 'bras bu bcad pa dang / baiḍūr+ya dang gser gyi myu gu dang /grog mkhar dang / lhog pa dang / byu ru la sogs pa bzhin te/ rin chen dang gser gyi myu gu la sogs pa rnams chu 'dzin gyi sgra sgrogs pa'i dus su/ skye ba'i ma nges pa kho na yin te/ dbu ma snying po las/ lhog pa byu ru bai ḍūr+ya/ /rin chen gser gyi skug sogs kyis/ /shing rnams sems ldan bcas pa ni/ /'di ltar ma nges pa nyid yin/ zhes so/ /'o na mu stegs drang srong dag gis bshad pa'i sman sogs kyis phan pa min nam zherdzin/ de tsam gyis gnas lugs dang / 'khor 'das shes pa'i nges pa mid de/ skabs 'ga'i cung zad bden kyang lhag ma snyon pa'i tshig lta bu dang mu stegs kyi lugs 'di dpyad na mi rung ba bong bu'i 'o ma bsrub na gshang dri bro ba lta bu yin pa'i jir te/ dbu ma snying po las/ 'ga' zhig don bzhin mthong ba yis/ /kun tu don bzhin ma yin te/ /gnag rdzi spyon pa'i tshig rnams ni/ /kun tu ji bzhin don min bzhin/zhes dang / ligs ldan gyis/ de ltar na bong bu'i 'o ma bsrub pa las mi gtsang ba'i dri 'byung ba ltar mu stegs rnams kyi smras pa de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /'dir rgya cher rjes su dpag pas dpyad rigs te/ shes bya'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu 'gro bar 'dod pas rjes su dpag pa'i gru gzings la rko248 tswarī 4

brten nas shes bya'i rgya mtsho'e mthar phyin tshe gtong bar byed pa'i phyir/dper na gzings dang gru sogs bzhin/ dbu ma snying po las/ ji ltar klung bzhiru brgal 'dod pa/ /gzings dag yongs su zin pa ltar/ /de bzhin btang bya yin na yang / /rjes su dpag pa bzung bar rigs/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ smras pa/ mchod 'os srog can drug dgu'i rgyu mtshan dang / /rdzas dang rnam grangs tshig gi don dgu rnams/ /ma 'dres ma nor za 'og ri mo ltar/ /rab gsal ches gsal shing rta che bzhin bkod/ /de ltar mu stegs lugs ngan mi shes bar/ /zer sgro sa bris dang don spyi ma shar dang / /grub mtha' smra 'dod rgyu mtshan ma go lang / /lugs de 'gog 'dod blun pos ljongs 'di gang / /yul dang dus kyis bskal ba'i gzhal bya'i gnas/ /phra zhib ma 'dres blo gros shel mig 'dir/ /rnam par gsal 'dis 'jam mgon snying dbus su/ /bzhugs sam mkhyen pa'i gter du gor ma chag /'gran par 'dod kyang legs bshad zla bral 'di/ /yongs 'du'i rkang 'thung bzhin dang gdong lnga bzhin/ /bcu gnyis bdag bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhin/ /mngon du gyur la spyon pa'i gar gyis ci/ /ljags lce smra ba'i 'o mtshor rnam spyod rgyas/ /mdzes sdug rab rdzogs grub gzhung dbyangs can ma/ /mthong tshe ngo mtshar cho ga byed pa po/ /rnam sad kun gyi mes por rgyal rnams gleng / /zhes grub pa'i mtha'i rnam pa ra bzhag pa 'khrul spong gdong lha'i sgra dbyangs kun mkhyen lam gsal sgron me'i rnam bshad las gcer bu ba'i rtag mtha' tshad mas bsal ba'i skabs sam le'u bdun pa'i 'grel ba grub zin to//245

grub mtha'i rnam pashad le'u brgyad pa bye smra'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/pra ṇa ma mi sur swas+t+ya/ bla ma dang mkhyen pa'i gter dkar ser rnamacigasu ma dbye ra med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir gnyis pa rang sde bdag med phra rags gtan la phab rim la/ lung rigs kyis rang sde'i grub mtha' bzhir bzhag pa dang / so so'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la 'thad ldan bzhag /'khrul ba dgag /theg pa che chung gi brtsad tshul gsum/ ding po ni rang sde bye smra mdo sems dbu ma ba/ /bzhir nges 'dir ni grub mtha' lngar min gsungs/ zhes pa rang sde la bye jimado dbu seca5 sa bzhir grangs nges te/ ston pa gzhan gyi lugs la de ltar dka' ya nga / shāka seng gi bstan pa 'di la grub mtha' lnga ba dang / theg pa nyam/ rang theg chen gsum las gzhan pa'i theg pa bzhi ba med par mdo sngas/sa du ma dang / mkhas grub du mas bshad pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/rig/sa ldan grags pas/ bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma ru/ /'gyur ro zhes dang / rdo rje snying 'grel las/ de nas bye brag smra ba'i gzhung / /de nas mdo sde pa zhes 'gyur/ /rang chos 6rnam shes smra ba dang / /de nas dbu ma'i gzhung zhes bya/ zhes pa dang /nyarngo/ thos pa dang rang rgyal 'dir/ /theg pa chen po gsum pa ste/ / 246

༄ngas rgyas pa yi bzhi ba dang / /thub pa'i gzhung ni lnga ba med/ ces grub mtha' dang theg pa'i grangs nges bstan cing 'phags pa lhas kyang /sa ngas rgyas rngo+os ni rnam pa bzhir/ /yid 'dod rnams kyis mngon mthong ste/ /bye brag smra la sogs pa'i lam/ /bshad pa'i de nyid sgrub pa po/zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar yang / yang dag par bsdus na rnam pa bzhir mthong ste/ gang zhe na 'og nas 'chad pa'i bye brag tu smra ba la sogs pa'i lam zhes dang / zla ba'i zhabs kyis kyang / bye brag tu smra ba dang / ñca / do sde pa dang / nam par shes par smra ba rnams/ ni/ dngos po yod pa grub pa'i mtha' la mi srid pa sto na pa na zhes dngos smra ba gsum du bshad pas dbu ma dang bzhir 'dod cing / slob dpon lhan skyes rdo rjes kyang /mdo sde bye brag smra rnam rig /dbu ma'i zhes dang / slob dpon a wa dhu ti pas kyang / rdo rje snying 'grel ltar bshad pa ni/ de nyid rin phreng las/ thes/ pa ni gsum ste/ nyan thos kyingotheg pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa/ theg pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /gnas pa bzhi ste/ bye brag tu ma ba dang / mdo sde ba dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / dbu ma nga 'i dbye bas so/ zhes dang / slob dpon dgra las rgyal bas kyang bde gshegs gzhung gi rab byed rang 'grel las/ kha che bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sde pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / dbu ma pas dbye ba'i sangs rgyas pa bzhis so // zhes dang /ne mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i chud las spyod lam la hūṃ gas bye brag chos/ /mdo sde rnam shes dbu ma ba/ /mos nga/'i semaṭasdo can nam pa shad de/ zhes dang / rdo rje a ra lizhi rgyud las/ kha cig 247

pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /kha cig byi brag smra ba'i lam/ /kha cig tu ni mdo sde pa/ /kha cig tu ni rnam shes nyid/ ces gsungs pa bzhin dgyes rdor sogs du mar bshad pa'i phyir/ theg pa yang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang sangs rgyas gzhan la gsum gyi tha snyad kho nar yang ma nges te/dpal mgon klus mdo kun btus las/ de lta mod kyi sems can gyi dagleba'i tshogs spyod pa tha dad pa dang / 'dul ba'i dbang dang / theg pa sna tshogs kyi sgo ston pas kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos bstan pa 'jug go/ /theg pa gsum du yang ma zad de zhes sdong po bkod pa'i snang byed dpal gyi 'jig rten na de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro dpal yon tog rgyal gyi rnam thar dper mdzad pas so/ /grub mtha' bzhi bo de dag theg pa che chung gi grub mtha' smra ba gnyis su 'du ste/ grub mtha'i sgos bzhag na bye mdo gnyis/ nyan thos sde pa'am nyin thos pa dang / dbu sems gnyis theg chen pa'am theg chen sde pa gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ bye mdo gnyis nyan thos kyi sde snod tsam khas blangs name/ der bshad pa'i grub mtha' zhe nas smra ba yin pas na nyan thos par bzhag la/ dbu sems gnyis theg chen gyi mdo sde rgya chen po'i bshad tshul theg chen thun mong min pa gang rung re snying nas dam bca' smra ba'i gang zag yin pas theg chen par bzhag pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'di bzhi theg dman theg chen sde tshul gnyis/ /theg gsum la sdud gsum 'dod lngar dbye 'khrul/ zhes pa sngar grub mtha'—248

bzhir bshad pa de lta ra dang / spub mtha' smra ba bzhi bo yang theg pa che chung gi grub mtha' smra ba gnyis su nges pa de'i phyir/ bod kha cig bye mdo gnyis nyan thos dang / sems tsam pa rang rgyal dang / dbu sems byang sems kyi theg pa bar sdud pa dang / de bzhin du kun shes mkhan mos kyang / bye smra'i nang du mdo sde pa 'dod pas grub mtha' gsum byas pa dang / bod kha cig /gnas ma bu ba bye smra las gzhan byas te grub mtha' lngar 'dod pa rnaca/sa 'khrul te/ sngar bshad pa'i grub mtha' bzhir bshad pa'i lung dang / lhag tu sangs rgyas pa la lnga pa mi rigs par shasungs pa rnams dang 'gal zhing rigs pa yang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ lam ma zhugs na grub mtha' smra ba bzhi med par thal ba dang / nang ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan yin na lam zhugs yin dgos par thal ba dang / dge tsho bsnyen dge tshul sogs so thar sdom ldan yin na lam zhugs yin dgos par shā thal pa dang / lam ma zhugs na skyabs 'gro dang bstan pa la zhugs pa med par thul ba sogs gnod byed mi lang ngo / /des na skal bzang mig 'byed ltar/ gang zag nyan thos pa ni nyan thos kyi lam zhugs dgos la/ des theg chen gyi sde snod khas len par ma zad don rtogs kyang / / bsam pa shugs chung bas rang don la zhugs pa shā ri'i bu lta bu sogs yin/ grub mtha' theg dman pa ni/ theg dman gyi sde sngod ltar gyi byang chub tsam lam bcas khas len kyang theg chen gyi bka' mi lerbe pa 'am blangs yang brjod don thun mong min pa mi 'dod pa dag yin pas de da nga / ga la gcig /'di dag la dpyad bya mang ste ma spros so/ /tsho+or+sha 249

gsum pa la rtsod pa dngarmelan genyis las/ dang po ni/ — nyan thortesde gnyis kun gzhi nyon yid dang / /chos kyi bdag med sa bcu sku gsum sogs/ /theg chen‘sngon bkar mi 'dod phyiru/ 'dod grags/ zhis pa/ sngon gyi nyan thos sde pa dog ni/ ji skad du/ mdo sde sogs su ma bsdus dang / /lam gzhan nye bar ston phyir yang / /theg chen sangs rgyas gsung min te/ /rig byed mtha' yi lta ba bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ theg chen sangs rgyas kyis gsungs ba ma yin te/ sde snod gsum du bsdus par mi snang ba dang / gaṅgā sogs la khrus dang sngags bzlas pas sdig pa 'dag pa sogs la ma gzhan ston po'i phyir dang / rig byed mtha'i ji lta ba bzhin smras pa'i phyir dang / rgyang pan bzhin du thams cad stong pa nyid cikhas blangs pas las 'bras bden bzhi dkom/ mchog sogs med par bshad pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma las/ gal te 'di dag kun stong na/ /skye ba med cing 'akag med pas/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po rnams/ /khyod la med par thal bar 'gyur/ /lta bu zhes legs ldan gsungs/ yang theg pa chen po ni sde ba bco brgyad po gcig gi khongs su gto ga sa na'ang /sangs rgyas kyi bkar rigs pa las de ca/ dmigs pa dang / bka' bsdu ba dang po'i dus su'ang ma bsdus la/ phyis phye bar gyur pa na yang sdud par byed pa rnams kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyir dang / longs sku dus rtag tu bzhugs par bshad pa nasdo— 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par bshad pa dang 'gal/ bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems shes su zhig sgyid lug 'gyur/ —zhes byang sems bde bar 'gro bar bshad pas be+eg bcasadzha250

thams cad sdus/ bsngal ba dang 'gal/ bde gshegs snying pos kunu / la khyabo pa dang / len pa'i rnam shes bstan pas bdag k+shid dang 'gal/sangs rgyas mya ngan yongasagyimi 'da'/ zhes dang / nyan thos dgra ba co ma sangs rgyas par lung ston pas myang 'das zhi ba dang 'gal lo/ dgra bcom la smod pa dang / khyim par phyag bya bar ston pa dang / sangs rgyas las byang semyo/sa bsngags pa dang / nam mkha' mdzod du byang sems kyi smon lam yang tshig tsam yin pa'i phyir dang / shāka thub sbrul par bshad pa dang / rtag rtu mnyam bzhag kho nar dang / las 'bras med pa'i bsngags pa ston pa darnga / sdig chen po yang rtsa ba nas 'dag pa dang /shi 0—/ tu rgyas pa'i mdor yang chad lta ston pa dang / rlo kri kri'i rmi lam gyi dbye ba yang ma bstan pa dang / mngon sum dang 'jig rte:na grags par 'gal ba mang po smras pa'i phyir dang mi rtag sogs bcu drug de nyid min na de nyid med par 'gyur ba'am lhas bstan pa'i de nyid du grags pa ba lang sogs bsad pa de kho na nyid du thal la/ des na 'di ni nges par bdud kyi skye bo blo gros ngan pa dang / rmongs pa rnams bslu ba'i phyir du sna tshogs pa mang po brtsamyo/sa pa yin no/ /zhes zer de bas na sngar gyi nyan thos sde sa/nyis kyi kun gzhi dang nyon yid mi 'dod pas/ thogs med kyi lung las rtsa sdu'i rmam shes zhes pas bstan par bshad chos kyi bdag med 'bum sos/ri shrī wathe bshad pa'i bden med dang / ci gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyang mi 2radod la/ sa bcu dang theg chen nas bshad pa'i sku gsum gyi yon tan yang mi 'dod/ sogs sgrastse sngar bshad pa'i lhag ma rnams ri sdus ri251

so gnyis pa ni/ de la rje btsun byams pas rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal las ches mkhas 'ag 'a yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ zhes sogs kyis chos spong ba'i nyes pa bstan pas kyang theg chen bkar bsgrubs/mdo sde rgyan las kyang / sngar lung ma bstan lhan cig byung / /spyod yul ma yin grub pa dang / /yod dang med na yod med dang / /gnyen po dang ni sgra gzhan phyir/ zhes sogs kyis/ theg chen bdud las bstan par gnod pa yin na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pas lung ston dgos pa la ma byung ba'i phyir dang / theg pa che chung lhan cig tu byung ba'i phyir na theg chen bka' yin pa sogs rgya cher bsgrub bo/ /de bzhin du rin chen phreng bar klu'i zhabs kyis/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des/ /theg pa chen por ga la 'a:ra/ zhes nyan thos kyi sde snod tsam la sangs rgyas kyi lam ma tshang tshul gsungs te theg chen bkar bsgrubs/legs ldan gyis/ theg chen sangs rgyas gsung yin te/ /bdag med la sogs ston pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi bdag nyid na /ston sbyir slob ma'i theg pa bzhin/ zhes bdag med pa stong pa sdug bsngal mi rtag pa sogs ston pa'i phyir dang / zhes sangs rgyas chos/ dge 'dun te dkon mchogad+ku gsum gyi bdag nyid chen po dag ston pa'i phyir dang / theg chen sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin te/ nyan thos kyi sde snod bzhin no/ /yang 'di dag bka'ad+kuyin te/ 'dul ba la snang / mdo sde la 'jug /252

chos nyid dang rma 'gal/ chos kyi phyag rgya bzhi dang yang mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ yang na rgyan las/ rang gi 'dul la snang phyir dang / zhes sogs ltar rnam pa gcig tu na/ theg chen gyi thun mong min pa nyan thos kyi sde snod la mi snang yang skyon med de/ der med kyang sgeg chen rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsdu ba po kun bzang 'adz+ram dbyangs/ gsang bdag byams pa sogs kyis bsdus pa'i phyir sdud pa po'ang mi gcig la/ rang gi sde snod gsum dang mthun pa sogs dang / yang dbyig gnyen gyis/ bla ma kun dga' 'od zer dang / /sdug bsngal phung ston sa ston dang / /'char ka stong nyid chu la skyes/ zhes sogs dang / legs ldan gyis kyang /bla makun dga' pa ta le/ /sdug bsngal phung po sa ba dang / /'char byed stong pa 'char ba dang / zhes sogar+sā ltar nyan thos kyi sde snod kyi mdo ming yod la da lta dngos su med pa dang / mdo 'ga' ma tshang ba bzhin du theg chen yang deng dus med la de dus nas nyan thos kyi ma thos pa mang zer ro byang sems la phyag 'tshal ba sde pa bco brgyad kyi gzhung du gsungs pa'i phyir/ sde pa bco brgyad kyi khongs su'ang 'du la/ khyad par 'grel bshad las/ dge 'dun phal chen sde nyid kyi sde snod kyi gzhi chen po zhes bya ba'i khongs su theg pa chen po de nyid gtogs te/ rme de na sa bcu ba'i mdo dang / pha rol tu byin pa'i mtshan nyid dag 'byung pa'i phyir dang /dge 'dun phal chen sde nyid kyi shar gyi ri bo'i sde dang / nub kyi ri bo'i sde dag las kyang / 'phral skad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dag 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ zhes dang / de nyid 253

las/ dge 'dun phal chen sde snod dag yi/ 'jimo/ rtem/ snu/ ba'i sde byo da kyi rkagazhi chen po 'a/sa kyang / theg pa chen po'i ma mo dang / sa bcu b.riri mdo la sogs pa phal cher 'byung ste/ zhes dang / dge 'dun phal chen pa'i bzang po'i lam pa phobang dpal yon can na gnas pa'i shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod las/ stobs dang mngon shes dbang thob pa/ thub pa nyi ma rnal 'byor pa/ /kun tu bzang la sogs pa ni/ /sa bcu po la gnas bcasaḥnas/ zhes dang / 'phags pa gnas brtan 'jigs med ri pa'i sde snod khri nyis stong pa las/ go cha chen po'i go bgos nas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dbang thob cing / /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams mngon gyur pa/ zhes pa legs ldan gyis drangs pa ltar/ theg pa chen po 'di dag gis bsdus par 'dod pas na kri kri'i mi lam gyis kyang mi gnod pa'i phyir sogs rgya cher bsgrubs shing / len pa'i rnam shes yang mi rtag par 'dod pa'i bdag med dang mi 'gal/ gaṅgā sogs la khrus byas tsam gyis sdig mi 'dag la/ der gnas klu ma dros pa'i smon lam gyis nam zhig bshes gnyen byas nas 'dag bar bshad pa mi 'gal/ smyung gnas sogs lha'i sngags smub ched dang / gzungs ni ting 'dzin shes rab khyad par can la 'dod cing / de ston pa'i yi ge la gzungs sngags btags pas mi 'gal/ stobs bzhi tshang na nges pa'i las 'dag pa dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi smon lam yang 'bras bu mngon byung yod pas tshig tsam min la/ da lta ma byung yang yi dwags 'ga'i ltar dang / yang dgalta ba sngon 'gro ba'i/— /rdziltar 'byung ba'i lam 'di 254— 4

nyid/ /theg chen du ya/nga nyer bstan pas/ /de dag gtan tshigs ma grub nyid/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ bden rnam bcu drug yang dag pa'i lta bar 'dod pa don dam par mi 'thad la/ kun dzob tu mthun pas khyod kyi rtags ma grub la/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba dag /'jig rten grags pa ji lta bar/ /de bzhin de ni 'gog pa min/ /de phyir gtan tshigs ma grub nyid/ ces gsungs pa ltar don dam par mtha' kun 'gog la kun rdzob tu rgyu 'bras mi 'gog pas chad lta bstan pa'ang ma grub bo/ /nam mkha'i lha'i de nyid du yang ga la 'gyur te/ de dag tshangs par zhen che bas tshangs pas lha rnams bskyed pas des bstan pa de nyid du 'dod pas so/ /shāka thub yang 'og min gyi rnam snang chen po'i sprul ba yin la der ma zad sku tshe 'ga' ma bzhugs pa'i tshul dang / bsnyung tshul dang 'tsho byed la bsnyung sman dri tshul dag sprul pa min na bskal ba grangs med pa gsum du srog mi gcod pa sogs tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu la de 'dra ji ltar 'thad/ 'di sprul ba min par so skye yin na mdzad pa bcu gnyis ji ltar ston/ sde pa tha dad kyi gzhung las kyang sangs rgyas kyi sprul bar bshad pa yod de/ log zhen gyi rngon pa'i ched du rngon pa'i gzugs su dang / mi dbang pad+ma skyes 'dul ba'i phyir rgan po'i gzugs su sprul ba'i phyir dang / ma 'gags pa la lha'i mig gis gang mthong dris pas/ ma 'gags pas smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul ba dang bar ma'i sems can grangs med pa dag mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pas khyod kyis smras pa la snying po med pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ 'ga' yis tshig gis 255

smrar med par/ /bya bar mi nus zhib pa'i blos/ /snying po yod dam snying po med/ /mkhas pas de la dpyad par gyis/ zhes pa ltar shing rta chen po mang pos legs par bsgrubs pas so/ /des na sngon gyi nyan thos sde gnyis theg chen bkar mi 'dod kyang / klu sgrub yab sras dang /thogs med sku mched yab sras/ phyogs glang chos grags phyin chad theg chen bkar 'dod pa'i nyan thos sde pa gnyis/ byung zhes bod kyi sngon gyi mkhasadzhapa 'ga' zhig 'dod par grags pa yang legs par go ste/ bye smra la yang phal chen sde pa'i mdo dag dang theg chen mthun pas theg chen 'dod pa kha shas yod rnga/ra mngon te/ rigs pas sgrub pa'i phyir te/ de dus kyi bye smra spyi dang gnas ma bus/ kyang thag chen gyi mdo las dngos po med par r+shagasungs pa de grangs can sogs mu stegs lugs kyi rtag dngos dgag pa yin zhes dgongs pa len pa'i phyir dang / de ltar bshad pa zhi 'tsho yab—sras kyang bzhed pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma rgyan rang 'grel las de lta min na—bye brag tu smra ba dang ci/ gnas ma bu'i tshul gyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'di ni lhur grangs can la sogs pa'i lugs pye/ dngos po dgag pa yin no zhes 'di bshad mi nus pa ci yod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rje yab sras kyang bzhed de/ rgyud bla ma'i rnam bshad las/ gnas ma bu pa'i sde pa la yang theg pa chen po'i mdo sde la skur ba 'debs pa dang / mir+sha'adebs pa gnyis yod la/ kha che bye brag tu smra ba sogs la yang gnyis yod par shes par bya'o zhes gsungs shing / jo bo'i gtam rgyud kyis kyang shes la/ bye smra'i nang tshan sde pa bco brgyad la theg chen 'dod mi 'dod 256

gnyis yod pa 'di thogs med zhabs kyi 'ang dgongs pa yin te/ bye smra'i gnas ma bu pa gang zag gi bdag med phra mo mi 'dod pa la theg chen bka' min zhes skur ba 'debs pa'am/ sdang mi sdang gnyis yod cing / de'i rigs pas sde pa gzhan la'ang sdang mi sdang gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla thogs 'grel las/ der nges par lhung ba chos 'di pa nyid de dag las/ kha cig theg pa chen po'i chos la sdang ba ste/ zhes sogs kyis dang / yang 'grel ba de las/ rnam pa du ma'i mu stegs pa mang po dang /de dang mthun par spyod pa chos 'di pa nyid dad pa yod kyang nyes par bzung ba 'dzin pa ste/ de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ don dam pa la mi mos pa gang zag tu lta ba ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di gnyis ka gnas ma bu ba'i bye brag bye smra kha cig yin te/ chos 'di pa zhes gnyis kar byung pas rang sde yin cing / gang zag tu smra ba zhes pas bdag smra bar bstan pa'i phyir/ 'di gnyis snga mas thar ba don gnyer mi byed cing / theg chen bka' min zhes sdang bas bkar khas mi len/ phyi mas thar ba don du gnyer la theg chen la mi sdang bas bkar 'dod kyang / stong nyid la skrag cing gnyisakas gang zag tu lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla ma'i dar ṭika las/ sngar gong du bshad pa'i chos 'di pa dang gang zag gi bdag khas len par 'dra yang / snga ma la thar ba don gnyer med cing /theg pa chen po'i chos la sdung ba yin la phyi ma 'di thar ba tsam la don gnyer yod cing / theg pa chen po'i chos la skur ba mi 'debs pa kha cig go /zhes so/ /mdo sde pa la ni shin tu gsal te/ grub mtha' dang mdo 257

sngagatra/ thams cad kyi bshad pa mnga' ba'i slob dpon byang chub bzang pos/'di ni sgo drug pa dang / 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde rnams sgra ji bzhin du khas len pa'i zhes pa nas 'di dag thego pa chen po zhes kyang brjod de/ lung dang snying rje chen po dag dang ldan pa'i phyir/zhes dang / de nyid rin chen phreng ba las kyang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la gsum ste/ mdo sde pa dang rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / dbu ma pa la gnas pa'i dbye bas so/ zhes so/ /des na spyir slob dpon 'di gnyis kyi bshad pa tshig zin ltar mi rung 'dra snyam pa 'ga' tsam snang yang /'di ltar bshad pa ni shin tu rung ste/ de gsum gas phar phyin bkar khas blangs yang / khyad med du mi 'gyur ba ni dgongs pa 'grel lugs gsum byed pa'i phyir dper na dbu sems gnyis kyis bzhin/ rnam 'grel las kyang / phung bo la sogs bye brag gis/ /mtshan nyid thams cad byed pa yin/ /khyad par can de'ang de nyid min/ /des kyang de dag mtshan nyid bral/ zhes sher phyin mdo'i dgongs pa blangs pa'i phyir tshul 'di'ang rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi mdo sde pa gcig pu min par phyis kyi lung rigs kyi mdo sde pa gnyis ka'i 'dod tshul du shes par bya ste/ der ma zad btsun pa dge srung la sogs pa lung gi rjes 'brang rnamyo sa kyis kyang sher mdo sogs khas mi len par rmi smra bar dngo/ ngas pa blangs nas 'chad pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma rgyan rang 'grel las/ rang gi sde pa gang dag chos thams cad dngos / po med pa la sogs pa'i mdo'i tshig gi 'chad pa na smad pa dang nyung ba'i don la sogs par 'chad de/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel bshad 258

las / rang gi sde pa gang dag ces bya ba ni btsun pa dge srung la sogs pa ste zhes gasdongs pa lta bu yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ paṇa chen lhan skyes rdo rjes/ mdo sde bye brag smra rnam rig /dbu ma'i rim bzhin gsal ba'i phyir/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med bshad/ ces pa ltar grub mtha' bzhis rim gyis gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa bshad tshul gsal bar bshad ces pa ltar 'di la gnyis/ gang zag gi bdag med phra rags gtan la dbab pa'i dang chos kyi bdag med phra rags gtan la dbab pa'i grub mtha' bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/ rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag med gtan la dbab pa'i dang / rdzas yod kyi bdag med gtan la dbab pa'i grub mtha' bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/ sgra bshad dbye ba grub mtha'i lugs bshad pa gsu/ma/dang po ni/ bye brag bshad mtsho gtso bor smra phyir dang / /rdzas kyi bye brag smra bas bye smra ba/ zhes pa gzhung bye brag bshad mtsho'i rjes su 'brang bas dang / brjod bya 'chad tshul rdzas kyi bye brag mang du smra ba ba/ nyis ka'i sgo nas bye brag smra bar btags te/ kun btus 'grel ba las/ du sa gsum rdzas kyi bye brag tu yod par smra ba'am/ bye brag tu bshad pa chen po'i lung dang ma/thun par smra bas na de dag la de skad ces bya'o/ zhesri dang /'grerkakyu ba rgyar sras mar yang / bye brag bshad mtsho zhes/ dang / ris/sa ldam gags pas/ kha cheri gzhung gi chu gter gyi/ /bye brag smra ba'i sa/zhung 'do da 'gyur/ zhes chu gter ram rgya mtsho'i sgras bshad pas/ kha cig 259

hoshad mtsho min zer ba mi 'thad do// gnyis pa la/ 'thad ldan dang / 'khrul ba dgag pa gnyis las/dang po ni/ gyes tshul gnyis sogs yod smra phal chen dang / /gnas brtan mang bkur sde bdun lnga gsum gsum zhes pa dbye na sde pa bco brgyad yod de/ gyes tshu' ni/ rtog ge 'bar ba dang / sde pa tha dad klag pa'i 'khor lo dang / slob dpon pad+ma'i dge tshul slong gi lo dri ba gnyis dang / 'od ldan dag las byung la/ de yang rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi las dang / gcig las dang / gnyis las dang / gsum las gyes tshul dag yod pa'i phyir te/ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu drug na gnas brtan pa so sos skad legs sbyar/ zur chag dang / rang bzhin pa dang / bha za'i skad kyis bton pas rtsa ba'i sde bzhir gyes bar rgyud sde spyi rnam las so/ /rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'i ngos 'dzin la dul lha sogs spyi'i lugs dang / pad+mas gsung lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba 'ga' zhig gis 'dod par grags pa ni/ rtsa ba'i sde bzhi thams cad yod par smra ba dang /phal chen pa dang / gnas brtan pa dang / mang bkur ba bzhi'i dbye ba ni/rim bzhin bdun dang lnga dang gsum dang gsum yin te dul ba lhas/ 'od srung sa ston chos srung sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phye dang gzhi kun pa/ /thams cad yod par smra ba bdun/ /shar dang nub dang gangs rir gnas/ /'dus byas rtag par smra ba dang / /'jig rten 'das smra phal chen lnga/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med gnas / /gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan gsum/ /sa sgrog ri dang 26 0

bsrung ba pa/ /gnas ma bu pa'i sde rnams ni/ /kun gyiṭa/ bkur ba rnam pa gsum/ zhes so/ /'di btus pa'i khungs bzang bas 'di ltar bzung ngo / /sa/nyis ngachi ni/ yod smra bzhi/ phal chen par drug /mang bkur la lnga gnas brtan pa gsum du 'dod de/ dge slong gi 'o dri ba las// 'od srungs zhes bya sa srung dang / /chos srung zhes ni bya ba dang //gzhi kun yod par smra ba ni/ zhes dang / dge 'dun phal chen dbye ba ni/ /drug ste shar gyi ri bo dang / /de bzhin nub ri zhes bya dang / /gangs gnas/ zhes bya de las gzhan/ /rnam par phye ste smra ba dang / / gzhan ni de bzhin btags par smra/ /'jis/ rten 'das smra zhes/ bya ba/zhes dang / mang pos bkur ba'i bye brag ni/ /rnam pa lngar ni mkhas pas bsgrags/ /gos dmar ba dang srung ba pa/ /ku ru ku l+le de las gzhan/ /mang du thos pa zhes bya dang / /gnas ma bu pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa dang / /'jigs med ri la gnas pa dang / /gtsug lag khang chen la gnas pa/ /gnas brtan dbye ba gsum du 'dod/ ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba rnams kyis 'dod tshul ni/ slob dpon shākya 'od kyis sngon 'di gcig bu las med pa las phyis chos rgyal mya ngan med 'das rjes su gzhan rnams skad 'don tshul gyis gyes par bshad pas so/ /gsum pa sde ba gnyis su gyes tshul ngos 'dzin ni/ yang na phal chen sde brgyad gnas/ brtan bcu/ zhes pa/ gnas brtan pa'i 'dod par grags pa la legs ldan ltar na lugs gcig la/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas/261

) pe la lar lo drug brgya zer yang / lo brgya dang bcu drug na chos rgyal nu/ ngan med pa'i tshe grong khyer me tob/ gis brgyan pa ra dge 'dun rtson pa'i rdzochos 'ga' 'byung ba'i dbang gis/ dge 'dun phal chen pa dang / gnas brtan pa gnyis su gyes la/ dang po la brgyad de/ phal chen pa dang tha snyad gcig pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba dang / mang thos pa dang / rtag par smra ba dang / mchod rten pa dang / shar ri ba dang / nub kyi ri bo pa'o/ /phyi ma la bcu ste/ gangs ri ba dang /thams cad yod smra dang / gnas ma bu pa dang / chos mchog pa dang /bzang po'i lam pa dang / kun gyis bkur ba dang / mang ston pa dang /choṭaṭa sbas pa dang / 'od srung ba dang / bla ma dgadzige /mang bkur ba'i 'dod par grags pa yang lugs gcig la/ sangs rgyas 'das nas lo brgya dang so bdun na/ rgyal po dga' bo dang pasle chen po'i dus grodo khyer pa tra li bu trar bdud sdig can bzang po zhes pas dge slo da gi cha byad kyis rdzu 'phrul sna tshogaṭashrī bstan te/ gzhi lngas dge 'dun gyi dbyen chen po bskyed pas sngar ltar rtsa ba'i sde gnyis su gyes nas/ lo drug cu re gsum du 'khrugs kyis gnas pa las/ de rjes lo nyis brgya 'das par gnas brtan gnas ma'i bus yang dag par bsdus pa las rim gyis gyes te/ phal chen pa la tha snyad gcig pa dang / ba lang gnas gnyis gyes pas ma bu gsum/ba lang rga/nas la'ang mang thos/ brtag smra ma cho da rten pa ste gsum gyes pas drug ste/ legs ldan gyis/ de dag ni dge 'dun phal chen pa'i dbye ba drug yin no/ zhes so/ /gnas brtan pa la'ang gangs ri ba thams cad 262 rī

yod smra ba/ gnas ma bu pa gsum gyes/ yod smra las rnam par phye ste smra—ba dang / bla ma pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang mang ston pa dang / chos sbasañcapa dang / gos dmar ba dang / 'od srung pa bzhi gyes te yod smra bdun—te/ ji skad du/ rnam pa bdun po de lta bu dag tu thams cad yod par smra ba'i dam tshig dag gnas so/ zhes so/ /gnas ma bu pa las ri chen po dang mang bkur ba gnyis gyes/ ri chen po las chos mchog pa dang / la ma bzang pa gnyis gyes pas gnās ma bu sde bzhi ste/ ji skad du/ gnas ma bu pa'i sde rnam pa bzhir gnas pa yin no/ zhes so/ /de ltar gnas brtan pa ni bcu gnyis so/ /bzhi ba ni/ dge 'dun phal chen pa'i 'dod par grags pa yang rtsa ba'i sde gsum du gyes pa'i dus sogs gnyis su gyes tshul snga ma dang 'dra la/ de nas rtsa ba'i gnas brtan pa/phal chen pa rnam par phye ste smra ba gsum du gyes la/ dang po la thams cad yod smra dang / gnas ma bu gnyis gyes/ yod smra la'ang yod smra dang ma do sde pa gnyis gyes/ gnas ma bu bar mang bkur ba/ chos mchog pa/bzang po'i lam pa/ grong khyer drug pa bzhir gyes pas gnas brtan pa drug /de ba'in du phal chen pa brgyad phye nas smra ba bzhi rnams yin te/ji skad du/ gnas brtan pa ni rnam pa drug tu sa/nas so/ /ya nga phal chen sde ni rnam pa brgyad de/ dge 'dun phal chen dang / shar gyi ri bo dang / nub kyi ri bo dang / rgyal po ri ba dang / gangs ri ba dang /mchod rten pa dang / don grub pa dang / ba lang gnas pa zhes bya ste/zhes so/ /rnam par phye ste smra ba yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ sa ston pa dang / 263

'od srung ba dang / mas sbas pa dang / nas dmar ba zhes bya ba'o/zhes so/ sde pa bco brgyad kyi sgra bshad ni/ phye ba'i tshe dge 'dun phal che ba 'dus bas phal chen pa/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos thams cad thugs gcig gis mkhyen par skad cig ma gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis rtogs zhes tha snyad 'dogs pas tha snyad gcig pa dang / sangs rgyas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi chos mi mnga' bar smra bas 'das smra dang / mang thos slob dpon la brten nas mang du thos smra dang / 'dus byas phan tshun brtags pa sdug bsngal rgyur smra bas brtags smra dang / mchod rten dang / shar ri dang / nub ri rnams la gnas pas rim bzhin/mchod rten pa/ shar ri ba nub ri bdag go /gnas brtan 'phags pa'i rigs yin par ston pas gnas brtan pa/ dus gsum yod par smra bas thams cad yod smra 'am/ 'das pa'i las la yod med 'bras bu myong ma myong sgos phye ste smra bas rnam par phye ste smra ba dang / gnas pa'i rigs nyid kyi bud med ni gnas ma yin la de'i bu yin pas gnas ma'i bu ste/de'i rigre/sa yin par ston pas gnas ma'i bu dang / slob dpon chos mchog pa dang / bzang po'i lam pa dang / kun gyis bkur ba'i slob dpon gyi lugs ston pas na rim bzhin chos mchog pa sogs so/ /saṃ su'i skad kyi byings las rjes ston du bsgyur te skye bo'i tshogs chen pos yang srid mi 'byung bar ston pas na mang ston pa'o/ /slob dpon chos sbas kyi yin par smra bas chos sbas so/ /'od srung gi yin par smra bas 'od sung ba/ bla ma'i yin par smra bas bla ma'o/ /legs ldan gyi gsung ltar 264

bshad do/ /'o na sde pa'i ming 'dir bshad pa dang / gzhan nas bshad pa rnams so sor bgrang na bco brgyad las mang ba byung ba ji ltar zhe na/ ming gi rnam grangs yin pas skyon med par snang la/ ming gi rnam grangs ni/ gnas brtan pa ni gangs ri la gnas pas gangs ri ba dang /yod smra la rnam phye smra dang / byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur thams cad kyi rgyur smra bas rgyur smra dang / de nyid la kha cig ri mu run ta ka'i ri la gnas pas mu run+ta ka ba dang / mang bkur dang kun gyis bkur ba 'gyur khyad tsam ste/ de nyid las/ kha cig a pan ta'i grong khyer du yang dag par bsdus pas a pan ta ka dang / kha cig ku ru ku la'i ri la gnas pa'i phyir ku ru ku la ba'o/ /'od srung ba la dam chos kyi char bzang po 'bebs pas char bzang 'bebs pa dang / bla ma la de nyid las kha cig /'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu phung po 'pho bar smra bas 'pho bar smra ba'o/ /'on kyang rtog ge 'bar bar lung drangs par 'jig rten 'das pa zhi ba dang / /don grub pa ni ri gnyis gnas/ /bzang po'i lam pa gangs ri ba/ /dge 'dun phal chen rtsa ba'i drug /ces bshad pa ltar gyi gangs ri pa dang de 'dra gzhan yang yod pas ming gi rnam grangs gzhan ma mthong zer ba'ang der 'khrul la/ kha cig 'di'i ming gi rnam grangs yang don gcig ming gi rnam grangs min te/ la la bye brag gi ming spyi la btags pa'ang mang po snang ba'i phyir te/ dper na yod smra la mu run+ta par btags pa banin te/ des na 'dir de nyid las kha cig ces pa rnams bye brag gi yin te/ legs ldan gyis/ thams cad smra ba nyid laske265

rnam par phye ste smra ba dang / rgyur smra ba dang / kha cig mu rusnya pa yang zerā ba dang / zhes dang / sgra bshad skabs su gang 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba thams cad yod de/ zhes smra ba'i phyir thams cad yod par smra ba'o/ /de dag nyid la zhes pa nas/ de dag nyid la gang cung zhig byung ba dang / 'byung ba dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba de thams cad ni rgyu dang bcas pa'o/ zhes smra bas rgyur smra ba'o/ /de rnams nyid las kha cis/ mu run+ta'i ri la gnas pa'i phyir mu run+ta ka ba zhes bya'o/ zhes ming snga ma gcig yin pas kha cig dang dgar tshis/ gis sgra ma byung la phyi mar byung bas so/ /zer ba ltar snang yang kha cig ces pa ming 'dogs mkhan la sbyar na legs par sems so/ /'di'i sde pa bco brgyad tshan pa gsum gyi nang ming gcig pa byung bas don gcig tu byed mi rung ste/ sde pa bco brgyad kyi 'dren tshul lugs tha dad pa yin pa'i phyir te/ dge 'dun phal chen par dul lha dang dbyig bshes kyis lnga dang / legs ldan gyis brgyad dang / rtsa ba'i sde gsum du 'dod mkhan gyis de dang mi 'dra bar brgyad dang / yang slob dpon gnyis su 'dod mkhan gyis phal chen par drug byas pa bzhin te/ 'di dag gi sgra bshad snga ma'i legs ldan skabs kyis yin yang / sde pa so so'i 'dod tshul slob dpon phyi ma'i lugs la mdzad de/ gzhan yang zhes sde pa so sor ma sbyar ba'i yang 'dod tshul bshad pas so/ /rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'i gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba ni/ skad legs sbyar dang / mkhan po rgyal rigs tshul khrims rnam dag gi mchog tu lung bstan pa sras sgra gcan 'dzin nas snam sbyar snam phran nyer lnga nas 266

snagu yan/ grwa rtags ut+pal pad+ma rin po tshe shing lo bzhi'o/ /ming dpal dang 'od dang grags pa dang bzang po'i mtha' can te/ sgra gcan 'dzin dpa ra dang / klu sgrub mtshan la dpal ldan bzang po dang / shākya dpal lta bu yin te/ dgra bcom pas byas pa'i ming gi nges brjod las/blo gros zhi ba 'byung gnas spas/ /dpal bzang grags pa yod smra'o/ /zhes so/ /phal chen pa skad pra kri ta rang bzhin pa dang / mkhan po bram ze'i rigs sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi mchog tu lung bstan pa 'od srung nas/ snam phran nyer gsum nas/ bdun yan grwa rtags dung / ming ye shes sam/ sbas pa'am/ snying po'i mtha' can te/ mar me mdzad ye shes dang / 'jigs med 'byung gnas sngas pa lta bu yin te/ nges brjod las/ bshes gnyen ye shes snying po dang / /bzang po dge 'dun phal chen pa/ zhes so/ /'di'i snying po sbas pa'i don yin no/ /mang bkur ba ni/ a wa sgra ma shi ta'am yi dwags kyi skad dam zur chags/mkhan po dmangs rigs 'breg mkhan 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mchog nye bar 'khor nas/ snam phran nyer gcig nas lnga yan grwa rtags me tog so rtsi ka/ming stag los/ 'bangs dang sde pa'i mtha' can/ chos 'bangs dang /grol sde lta bu zer yang / nges brjod las/ mang pos bkur la tshul khrims dang / /zla ba seng ge sbas pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ da na shi la dang / karma shī la lta bu tshul khrims mtha' can dang / bgrod dmaṇ+ḍa seng ge lta bu seng ge'am ha ri'i mtha' can yod par mngon/ gnas brtan pa ni/ skad bi sha tsi sha za'i skad dam 'bring du 'don pa/ mkhan 267

po rje rigs spyig ma mkhan mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i mtshog tu lung bstan pazhekabya ya na nas/ snam phran snga ma ltar dang / grwa rtags 'khor lo ming lha dang / 'byung gnas dang / go cha ste/ rin chen 'byung gnas dang /shes rab go cha lta bu yin te/ nges brjod las/ gnas brtan pa la go cha lha/ /sde dang 'tsho dang skyong ba'o/ zhes so/ /mkhan po'i ming gi mtha' can yang yod de/ mkhan chen zhi 'tshos bod la mdzad pa lta bu dag go /gnyis pa ni/ de kun bye smra'i sde dang sde gnyis 'gal/ /'dus tsam la chung theg chen bshad phyir yang / /mang bkur sde lngas brjod med bdag smra yang / /gsum ldan bdag med kun mtshungs de ga'an min/zhes pa sde pa bco brgyad po bye brag smra ba'i sde par khas blangs nas/ yang lo chen sher rin gyis/ sa ston pa dang / dpe ston sogs grub mtha' gnyis pa mdo sde par 'dod pa 'gal bar ma zad nyes pa yang che bar snang ste/ rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'i skabs sa ston pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde yin pas/ rtsa ba'i grub mtha' dang mdo sde'i lugs mi mthun la/ sa ston pa rang gi 'dod pa'i skabs su 'ang bar do mi 'dod par bshad pas/mdzod rang 'grel gyis de rgyas par sun phyung zhing / khyed mdzod rang 'grel dus slob dpon dbyig gnyen mdo sde par 'dod pas so/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i sde gsum gyi skabs mdo sde pa zhes pa gnas brtan pa'i nang 4tshan dang / sa ston pa rnam par phye smra'i sde bzhi'i nang tshan yin la/ khyad par du sprun ras gzigs brtul zhugs las/ rang gi sde pa rnam par miste smra ba dang / chos srung ba dang / gos dmar ba dang / gnas ma—268

bu dang / sa ston pa dang / chos mchog pa dang / sa sgrogs ri ba dang bdun ni phal cher gang zag gi bdag tu smra ba yin no zhes gsungs pas na/sde pa bco brgyad kyi nang tshan sa ston pa dang / mdo sde pa gcig par 'dod pa ni/ sngon mi gcig gi kho bos ri bong 'di wa'i bu yin par 'dod byas pa bzhin no/ /yang gal te sde pa bco brgyad kyi rab byung cho ga dang tshogs pa mi gtogs pa'i mdo sde pa med cing / sde pa bco brgyad kyi bka'i nang du mi gtogs na de'i bka' mi rnyed pas des na der bsdus snyam na/ 'on de 'dra ba'i tshul gyis 'dus tsam la sde pa bco brgyad du nyan thos sde gnyis kho na bsdus pa rgya chung ba'i skyon yod de/ theg chen gyi dbu sems dag la'ang so thar gyi cho ga sogs sde bzhi gang rung la ltos dgos pa dang / legs ldan yab sras kyis theg pa po yang phal chen pa sogs kyi mdo sder 'du bar bshad pa'i phyir/ yang sgras der 'dus tshul yang mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi tshul yin gyis sde pa de dag gi 'dod pa'i sde snod la theg chen thun mong min pa'i sde snod 'dod mi rung ste/ shing rta chen pos/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ zhes sogs kyis gnod la/ sde snod de dag gi don 'chad tshul yang gong 'og gi lugs tha dad yin pa sogs bsdu bar bya'o/ /yang kha cig mang bkur gyi sde pa gnas ma bu pa dang / bzang po'i lam pa dang / ku ru ku l+le ba dang / chos sbas pa dang /bla ma pa lnga gang zag gi bdag 'dod kyi gang zag gi bdag med mi 'dod zer ro/ /yang lo tsa pa sher rin na re/ gnas ma bu bas sa/nga zag de phung po dang gcig tha dad rtag mi rtag sogs gang du yang brjod du med kyang 269

d+dha rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dod de/ 'jug pa las kha cig de nyid—gzhan nyid rtag mi rtag /la sogs brjod med gang zag rdzas yod 'dod/ces shes byed du 'dren pa dag ni/ rang 'grel ‘ltar grub mthalnga gong ma'i rdzas yod khas blangs par song yang dngos su dang kho rang lugs kyi rdzas yod mi 'dod pa'i khyad par ma shes pa'i 'chal gtam yin no/ /de gnyis ka mi rigs te/ des kyang chos thams cad bdag med par yang 'dod la/gang zag kyang rdzas btags gang du'ang khas ma blangs pa'i phyir/ dang po—grub ste/ des gang zag phung po las ngo bo tha dad du brjod na mu stegs pa'i bdag ltar 'gyur la/ de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bkag nas chos—thams cad bdag med par gsungs pa dang 'gal la phung po yin na'ang —bdag du mar 'gyur bas gnod des na bdag brjod du med pa mdzes zhes smra ba'i phyir te/ tshad ma'i de nyid las/ mu stegs pa ltar thal 'gyur byir/ /gang zag phung bo las gzhan min/ /du mar sogs 'gyur phyir de nyid/ /ma yin de phyir brjod med legs/ zhes dang / dka' 'grel las kyang / ci ste gang zag brjod du med pa nyid la rigs pa gang yin zhe na/ mu stegs zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ gal te gang zag phung po las tha dad pa yin na/ de ni mu stegs byed kyis kun tu btags pa'i bdag tu lta bar 'gyur ro/ zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ṭ+wāg pa'i mtha' bkag pa dang / chos thams cad bdagar+shamed pa'o zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhes dang / gang zag du mardzinyid du 'gyur na gcig tu'ang 'dod de/ ji skad du 'jig rten skye ba na 270

gang zag gcig skye ste/ 'di lta ste/ dper na de bzhim gshegs pa bzhin—no/ zhes so/ /'dis ni sde pa 'di pas gang zag gi bdag med mi 'dod zer ba'i lugs ngan sel lo/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ mdzod 'grel las/ gang gnas ma'i bu rnams gang zag yod par 'dod pa ji lta bur 'di ni re zhig dpyad par bya ba yin te/ ci de dag rdzas su 'dod dam 'on te btags/ par 'dod ces pa nas/ de ni rdzas su yod pa kho na'ang min la/ btags par yod pa yang ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /'o na ci'i phyir gang zag brjod du med par khas blangs snyam na/ rigs pa sngardzim de yin la/ lung ni mdo las/ dge slong dag ngas khyed la khur yang bstan par bya'o/ /khur len pa dang / khur 'dor ba dang / khur 'khyer ba yang bstan par bya ste/ de la khur ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga rnams so/ /khur len pa ni sred pa'o/ /khur 'dor ba ni thar—ba'o/ /khur 'khyer ba ni gang zag go /zhes bshad pa la brten nas/dka' 'grel las/ 'di ltar zhes sogs ltar las byed pa po/ 'bras bu longs spyod pa po/ phung po snga ma dor nas phyi ma len pa'i 'khor ba po dang / grol ba po'i bdag 'dod la/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyis khur 'khyer ba ni gang zag ste/ rtag pa'am mi rtag pa zhes ni mi brjod do/ / zhes pas brjod du med par 'dod do/ /'jug pa'i lung don thal 'gyur ba ltar na/ rdzas yod khas blangs par song ba'i don yin no/ /des na mang bkur sde lngas las 'bras kyi rten gyi gang zag gam bdag ni brjod dzhadu med pa khas len cing smra yang mu stegs pa'i 'dod pa'i rtag pa dang /271

phung po las ngo bo tha dad pa dang / cha shas med pa'i gcig pu ste khyad par gsum ldin gyi khyad par dang tshogs pa gang dang yang ldan pa'i bdag med par 'dod cing / thub pa'i lugs gces par 'dzin pa'i bye mdo kun dang mtshungs pas gzhan sde nam yang min la yang bye smra ltar mkha' sogs dngos por 'dod pas bye smra las gzhan min pa'i phyir te/ ji skad du/gnas ma bu la sogs pa dag gis ni skad cig ma dang skad cig ma min pa nyid kyi dngos po rnams phung po gnyis su 'dod de/ 'di ltar de'i 'dod pa'i blo dang sgra dang me lce la sogs pa skad cig ma yin la/ sa dang nam mkha' la sogs pa dag ni skad cig ma ma yin pa dag yin no/ /zhes so/ /zhes dang / mdzod 'grel las kyang / gang te 'di phung po rnams las gzhan du brjod par bya ba min na/ shes bya ni rnam pa lnga ste/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba dang / 'dus ma byas pa dang / brjod par bya ba min pa'o/ zhes shes bya lngar 'dod pa la 'gal ba brjod pas so/ /des na 'di bas bdag med 'dod la/ las 'bras kyi rten gang zag gam bdag ni rdzas su med pa dang rdzas su yod pa sogs su mi 'dod pas gang zag smra ba sogs las/ bdag smra ba legs ldan sogs kyis kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir te/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ sngar bstan pa'i dge 'dun phal chen pa sogs brgyad dang / phyis bstan pa'i gnas brtan pa dang / thams cad yod smra dang / mang ston pa dang / chos mchog pa dang / 'od srung ba sogs ni chos thams cad bdag med par sab yin la/ lhag ma gnas ma bu la sogs pa sde ba lnga ni gang zag tu smra ba 272
