sras mjal ba las 'di lta ste/ zla ba'i dkyi‘mo 'khor dpag tshad bzhi khri gnyis stong nas 'gro ste zhes dang / de nyid las/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas pa dang / rngams su dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong yod la/ rgyang dpag tshad rdug khri yod pa'i sa chen po zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag gi bshad tshul ṭika chen de nyid las/ ri rab kyi tshad kyang steng du 'phags pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang 'og tu yang brgyad khri bzhi stong du bshad cing / kha dog kyang ri rab kyis shar dngul/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub gser/ byang shel dkar por bshad la/ nyi ma'ang lhun po'i rtse mo'i thad nas 'char ba nub pa dang skye dgu rnams kyi tshe yar 'phel ba na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang dpag tshad brgya bar 'gyur ba dang / gling bzhi'i tshad kyang 'dzam bu'i gling ni dpag tshad stong phrag bdun yin no/ ba lang spyod ni stong phrag brgyad yin no/ /shar gyi lus 'phags po ni dpag tshad stong phrag dgu yin no/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan ni dpag tshad stong phrag bcu yin no/ zhes bshad pa dang / gser gyi ri las brgal ba'i ri rab dang nye ba rnams na yang gling mi 'dra ba du ma dang / mtsho dang ri mi 'dra ba du ma dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma'i tshad dang ldan pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pa zhig bshad la/ gser gyi ri bo stong phrag drug cu ba rnams kyi dbus na lhun po gnas zhes mi tsam ma gtogs gser gyi ri bdun gyi grangs kyang ma bshad cing gser gyi ri bo'i dpangs dpag tshad khri phrag drug cu bshad pa sogs mngon mdzod dang sa sde gnyis ka dang mi mthun pa che zhing dus 'khor dang yang gtan mi mthun no/— /der ma zad mdo dang lung gzhan las 434

kyang mngon pa dang dus 'khor gnyis ka dang mi mthun pa'i rnam bzhag zur tsam mang du 'byung zhing / de dag thams cad kyang mi mjed 'jig rten 'di dang / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad kyi dbang du byas na dag ma dag gi 'jig rten la mtha' gcig tu tshad bzhag dka' ste gdul bya'i las nyon spyod pa'i mtha' ma bkag pa bzhin du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi smon lam yang mtha' yas pa'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo las/ 'jig rten gyi khams kha cig sa lta bur 'dug go /kha cig sna chogs pad+ma'i dbyibs su 'dug go /kha cig shing rta'i dbyibs su 'dug go /steng ba/yogs med pa dang / snrel zhi dang / spyi'u tshugs dang / zhes gsungs pa dang / byang sems sa dang po bas smon lam chen po bcu 'debs pa'i nang gi smon lam drug pa zhing khams mtha' yas bar mngon du byed cing 'jug par smon pa'i mdo sa bcu pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams shin tu rgyas pa dang / tha gru che ba dang /tshad med pa dang / sra ba dang / rags pa dang / 'chol ba dang /steng sa/yogs med cing gzhi phyal ba dang / 'jug pa'i khyim can dang /zhes sogs dang / dbyigaganyen gyis de'i 'grel bar/ de la shin tu rgyache ba dang / tha gru che ba dang / tshad med pa zhes bya ba ni stong la sogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gsum po dag go /phra ba ni gang dag na yid kyi lus yod pa rnams so/ /rags pa ni gang dag na yid kyi lus ma yin pa yod pa rnams so/ /'chol ba ni go rims su mi gnas pa rnams so/ /steng g.yogs med cing gzhi phyal ba ni khyim gnas pa ma byas pa rnams so/ /435

'jug pa'i khyim can ni khyim gnas pa byas pa rnams te 'di ni mtha' dag gi mtshan nyid do/ zhes gsungs la/ 'jig rten khams kyi rgyu dang / ngo bo/ gnas tshul/ rnam dbyibs/ nges tshig lnga las/ dang po ma dag pa'i de ni sems can spyi mthun las kyis sna tshogs grub pa yin te/ dper cin las kyi sa bon khyad par las 'bras bu sna tshogs smin pa bzhin te/ phal chen las/ ji ltar sa bon khyad par gyis/ /'bru rnams sna tshogs smin pa ltar/ /de bzhin las kyi khyad par gyis/ /sems can rnams dang zhing 'byung ngo / zhes so/ /dag pa'i zhing ni klu'i nus pas mkha' la sprin chags pa ltar sangs rgyas kyis sngon byang sems dus su smon lam btab pa'i dbang gis sna tshogs su grub ste/ phal chen las/ klu'i rgyal pos sprin phung rnams/ /nam mkha'i dbyibs la ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas smon lam gyis/ /zhing rnams kun tu 'byung ba yin/ zhes gsungs/gnyis pa ngo bo ni/ ma dag pa'i de ni las nyon gyis bslad pas na ma dag la/ dag pa'i de ni las nyon gyis ma bskyed par smon lam las grub pas na dag pa zhes bya ste/ ma dag tshul yang / phal chen las/ zhing gi dbyings rnams lal ni/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par gnas/ /sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs las/ /chos nyid de dag de na snang / zhes gsungs pas dbyings ni kham sa te khams la lar nyon mongs pas sems can la las nyon mongs pa'i chos nyid dam rang bzhin nam ngang tshul kun snang zhes bshad cing / dag tshul yang / de nyid las/ zhing rnams la la 'od btang ba/ /rin chen rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rnamyo/ pa sna tshogs dri med 436

dag /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs su spyangs/ zhes gsungs pas dri med snga ma nag nog med pa dang phyi ma las nyom/ dri mas ma bslad pa'i don rnam pa sna tshogs ni zhing la'ang sbyar la gtso bor sdug kun sna tshogs kyi dri ma med par byas ma/ kun btus las/ sems can gyi 'jig rten gang yin pa dang snod kyi 'jig rten gang yin pa las dang nyo'o/ mongs pas bskyed pa/las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba 'di mtha' dag ni sdug bsngal bden pa'o/ /yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ma yin par blta ste/ las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa min/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis phyung ba min gyi/ smon lam dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang gis byung ba dag go /zhes gsungs pa dang yang mthun la 'di nyan thos sde pa phal cher gyis mi 'dod kyang dbu sems kun bzhed la spyir so skye'i gzugs phung la sdug bden dgos kyang /dag zhing so skye'i gzugs phung de ma yin pa'i dmigs bsal gces so/ /gsum pa gnas tshul yang nam mkha' la brten te dang / 'byung ba la dang /'od la dang / sangs rgyas sku'i byin la gnas pa sogs yin te/ phal cham/ las/ zhing rnams rgya mtsho la la dri med 'od can nam mkha'i dbyings la gnas/ /snang ba'i snying po'i 'od can nor bu'i rgya mtsho dag la legs par gnas/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med rgya chen pad+ma'i rgya mtsho dag la gnas/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor dbyings rnams la la sangs rgyas byin la gnas/ zhes gsungs pa bzhis rim bzhin du zhing khams dri med kyi 'od can mkha' la dang / /snang ba'i snying 'od can 437

ni nor bu'e rgya mtsho la dang / zhing mtha' dbung ste mtha' dbus med pa'irtergya chen ni pad+ma'i mtsho la dang / de la la sangs rgyas byin la gnas par bshad pas so/ /bzhi ba rnam pa dang dbyibs ni/ nor bu dang / rgya mtsho dang / ri rab dang / rdo rje dang / seng ge lta bu dang / zla gam dang / khri dang / pad+ma dang / mig dang / mdzod spu dang / sangs rgyas kyi phyag lta bu sogs yod de/ phal chen las/ phyogs rnams kun na zhing rnams rgya mtsho snang / /la la skum po la la zur gsum ste/ /de dag la la phyogs na gru bzhir gnas/ /nor bu pad+ma 'khor lo yan lag brgyad//kun kyang las rnams rgya mtshos rnam par bris/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o//yang zhing la la na gling bzhi yod pa 'di lta bu dang / gling bzhi med pa bde ba can lta bu lha mi rnams kyang lhan cig pa dang / sangs rgyas ri rab 'od yang dag 'phags kyi yid rab tu dga' ba na/ 'dzam gling la dpag tshad bye ba dang / gzhan gsum la brgyad khri re re yod pa dang / mngon dga'i zhing na gser dngul gyi skas la 'dzegs te sum cu rtsa gsum du 'gro bar bshad pa dang / de bzhin du zhing la lar 'od med pa dang yod pa gnyis dang / yod pa la'ang lha'i dang / khyim gyi dang / nyi zla'i dang /rang gi dang / ri'i dang / shing gi dang / nor bu'i dang / mar me'i dang / sangs rgyas kyi dang / pad+mo'i dang / spos chu'i 'od can sogs can sogs yod de/ phal chen las/ zhing rnams la la 'od med de/ /mun pa'i 'jigs pa shin tu che/ /reg na sdug bsngal spu gri 'dra/ /blta na mi zad skyi yang g.ya'/ /zhing rnams la la lha 'od can/ /la la khyim gyi 438

'od can te/ /la la nyi zla'i 'od dang ldan/ /zhing rnams la la rang gi 'od/ /shing gi 'od can dri ma med/ /la la ri'i 'od can te/ /zhing rnams la la nor bu'i 'od/ /la la mar me'i 'od can te/ /zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas 'od/ /zhing rnams la la pad+mo'i 'od/ /spos chu'i 'od dang ldan pa'ang yod/ /smon lam dbang gi rnam par sbyangs/zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal zhing bkod las sangs rgyas nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po'i zhing nyi zla med par smin mtshams kyi nor bus gsal ba dang /blo gros mi zad pa'i mdor 4mi 'dzum zhing na zhing bye ba khrag khrig bye ba phrag brgya nyi zla re res gsal bar bshad pa dang / de nyid las/ rgyan dang tshul rnams tha dad par/ /sna tshogs mig yor lta bur snang / gsungs ba ltar/ zhing la rgyan yod med gnyis dang yod pa la yang rim po che dang dpag bsam shing sogs kyis tha dad par bshad pa dang / de nyid las/zhing rnams la lar sangs rgyas med/ /zhing rnams la lar sangs rgyas bcas/ /la la'i zhing na sangs rgyas gcig /la la sangs rgyas mang po'o/zhes gsungs pa ltar zhing la sangs rgyas yod med gnyis dang / yod pa la'ang zhing gcig la dus gcig tu sangs rgyas gcig dang ldan pa bde ba can dang / bde gshegs kun bzang gi zhing mig mi 'dzum lta bu dang /dus gcig la zhing gcig la'ang 'dzam gling gi grangs ltar du ma cig car 'byung ba mi mjed kyi zhing 'di lta bu ste/ 'di la nyan thos sde pa la las gcig las med zer kyang phal cher gyis snga ma ltar 'dod do/ /zhing gi gnas tshad kyang bskal ba gcig dang / bcu dang / rdul grangs dang /439

byi bar gnas pa sogs yod de/ de nyid las/ zhing rnams la la bskal ba tsam/ /la la bskal ba bcu ba ste/ /zhing rnams la la rdul mnyam pa'i/ /bskal ba bye bar brjod pa yin/ zhes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams thad kar mtha' med kyang steng 'og la mtha' yod par nyan thos sde pa la la 'dod kyang / theg chen pa bzang spyod ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' med par 'dod do/ /lnga ba nges tshig ni/ bcud kyi sems can gnas pas na snod dang / 'jig pa dang ldan pas na 'jig rten zhes bya'o//gnyis pa/ stong gsum mi mjed 'di la'ang mi 'dra ba bye brag tu bshad na gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad re re stong la stong spyi phud dang / de stong la stong gnyis pa dang stong bar ma zer/ stong gnyis pa de stong la stong sa/sum gyi stong chen por bshad pa ri rab sogs bye gab phrag brgya yod pa'i mi mjed 'jig rten du nyan thos sde gnyis su ma zad theg chen skabs su'ang gsang 'dus 'grel ba sogs du mar paṇa grub du mas bshad pa ni thun mong ba ste mdzod ltar du 'dod do/ /theg chem/ thun mong min pa'i dbang du btang na phal chen ltar bshad na/ 'jig rten 'di gzhi kun nas ston pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'kho ra la sogs pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i steng na spos chu'i rgya mtsho nor bu kun skenas snang ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa la pad+ma chen po spos kyi rgyal mtshan khyer ba 'od zer dang ze ba sna tshogs pa/ zhes pa la/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying por me tog gis brgyan pa gnas de ni gru bzhi pa rdo rje dang nor bu'i 'khor yug can nor bu'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ mtho dman 440

med pa rin po che thams cad las grub pa rdo rje ltar sra ba 'di gnas so/ /de'i steng na spos chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul dang mnyam pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang de snyed gnas te/ de dag kyang gzhi gzhan dang gzhan la gnas pa/ dbyibs gzhan dang gzhan du 'dug pa/ ngos gzhan dang gzhan la lta ba/ rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan gyis 'jug pa/ rgyan gzhan dang gzhan yod pa yin no/ /de'i mtsho dbus ma la nor bu'i rgyal po pad+mo chen po zhes bya ba la sangs rgyas kyi zhing du ma yod pa'i bcu gsum pa ni mi mjed 'di yin no/ /yang rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag mthil na rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / nam mkha' dang / me dang / chu dang / sa'i khams rgya mtsho dang / me tog mtshan med dang / phyag mthil gyi rgyud la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams nyer lnga yod pa'i dbus ma ni mi mjed 'di yin no/ /'di la'ang kha cig /zhing khams rgya mtsho gzhi snying mi mjed sogs du ma chud pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dang / rgya mtsho de la sogs pa du ma chud pa me tog rgyan can / de la sogs pa du ma chud pa 'og min chen po zer ba mi 'thad de/ phal chen las/ mi 'byung bar ma zad rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud rtsi tshul yang mi snang la rgyud dag dang mi mthun par bshad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ yang mkhas pa mang pos kyang / stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya rgyud dang por byed pa dang / yang la las rgyud gsum pa bye ba phrag brgya gzhi snying me tog bkod par 'jog pa dang la la de yang mi 'jog par da dung bar du rab 'byams rgya mtsho 'jug pa dag mi 'thad de/ de ni phyag 441

rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud ma mthong ba'i 'ol tshod du 'dug pa'i phyir/des na 'di ltar yin te/ gling bzhi ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang nyi zla nasatshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad phye ba zag brgya ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig go /stong gsum chen po byi ba phrag brgya la gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i mtshams sbyor gcig go /gzhi snying mi tog gis brgyan pa'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa rab 'byams kyi 'jig rten khams kyi rgyud gcig go /gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i rgyud dang po bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi snying mi tog gis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi rgyud par ma gcig go /de'i rgyud bar ma bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa rab 'byams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud gsum pa dang de nyid rang la gzhi dang snying po me tog gisabargyan pa'am bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig 'jog gi de'i bar la gzhan mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ dper na stong gnyis pa stong la stong gsum chen po 'jog pa bzhin no/ /phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ rigs kyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams du ma nges par ston pa yod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams re re nges par ston pa re re la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mtshams spyor ba nges par ston pa'i bkod pa rab 'byams du ma yod par khong du chud par bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa yan chad kyi gzhi snying me tog bkod pa la rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud gsum 442

dgos pa dang / de la mtshams sbyor ba dgos zhes mdor bstan nas/ de nyid las/ rigs kyi bu de la mtshams sbyor ba bkod pa rnams kyi tshad ni gling bzhi'i 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya dang / ri'i rgyal po bye ba phrag brgya dang /rgya mtsho chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang / zla ba dang nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya dag 4 gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de me tog gi sazhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa rab 'byams kyi mtshams skyor ba rnams kyi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa gcig go /me tog gi gzhi'i snying po rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa rab 'byams kyi mtshams sbyor ba bye ba phrag brgya gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de me tog gi gzhi'i snying po rgyan bkod pa rab 'byams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud gcig go /me tog gi gzhi'i snying po rgyan bkod pa'i rgyud bye ba phrag brgya rnams gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de me tog gi gzhi'i snying po rgyan bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud bar ma gcig go /'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams bar ma bkod pa'i rgyud bye ba phrag brgya gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de me tog gi gzhi'i snying po rgyan bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bkod pa gcig ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad des sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na yongs su sbyangs so/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i mi mjed 'jig rten gyi rnam bzhag la/ rje bla mas/ mdo rgyud gzhan dang bshad — 443

srol mi 'dra ba'i/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ cegagasungs pa ltar dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyi snod nang skyes bu'i rdo rje lus mthun par tshad dbyibs sgo nas gtan la phab ste gzhan bskyed rdzogs kyi lha'i dkyil 'khor tshad dbyibs sogs khams drug dang chos thams cad la rang rang gi sngags sum̐ grags pa'i sa bon sbyar te dbang po rab lo gsum phyogs gsum sogs tshe gcig la 'bras bu sangs rgyas ster ba 'di'i bshad tshul rgyas par grub pa'i dbang rgyug rje nor bzang zhabs kyis ṭika chen de nyid snang bar blta dgos gsungs pa ltar ṭika chen dang spyi don 'od rgyan rjes 'brang ba sogs kyis da lta'i bar du gsal bar bshad pa der lta la 'dir rnam grangs tsam bkod na ye shes le'u 'bum phrag lngar bshad kyang nang skyes bu'i lus la srid zhed la khru bzhi yod pa ltar srid pa gsum mam khams gsum gyi gnas bsdoms pa'i chu zheng gnyis kar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi bzhi ste nang skyes bu'i lus la khru gang byung ba de'i dod la phyi'i snod la 'bum phrag gcig sbyar ba'i rigs pa sbyar rgyu yin te/ 'grel chen las/de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad 'bum phrag bzhi ste lus khru bzhi'o/ zhes gsungs pas 'og gzhi rlung dkyil zlum po rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa dang nang lus kyi 'dom la khru bzhi sbyar/ de'i steng du me dkyil rlum po 'bum phrag gsum pa dang lus la dpung lhu nas khru gsum sbyar/ de'i steng du chu dkyil thum po rgyar 'bum phrag gnyis dang lus khru gnyis sbyar/ de'i steng gi dbus su sa dkyil zlum po 'bum phrag gcig pa dang lus kyi brang khru gang sbyar la dkyil 'khor bzhi re re'i dpangs la stong phrag lnga bcu re yod 444

la 'khor yug la rang rang gi sum 'gyur yin dkyil 'khor rang rang gi mtha' gyen du 'phags pa lcags ri lta bu phyi ma phyi ma mtho ba can sa dkyil man chad la 'bum phrag gnyis yod pa dang / lus la rkang pa nas rked pa'i bar la khru do yod pa dkyil 'khor 'og ma gsum re re'i nang na dmyal ba gnyis gnyis te rlung dkyil gyi phyed 'og mar dmyal ba bdun pa ngu 'bod chen po gnas la/ de'i gnas na brgyad pa rdo rje dmyal ba yang gnas pas gnas gcig byas/ steng cha la mun pa chen po zhes pa'i dmyal ba dang /de bzhin du me dkyil la cha 'og mar me'i dmyal ba dang / cha gong mar du ba mi zad pa'i dmyal ba dang / chu'i cha 'og mar 'dam gyi chu yang dag ldan pa'i dmyal ba dang cha steng mar bye ma'i chu bye ma yang dag ldan pa'i dmyal ba gnyis dang / sa dkyil cha gnyis su bgos pa'i 'og ma stong phrag lngar saseg ma'i chu'i dmyal ba dang de steng stong phrag nyer lnga bgos pa'i stong phrag bcu gnyis lnga brgyar lha min grong dang / de steng stong phrag bcu gnyis lnga brgyar klu'i grong dang / sa'i steng du 'grel chen las/ lhun po tshad ni 'bum phrag gcig ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar lhun po 'bum phrag gcig dang rked pa nas mgrin pa'i 'og gi khru gang sbyar/ de'i steng du stong phrag nyer lnga ni lus mgrin pa sor drug dang / de steng stong phrag lnga bcu lhun po'i gdong bar grags pa lus kyi mthong skra mtshams bar gyi ba/dong la sbyar/de nas stong phrag nyer lnga lhun po'i gtsug tor grags pa lus kyi gtsug tor dang gzugs med gnas dang sbya ra/ lhun po de'i shar itronī la dang /lho pad+ma rā ga dang / nub chu shel dang / byang ke ta ka dang / /snying 445

po mar gad kyi rang bzhin dang / steng gi rgya tshad 'grel chen las/ lhun po yi ni steng gi rgya shar nas nub dang byang nas lho'i cha'i bar du stong phrag lnga bcu'o gsungs pa ltar dang / rtsa ba stong phrag bcu drug pa stegs bu tshad stong phrag gcig yod pas bskor ba gzhan du ri rab kyi bang rim du bshad dzepa 'dir ri'i dbang po'i rwa lnga ni gdugs che chung lnga chung rim nas brtsegayopa ltar sgor mor gnas shing rwa 'ogam dang 'gram stegs mnyam la/ rwa steng ma ni kha ba'i ri'am bsil ri la reg pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor steng gari'i dbang po'i rwa lnga'i khongs skyibs su ri drug la rim pas gling re 'byar —ba ste/ nang nas zla ba'i gling dang 'od dkar gyi dang rab mchog gi dang ku sha'i dang mi'am ci'i dang khrung khrung gi dang drag po'i gling ste/ gling drug gling so so'i mthar mtsho re re phyi nas nang la chang dang chu dang 'o ma dang zho dang —mar dang sprang rtsi'i rgya mtsho ste mtsho drug dang ri nang nas phyi la rim pas 'odashesngon dang man+dar dang ni dzi ṭa dang nor bu'i 'od zer dang / dro med dang bsil ri ste ri drug gis ri rab rlum por bskor te gnas la re re'ang phra spom dpag tshad brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa brgyad re yod pa gling bdun pa 'dzam gling chen pos 'khor yug tu bskor ba zheng phra sbom la 'bum phrag gcig yod pa las kyi sa dang / de'i mtha' na ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor grags pa rgya mtsho bdun pa chu dkyil dang dbyer med pa/ de'i mtha' na ri bdun pa rdo rje'i rir grags nga 'i mtha' bskor ba gzhan du rta gdong gi mer yang grags pa me dkyil gyi cha shas so/ /'dzam gling chen po'i steng na shar gling rlung gi rang bzhin zlum po dang / lho gling me'i rang bzhin gru gsum dang / nub 446

gling sa'i rang bzhin gru bzhi ba/ byang chu'i rang bzhin zla gam ste/ 'jig rten 'dir chags pa'i 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams gsum dang / sa dkyil man chad la gnas pa'i dmyal ba dang / lha min dang steng 'og ci rigs na yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang mi ste 'dod pa 'og ma lnga dang / ri rab mgrin pa man chad la mas rim nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang 'thab bral dang dga' ldan dang 'phrul dga' dang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de 'dod lha drug dang 'dod pa bcu gcig dang ri rab kyi gdong bar tshangs ris tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs chen dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang / dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang /min med dang / bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / 'og min te gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu drug dang / gtsug tor la gzugs med bzhi ste/srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig bshad la/ 'grel chen las/ stong gcig ces bya ba mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbus nas steng dang 'og tu stong phrag re re ste/ shar dang nub dang byang dang lho dang bden bral dang dbang ldan dang rlung dang mer ro/ /de bzhin du stong phrag gnyis dang gsum mo/ zhes gsungs pas stong gsum rnam bzhag yang 'dod pas/ la las gzugs ga thugs med ri rab la btsud pa dang stong gsum chad gsungs pa khegs so//na nga lus la tshigs sum brgya dang drug cu yod pa ltar phyi la zhag sum brgya drug cu yod par bshad pa sogs mang / zla ba gang bri'i rgyu mtshan la dogs cho 447

pa mang ba 'og tu 'chad do/ /sa sde dang mdzod kyi lugs la ri rab chu mtsham sa yan chad la rgya dpangs gnyis kar dpag tshad brgyad khri yod/ chu'i nang du brgyad khri nub pa byang nas ngos bzhi rim bzhin gser dngul baiḍūr+ya shel gyi rang bzhin du mdzod dang gser dngul shel baiḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin du sa sdes bshad/ gdags pa las/ shar phyogs kyi ngos ni shel las grub pa/ lho phyogs kyi ngos ni baiḍūr+ya las grub pa/ nub phyogs kyi ngos ni dngul las grub pa'o/ zhes gsungs/ de'i mthar mtsho bdun dang gser ri bdun gyis gru bzhir spel mar bskor ba'i ri rnams kyi rang rang gi rngams dang dpangs mnyam la snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma phyed kyis dman pa ri rab kyi phyed dang gnya' shing 'dzin mnyam pa sogs so/ /de rnams kyi go rim/sa sde las/ gser gyi ri bdun po 'di lta ste/ gnya' shing 'dzin dang /rnam par 'dud dang / rta rna ri dang / lta na sdug dang / seng ldeng can dang / gshol mda' 'dzin dang / mu khyud 'dzin rnams mngon par 'grub par 'gyur te/ de dag kyang rim par ri rab 'khor bar 'dug go /zhes dang / ri de dag gi ming rnams ni de dag gi rtse mo'i rnam pa 'dra ba'i bye brag las blta bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs la/ mdzod las/ gnya' shing 'dzin/ /gshol mda' 'dzin dang seng ldeng can/ /de bzhin blta na sdug ri dang / /rta rna dang ni rnam 'dud dang / /mu khyud 'dzin ri'o/ zhes gsungs pa'i go rims su gnas la/ mdzod las/ 'dzam bu gling ste shing rta'i dbyibs/ /gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ zhes ngos thung shos la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi bshad la/ —sa las/ 'dzam 448

rme—gling shing rta lta bud+kungos gsum la stong phrag gnyis gnyis dang thung shos la lnga brgya ste mtha' bskor drug stong lnga brgya dang / ba lang spyod skum po dpag tshad bdun stong lnga brgya/ byang sgra mi snyan gru bzhi dpag tshad brgyar stong ste/ shar lus 'phags zla gam ste ngos gsum la nyis stong re dang thung ngu lastong phrag gcig /mdzod las/ ngos bung ngu la sum brgya lnga bcur bshad/gling phran brgyad rtogs sga la/ phal chen las/ gling bzhi'i 'khor gling phran bye ba phrag brgyad cu yod par bshad la/ gling de'i rtsa ba'ang ri ltar gcig tu yod la rtse mo gling dang tha dad du yod pa de ni gling de'i gling g.yog ste/ gser gling / zangs gling / seng ga la'i gling sogs gling 'di'i g.yog gam 'khor yin la/ sa ltar na gling bzhi la gser lam yang yod de/ sa las/ 'dzam bu gling gi nye 'khor na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lam gser gyi rang bzhin can yod de/ rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs kyi sems can gyi pus mo/'i tshad tsam gyi rgya mtshor nub cing 'dug ste/ 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jig rten du byung ba na rgya mtsho'i chu pus nub tsam zhig skam par 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs so/ /zla ba tshes gcig la ma rangs pa'i rgyu zhe na/ mdzod pa dang dus 'khor ba na re/ nyi ma dang nye pa'i 'od phog pa'i grib ma'i dbang gis zhes 'dod de/ mdzod las/ nyi ma dang ni nye ba las//rang gi grib mas sgrib par snang / zhes dang / dbang masku ra bstan las/ —rim pa ji ltar bla ba shar/ /cha rnams kyis ni rdzogs par 'gyur/ /'phel 'grib grib ma'i dbang gis te/ /gli ba cha dang rdzogs pa min/ zhes gsungs la grib mas bsgrib lugs la gdags pa'i don du bsams nas/449

nyan thos mngon pha pha na ji tshu rol la nyi 'od phog pa'i grib mas thongs 5bsgrib par 'dod pa la/ slob dpon dgyig gnyen gyis tshur ngos kyi mamidzil glib mas ma sgrib sar phar ngos kyi mthil basbrib pa ya mtshan te/ grib ma tshu rol gyi ngos nas 'bab dgos so/ /dgongs nas thags so lo zheyopa ma rangs pa smras so/ /rang 'grel las/ gdags pa las/ nas/des na pha rol gyi ngos su grib cha babs pas dkyil 'khor ma rangs par snang ngo / zhes bstan te/ zhes thags so lo zhes gsungs/ 'grel bshad gnyis las/ ka ba la sgron me'i dpe bkod kyang zla ba'i nyi ma ngos la zla tshes phyed sgor yod pa'i cha de lcags ris bsgrib pa'i cha lta bur mngon pas nyi grib la mi 'grib pas nyi 'od kyis 'ug pa'i mig la mun pa skyed pa lta bu'i rang grib yin par bshad na legs so/ /sa sde las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni yud tsam gyi steng du 'dzur ba na zla gam du snang ste/ de'i pha rol gyi ngos de'i tshu rol gyis bsgrib pa'i phyir mi snang ste/ ji lta ji ltar 'dzur ba de lta de ltar shin tu gang bar snang ngo / /mar gyi ngo la ji lta ji ltar thung ngu 'dzur ba de lta de ltar bri bar snang ngo / zhes gsungs phas bla 'og 'dzur tsam ma gtogs bla 'og bsgyur bar ma bshad cing mi 'thad la/ yang sa'i dngos gzhi las/ nyi ma'i mthil gyi steng gser gyi rwa bas bskor ba dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya dang shel dang gser gyi rtsig skyabs bzhi dang / mda' yab dang zam pa rgyud pa bzhi dang ldan pa gzhal yas khang dang skyed mo'i tshal sos/sa gnasapha lha'i bu zla ba 'khor bcas bzhugs par bshad pas na/mkhas rloro kha cispru/ pho tshod kyis dus— 'khor dang sa sde'i lugs la zla ba'i 450

'og chu shel dang steng in+d+ra rī la yin la gnam gang la bla 'og bsgyur steng gi in+d+ra rī la bstan par 'dod pa rmongs pa'i gdon gyis brlam pa'i brlab brdol lo/ /yang nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla ba bri gang la kun mkhyen dbyig gnyen yang ma rangs bsam nas mkhas pa jo nang phyogs las pa'i gsung na re/ gling 'dir nyi 'od kyi 'od dmar sogs ci yang med pa'i mtshan dus bcu gsum lta bu'i tshe na'ang zla ba ma gang 'dug la de'i tshe nyi ma'i rjes dang zla ba'i bar na skar khyim bcu gsum ma long tsam snang la de la'ang nyi 'od kyis khyab na nyi ma'i mdun na'ang de ltar khyab dgos pas skar khyim gcig min pa'o mkha' ngos kun nyi 'od kyis khyab par 'gyur bas/ sa sde las gling gnyis la mun pa dang gnyis la snang bar bshad pa dang / mdzod las/nam phyed nyi ma nub pa sogs dang 'gal tshul rgyud 'grel gyi mchan bur bshad pa/ ṭika chen las kyang 'dod pa de bkod nas lan ma mdzad la byams gling ba stag lo phug pa kar 'brug sogs dus 'khor la yig 'jog mdzad pa kun gyis de ma mthong ba ltar byas nas smad 'khyer sna tshogs smras so/ /rang lugs ni/ de la khyab pa yod de/ gling la nyi ma'i 'od kyang nub la mkha' ngos la nyi 'od ma nub pa nam stong kyi skya 'od dang / nam smad kyi skya 'od lte bu yin la/ sa sde dang mdzod kyis gling la gsungs kyi gling gi nam mkha' la de ltar ma gsungs pas/ nam mkha' skar khyim byed gnyis tsam min pa nyi 'od kyis ma khyab na/ tshes bcu bzhi bco lnga bcu drug kun la 'dra bar nya gang bas khyab par 'gyur la/ bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel 'dir yang de ni mig dmar la sogs pa'i gza' rnalas nub pa'i don du 451

zhes yang yang bshad pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dang ye shes la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal dpir na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni nyi ma'i dbang gis 'dzam bu gling du gzugs dang kha dog gzi brjid dang 'od rab 'bring tha mar snang yang / zhes dang / yang mdo de nyid las/ 'jam dpal dper na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyi ma'i dbang gis 'bri ba dang / skye ba dang mi snang bar yang 'gyur la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la ni 'bri ba dang mi snang ba dang skye ba med de/ 'on kyang sems can rnams kyi sngon gyi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par nyi ma'i grangs dang yud tsam dang / yud tsam phyed dang / zla ba phyed dang / bla ba dang zla ba lo bgrang ba'i grangs bzhag pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi brlabs kyis bya ba de lta bu dag byung yang / zhes sogs lta bu'i mdo du ma dang / do ha kha cig las kyang / zla ba 'grib dang rgyas pa ni/ /zla ba 'gyur ba ma yin te/ /nyi ma'i rkyen gyis 'phel 'grib snang / zhes pa lta bu'i lung du ma dang / rigs pa'i gnod byed mi zad pa 'bab pa'i phyir ro/ zhes rang bzhin gyi grub mtha' dang mdo rgyu da bye ba'i don la blo 'od 'bum phrag 'phros pa'i dpyod ldan cig smra'o/ /'di dag ni dka' gnas dor te sla bar rgyas par bshad pa'i dka' 'grel ni min no/ /spro bya mang moni yi ges mi langs so/ /de lta bu'i 'jig rten 'dir/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro mi lha ste 'gro ba lnga/ skye gnas kyi sgos mngal phyes sogs skye gnas bzhi yod pa mthurna la ri rab sogs ri so so'i ming dbyibs dang sogs sgras ngo bo tshad gnas gzhi dang sdod yun sogs mi 'dra tshul 452

sogs dang / yang ri sogs zhes pa'i sogs khong nas dkyil 'khor gsum dang gling nyi zla sogs mi 'dra tshul nyung gsal spros nas/ mdzod las/ tsha dmyal brgyad yi dwags dud 'gro gnyis te ngan 'gro bcu dang / 'dod lha drug gling bzhi'i mi ste 'dod pa nyi shu dang / sa las/ 'dod pa'i khamasponi gnas gzhan sum cu rtsa drug ste zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnas kyi sgo nas 'dod pa so drug ste tsha grang gi dmyal ba bcu drug yi dwags lha min gnyis te bco brgyad dang / mi la gling bcu gnyis kyi mi dang 'dod lha drug ste bco brgyad dang so drug bshad nas dud 'gro la gnas tha dad med pas ma bgrang la/ sa sde las/ gzugs kyi khams ni gnas rigs bco brgyad de/bsam gtan dang po chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen por bsgoms pas/ nes sogs ltar bsam gtan bzhi'i rgyu snyoms 'jug tha 'bring rab gsum gyis bsam gtan bzhi re re la so skye'i gnas gsum gsum dang / 'phas/sa pa'i bsam gtan bzhi ba chung ngu gsum spel/ 'bring drug spel/ chen po dgu spel/ shin tu chen po bcu gnyis spel/ ches mchog tu che ba bco lnga spel lnga ste spel sgom las rim bzhin mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ gya nom snang ba/ shin tu mthong ba dang / 'og min te gnas gtsang lnga dang bcu bdun/ de'i steng na sa bcu la gnas pa rnams kyis sa bcu yongs su bsgo mas nas skye ba'i gnas 'og min chen po ste bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir/kha cig theg chen skabs su'ang gnas rigs bco brgyad mi 'dod par —gnas gtsang lnga'i 'og min du longs sku yod par 'dod pa mi 'dod de/bcom ldan 'das kyis/ gtsang ma'i gnas dag spangs nas ni/ /'og —453

min gnas ni nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs der sangs rgyas zhes dang / sa las/ gnas gtsang ma rnams las 'das pa na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la spu/nas pa rnams kyis sa bcu yongs su bsgoms nas gang du skye ba'o/ zhes dang /chos dbyings bstod pa las/ so so rang rig rnam dag na/ /sa rnams de yi bdag nyid gnas/ /dbang phyug chen po'i gnas mchog dang / /'og min nyid de rnam mdzes pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dbu sems ga/nyis ka'e 'dod tshul mthun snang yin no/ /kha cig 'og min ni khams gong du mi 'dod/ rang gi sems rnam par dag pa tsam la 'dod pa dang /yang 'og min na gzhal yas khang med par 'dod pa dang / yang longs sku'i 'khor la dag sa pa'am sa bcu ba pa 'ba' zhig gis khyab par 'dod pa thams cad mi 'thad par shing rta chen po'i lung gnyis las sgrub la/ dbu ma snying po dang / rtog ge 'bar ba dang / skyabs gsum bdun cu ba/legs ldan chung ba'i dbu ma'i tshul dgu ba sogs dang 'gal tshul 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs med bzhi ste khams gsum mo/ /de la rlung dkyil sogs gzhi dang po/ gnas khang sogs gnyis pa dang / lo legs gsum pa dang / bde ba bzhi ba dang / nyi zla lnga ba dang / kha zas drug pa ste gzhi drug dang / dus tshigs dang lo sogs dus rnam pa bcu dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams kyi dngos po sogs yongs su bzung ba'i dngos po bdun dang / lus kyi yo byad bcu dang / 'dod pa la spyod pa bcu dang / rgyun mi 'chad par rjes su spyad pa rnam pa brgyad dang 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad 454

dang / phyogs gsum dang / 'jig rten gyi spyod pa gsum dang / gtayornam pa gsum dang / nyes rtsom nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang / sems can gyi rigayodrug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ 'di bya ba'i sgo nas 'jog dgos te/ bskal ba dang por rigs bzhi so sor gyes tshe rkus sogs mi byed pa rje rigs dang / byed pa dmangs rigs dang de la'ang bya ba shin tu mang ba tshos byed pa dang /thags 'thag pa dang / mi tog phreng ba 'chos pa sogs kyis de dang de'irigs zhes btags pas na/ brgya ba las/ bya ba'i cha ni cog la yang //rigs zhes bya bar brjod pa yin/ zhes gsungs la/ 'chi mdzod lo grags 'gyur las/ sa bon las byung rus yin no/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sngar rus gcig kyang bar skabs su bya ba'i sgo nas rigs du mar gyes pa yod do/ /dus brgyad dang mngal du 'jug pa bzhi dang / spyod lam bzhi dang / 'tsho ba rnam pa drug dang / kun nas bsrung ba rnam pa drug dang /sdug bsngal rnam pa bdun dang / nga rgyal bdun dang / rgyags pa rnam pa bdun dang / tha snyad bzhi dang / tha snyad kyi gzhi ches mang po rnams dang / rdul phra rab yang rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus kyi gong bu yin pas 'byung ba re re la'ang 'byung bzhi'i rdul yod dgos pa ni dbu sems mthun par 'arnod de/ 'dod par 'byung bzhi'i gzugs gang skye yang rdul rdzas brgyad ldan du 'dod pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ 'dod na dbang po med pa dang //sgra med phra rab rdul rdzas brgyad/ ces dang / sa'i dngos gzhi las/gzugs 'dus pa de dag kyang mdor bsdus rdzas rnam pa bcu bzhi yod de/'di lta ste/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang 455

ro dang reg bya rnams dang mig la sogs pa'i dbang po gzugs can lnga ste/yid kyi spyod yul gyi gzugs nyid ma gtogs so/ zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ sa chu me dang rlung rnams ni/ /re re'ang ngo bo nyid du med//gang gsum med par re re med/ /gcig med pa yang gsum med do/ zhes dang / 'on te so so rang yod na/ /bud shing med par me cis med/ / g.yo dang thogs dang sdud pa dag /chu dang rlung dang sa de bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin du 'byung ba 'dus pa la yang 'byung bzhi gcig mngon pa dang / gnyis mngon pa dang / gsum mngon pa dang / bzhi char mngon pa yang 'dod de/ sa las/ la la ni 'byung ba gcig pu dmigs te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sa gcig pu mngon pa rdo dang nor bu sogs dang /chu gcig pu mngon pa mtsho dang mtshe'u sogs dang / me gcig pu mngon pa me lce dang mar me sogs dang / rlung gcig pu mngon pa rdul med pa'i rlung sogs so/ /yang sa las/ la la la ni gnyis dmigs te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sa chu gnyis mngon pa chab rom dang / shing rlon dang /sa me gnyis dmigs pa nor bu sregs pa dang / gser sregs pa sogs dang / yang sa las/ la la la ni gsum dmigs te/ zhes pa ltar sa me rlung gsum mngon pa/ shing mes sreg pa g.yo ba lta bu dang / rtsa sreg pa 'gul ba lta bu sogs dang / yang sa las/ la la la ni bzhi char dmigs te/ 'di lta ste/ nang gi gzugs 'dus pa lta bu dag ste/ zhes gsungs shaṃ ltar nang lus la khams bzhi char mngon sum du dmigs pa'i phyir ro/zhes de lta bu dang / tshe tshad bong tshad sogs she sa par bya la/ der po456

zad lung du0ma dang rigaspopha du ma la brten skos nges pa'i las 'dago/ par lkethab la/ sogs sgras/ theg la gzungs bzhi bshad pas zab mo'i sgom ston pas/ bram ze'i rig byed kyi sngags dang mi —'dra la/ theg chen gyi dge bsnyen dang / dge slong sogs kyi sdom pa nyan rang rigs can la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du khas len kyang / byang sems sa mthon po 'ga' zhig mi dus byang chub bar du dang / thob tshul dang ldan tshul khyad 'phags sogs yod tshul nyan thos sde pa'i lan gyi skabs du ma 'dir sbyar bar bya la/ nyan—thos sde pa phal che bas/ mdo las/ las rnams bskal ba brgyar yang ni//chud mi za ba'ang / zhes sogaṭashaṃ kyis/ nges pa'i las la rnam smin 'byin nges kyis khyab par bshad zer pa la/ theg chen pa dag gis brgyar yang zhes dang / 'ang sgra gnyis pas chud mi za ba yin kyang rkyen gzhan gyis gzhom par yang bshad pa yin7te/ yang sgra dang 'ang sgra gnyis pas nges pa'i las kyang rkyen la ltos par bshad pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rkyen gzhan gyis de'i mthun rkyen med par byas na'am sa bon nyams pa gang byas na'ang rnam smin 'byung rung gi rgyu dang rkyen phrad rgyu med par bshad pa'i phyir dang / rgyu rkyen gnyis ka ma 'dzom par 'bras bu 'byung na/ dgun gyi sa bon ma nyams pa rkyang pas kyang 'bras bu 'byinajipar thal bas zhing ba dag gi ngal ba don med par 'gyur la/ rgyu ma tshang bar rkyen rkyagabs 'bras bu 'byin pa su yang mi 'dod pa sogs rigs pa du ma dang / lung las/ chos 'dzin pa de'i las tshe de la myang ba dang mgo bo na ba tsam gyis kyang byang ba sogs —kyi lung du ma dang byang sems kyi skyes/ rabs rdu ma dang / dga' bo dang 457

ngo/ra phreng dang mthong ldan dang phag—pa'i snying so sogaspomirda du gcan gyi ma ngh+ru)ca/ dgra dang bde byed de ma gsod mi dang pha gsod pa sogs sngon byung byu mdo du mas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ legs ldan gyis/ dbu ma snying po dang /trertog ge 'bar ba las/ bskal ba brgyar yang zhe sa bya ba dang / 'ang gi sgra gnyis pas 'gyur ba yang ston pa yin te/ dzi zhes sogs dang / bshes springs las/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las/ /phyi nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang / /zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ zhes dang / stobs che chung 'joms tshul rgyas par/ rnam bshad rigs pa las kyang / sangs rgyas kyi gsungs la dad pa tsam gyis kyang / sdig pa chen po dag zil gyis gnon te/ 'di ltar mi dge bas dge ba stobs dang ldan pas so/ /'di ji lta ra shes par bya zhe na/ khyad par rnam pa bcu dag gis te/ zhes dang /khyad par bcu ni/ de nyid las/ 'du byed rnam pa mtshungs par ldan/ /sa nyid 'bras bu rnam gnyisaphyonyid/ /'chad dang chung ngus yang dag 'joms/ /spong dang phyogs kyis khyad par nyid/ ces gsungs pa 'dis che ba des chung ba 'joms pa'i khyab mtha' bstan pa min kyang / 'phen pas zin na/ gzhom pa dang / 'a phen pas ma zin kyang 'joms pa'i stobs ldan dag bstan la/ dge ba dang mi dge ba gnyis rim pa bzhin ma 'baltapa dang 'bad dgos pa ni 'du gyed kyi khyad par dang / ji lta ba bzhirtswadang / phyin ci log gi rnam pa can ni rnam pa'i khyad par dang / dge rtsa gsum dang mi dge ba'i rtsa ba gnyis sam gcig dang ldan pa ni mtshungs ldan gyi khyad 458

par dang / dmigs sogs kyis sa thams cad pa dang sa gcig pa nyid yin pa ni sa'i khyad par dang / 'bras bu lnga dang bzhi yin pa ni 'bras bu'i grangs kyi khyade par dang / bskal tshen brgyad khri'i bar dang / bar bskal tsam yin pa ni 'bras bu mthar byin pa'i khyad par dang / dge bas mi dge ba rtsa ba nar+sā gcod la mi dge bas dge ba dus re zhig las mi chod pa ni 'chad pa'i khyad par can dang / spong lam skad cig ma gcig gis kyadza thog ma med pa'i dus nas zhugs pa'i mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa ni yang dag 'joms pa'i khyad par dang / gnyen pos mi dge ba spangs kyi/dge ba spong byed med pa ni speng ba'i khyad par dang / dge ba 'dzin pa la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas phyogs dang / mi dge ba 'dzin pa la bdud tsam yin pa ni phyogs kyi khyad paradzidang / thog med nas bsags pa'i mun pa sgron me'i snang bas skad cig gis sel ba sogs dpe'i khyad par te bcu'i sgo nas stobs cher bshad pa sogs dang / des na rkyen ga'an gyis ma bcom na 'ablos bu 'byin par nges pa ni nges pa'i las kyi don dang / ma nges pa ni rkyen gzhan gyis ma bcom kyang 'bra༄ bu 'byin par ma nges la/byas bsags kyi las kyang da gdod rkyen gyis ma mecom gong du nges pa'i las dang / bcom pa nas byas bsags gnyis ka'i las ma yin pa'i phyir/sa'i dngos gzhi dang bsdu bar bshad pas dbu sems mthun no/ /skabs 'dir spub mtha' nong 'og gyispun mong tsam ni so thar rigs brgyad kyi thob tshul ldan pa dang gartong tshul nyen thos kyi sde snod lung sde bzhi ltar yin pas ldam gsum rab dbye dang / lam rim laspo spyang / tsho3 'jug sdom rten la 459

thun mong min pa'i cho ga deng sang med pas de nyams len mi 'ong bar dgongs nas lam sgron gyi don de ltar bshad la/ yang kha cig /so thar sdom pa theg pa che chung dang grub mtha' so sor 'jog khul byas nas mdo 'ga' zhig gi lung gi tshig skam tsam drangs yang ldan thob gtong tshul thams cad lung sde bzhi'i bshad tshul kho nar sbyor ba dang / bsnyen par rdzos/sa tshul yang / 'dren pa rang rgyal rang byung tshul cig dang / sogs ltar rang byung gi bsnyen rdzogs sangs rgyas dang / rang rgyal gnyis las/ byangagasems la 'ong mi 'ong gi dogs gnas tsam yang ma shar ba dang / sdom gsum rab dbye las/ rgyal sras byams pa 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /bdagahonyid chen po 'ga' zhig gis/ /mkhan po mdzad nas/ zhes pa 'dis/byams 'jam dbyangs lta bu'ang khyim par byas 4nas mkhan po mdzad tshul bstan snyam ste/ rjes 'jug ṭika spyi thar thor byed mkhan mang pos/ theg chen skabs khyim pas mkhan po 'ong snyam pa dang / sdom gsum las lha dang byis pa'i dge slong ni/ /'dul ba'i sde snod dag las bkag /ces pa'i dgongs par byas nas theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs la'ang skyes tsam nas dge slong yin pa dang / lhar gyur pa'i dase/ slong tsam yang med snyam pa dang / yang kha cig /sems can gzhir bzhag la de ltar 'dod pa ni theg chen gyi mdo du ma dang / rgyal ba dang rgyal tshab shing rtaci chen po ches mang po'i gsung dang 'gal bar mthong ste/ de bāg gis ni byang sems la rab byung phyogs kyi sdom pa len pas thob pa dang / chosaganyid kyis thob pa dang / sprul ba'i ston pa gsum yod sar bshad de/ mdo 460 —

sde rgyan las/ sa rnams kun la blo ldan gyis/ /rab byung len pas thob pa dang / /chos nyid kyis ni thob pa gzhan/ /rab tu byung ba ston byed bzhin/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar/ de la rab tu byung ba ni rnam pa gsum du rig par bya ste/ yang dag par len pas thob pa dang / chos nyad kyis thob pa dang / sprul ba rnams kyis ston par byed do/ zhes pa lta bu du ma dang / sprul ba'i ston pa la'ang byang sems kyis dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho ba sogs ston par bshad pa dang / chos nyid kyis thob tshul skyes tsam nas yin par rigs pa'i dbang phyug cha bas bshad pa sogs te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis sems bskyed pa/ /sprin dang 'dra ba nyid du bstan/ zhes dang / 'grel bar/ dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sogs pa ston pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba rnams de la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ zhes pa dang / rtog ge 'bar ba las/ 'jig rten dbang rgyug la sogs pa'idzebyang chub sems dpa' ni khyim pa ma yin te/ chags pa thams cad yongs su spangs pa dang / so sor thar ba'i sdom pa yang dag par blang ba dang / zhes sogs dang cha bas 'grel ba nyi 'od snang ba las kyang / rab tu byung ba'i chos ni sa rnams kun la/ zhes pa ste len pas thob pa gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis thob pa la sogs pa'o/ /chos nyid kyis thob pa ni skye ba phyi ma la skyes thob tu 'brel ba'am/ zhes dang / mdo du ma yod pa 'i phyir/ de lta bu la dgongs nas las ṭika chen pos kyang longs sku'i rngobyad can gsungs kyi khyim par ma kesungs so/ /da phyin chad pa snyi ta'i kha nas rab byung min pa'i gang zag 461

la khyim pas khyab snyam pa'i blun skad ma smra bar khyim pa zhes pa'i don shes par gyis/ 'dir rgyas par spro rigs kyang yi ge mangs dogs la bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes ba la sdom pa gsum gyi len thob gtong gnas sogs shes dgos/ de la rgyan drug sogs paṇa grub kyi gzhung bzhin rang bzo med par mdo sngags kyi gnad shes dgos kyi mdo tshig tsam dang rgyud tshig tsam gyis mi chog ste/ mkhas pa rnams kyis mdo gcus rgyud dkrugs gsungs pa ltar gnas pa'i phyir/ 'di skor gzhan du 'chad 'dod pas der shes dgos so/ /phung po lnga dang sogs sgras khams bco brgyad dang skye mched bcu gnyis kyi dbye tshul mdzod dang mi mthun pa ni/phung khams re re'i steng nas kyang rgyu bcu ci rigs dang / rkyen bzhi dang 'bras bu lnga sogs ci rigs kyi lag rjesabastan pa'i ched du dbye ba 'di ltar mdzad de/ mig sogs la gcig nas bcu gcig gi bar du dbye tshul/sa'i dngos gzhi'i yid kyi sa las/ mig ni rnam pa gcig ste/ gzugs la lta ba'o/ /rnam pa gnyis te/ rgyas pa las byung ba dang rnam par smin pa las byung ba'o/ zhes pa nas/ rna ba la sogs pa nas lus kyi bar du yang de dang 'dra ba las/ rnas pa gsum pa dang / rnam pa bzhi pa la ni bye brag yod de/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mig la byed las gzugs la lta bas gcig dang / skyed byed dam rgyu'i sgo nas rgyas byung gi dang / rnam smin gyi mig gnyis dang / de bzhin du sha'i dang / lha'i dang / shes rab kyi mig gsum dang / 'dzum pa'i mi'i dang / mi 'dzum pa'i lha'i dang /brtan pa'i gzugs khams kyi dang / mi brtan pa'i 'dod pa'i mig bzhi 462

dang / 'gro ba lnga'i lnga dang / rang rgyud dang / gzhan rgyud dang / sdug pa dang / mi sdug nga/ dang / dri ma can dang / — dri ma med pa ste drug—dang / rnam shes yod med gnyis/ mthu ldan mi ldan gnyis/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi rnam r+shas gsum gyi rten de bdun/ gnas kyi mig dang / sprul ba'i mig /dge mi dge'i rnam smin las byung ba gnyis dang /kha zas dang / gnyid dang / tshangs spyod dang / snyoms 'jug bzhi'i rgyas byung bzhi ste brgyad dang / thob ma thob gnyis kyi dang / sngon thob ma thob gnyis kyi dang / thob las nyams pa dang / spang bya yin min gnyis dang / spang ma spangs gnyis kyi ste dgu dang / dus gsum gyi gsum dang /phyi nang gi gnyis dang / rags phra ba'i gnyis dang bzang ngan gnyis kyi gnyis dang / nye ring gnyis kyi ste bcu gcig tu dbye ba'i bar bshad cing /rna sogs lhag ma bzhi yang de dang 'dra la sum tshan dang bzhi tshan dbye tshul mi 'dra ba dang / yid ni chos rnam par she sa pa'i gcig dang / shed bye ba'am brda byang gi gdags par gtogs pa dang / shed ma bye ba'am byis pa'i gdags par mi gtogs pa ste gnyis dang / yang 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das gnyis te gnyis dang / sems yid rnam shes te gsum dang / dge mi dge ba'i gnyis dang / lung gabastan la bsgrib ma bsgrib gnyis kyi ste bzhi dang / rgyu 'bras bde sdug btang snyoms lnga'i dus kyi lnga dang / rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug dang / rnam shes gnas pa bdun gyi bdun dang tshig bla dwags kyi 'dus te reg ldan dang / thogs 'dus reg ldan dang / zhen pa dang mngon byung la brten pa gnyis dang / zang 463

zing bcas ma bcas gnyis dang / 'jig rten 'das ma 'das gnyis te rmebargyad dang / sems can gnas dgu'i dgu dang / bcu tshan med la bcu gcig sngar bzhin dang / 'dod pa'i dge mi dge gnyis dang / lung ma bstan la bsgrib ma bsgrib gnyis dang / gzugs kyi dge ba dang / lung bstan bsgrib ma bsgrib gnyis te gsum dang / gzugs med kyi de gsum dang / slob mi slob kyi gnyis te bcu gnyis kyi bar bshad la/ de bzhin du/ sa de nyid las/ gzugs ni gcig ste/ mig gi spyod yul gyi don gyis so/ /sogs kyis gzugs sogs lnga la gcig tshan nas bcu tshan bar bshad la/ yid kyis las/ chos kyi khams ni mdor bsdus na/ /gdags pa'i chos rnams dang bcas par/ /chos brgyad cu rtsa bdun yod de/ zhes pa ltar/ sems byung nga gsum dang / chos kyi skye mched du gtogs pa'i sdom sdom min gnyis nas/ tshogs pa ma yin pa'i bar nyer drug dang 'dus ma byas kyi dngosajipo brgya dang gya bdun bshad la/ yang chos khams la gcig tshan nas bcu tshan bar dang / de nyid las/ nang dang phyi'i skye mched rnams kyi rab tu dbye ba de dag ni drug brgya dang drug cu yod do/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bsdoms na skye mched midabye ba drug brgya dang drug cu byas la/ sgra bshad kyang / yid kyis las/ zad par ma gyur gyi bar du gzugs rnams la lta ba'i phyir spyod bas na mig go /zhes pa nas/ yid kyi yul 'ba' zhig tu 'dzin pas na chos rnams te/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu 'di dag ni byings sgrub kyis mi thon pas nges tshig gis bshad pa yin te/mkhas 'jug las/ ma zad par du gzugs spyod dang / zhes mig gi skad 464

dod/ tsagru'i tsa la ra bsnan/ k+ṣa k+ṣa ya byas byu ba ma sa cu gong du bzhag ste/ rū ba ma sa shrī tsā/ rā/k+ṣa ya lta bu ci rigs byas chog rkabod skad lta bu min 'dug pa ni tshad mdzan sogs du mas bshad tshul las shes dgos shing / sgra bshad bsdus na/ 'di la grags par dmigs pas na rna ba dang / dri rnams snom pas na sna dang bkres pa'i nyam chung bsel ba dang /bzod pa sna tshogs la 'dris pas 'bod par byed pas na lce dang / 'di ni dbang po zad par gyi rjes su song bas na lus dang / yun ring po nas byas pa rnams kyis bcos shing bsrung la bdag gir bzung ste/ bdag dang bdag gi'o snyam nas sems can nas shed bu'i bar ming btags pas na yod dang / de dang de zhes btags su rung ba rīdang gnod pa byar rung bas na gzugs dang / brjod bzhin du 'jig pas sgra dang / smra ba sna tshogs gnas pas na sgra dang rdzi phyogs su 'gro zhing rgyugs pas na dri/ nad rnams sdud pa dang myang bar byas pas ro dang / lusatsho kyi reg par byas bas reg bya dang / yid kyi yul 'ba' zhig tu 'dzin pas tshon chos zhes gsungs la/ 'di ltar du dbye ba dang de dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan legs par go dgos shing / de ltar go na phung khama.oṃskye mched rten 'brel gnas dang gnas min dbang po la mkhas pa rnams kyang bsdus par rig pa yin/ zhes bshad pas mkhas pa'i don dang ming gnyis ka ldan pa gcig bya 'tshadze+ezhing / dge sogs mi 'dra yang / zhesasgo la/ dge ba la/ mngon pa kun btus las/ ji ltar na dge ba yin/ daṣ+kagernams ni du zhes dris pa'i dge bar 'jog tshul la/ ngo gotsho nyid kyi dgeb nas rgyu mthun gyi dge ba'i bar 465

bcu gsum bshad de/ kun btus las/ ngo bo nyid dang / 'brel ba dang / rjes sa'agrel ba dang nas/ khyu mthun pas kyang dge bar blta'o/ zhes gsungs de ltar bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ dge ba'i ngo bo kun slong dmigs pa 'bras bu rnams sogs la mkhas shing 'dor len ched dang / dge ba lo phusmekhams skye mched cidu yod gnyis kyis bshad skul/ sogs sgras de bzhin du mi dge ba bcu gnyis dang phung po sogs gang tsam yod dang / lung ma bstan bcu bzhi dang / phung sogs du yod dang / las dkar nag bzhi dang / mthong chos myong 'gyur gsum sogs 'dzin la/yang sgras de dag gi dbye bangasogs mi 'dra yang mdo gong 'og gdul bya'i dbang gis dgongs pa mi 'gal tshul sogs yang shes dgos par bstan la/sdom gsum las/ las dang rnam smin gnyis ka dkar ba dang / de gnyis ka nag pa dang / las dkar rnam sminatsho nag pa dang / las nag rnam smin dkar ba bzhi gsungs par/ 'grel ba du mas kyang dgongs pa ma lon la/ rtechen po shāka mchoskagi dri bā dang rang lan gnyis dang / de'i lan go rams chen pos kyang / rdzad gzhi rtags su bapod pa tsam las mi snang la/ 'di la da dung las dkar nag gi don dge ba dang mi dge bar byas na las nges pa mi 'thad pharathal ba dang / mdo sngags gong 'og ches mang bar ga nas dang gnas min la mkhas pa dang gnas dang gnas min mkhyen par bshad pa rnams mi 'thad par thal ba dang / lung sogs las lagagacig tu dkar ba blang bya dang gcig du nag pa dang 'dres ma spang byar bshad ba mi 'thad par thagob sogagaji ltar sprong snyam nas sde lnga dang — 466

mdzod rnam bshad rigs pa lung sde bzhi sogs theg pa che chung gi mdo bstan bcos ches mang bar las dkar napoganyis dang— 'dres pa ste gsuca/ bshad pa dang nag 'dres gnyis 'dor bar bshad pa bden yang spyir 'dres pa dor dgos kyang / dmigs bsal dgos pa chen po dang / rgyal sras mthon po 'ga' zhig gi spyod byar yang gsungs pa yod de/ dper na ston pas dman pa 'ga' zhig la bde 'gro'i rgyu bsod nams bsngags la/ thar 'dod chen po la lar de 'dra'i rgyu 'bras smad pa lta bu yin te/ bzhi brgya ba las/ ches chags de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /mtho ris 'dod pa rnams la gsungs/ /thar ba 'dod rnams la de nyid/ /smad 'gyur gzhan du smos ci dgos/ zhes pa rtsa 'grel dang / mdo las/ kun 'byung mtha' dag spang bar bya'o zhes gsungs de lta bu mang yod dang / spyod 'jug dang / blo gros mi zad pas sbyin pa'i dus tshul khrims brtul bar bshad pa dang / rgyal sras kyi mi dge bcu'i rgyu la zhugs kyang bsod nams thob la nyes pa med tshul/ theg bsdus las kyang / de la zad pa nyid ni gang byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa rnam sa de lta bus srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i las rnam pa bcu spyod kyang / gang gis kha na ma tho bar mi 'gyur la/ bsod nams tshad med pa yang bskyed cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang myur du mngon par rdzogs par skyi 'tshang rgya'o/ —zhesarna dang / de bzhin du 'phags pa lhas semasamikyi sgrib spyong 'phags pa'i rin spring dang chos yang dag par sdud pa sogs mdo du mas sems chos kyi rtsa bar bshad pa rnams kyis don 'di rnagrub la/ kun btus 467

las/ gnayo/ la rnam par smin pa sa/nag pa'i las gang zhe na/ gang mi—dge ba'o/ /dkar la rnam par smin pa dkar ba'i las gang zhe na khams gsum pa'i dge ba'o/ /dkar nag tu gyur pa rnam par smin pa dkar nag tu gyur pa gang zhe na/ gang 'dod pa dang rab tu ldan pa'i rab tu 'dres ma ste/ bsam pas nag la sbyor bas dkar ba'am/ sbyor bas nag la bsam pas dkar ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa mdzod ltar min la tshig mi mthun kyang dgongs pa mi 'gal te/ 'dir gzhi bsam sbyor mthar thug gi bar mi dge bas byas pa dang po dang / gzhi nas mthar thug gi bar dge bas byas pa'i khams gsum gyi dge ba ni gnyis pa dang / 'dres ma'i bsam pa'i sgo nas nag la sbyor bas dkar ba bram ze sems ngan pas dge 'dun la ston mo drangs te klur skyes nas sog ma tsam yang med par smon bas sog ma med du skyes pa lta bu dang / sbyor bas nag la bsam pas dkar ba ded dpon snying rje chen po can gyis mi nag mdung thung can bsad pa dang / dge slong dag la lhas sbyin gyis sdig lta bsgrags su btsug pa dang /lha sbyin dang 'khor rnams dbye ba byas pa lta bu dang / sems kyi tshosgrib spyong las/ de 'dul bya ba'i blo yis ni/ /mchod rten bshig kyang nye—sa med de/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu sogs so/ /de dag gis ni srog gcod la yang dge ba gcig bstan ñcā/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ dge ba yin te/gang gi phyir ma chags pa la sogs pa'i sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i phyir/ gal te ma chags pa la sogs pas kun nas slangs pa'i srog gcod pa yang smad pa zhig yin na/ zhetsho sogs dang tsāsam pa desna dge yang sbyor 468

ba log pas kyang 'bras bu ngan pa skyed pa ni phyag 'tshal ba'i lus sgur tsam byas pas sgur bor skyes pa dang / thod pa sa la ma gtugs pas thod skyon can sogs su skyes par las rnam 'byed kyi mdor bshad pa lta bu ste mkhas chen rnams kyi'ang som nyi'i yul bsal zin to/ /mkhas pas/ brgya yi nang nas don shes pa/ /tshig gi mdud grol re re tsam/ zhes pa ltar lags so// snyilnga ba bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag ni/ shes byar bden gnyis ngo bo gcig ldos/ dbye/ /kun nyon skye rung dmigs pa kun rdzob bden/ /rnam grangs tha snyad bden sogs dbye na gsum/ /rnam dag lam dmigs mthar thug don dam bden/ /rnam grangs chos nyid de nyid sogs dbye zin/zhes pa la/ bden gnyis kyi dbye gzhi shes byar rigs te/ lo tsā sang can gyis bsgyur ba'i chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed las/ 'di dag thams cad mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /chos dang de bzhin chos nyid kyis/ zhes so/ /shes byar dbye na rnam 'byed 'di'i 'grel ba las/ chos nyid ni yod pa yin la/ chos ni med pa yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gnaspolugs su yod pa'i chos nyid don dam bden pa dang / der med pa'i chos kun rdzob bden pa gnyis yod cing / de gnyis gang rung cig med na mi rung bas nyung na mi 'du 'khor bar ldog 'jug la ltos na de gnyis las mang mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ med snang dag las gang rung zhig /med na 'khrul dang ma 'khrul dang / /de bzhin kun nas nyon mongs dang / /rnam par byang ba mi 'thad do/ 469

zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar/ yang ci'i phyir don gyis med pa dang snang ba dag las gang rung zhig med pa mi 'dod ce na/ zhes sogs kyis nyung na mi 'du bar bshad cing / de nyid las/ chos dang de bzhin chos nyid kyis/ /thams cad bsdus pa nyid phyir ro/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar/ 'o na ci zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa rnam par bzhag pa gang yin pa de/ zhes pa nas/thams cad smos pa yang de yang de tsam nyid do/ zhes bstan pa'i don du yin te/ de las gzhan ni 'di nyid du 'dus pa'i phyir ram med pa'i phyir ro/ zhes gsungs pa 'dis chos dang chos nyid tsam khol phyung min par 'khor ba kun chos dang theg gsum myang 'das chos nyid du 'du tshul sgo nas bden pa gnyis las grangs mang mi dgos par bshad pas/ dngos smra bas kyang shes bya la bden gnyis su zad lugs mdo ltar bshad pas de las gzhan du sgro skur dag smra par mi bya'o/ /'o na bden gnyis gcig tha dad kyi tshul gang yin snyam na 'di la bod kyi blo bzo mang yang ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad yin te/ ngo bo tsam yang mi gcig pas tha dad yin na/ dgongs 'grel las/ gal te 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid dang don dam pa'i mtshan nyid tha dad pa yin par gyur na ni bden pa mthong ba rnams kyang 'du byed kyi mtshan ma dang ma bral bar 'gyur sogs kyis bden pa mthong bas 'du byed kyi mtshan ma dang ma bral bar thal ba dang / mtshan 'dzin dang gnas ngan len gyis 'ching ba gnyis las mi grol bar thal ba grub pa de bla na med pa'i thar ba dang rdzogs byang mi thob par thal ba bzhi sogs kyi skyon 'ong la/470

yang dgongs 'grel las/ bden pa mthong ba rnams 'du byed kyi mtshan ma dang ma bral ba ma yin gyi/ zhes pa nas/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de'i phyir/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid dang don dam pa'i mtshan nyid tha dad pa zhes byar mi rung ste/ zhes sogs kyis/ bzlog zla bzhi sogs grub pas ngo bo gcig par yang grub cing / ldog pa tsam yang tha dad min pa'i gcig yin na/ dgongs 'grel las/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid dang don dam pa'i mtshan nyid tha dad pa min par gyur na ni/des na byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad bden pa mthong ba yin par yang 'gyur sogs kyis/ so so skye bos bden pa mngon sum du mthong bar thal ba/ des grub pa de bla med kyi myang 'das thob par thal ba dang / 'du byed bzhin du don dam bden pa yang sna tshogs par thal ba sogs kyi skyon 'ongs la/ yang dgongs 'grel las/ gang gi phyir so so skye bo bden pa mthong ba min/ zhes pa nas/ de'i phyir 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid dang don dam pa'i mtshan nyid tha dad pa min zhes bya bar mi rung zhes sogs kyis bzlog zla rnams grub pas/ ldog pa tha dad pa yang grub pas na ngo bo tsam yang mi gcig pa'i tha dad dang ldog pa tsam yang tha dad ma yin pa'i gcig pa gang du yang khas blangs na nyams par rgyal ba dang rgyal tshab dang /dbyig gnyen sogs dbu sems gyi chen po rnams bzhed de/ dgongs 'grel gyi blo gros rnam dag gi le'u las/ 'du byed khams dang don dam satshan nyid ni/ /gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /gcig dang tha dad nyid du gang rtogs pa/ /de dag tshul bzhin ma yin zhugs 471

pa yin/ zhes dang —/ chos nyid rnam bshad las/tsho gnyis po dag ni—gcig nyid dang / /so so pa yang ma yin te/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar/ de lta yin na༈ chos dang chos nyid dag gcig pa nyid du khas blang bar bya'am/ 'on te tha dad pa nyid du snyam na/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis po dag ces bya ba chos dang chos nyid dag ni gcig pa nyid dang tha dad pa nyid du mi 'dod do/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /bden gnyis so so'i mtshan nyid la/ kun nyon skye rung gi dmigs pa'i chos tha snyad pa de/ kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ blo gros mi zad pa rtsa 'grel dang /rnam bshad rigs pa las/ las dang rnam par smin pa dag ni kun rdzob tu rdzas su yod/ don dam par ni med de/ 'jig rten pa'i shes pa'i yul yin pa'i phyir ro/ zhes so/ /dbye na gang zag dang / des kun brtags pa'i cha dang / chos rnams kyi bya byed las gsum gyi char gyur pa'i tha snyad gsum ste dgongs 'grel 'jam dbyangs kyi le'ur bshad pa lta bu'am/btags pa'i kun rdzob/ shes pa'i kun rdzob/ brjod pa'i kun rdzob gsum ste/ dbus mtha'i 'grel ba las/ kun rdzob ni rnam pa gsum ste/ btags pa'i kun rdzob dang / shes pa'i kun rdzob dang / brjod pa yang kun rdzob bo/ zhes so/ /sgra bshad ni kun rdzob de gsum gyi ngor ram dbang gis bden pa'am yod pas na kun rdzob bden pa ste/ dbus mtha'i 'grel ba las/ des kun rdzob bden pa nyid de/ zhes so/ /'di'i zur gyi bden pa'i skad dod sa ta yod pa sogs la 'jug pas so/ /ming gi rnamartegrangs tha snyad bden pa dang gzhi'i chos sogs so/ dhe /rnam dag lam gyite472

dmigs pa mthar thug de don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi phung sogs kyi chos dang gang zag gi bdag med gnyis lta bu ste/ dgongs 'grel gyi rab 'byor le'u las/ rab 'byor phung po rnams la rnam par dag pa'i dmigs pa gang yin pa de ni ngas don dam bden pa yin par yongs su bstan cing / zhes sogs so/ /sgra bshad dang / rnam grangs ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes ni dam pa yin la de'i don yin pas don dam pa dang / snang tshul dang gnas tshul mthun pas bden pa ste/rnam bshad rigs pa las/ dam pa ni ye shes 'jig rten las 'das pa yin te/ de'i don yin pas don dam pa'o/ zhes gsungs la/ dgongs 'grel ltar sangs rgyas rnams byung ngam ma byung rung rtag tu de bzhin du gnas pas na de bzhin nyid dang phyin ci ma log pas na yang dag mtha' dang / spros pa'i mtshan ma 'gog pas na mtshan ma med pa dang / bhārma ṅgā tu'i ṅgā tu ni/ khams dang dbyings dang sa bon dang bad kan sogs la 'jug pa las/ 'dir rgyu'i sgo nas bshad/ 'phags pa'i chos 'byung ba'i rgyur dmigs pa'i sgo nas byed pas na chos dbyings te/ dbus mtha' las/ stongamru nyid de mdor bsdu na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam bden/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /sogs sho lo ka gnyis byung / dbye ba bsdus na chos dang gang zag gi bdag med gnyis dang / rgyas par na bdag med gnyis re re la'ang stong nyid bcu drug re ste/ dbus mtha' las za ba bza' dang de yi lus/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel ste lhag ma ni sngar mtsha na nyid gsum 473

dang gzhan du spros zin to/ /drug pa bden gnyis nges 'byed kyi tshad ma ni/ mngon lkog dbang gis tshad mar mngon rjes gnyis/ /mngon sum bzhi dang dbang mngon 'og ma 'khrul/ zhes pa la/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid sogs 'dra la/ de la dbye na mngon gyur dang lkog gyur dbang gis mngon sum gyi tshad ma dang rjes dpag gnyis yod par lung rigs kun mthun rjes dpag tshad ma ni/ sa'i dngos gzhi ltar na/ mngon par brtags pa'i gtan tshigs kyis/ brtags bya'i yul gsar 'jal gyi shes pa ste/ de'i rten gtan tshigs la dbye na/ rtags sam mtshan ma dang ngo bo nyid dang / las dang chos dang rgyu 'bras kyi gtan tshigs lnga dang / de ci rigs la brten nas brtags par bya ba'i yul la gsar du mi slu ba'i shes pa rnams tshad mar 'jog ste/ sa'i dngos gzhi las/ rjes su dpag pa gang zhe na/ mngon par brtags pa dang bcas pas mngon par brtag pa dang mngon par brtags par bya ba'i yul lo/ /de yang rnam pa lngar blta bar bya ste/ rtags dang / ngo bo nyid dang / las dang / chos dang / rgyu dang / 'bras bu'o/ zhes gsungs pa 'dis rjes dpag gis gzhal tshul dngos su bstan nas tshad ma don gyis bshadaro/ /gtan tshigs lnga'i rtags sam mtshan mas gzhal ba ni da ltar ram sngon mthong pa'i mtshan ma zhaga' zhig las yu la brtags pa ste/ dper na ru mtshon las shing rta dang / rgyal po las yul 'khor dang nog dang rwa las ba lang dpog pa lta bu dang / ngo bo nyid ni mngon gyur las sam phyogs gcig ci rigs kyi ngo bo nyid las lkog gyur daphog pa ste/ dper na da ltar ba las 'das 474

pa dang / 'das pa las ma 'ongs pa dang / rgyan dang gos kyi phyogs gcig las rgyan dang gos de 'dra'i tshogs kun dpog pa lta bu dang / las ni/ byed pa las las kyi rten brtags pa ste/ dper na mi 'gul ba dang bya tshangs sogs ldan pa las sdong sdum dang / rjes las glang po dang / skad tser re las/ rta sogs dpog pa lta bu dang / chos las ni/ mi 'bral ba'i chos las/ de dang 'brel ba'i chos rto gas pa ste/ dper na mi rtag pa dang 'brel ba las sdug bsngal dang / de dang 'brel ba las/ stong pa dang bdag med dpog pa lta bu dang rgyu dang 'bras bu las ni/ rgyu las 'bras bu dang / 'bras bu las rgyu dpog pa ste/ dper na 'gro ba las yul gzhan du phyin pa dpog pa dang / yul gzhan du phyin pas 'gro ba dpog pa lta bu ste/ 'di la zhib cha cig dgos 'gro ste/ bshad tshod tsam bkod do/ /mngon sum ni/ lkog tu ma gyur pa dang / mngon par brtags zin dang / brtags bya min cing ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa ste/ lkog tu gyur pa'i rgyu bsgrib g.yogs kyi dang / mi snang bar byed pa'i dang zil gnon gyi dang rmongs pa'i sgrib pa bzhi dang yul gyi dang / dus kyi dang /phra ba'i thag ring ba gsum gyis lkog gyur ma byas pa'i chos gcig mngon gyur byas so/ /mngon sum la dbye na/ rigs pa'i rjes 'brang dag dbang yid rang rig rnal 'byor mngon sum bzhi 'dod de sngar bshad pa lta bu dang / sa ltar na dbang mngon yid mngon 'jig rten gyi mngon sum dag pa'i mngon sum bzhi yod de/ sa'i dngos gzhi las/ mngon sum de su'i mngon sum du brjod par bya zhesgon/ mdorobasdu na bzhi ste/ /dbang po 475

gzugs can gyi mngon sum dang / yid kyis myong ba'i mngon sum dang /'jig rten gyis mngon sum dang / sdog pa'i mngon sum mo/ zhes so/ /'dis yul mngon sum dang yul can mngon sum gnyis ka bstan to/ /dbang yid mngon sum gnyis bsdus pa ni/ 'jig rten mngon sum dang /dag pa'i mngon sum gnyis ka yin la/ dag pa'i mngon sum la 'jig rten pa'i mngon sum dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mngon sum gnyis yod cing / mngon sum la ma 'khrul ba zhes pa'i 'khrul ba la ci 'dra dgos snyam na/ yul la 'khrul ba'i mngon sum mam ltar snang lnga'am bdun yod de/ smig rgyu la chur 'du shes pa lta bu 'du shes 'khrul ba dang / zla ba gnyis snang lta bu grangs 'khrul ba dang / mgar mer 'khor lo mthong ba lta bu dbyibs la 'khrul ba dang / dung ser 'dzin lta bu kha dog la 'khrul ba dang / ljon shing 'gror snang lta bu las la 'khrul ba dang lnga/ de lnga la dga' bas sems 'khrul ba dang / lnga po der zhen pa lta bu lta ba 'khrul ba dang bdun no/ /sems tsam pa'i skabs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi sar ma gtogs pa'i sa 'og ma'i dbang mngon thams cad 'khrul bas bslad pa yin te/ de'i dbang mngon lnga la phyi rol don snang gis ma bslad pa med pa'i phyir/ bdun pa rna ma rig gi de nyid bye brag tu 'chad pa la/ theg bsdus las/ thams cad ba sdu na rnam par rtog pa bcu ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kun gzhi rtsa ba'i rnam rtog dang / mtshan ma'i rnam rtog gzugs sogs rnam par rig ba dang / mtshan snang rnam rtog mig sogs kyi rnam shes dang / mtshan ma 'gyur bzhi rnam rtog rga sogs dang bde sogs dang —476 —

chags ṭ+wā+oṃ5ོ gas khams sogs 'gyur ba'i rnam rig dang / mtshan snang 'gyur ba'i rnam rtog ni de dag snang ba'i rnam shes dang bstan pa'i dam pa yin min gyi chos nyan pa'i dang / tshul min ṅgem rtog ni phyi ba'i rnam rtog dang /tshul bzhin rnam rtog ni 'di ba'i dang / mngon zhen gyi rnam rtog ni lta ngan re gnyis dang mtshungs ldan gyi de dang / rnam g.yeng gi rtog pa ste bcu yod pa las/ de rnams bsdus nas thog mar kun rtog gis kun nas btags pa ltar ma grub par rtogs na 'khrul rtog gzhan ldog sla la/ de yang theg bsdus las/ de kho na shes bas ma sad pas rnam par rig pa tsam nyid du ji ltar rjes su dpag par bya zhe na/ lung dang rigs pas dpag par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar lung rigs du ma las theg bsdus kyi rigs pa gsum gyis stong gzhi chos can/ gzhan dbang sgra rtog gis kun btags pa ste sgro btags pa ltar snang bar ma grub ste/ theg bsdus las/ gzhan gyi ngo bo nyid kun brtags pa'i ngo bo nyid du ji ltar snang ba de'i bdag nyid ma yin par ci mngon zhe na zhes dris pa'i lan du rigs pa gsum gsung pa'i don bsdus te/ smras pa/ snga rol de blo med phyir de'i bdag 'gal/ /de ming mang phyir don gcig bdag mang 'gal/ /ming don gcig 'jug ma nges bdag 'dres 'gal/ zhes bya ba la/ rigs pa dang po lto ldir ba bum pa'i tha snyad brtags pa'i cha'am de'i tha snyad kyi gzhi'am gnas yin par snang ba de bum pa'i gnas lugs yin na/ de ming ngam brda'i dbang gis mim bzhag par 'gyur la/ de lta na bum pa'i brda sbyor mi dgos la bum pa'i ming ma btags pa'i sngon du lto ldir ba la bum pa'o snyam pa'i blo yod 477

dgos par 'gyur ba la de lta bu'i blo skye ba med pa'i phyir/ de nyid las/ming gi snga rol na blo med pas de'i bdag nyid du 'gal ba dang / zhes so//de ltar grub na gang zag gcig la brgya byin dang dbang po dang grong 'joms sogs ming tha dad pa du ma 'jug pa ltar don gcig pu de ming 'gal ba du ma ltar bdag 'gal ba mang por yod dgos na de med pa'i jir/ de ltar du grub pa med de/ de nyid las/ ming mang pos bdag mang por 'gal ba dang zhes so/ /de ltar grub na nyer spas zhes pa'i ming gcig lta bu phyogs bzhi'i skyes bu bzhi la 'jug tshe de bzhi'i bdag gcig tu 'dres par thal ba dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ de ltar 'dres pa med pas de ltar grub pa med do/ /de nyid las/ ming nges pa med pas bdag 'dres par 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ zhes so/ /des stong gzhi'i chos tha snyad pa rnams gnas lugs su med kyang der snang ba 'khrul ba sgyu ma'i rta lta bu dang / don ma grub kyang 'khrul ba'i nyon mongs skye ba ni sogs sgras smig rgyu lta bu dang /de'i phan sa/nod rmi lam lta bu sogs dang / gnas lugs ni dgag bya'i bdag de gcad tsam gyi nam mkha' lta bur shes dgos pa'i phyir/ de nyid las/ chos rnams ming la dmigs pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs med rnams dag /sgyu ma la sogs 'dra ba dang / /de bzhin mkha' 'drar shes par bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ theg bsdus las/ rnam par g.yeng ba bcu po 'di dag gi gnyen por shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad du rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bstan te/ zhes gsungs pa'i byang sems rnam g.yeng gi rtog pa bcu las/ dngos po med pa'i mtshan ma'i rnam 478

g.yeng dang / de bzhin du dngos po'i dang / sgro 'dogs pa'i dang /skur 'debs kyi dang / gcig pa nyid du dang / tha dad pa nyid du dang /ngo bo nyid du dang / khyad par du dang / ming ji lta ba bzhin du don du dang / do na ji lta ba bzhin du ming du rnam par g.yeng ba ste bcu'i dang po'i gnyen por/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid du yod bzhin du sogs dang / dngos por rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen por/bka' stsal ba/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / zhes sogs dang / sgro 'dogs pa'i gnyen por/ bka' stsal ba/byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong sogs dang / skur 'debs kyi rnam rtog gi gnyen por/ bka' stsal ba/ stong pa nyid kyi ni ma yin no/ /zhes dang / gcig rtog gnyen por/ bka' stsa sha ba/gzugs kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gzugs ma yin no/ zhes sogs dang / tha dad rtog pa'i gnyen por/ bka' stsal ba/ stong pa nyid las gzugs gzhan min te/ gzugs nyid stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so/ zhes dang / ngo bo nyid du rtog pa'i gnyen por/ bka' stsal ba/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste gzugs zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo/zhes sogs dang / khyad par du rtog pa'i gnyen por/ bka' stsal ba/ngo bo nyid ni mi skye mi 'gag /kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin/ rnam par byang ba ma yin no/ zhes sogs dang / ming ltar don du rtog pa'i gnyen po la/ bka' stsal ba/ ming bcos ma la chos de dag so sor brtarga/sa 479

nas ming glo bur gyi rjes su tha snyad 'dogs te/ ji lta ji ltar rjes su tha snyad 'dogs pa de lta de ltar mngon par zhen to/ zhes dang / don bzhin ming du rtog pa'i gnyen por/ bka' stsal ba/ byang chub sems dpas ming de dag thams cad yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /yang dag par rjes su mi mthong pas mngon par zhen pa med de/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i sher phyin gyi don thams cad bsdus par bshad la/ gcig dang tha dad 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog ni bden gnyis kyi steng gi ldog pa gcig 'dzin dang ngo bo tha dad 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi gnyen po bshad la/ rnam rtog phyi ma bzhi'i gnyen por tshol ba bzhi dang shes pa bzhi bshad pa/ tshol bzhis btsal bzhin med phyir der de med/ ces smras te/ de'i don ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ming dang don dag phan tshun du/ /glo bur ba ni nyid du tshol/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel dang / kun btus las/ kun tu tshol ba bzhi ste/ ming kun tu tshol ba dang / dngos po kun tu tshol ba dang /ngo bo nyid 'dogs pa kun tu tshol ba dang / bye brag tu 'dogs/ pa kun tu tshol ba'o/ zhes dang / de bzhin du theg bsdus dang / byang sa/ las kyang / de la ming yongs su tshol ba ni byang chub sems dpa' 'am gang ming la ming tsam du lta'o/ /de bzhin du dngos po la dngos po tsam du lta ba ni/ zhes sogs kyis/ ming la ming tsam du lta ba dang / dngos po la dngos po tsam du lta ba dang / ngo bo nyid du btags pa la de tsam du lta ba dang / bye brag gam khyad par du btags pa la de tsam du lta ba bzhis btsal ba bzhin du med cing mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ rnam rig tsam du zad la/480

btsal na de'i don med pa'i phyir/ rnam par rig pa tsam yang don dam dpyod ngor med nga/ stong nyid du 'dod de/ theg bsdus las/ yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid la ji ltar 'jug ce na/ rnam par rig pa tsam gyi 'du shes kyang bablog nas 'jug ste/ zhes dang / byams chos gzhan gyi da tho/ngas pa 'og tu 'chad la/ sems tsam pas kyang stong nyid sgom dus sems 'gog par bshad na dbu ma pas lta ci smos/ de nas lhan cig dmigs nge8 shrī kyis phyi don med par bshad pa/ lhan cig dmigs pa nges phyir de gzhan min/ zhes smras te/ rnam nges las/ lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir/ /sngo dang de blo gzhan ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa la 'khrul pa ches mang yang 'dir mi spro zhing / mdor bsdu na/ kha cig rtsod gzhi sngor snang dbang shes dang de'i rnam pa byas nas mdo sde pa la rdzas gzhan ma yin par sgrub 'dod pa grub zin sgrub pa dang / bye smra la zer ba'ang ma grub pa'i rtags so/ /yang kha cig mdo sde par sngor snang dang de'i dbang shes rtsod gzhir byed pa yang sgrub chos tshad bsal lo/ /yang la la sngon po dang de snang dbang shes rtsod gzhi zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ de gnyis lhan cig dmigs nges ma yin par ma grub na sngon 'dzin yid mngon chos can/ sngor snang dbang shes/ dmigs byed du thal/ sngon po dmigs byed yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa khas/ yang rtog pa rtsing ba dag skabs 'di'i lhan cig dmigs nges rtags kyis sngo sogs dang de 'dzin shes pa rdzas gzhan min par sgrub pa dang / rdzas gcig tu sgrub pa khyab mnyam du bsam nas rdzas gcig tu sgrub pa ches 'khrul te/ 'o na bum 'dzin rtog par bum pa snang ba dang bum 'dzin 481

rtog rnga/ chos can/ rdzas gcig tu thal/ lhan cig dmigs nges yin pa'i phyir/ rnam nges las/ de phyir snang don de blo dag /phyi don yod kyang tha dad min/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum khas/ yang mang pos lhan cig dmigs nges kyi nges pa'i don tshad mas nges pa la byed pa sogs ni dmigs pa zhes pa dang blos pa sogs so/ /des na 'dir rtsod gzhi ni sdo dang de blo zhes pas sngon po dang sngon 'dzin shes pa lta bu sgrub chos ni gzhan ma yin zhes pas rdzas sa/zha ji— bkas/ tsarma dang / rtags kyi don ni lha na cig ni dus gcig pa dang / dmigs pa ni rtogs pa dang /nges pa ni phan tshun nges pa ste khyab pa'o/ /des na sngon po dang sngon 'dzin shes pa chos can/ tha dad du snang yang rdzas gzhan ma yin te/ lhan cig dmigs nges yin pa'i phyir/ dper na zla gnyis bzhin/ 'di'i rang 'grel las/ tha dad par snang pa nyid yin yang sngon po ni nyams/ su/ myong ba las don gzhan pa'i rang bzhin nyid ma yin te/ de dag lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir zla ba gnyis la sogs pa bzhin no/ zhes so/ /de'i rtags sam phyogs chos ni/ de gnyis chos can/ lhan cig dmigs nges yin te/ phan tshun gcig dmigs byed kyi ngo bor skyeru na gcig shos yang dmigs byed kyi ngo bor skyes pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ 'di'i rang 'grel las/ 'di dag las rnam pa gcika ma dmigs na gzhan dmigs nga/ med do/ zhes so/ /de ltar phan tshun khyab pa nges pa deci'adi'i nges pa'i dosna/ yin te/ chos mchog gi 'grel bshad las/ des na 'di ni nges pa'i don du bstan pa yin te/ shes bya dmigs pa ni shes pa dmigs pa'i 482

bdag nyid can yin te/ zhes so/ /rtsa ba'i khyab pa yod de/ lhan cig dmigs ngespa yin na rdzas gzhan ma yin dgos te/ ros gzhan dang rang bzhin tha dad la lhan cig dmigs nges med pa'i phyir/ 'di'i rang 'grel las/ rang bzhin tha dad pa la ni 'di 'thad pa ma yin te/ zhes dang / 'grel bshad 'thad ldan las/ rang bzhin tha dad pa ste/ rang bzhin phan tshun dben pa la ni nges par lhan cig tu 'dzin pa 'di 'thad pa min te/ zhes so/ /'di la rang rig gis ma nges snyam na skyon med de/ sngon 'dzin myong ba'i rang rig gis sngon po ma dmigs kyang sngon po dmigs byed kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i phyir/ 'grel bshad las/ shes pa dmigs pa yang shes bya dmigs pa'i bdag nyid yi na no/ zhes gsungs pa'i bdas/ nyid ces pa'i don yin la/ 'dis mig shes kyis gzugs dmigs tshul sogs kyang shes par bya/ yang kho na re/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang de'i shes bya chos can/ rdzas gzhan ma yin par thal/ lhan cig dmigs nges yin pa'i phyir na rtags ma grub ste/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs ma dmigs kyang shes bya du ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ 'grel bshad las/ gang yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi shes bya dang thugs la/ zhes pa nas/tha dad pa nyid du rgyud gzhan gyi rang gis dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /sems byung dang sems yang de dang 'dra bar bshad la/ snang gzugs gnyis kyis ma nges zer na bar ma chod pa'i snang gzuspu /sa ni/ lhan cig dmigs nges dang rdzas gzhan ma yin par 'dod de/ dngos rgyu tshar gcig gis ngo sto cig car bskyed pa'i phyir/ rang 'grel las/ 'bras bu rgyu la 483

'khrul ba med pa 'i phyir/ snang ba bar chad med pas gzugs dang lhan cig gzung ba'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir bzung bar 'gyur ro/ zhes so//snang gzu4sa tsam la byed na lhan cig dmigs nges ma grwab ste/ gzugs ma dmigs kyang bar snang dmigs pa yang yod/ 'ug pa dang byi bas mtshan mo snang ba ma dmigs kyang gzugs dmigs pa lta bu yod pa'i phyir/rang 'grel las/ yang na snang pa 'ba' zhig kyang mthong ba'i phyir dang /snang ba med pa'i gzugs kyang srog chags kyi bye brag 'ga' zhig gis mthong ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /yang la la na re/ lha sbyin dang mchod sbyin gnyis kyis byad gzugs gcig la dmigs pa'i tshe mig shes gnyis phan tshun gcig gcis/ dmigs byed kyi bdag nyid du skyes par thal/ de'i tshe lha sbyin gyis dmigs pa 'i gzugs gang yin mchod sbyin gyi mig shes kyis kyang dmigs pa 'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i tshe de byad gzugs gcig gi gzugs la thun mong du dmigs pa'i phyir na ma khyab cing / rtags grub ste/ de ltar thun mong du bltas kyang gcig la snang pa gcig shos la snang mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ dper na lha sbyin mchod sbyin gnyis la zla gnyis snang tshe mchod sbyin la snang ba lha sbyin la mi snang pa'i phyir te/ skyes bu gcig la dgra gnyen gyi yid du 'ong mi 'ong snang tshul mi mthun sogs ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems 'grel rab zhi'i 'gyur las/ phyi rol don ni gcig la yang / /shes pa tha dad rab 'jug ste/ /yid 'ong gzugs ni gang yin pa/ /de nyid gzhan la gzhan du snang / zhes so/ /yang phyi don 'gog byed/ lang gshegs las/ gang zag rgyun dang 484

phung po dang / /rkyen dang de bzhin rdul rnams dang / /gtso bo dbang phyug byed po dag /sems tsam po las rnam par brtags/ /don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ /rigs pas rnam par brtag na ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa 'gag par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i/ rdu la la dpyod pa nyi shu'i rigs pa dang / gang zag dang ṅgen sogs la dpyod pa gcig du bral gnyis las/ dang po rdul rnams dang / rigs pas rnam par brtag na ni/ zhes pa'i don nyi shu ba las/ drug gis cig car sbyar ba na/ /phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur/ /drug po dag kyang go gcig na/ /gong bu'ang rdul phran tsam du 'gyur/ zhes pa'i don 'gal spong dang bcas pa ni/ phra rdul bskor tshe shar ngos nub phyogs la/ /mi blta cha bcas bltas na rags mi 'gyur/ /phra rab yin kyang bye smra'i min ci 'gal/ zhes pa la bye brag pa rnams rdul phra rab cha med 'byar ba las gong bu 'ong ba dang bye smra dang mdo sde pa'i dge 'dun srung phra rab cha med du ma ma phrad par bskor ba tsam dang mdo sde pa'i btsun pa sogs mdo sde mi rma nga po phra rab cha med du ma bar med kyang ma reg par 'dus pa las gong bu 'dod pa rnams la dbus rdul phra rab gcig la phyogs bzhi steng 'og gi rdu shaṃ phra rab drug gis sbyar ba'i tshe shar rdul la 'byar ba'i cha des nub rdul la rma reg na phra rab cha drug tu 'gyur la/ reg na phyogs drug ka la reg pa'i drug ka'i go sa gcig pa'am phyogs gcig pas gong bu chen po 'ang rdul phra rab tu thal zhes/ dbyig gnyen gyis bshad la/ kho na re/ phrad par mi 'dod pas skyon med do zer na/ dbus mtha' las/ 'byar ba dang ni 485

bskor ba 'am/ /bar med rnam par gnas kyang rung / zhes pa ltar phrad ma phrad gang yin kyang rung de'i tshe phra rab drug gis bskor ba'i dbus kyi phra rab kyi shar ngos/ kyi phyogs de nub ngos kyi phra rab phyogs la mi lta na cha bcas su 'gyur te/ de la nub la lta mi lta'i cha yod pa'i phyir/ bltas na phra rab ci tsam tshogs kyang bong tsho da rags pa ri sogs 'ong mi srid par 'gyur te/drus/ gis bskor tshe shar ngos kyi go sa tsam la med pa'i phyir/ zhes 'dis thams cad 'gog nus pas rtsa bar bkod pa yin no/ /'di la stag los phyogs kyi cha yod na rdul phran min par 'phags pas bshad zer la/ skabs 'di la'ang rdul phra rab zer rgyu la rdul phran smras pa ni rdul phran cha med nang pa surug kyang mi 'dod de/ de ni rdul phra rab tu bsil na phra rab du ma'i phung por mi 'dod mkhan med pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang / /sogs ltar du ma yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'phags pas/gang la cha shas kyis brtags pa/ /de ni rdul phran ji ltar 'dod/ ces dang / brgya ba las/ gang gi rdul la phyogs yod pa/ /des rdul rdul phran min par bsnyad/ ces gsungs pa min nam zhe na/ khyod kyis gang smras thams cad 'di 'dra'i long gtam 'ba' zhig rang yin/ de'i don ni rdul phra rab la yang dpyad na phyogs cha'i dbye ba rigs pas mthong la de ltar na gang la cha shas kyi brtags pa byar rung ba de ni bye mdo dang bye brag pa khyed cag gis 'dod pa'i rdul cha med pa'i phra rab tu gang 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ phyogs kyi dbye bas dbye ba yis/ rdul phra la yang dbye ba mthong / /gang la cha shas kyis brtags 486
