zad par khong du chud par mi nus te skye ba dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / nyan thos kyi mdo las/ gang sdug bsngal 'di ma lus par spangs pa/ nges par spangs pa byang bar gyur pa zad pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'gog pa nye bar zhi ba nub pa/ sdug bsngal gzhan gyi mtshams mi spyor zhing mi 'byung mi skye ba 'di ni zhi ba/ 'di ni gya nom pa ste/ 'di lta ste/phung po thams cad nges par spangs pas srid pa zad pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'gog pa mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ de yang mdo 'di'i da ltar gyi myang 'das dbang du byas nas ma lus par spangs pa nas/ nub pa/ zhes pa'i bar dang / ma 'ongs pa'i sdug bsngal bral tshul dbang du mdzad nas sdug bsngal gzhan gyis mtshams mi sbyo se ba nas/mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar du bshad par 'grel ba de las bshad pa'i phyir dang / rjes zlos kyi mdo las/ rjes zlos zhes bya'i mdo 'di ni/ shā ri'i bu yis mya ngan 'das/ /mngon sum byas nas bshad pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs sa bon dang bcas pa spangs pa na myang 'das thob la de yang nyon mongs zad kyang de'i bag chags kyi 'khrul ba'i lhag ma dang bcas pa'i myang 'das ni lhag bcas myang 'das dang / 'khrul ba'i lhag ma med pa'i myang 'das ni lhag med myang 'das yin te/ 'di'i phung po sogs zad pa ni chos dbyings su zad pa'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo 'di las/ gang sdug bsngal 'di ma lus par spangs pa sogs kyis spangs tshul dang / zab mo'i mdo du ma las/ ma skyes/ pa/ ma 'gag pa/ gzod ma nas zhi ba/ rang bzhin gyis mya ngan 912

las 'das pa'o/ /zhes pa'i mdo snga ma'i zad pa dang / 'di'i mi skyes rnams chos dbyings dgos par 'dra ba'i phyir te/ rin chen phreng ba las/zad dang mi skyes don du ni/ /gcig pa de phyir bzod par gyis/ zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ nyon mongs gdod nas zad phyir ro/ zhes dang / de'i thogs 'grel las/ de'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gdod ma nas zad cing 'gag par mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / tshig gsal las/nang dang phyi'i dngos po ma dmigs pas nang dang phyi la bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bdag gir 'dzin pa rnam pa thams cad du zad pa 'di ni 'dir de kho na nyid do/ zhes dang / de'i don lam rim las/ phyi dang nang gi chos sna tshogs pa de kho na min bzhin du de kho na nyid du snang ba 'di thams cad bag chags dang bcas pa nye bar zhi bas bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa rnam pa thams cad du zad pa ni/ 'dir thob par bya ba'i de kho na nyid chos kyi sku'o/ zhes so/ 'dis 'gog bden don dam bden par bshad pa yin no/ /bcu ba ni/ bag chags shes sgrib nyon min ma rig 'ang bzhed/ /nyon mongs ma zad shes sgrib spong mi rtsom/ zhes smras te/ 'di ba'i sgrib gnyis spangs tshul thun mong min pa yin te/ 'jug 'grel las/de la ma rig pa'i bag chags ni shes bya yongs su gcod pa'i gegs su gyur pa yin la/ zhes sogs kyis dug gsum gyi bag chags shes sgrib dang /'jug 'grel las/ nyon mongs dag ni ma rigs pa dang / 'dod la sogs pa ste/ zhes pas dug gsum nyon mongs su bshad kyang nyog mong5 shrī can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa dang shes sgrib tu gyur pa'i ma rig pa yod de/ 'jug 913

'grel las/ nyon mongs pa can min pa'i ma rig pa kun tu spyod pa'i phyir/zhes dang / skyabs 'gro bdun cu ba las/ mi shes nyon mongs min spangs phyir/ /phyis nas sangs rgyas kyis bskul bas/ zhes dang / ma rig nyon mongs med yod pas/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen spangs pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ shes sgrib la shes pa yin min gnyis yod la/ shes sgrib dang thogs sgrib don gcig/ sa brgyad par nyon mongs kun spangs pa na shes sgrib spangs dgos kyi de'i snga rol tu ma yin te/ nyon mongs ma spangs bar du de'i bag chags spangs thabs med pa'i phyir te/ dper na snum gyis gos pa'i snum ma bsal bar de'i gos pa bsal mi thub pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ 'jug 'grel las/ de ni bag chags te nyon mongs pa'i mur thug pa dang goms pa dang rtsa ba dang bag chags zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs so/ de ni zag pa med pa'i lam gyis nyon mongs pa spangs kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis spangs par mi nus te/ tidzimar dang zhes sogs dang / gzungs rgyal gyis zhus pa las/ de bzhigagashegs pa'i zag pa zad pa shes pa ni rnam par dag pa dri ma med pa yongs—su dag pa 'od gsal ba bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad yang dgapar bcom pa'o/ /nyan thos rnams kyi zag pa zad pa ni tshad yod pa bag chags yang dag par ma bcom pa'o/ /sogs dang / rgyud bla ma las/dri med dbyings la chags med pa/ /thogs med phyir de dag pa yin/ /yi shes gzigs pa dag pa pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med phyir/ /'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa ni/ zhes dang / de'i thogs 'grel las/914

mdor bsdus na rgyu gnyis kyis na gcig shos nyi tshe ba'i ye shes kyis mthong ba la ltos nas/ shin tu rnam par dag pa zhes brjod do/ /gnyis po gang dag gis she na/ chags pa med pa'i phyir dang / thog/sa pa med pa'i phyir ro/ zhes dang / de ltar phyir mi sdog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gzigs pa de ni/ zhis gsungs la/ thogs sgrib ci rigs las grol ba'i ye shes kyi mtha' phyir mi ldog pa'i sa ste sa brgyad pa nas bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /don 'di 'dra du ma la datho/ngas nas/rnam bshad las/ sa bon de las gzhan pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa shes sgrib tu 'jog pa ni/ sa brgyad pa ma thob bar du spong ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ zhes so/ /'dir spro bya mang yang gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ snang bas yod mtha' stong bas med mtha' sel/ /de sogs thun mong min mang dbu ma ltos/ zhes smras te/ sngar rten 'byung gi skabs cung zad bshad la/ grub mtha' 'og ma dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan zhib par the/sa dgos la/ gzhan yang / 'gog snyoms kyi khyad par dang zab mo'i lta ba skyed tshul sogs 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung dang mdo btus gnyis dang rnam bshad gnyis lam rim sogs las shes dgos so/ /lnga ba de dag nges byed tshad ma'i khyad par 'khrul spong dang bcas pa la/tshad ma'i khyad par dang 'khrul spong gnyis/ dang po la/ grangs nges dang mngon sum gyi khyad par dang / rjes dpag gi khyad par bshad pa gsum/dang po ni/ mngon rjes nyer 'jal lung gi tshad ma bzhir/ /bshad kyang gzhal bya'i dbang gis mngon rjes gnyis/ zhes smras te/ 'dir lugs 915

'di'i tshad ma'i rnam bzhag mdor bsdus shig smras na/ dzig gsal las/tshad ma dag ni du zhig mtshan nyid ni gang / yul dag ni du zhig ci bdag las skye ba zhig gam gzhan nam gnyis ka'am rgyu med pa las yin zhes bya ba 'di brjod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyi don cung zad bshad na/ mi slu ba'i shes pa tshad ma'i mtshan nyid de/ brgya ba'i 'grel ba las/mi slu ba'i shes pa ni 'jig rten na tshadabyum nyid du mthong na/ zhes gsungs ba'i phyir/ sgra bshad na/ skad dod bra mā ṇa zhes pa'i pra pra tha ma zhes sogs byas nas thog gam gsar du sogs la byas nas bshad na mi rung ste/rtsod zlog las/ de yang dang po 'grub min la/ /bar ma yin zhing tha ma'ang min/ zhes dang / brgya ba'i 'grel ba las/ 'jig rten pa'i mthong bas de kho na mthong ba gsal ba rigs pa ma yin te/ de ni 'jig rten kho na las tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /des na chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab lta bu ni rab tu 'jal bas na tshad ma zhes bya ste/pra rab tu dang mā ṇa 'jal ba la 'jug pa'i phyir dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de ltar bshad ba'i phyir te/ blo gros mi zad pa las/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i chos rnams rab tu shes pa ni shes rab po nges par 'byed pa'i chos rnams la rtog pa ni shes rab bo/ /'phags pa'i chos mngon du gyur pas na/ shes rab ni tshad mar gyur pa'o zhes sogs gsungs so// /mā ṇa sems pa la byas nas bshad snang ste/ pra dz+nyā dang pra mā ṇa'i pra snyegs sa 'dra ba'i don no/ /tshad ma la dbye na mngon sum tshad ma dang /rjes dpag dang / yid ches tshad ma dang nyer 'jal tshad ma bzhi yod de/916

spuzhal bya mabe+en rgyur dang cung zad lkog gyur dang shin tu lkog gyur dang /dpe don mngon lkog 'dres pa ste bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ tshig gsal las/de ltar tshad ma bzhi las 'jig rten gyi don rtogs par rnam par 'jog pa yin no/ zhes dang / tshad ma'i grangs 'jug pa gzhal bya'i gzhan gyis dbang yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / gang gi tshe de ltar gzhal bya gnyis gnas pa med pa de'i tshe lung la sogs pa/ zhes pa nas/ tshad ma gzhan nyid ma yin pa ma yin no/ zhes so/ /bzhir byed pa 'phags pa dang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin te/ rtsod zlog las/ re zhig gal te mngon sum gyis/ zhes dang / rjes dpag lung dang nyer 'jal dang / zhes dang / mdo dgongs 'grel las kyang / de ltar na 'thad pa sgrub pa'i rigs pa de ni mngon sum gyi tshad ma dang rjes su dpag pa'i tshad ma dang lung gi tshad ma'i mtshan nyid lnga po dag gis yongs su dag pa yin no/ zhes dang / rang rig gi dpe nye bar sbyar ba'i mtshan nyid/ ces so/ /yang de la mngon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis su 'du ste/ sa/zhal bya mngon lkog gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir dang / brgya ba las/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung lkog gyur la/ zhes pa'i 'grel bar zla bas/ dngos po thams cad mngon sum du shes pas go bar bya ba ni ma yin gyis rjes su dpag pas rtogs par bya ba yang yod de/ zhes so/ /des dbang po drug po ci rigs kyis gzung bya de mngon gyur gyi don yin te/ mngon gyur dang dbang po'i yul lkog gyur ma yin pa'i chos rnams don gcig pa'i phyir te/'chi med mdzod las/ mngon sum dang ni dbang po'i yul/ zhes dang /91k+ṇi

dbang po mngon sum rtogs pa'i don mngon gyur du bshad pas so/ /rtags la brten nas sam rtags stobs kyis rtogs par bya ba lkog gyur gyi don yin te/ rjes dpag gi gzhal bya dang lkog gyur dang dbang po'i yul min pa dom/ gcig tu 'dir bshad cing tshad ma pa ltar mi rung ba'i phyir te/ 'chi med mdzod las/ lkog tu gyur dang mngon sum min/ zhes pa'i mngon sum ma yin pa'i skad dod/ atī : ya/ zhes pa dbang po las 'das pa la yang 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtags min 'dzin stangs yul gyur mngon sum par/ /bslu med shes pa mngon sum tshad mar bzhed/ /dbye ngo dbang mngon yid mngon rnal 'byor mngon/ zhes smras te/ rtags la ltos pa min par rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul gyi gzhal bya mngon sum pa la mi slu ba'i shes pa gcig mngon sum gyi tshad ma'i don yin te/ mtshan gzhi dang / rang gi mtshan nyid gzugs rung lta bu dang / spyi'i mtshan nyid gzugs mi rtag pa dang gzugs bdag med lta bu yin kyang rung / rtags la ma brten par 'jig rten te shes pa des don myong stobs kyis snang bar yod na ni/ skabs 'dir de 'dra gang yod thams cad shes pa des mngon sum du dmigs par bya ba dang / mngon gyur pa dang mngon sum pa yin pa'i phyir/ yul de'i sgo nas yul can shes pa dang gnyis ka mngon sum zhes bzhag dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na sngon po'i blo bzhin/ tshig gsal las/de'i phyir gal te 0/tshan gzhi'am rang gi mtshan nyid dam spyi'i mtshan nyid kyang rung ste/ 'jig rten na yod na ni/ thams cad mngon sum du dmigs par bya ba yin pa'i phyir lkog tu ma gyur pa yin te/ de'i phyir de'i yul can 918

gyi rnam par shes pa dang lhan cig tu mngon sum nyid du rnam bar gzhag go /zhes so/ /der ma zad zla ba gnyis 'dzin dang spa shad 'dzag snang can gyi shes pa sogs log shes rnams kyang rang gi snang ba la mngon sum tshad ma yin te/ tshig gsal las zla ba gnyis la sogs pa dag ni rab rib can min pa'i shes pa la ltos nas mngon sum nyid ma yin la/ rab rib can la sogs pa la ltos nas ni mngon sum nyid kho na'o/ zhes so/ /rang gi snang ba la mngon sum tshad ma yin kyang mngon sum tshad ma yin mi dgos te de dag mi slu ba'i shes pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang / tshad min kyi shes pa don mthun dang don mi mthun du ma yod pa'i phyir dang / shes pa thams cad tshad mar 'dod pa ha cang thal bar bshad pa'i phyir/ 'jug par/ mi shes gnyid kyis rab bskyod mu stegs can/ /rnams gyi bdag nyid ji bzhin brtags pa dang / /sgyu ma smig rgyu sogs la brtags pa gang / /de dag 'jig rten las kyang yod min nyid/ ces dang / brgya ba'i 'grel ba las/ rnam par shes pa thams cad kyang tshad ma nyid du thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gang dag rtog ngor yod pa la tha snyad du yod pas khyab par 'dod pa dang 'jig rten tha snyad la 'di yod dang 'di med mi rung 'dod mkhan dang / zla ba'i lugs 'dod kyang log shes rang gi snang ba la mngon sum tshad mar 'dod pa la ngo mtshar byed pa dag dang rtog med kyi —shes pa thams cad tshad mar 'dod pa rnams kyis lung 'di dag la mig phyis la snyon ma lding bar ltos shig /de la dbye na dbang mngon yid mngon rnal 'byor mngon sum tshad ma gsum yod pa'i lhag ma mthun phal cher sngar —919

bshad cing / yid mngon la yul gsal ba mthong ba'i rtog bral mi dgos par rtog pa du ma yod de/ dran shes rnams dang rjes dpag gis drangs pa'i bcad shes rnams dang / dbang mngon gyis drangs pa'i yid shes tshad ma rnams sogs yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ rtags brten lkog yul bslu med rjes dpag ste/ /lkog gyur dpe dang shin tu lkoka 'jal ba'i/ /rjes dpag nyer 'jal lung gi tshad mar bzhed/ ces smras te/ rtags da nga rgyu mtshan dang shes byed kyi rgyu rnams don gcig pas de dag la —r+sha/tem/ nas rang gi 'dzin stangs yul gyi gzhal bya lkog gyur la mi slu ba'i shes pa ni rjes dpag tshad ma'i don yin no/ /brgya ba'i 'grel ba las/ dngos po thams cad mngon sum gyi shes pas go bar bya ba ma yin kyi rjes su dpag pas rtogs par bya ba yang yod do/ zhes so/ /dbye na dngos su skyed byed sgo nas thal 'gyur la brten pa dang / gtan tshigs la brten pa 4 /nyis yod de/ bdag skye 'gog pa'i 'gal brjod kyi thal 'gyur gnyis/ lta bu 'dod don sgrub pa'i thal 'gyur gyis rjes dpag skyed pa rtogs sla la bzlog pa 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur gyis kyang dbang rnon la dngos su rjes dpag skye da nus te thal 'gyur des gzhan gyi 'dod pa mi 'dod pa'i thal ba dang snga rgol gyi 'dod do na bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis go thub pa'i phyir te/de ltar ma go na phyi rgol des thal 'gyur de'i bstan bya'i gtso bo ma rtogs par 'gyur ba dang / tshig tsam las ma go par yang 'gyur la snga rgol gyi 'dod pa ma go ba'i rtul bor 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de las thal 'gyur de las rtags sbyor ma bkod pa'i phyir te/ tshig gsal las/ khyed cag gi 920

rtsod pa 'di ni nas/ 'di dag tsam zhig gis brtsad pa na ci pha rol po khas len par mi byed dam/ zhes gsungs la/ dbang rtul la tshad ma pa ltar thal rtags gnyis ka bkod tshul bshad zin to/ /rtogs tshul sgo nas dbye na/ rang don skabs kyi rtags la brten pa dang / gzhan don skabs kyi rtags la brten pa gnyis yod de/ gzhal bya'i sgos dbye na gsum yod do/ rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi gzhal bya lkog gyur rtags stobs kyis dngos su rtogs pa'i shes pa cung zad lkog gyur rtogs pa'i rjes dpag yin te/tshig gsal las/ lkog tu gyur pa'i yul can rtags sgrub par bya ba la mi 'khrul ba las skyes pa'i shes pa rjes dpag go zhes so/ /'di gzhal bya'i gnas gnyis pa rtogs byed do/ /de'i steng nas dpe don chos mthun gzhal ba'i rjes dpag ni nyer 'jal rjes dpag tshad ma yin te/ dper na ba lang dang ba min 'drar 'dzin dang / myu gu dang gzugs can gnyis rdzun par mtshungs 'dzin lta bu/ tshig gsal las/ 'dra ba las nyams su myong ba'i don rtogs pa ni nyer 'jal ba ste/ dper na ba min ni ba lang dang 'dra'o snyam pa lta bu'o/ zhes so/ /rang gi 'dzin stangs yul gyi gzhal bya shin tu lkog gyur rtags stobs kyis rtogs pa'i blo ni yid ches rjes dpag dang lung gi tshad ma ste/ dpyad gsum dag pa'i rin chen 'phreng ba la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang dang de'i rgyu bla ma bsu skyel sogs kyi 'brel ba rtogs pa lta bu ste/ tshig gsal las/ dbang po las 'das pa'i don mngon sum du rig cing yid ches par gyur pa dag gi tshig gang yin pa de ni lung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas/ lung dang lung gi tshad ma gnyis ka bstan 921

to/ /de ltar na tshad ma dang gzhal bya dag 'jig rten tha snyad du yod kyi dngos smra ltar don dam par med de/ phan tshun ltos grub tsam yin pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur ba rang lugs la mi 'dod pa'i don ga la yin te/tshig gsal las/ de ltar tshad ma bzhis 'jig rten gyi don rtogs par rnam par 'jog pa yin na de dag kyang phan tshun ltos nas grub par 'gyur te/ tshad ma dag yod na gzhal bya'i don dag tu 'gyur la/ gzhal bya'i don dag yod na tshad ma dag tu 'gyur gyi tshad ma dang gzhal bya gnyis ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa ni yod pa ma yin no/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dzin stangs yul la nges 'dren der tshad ma/ /gzhan gyis gnod bral de la mi bslu'i phyir/ /'khrul yang tshad mar mi 'gal mi bslu'i don/ /skabs stobs mang bshad kun rdzob la yang bshad/ /de'i phyir rdzas kyi sgra bzhin gcig la min/ zhes smras te/ de yang stag lo na re/ kun rdzob la tshad spub mi yong ste/ tshad grub kyi don bslu med dang bslu med kyi don tshugs thub tu grub pa yin pas zer pa de 'gog byed yin kyang sngar lung rigs rnam dag gis bkag zin la/ don bsdus spyo bum 'dzin dbang mngon bum pa la tshad mar song ba yin te/ des bum pa yod par bzung ba la don dam dpyod byed dang tha snyad dpyod byed tshad ma gnyis gang gis kyang mi gnod pa'i phyir te/ don dam dpyod byed kyis kyang de ma rnyed kyang bum pa yod pa mi khegs pa'i phyir/ des na de de la mi slu ba'i blo yin te/ de de 'jal byed gyi blo yin pa'i phyir te/ dpa' bos spel bstod las/ don dam gzigs pas na mi slu ba/ zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir dang / chos 922

yang dag par sdud pa las kyang / nges par sems pa rig pa khong du chub pa/ mngon par rtogs pa shes pa shes bya la mi slu ba ste/ zhes gsungs la/sa bcu ba las/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'di ni kun 'byung pa'o/ /nas/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ zhes gsungs shing /yang dag pa zhes pa las lhag pa'i mi slu ba zhes pa'i rwa can zhig mi dgos sems bzhi ba pas gzigs tshul de cung zad thugs la e lda na gang ltar rang phung gzhan phung ma byed cig/ des na rang yul la 'khrul yang tshad mar mi 'gal te rang gi yul la 'khrul yang de gzhal ba yod pa'i phyir te/dper na rjes dpag bzhin skabs 'di'i mi slu ba tshugs thub la byed mi dgos te/ tshad ma'i mi slu ba'i don tshugs thub tu grub mtha' gcig gis kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / rang rang gi lugs kyi rdzun pa tshad grub yod pa'i phyir/ mdo bstan bcos nas mi bslu ba dang bden pa dang yang dag pa zhes bshad tshad thams cad don dam bden pa'am bdenarnagrub gang rung kho nar bshad mi dgos par thal/ skabs stobs kyis rigs pa drug cu ba'i 'grel bar bzung ba'i don yod pa la phyin ci ma log pa dang bden pa'i tha snyad rung bar bshad 'chi med mdzod las yod pa rtag pa mchod 'os sogs la bden sgra 'jug par bshad cing / blo gros mi zad pa dang chos yang dag par sdud pa sogs las sngar ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ dper na rdzas sam dngos po'i sgra bzhin no/ /shin tu spros pas chog go/gnyis pa lam la/ gsung rab thams cad kyi don rnams skyes bu 923 /

gsum tsu lam du bsdus te theg pa'i grangs nges bshad pa dang / theg pa so so 'i khyad par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gsung rab thams cad mngon mtho nges legs kyi thabs gnyis su bsdu ba dang / skyes bu gsum gyi lam du bsdu ba dang theg pa'i grangs nges dang bcas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/mngon mtho nges legs sgrub byed dad shes gnyis/ /shes rab sngon 'gro dad pas/ snod rung byed/ shes rab grol rgyu mi rtog don sgrub phyir/ zhes smras te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ de la mngon mtho bde ba dang / /nges par legs pa thar bar 'dod/ /de'i sgrub pa mdor bsdus na/ /mdor na dad dang shes rab po/ zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ longs spyod dang lus 'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang / zhes gsungs pa ltar de yang rkang pa dang pos mngon mtho ni lus longs spyod 'khor dang rtsom pa rnams te/ de sgrub byed dad pa dang / nges legs ni theg pa che chung gi thar ba gnyis dang thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ de sgrub byed shes rab yin par mdor bstan nas rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyis rgyas par bshad de/ dad pa dkar chos thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba dang / dad pas chos kyi snod rung byed lam so so yang thob par byed de/ rin chen phring ba las/ dad can nyid phyi ra chos la bsten/ nas/ de ni dad pa can zhes bya/ /nges par legs pa'i snod mchog yin/ zhes pa nas/ yid dang lus dang ngag gi ni/ /mi dge kun nas bzlog bya zhing / /dge la rtag tu 'jug bya ba/ /'di ni chos rnams gsum du bshad/ /chos 'di dmyal ba yi dwags dang / /dud 'gro dag las rnam grol zhing / /lha dang mi yi nang nyid du /924

bde dpal rgyal srid rgyas bar thob/ nas/ de'i 'bras bu mdor bsdus pa'o/ /zhes mngon mtho rgyu bcas bshad la/ dkon mchog tā la las kyang /dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar skyed pa ste/ zhes sogs kyis dad pa so so dang /de dag gi lam dang skye ba dang bya ba so so la 'god tshul bshad de/ bslab btus dang de'i 'grel ba'am mchan sogs las shes dgos shing / shes rab ni/ spyir yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang khyad par du zab mo'i gnas lugs lta ba'i mig lta bu yin te/ mdo sdud pa ltar phar phyin gzhan rnams sangs rgyas sar 'khrid byed yang yin la/ de'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i zab mo'i shes rab ni zhi ba'i sgo gcig pu ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ shes rab ldan phyir yang dag rig /'di gnyis gtso bo shes rab ste/ zhes dang / nges par legs pa'i chos dag kyang / /zab cing phra bar snang ba dang / /byis pa thos dang mi ldan la/ /skrag pa byed par rgyal bas gsungs/ zhes sogs rgyas par bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dman 'bring mchog gi skyes bu'i lam rim du/ /chos tshul kun 'dus don gnyis las brtsams phyir/ /'bring las nyan rang gnyis dang de dag lam/ /chen por theg chen theg pa bzhi min 'dir/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam du rgyal bas chos tshul thams cad 'du ste/ rgyal ba rnams kyis dang por thugs bskyed pa dang / bar du tshogs bsags pa dang / mthar sangs rgyas nas chos 'khor bskor ba thams cad gdul bya'i gnas skabs dang ṣ+ṭathar thug gi don gnyis sgrub pa la brtsam pa sha stag yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba'i bde ba thob pa'i sbyin pa dang tshul khrims sgom pa ste/ gzhi gsum spyod pa thams 925

cad skyes bu chung ngu'i lam la 'jug bya ste/ lam sgron las/ gang 'i /ga thabs ni gang dag gi /sogs dang / bsdu ba las/ de la'ang dang po ni tha ma yin no/ zhes dang / rta dbyangs kyi kun rdzob byang chub sems sgom las/ mi 'tshe ba dang bden pa dang / /byin nas len dang tshangs par spyod/ /sbyin pa thams cad btang ba ni/ /'di ni bde 'gro'i spyod pa yin/ zhes so/ /'khor ba me 'bar ba'i klong ngam btson dong nas rang gcig pu thar 'dod kyi gzhi gsum spyod pa 'bring gi lam yin te/ lam sgron las/ 'khor ba'i bde la rgyab phyogs shing / /sogs dang bsdu ba las/ gnyis pa ni 'bring yin no/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems sgom las/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yongs mthong nas/ /spangs phyir bden pa'i lam sgom zhing / /kha na ma tho gnyis spong ba/ /'di ni zhi ba'i spyod pha yin/ zhes so/ /'gro kun mar mthong zhing sdug bsngal las grol 'dod kyis ci byed gzhan don du bla med byang chub thob phyir du lam gsum sogs la rtsom pa mtha' yas spyod pa'i blo ldan ni skyes bu chen po'i lam ste/lam sgron las/ rang rgyud gtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /sogs dang /bsdu ba las/ gsum pa ni mchog yin no/ /zhes dang / dpa' bos 'di dag kun kyang bslab bya ste/ /nges 'byung lam gyi yan lag yin/ /chos kun stong pa nyid rtogs pas/ /'gro la snying rje'i chu rgyun 'byung / /thabs mkhas spyod pa mtha' yas pa/ /nges 'byung mchog gi spyod pa yin/zhes gsungs la/ de yang nges pa dang ma nges pa'i phyag rgya'i mdo las phyugs kyi shing rta lta bus bgrod pa sogs lnga bshad cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 926

dzu 'phrul lta bus bgrod pa shin tu myur ba gcig phar phyin theg par yang bshad la/ de yang bsam pa stobs che chung gisabazhag par snang bas/rgyal ba'i lo tog la dus gsum du gal che ba'i snying rje chen po dang byang chub kyi sems la sgo gsum kun gyis nus pa sbrug nas bsgom pa gcig gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po gces shes su snang bas lam ltar snang cha ma tshang ba'i yan lag re la mi 'bad par lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan snang mtha'i sgyu 'phrul dpal mnyam med a ti sha'i thugs dam nying khu/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du mi'i blos gar mdzad pa ston pa rin po che'i phyag srol/ sku mched gsum gyi gsung zin bris rnams dang / khyad par du gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir mngon sum du rgyal ba gnyis pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i rje bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i lam rim gnyis dang sras so so'i gsung rgyun dang de'i nang nas brjod bya zab la rgyas kyang tshig nyung ba 'jam dpal zhal lung ni ngo mtshar bar yod mod/ 'di la bar bar na dmigs skor sbas pa dang sa bcad bzhag pa sogs phyag len la shin tu ltos dgos shing dka' gnad du ma 'grol ba la lam rim gnyis dang rnam bshad gnyis sogs la shin tu mkhas dgos la sngon med pa'i ngo mtshar ba yod do/ /de yang rje rin po che la 'jam dbyangs kyis gnang ba bzhin rje sher seng nas lta khrid dran pa bzhi ldan du brgyud pa 'di gsang chos su byas 'dug la/ 'di ni mdo sngags zung 'brel du nyams su len tshul byin rlabs shin tu che ba ba so pa nas dben sa lugs la shin tu dar zhing mdzad byang med pa'i khrid yig rnying ba'ang ches legs pa 'ga' zhig 'dug pa dag so sor shes dgos la sprul tso927

ba'i gles/sa bam nas sgrol ma'i rjes dran lnga bshad pa dang yang mthun zhing shin tu legs so/ /'o na brgya ba'i 'grel ba las/ lha yi therga/ dang tshangs pa'i theg zhes lha'i theg pa dang tshangs pa'i theg pa bshad—la/ 'dir yang skyes bu gsum gyi lam rnams lam yin min ji ltar zhe na/ lha dang tshangs par skye ba'i thabs la de'o theg par bshad pas theg pa ma yin la theg pa bzhi rgyal ba 'di'i bstan pa la mi rung bar rdo rje snying pos gsungs pas theg pa gsum du nges shing / skyes bu che 'bring lam la'ang ci rigs yod cing skyes bu 'bring gi theg pa la nyan rang gi theg pa gnyis dang skyes bu chen po la mdo sngags bgrod byed gyi lam la byang sems theg pas khyab pas so/ /gnyis pa theg pa so so'i khyad par la nyan rang gi theg pa'i khyad par dang /theg pa chen po'i khyad par gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dir nyan rang rtogs mthun sa brgyad dus 'bras dbye/ zhes smras te/ 'dir zhes pa ni thal 'gyur ba'i lugs 'dir khyad par dgar ba'i tshig go /des na skabs 'dir bgrod byed kyi mngon rtogs mthun te/ gnyis ka'i bgrod byed lam la shes rab gang zag gi bdag med phra mo rtogs dgos shing snying rje chen po yod kyang gzhan don khur du 'khyer ba'i snying rje chen po med pa sogs dngos smra'i skabs ltar yin pa'i phyir te/ zla bas skyabs gsum bdun cu ba las/ rang don la gzhol 'di dag ni/ /snying rje chen po dang bral ba'i/ /rang rgyal rgyal ba'i gsung las skyes/ /theg pa chen por mi bsngags so/ /zhes rang rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gsung las skyes ni nyan thos te de gnyis ni rang don lhur len pa sogs kyis theg chen gyi mdo las bsngags brjod med par 928

bshad pas so/ /'o na/ de gnyis theg pa tha dad pa med par 'gyur snyam na/ rigs mi 'dra ba dang / nyan thos kyi sems bskyed ni shin tu skrag nas thar ba tsam 'dod pa dang / dus tshe gsum sogs dang / rang rgyal gyi sems bskyed ni rang don tsam du rdzogs byang thob 'dod cing / dus bskal ba chen po brgyar sangs rgyas mnyes nus par bshad pa dang / 'bras bu mtshan dpe rjes mthun yod med gyi khyad par sogs kyis theg pa tha dad du skabs 'dir yang yin te/ sngar legs ldan gyis bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir te/ skyabs gsum las/ de 'dir thar ba'i cha nas ni/ /brtsam ste rtag tu dge ba la/ /nyan thos nyid phyir 'bad na ni/ /rim gyis nyan thos nyid du 'gyur/ zhes nyan thos kyi sems bskyed dang / de nyid las/gang zhig rang byung ye shes 'dod/ /rang rgyal byang chung don gnyer bas/ /brtson pa de yang rang rgyal gyi/ /byang chung kho na nges 'thob bo/ zhes so/ /nyan thos la mngon pa ltar zhugre/sa 'bras brgyad/ zhugs pa nas slob par 'jog gi so skye slob par mi 'jog pa dgra bcom ni nyon mongs zad nas mi slob par 'jog pa rnams yin te/ de nyid las/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rtogs nas shes te dad gyur pa/ /skyes bu gang zag zung brgyad po/ /mi phyed dge 'dun zhes bshad do/ /nyon mongs gzhom phyir slob pas na/ /gang zag bdun ni slob pa yin/ /nyes pa ma lus zad pa'i phyir/ /brgyad pa mi slob par bshad do/ /de rnams 'bras bur gnas pa bzhi/ /bzhi ni zhugs pa po yin la/ zhes dang / gang zhig 'phags lam ma skyes pa'i/ /byis rmongs so so skye bo 929

dag/ de ni slob dang mi slob pa/ rī /mi na zhes bston bcos las bshad do/ ne+ezhes gsungs lane rgyud bla thogs 'grel las so skye slob pa'ang bshad do/ /de dag gis dgra bcom pa yang mthar thug gi thar ba ma thob kyang las nyon gyis mi skye ba dang / zag med dbyings na 'khod pa sangs rgyas kyis bskul ba sogs bshad do/ /de nyid las/ 'di dag srid pas yid skrag pa'i/ /yid kyi byang chub gnyis thob pa/ /nas/ de yang 'jig rten 'dren par 'gyur/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa la mos spyod kyi sa dang / 'phags pa'i sa'i khyad par gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa brtan sems bskyed phar phyin yal ga rgyas/ /tshogs sbyor yon tan rtogs sgom ngo bos 'byed/ ces smras te/ rin chen phring ba las/ chi de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems// /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang / zhes gsungs pa ltar theg chen sems bskyed brtan pa'i tshad ni grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i mgo brtsams pa nas 'dzin cing brtan pa'i rgyu mtshan khyad par bzhi ldan yin te/ theg pa chen po bsdus pa las/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dang / /sems brtan khyad par 'gro ba yis/ /byang chub sems ba/pa' grangs med gsum/ /kun tu rtsom par mdzad pa/ zhes dang /de'i 'grel bar/ bzang bo ni dge ba ste de stobs dang ldan par gyur pa bzang po'i stobs can te de de la yod pas smon lam gyi stobs can no/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs can ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis zil gyis mi rdzi non pa'i phyir ro/ /smon lam gyi stobs can ni rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad pa'i phyir ro/ /sems brtan pa nyid ni mi dge ba'i—930

grogs pos mos pa bzlog kyang byang chub kyi sems yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /khyad par du 'gro ba ni mthong ba'i chos dang tshe rabs phyi ma la dge ba'i chos 'phel ba dang yongs su mi nyams pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar gang gi tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba dang smon lam gyi stobs can dang / sems brtan te bar ma dor khyad par du 'gro ba ste/ yon tan cung zad kyis chog par mi 'dzin pa de nas brtsams te grangs med gsum brtsams so/ /zhes so/ /sems bskyed brtan na phar phyin ming yang thob la de dag rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gzhung shing lta bu yin te/ rje bla mas/ sems bskyed theg chen lam gyi gzhung shing ste/ /sogs dang / sharnyi pa'i dag ldan las/ sems bskyed bsam sbyor lhag bsam dang / /pha rol phyin drug tshad med dag /mngon par shes dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ /so sor rig rton tshogs gnyis dang / /byang chub phyogs mthun zhi gnas sogs/ /gzungs bzhi chos kyi mdo bshad dang / /bgrod cig thabs la mkhas pa'o/ zhes grogs mi zad pa brgyad cu bshad cing des theg chen thams cad bsdus par thub dgongs las bshad pas so/ /des na grangs med gsum gyi thog ma mos spyod nas 'dzin par byang sar bshad la/ de'i mgo yang tshogs lam nas yin par kun btus 'grel bar bshad pa a bh+ya dang mthun pas/ sems bskyed nam thob pa nas tshogs lam dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gsar thob nas sbyor lam du 'jog la/ 'di gnyis kyi so so'i dran pa nyer bzhag sogs byang phyogs dang po gsum gyis tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum dang dad sogs dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga ni sbyor lam drod sogs 931

bzhi'i gnyis kyi skabs dang sbyor lam tshogs lam pa la rigs dar snyiri rje sogs kyi rtags dang drod sogs bzhi la rgyan ltar so sor yod la/ tshogs lam ngo bo thos byung dang bsam byung gtso yang zhi gnas yod pas sgom byung yang yod la/ sbyor lam gyi ngo bo gsum ga yod pa sogs dang sgom tshul yang mngon rtogs rgyan ltar dmigs rnam sogs shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/sa bcu mnyam bzhag dbyer med sbyor rjes kyi/ /yon tan mdzad sogs bcu gnyis gong nas gong / /re re'ang nges tshig dbye bra yon tan rten/ /rnam smin ltas gnyis spang gnyen brgyad kyis bshad/ ces smras te/ sa bcu ba las/ ji ltar bar snang bya rjes mkhas rnams kyis/ /brjod par nus ma yin zhing mi mthong ba/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i sras kyi sa kun kyang / /brjod mi nus na nyan par ga la nus/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo la dbyer med pa nam mkha' la byas bgrod pa'i shul lta bu yin kyang gdul byas don dam phar phyin sogs la spyod pa'i sbyor ba dang rjes thob kyi yon tan tshan pa bcu gnyis po so so'i grangs dang / sgrib gnyis spo nga ba'i mthu dang / phar phyin lhag tshul dang / rnam smin gyi skye ba sogs 'phel ba'i khyad par gyis sa bcur 'jog pa'i phyir te/ 'jug 'grel las/ de yang gong nas gong du yon tan gyi grangs dang mthu phul du phyung ba thob pa dang sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin lhag pa dang / rnam par smin pa 'phel ba'i bye brag gis sa rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i rnam par dbye bas dbye ba bcur bzhag gi 'di la rang gi ngo bo'i khyad par gyis byas pa'i dbye ba ni yod pa ma yin no/ zhes so/ /sa re re yang khyad par 932

brgyad brgyad kyis bshad de/ blo gros mi zad pa ting 'dzin rgyal po dkon mchog sbrin sa bcu ba sogs las sa dang po rab dga'/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ nas ṭa4 bsto ba chos kyi sprin gyi bar bshad cing / khyad par dang po nges tshig ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ de dag dang po rab dga' ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed phyir/ zhes dang / gnyis pa dri ma med ces bya/ /lus dang ngag dang sems kyi las/ /bcu char dri ma med pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / sa gsum pa ni 'od byed pa/ /ye shes zhi ba'i 'od 'byung phyir/ /bzhi ba 'od 'phro can zhes bya/ /yang dag ye shes 'od 'byung phyir/ /nas/ bcu ba chos kyi sprin yin te/ /dam pa'i chos kyis char 'be+ebs phyir/ zhes dang / chos dbyings bstod pa las/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /nas/ ye shes rang bzhin 'di yi sku/ /dri med nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'dzin pa las/ /chos kyi sprin ni kun tu 'byung / zhes pa lta bu dang / khyad par gnyis pa bslab gsum gyi rgyu 'bras dang zag med kyi phung bo lnga'i sbyong tshul gyi dbye ba ni mdo sde rgyan las/ chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas 'dir/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims lhag sems dang / /sogs kyis sa dang po drug la bslab gsum sbyar tshul dang / de nyid las/ mtshan med 'du byed dang bcas pa/ /nas/ sa bzhi po yang yang dag rten/ zhes pa nas sa bdun pa sogs bzhi la bslab gsum gyi 'bras bu mtshan med 'du byed dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu dang po dang / 'du byed med dang zhing dag pa 'bras bu gnyis pa dang / sems can smin pa sogs dang gzungs dang ting 'dzin 933

thob pa'i bar 'bras bu bzhi 'grub pa dang / yang de nyid las/ choyonyid rab tu rtogs nas 'dir/ /tshul khrims kyi ni phung po spong / /sogs kyis zag med kyi phung bo lnga sbyangs nas 'grub tshul dang / khyad par gsum pa yon tan gyi grangs kyi khyad par ni/ 'jug par/ de tshe 'di yis sangs rgyas brgya mthong zhing / sogs dang / sa bcu ba las/ rab tu byung nas kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam gcig la ṇ+ḍing nge 'dzin brgya rab tu 'thob cing de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas brgya mthong ba dang / de dag gis byin gyis brlabs kyang yang dag par shes pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed pa dang / zhing brgyar yang 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya snang bar byed pa dang / sems can brgya yongs su smin par byed pa dang / bskal ba brgyar gnas par byed pa dang / bskal ba brgya la sngon dang phyi ma'i ma thar 'jug pa dang chos kyi sgo brgya rnam par 'byed pa dang / lus brgya kun tu ston pa dang / lus re re yang 'khor byang chub sems dpa' brgya brgya dang ldan par kun tu ston pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa sa dang po la thob la/ yon tan de dag sa gnyis par stong 'gyur dang / gsum par 'bum dang / bzhi bar bye ba phrag brgya dang / lnga ba la bye ba phrag stong dang / drug pa la bye ba brgya phrag stong dang /bdun par bye ba khrag khrig 'bum dang / brgyad par stong gsum gyi 'jig rten khams 'bum gyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang / dgu par stong gsum 'jig rten khams grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab ji snyed kyi grangs dang / bcu ba la sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod 934

du med pa'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yon tan thob par brtsod do/ /khyad par bzhi ba brten pa phar phyin gyi lhag thob ni/ sa bcu la phar phyin rim bzhin lhag pa 'thob kyang phar phyin lhag ma rnams kyang sgrub pa tsam la khyad par med pa'i phyir te/ dbus mtha' las/ khyad par can dang khyad med ni/ /sa bcu dag tu shes par bya/ zhes so/ /khyad par lnga pa rnam smin gyi skye ba 'dzin pa'i khyad par ni/ /sbyir byang sems kyi/ skye tshul la/ dbang dang rnam smin gnyis te/ dbang gis skye ba de ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan rnams kyi las dang ni/ /gzhan yang smon lam dag dang ni/ /ting nge 'dzin dang dbang 'byor ba'i/ /dbang gis skye bar 'dod pa yin/ zhes mos pye+od pa 'dod par las dbang gis dang / sa thob pa ngan 'gror smon lam dbang gis dang / bsam gzugs thob kyang 'dod par skye ba ting 'dzin dbang gis dang / sprudze+eba'i dga' ldan gnas la sogs par skye ba dbang 'byor ba'i dbang gis skye ba ste/ dbang gis skye ba bzhi dang / rnam smin gyi skye ba ni sa bcu la rim bzhin phal cher 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'khrul dbang byed rgyal po dang / stong gi bdag po dang / stong gnyis kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang gnas gtsang lha'i rgyal po rnams su skye ba 'dzin te/ rin chen phreng ba las/'dzam gling dbang phyug chen por 'gyur/ zhes pa nas/ de yis rnam nga ra smin pas na/ /stong gnyis bdag po'i tshangs par 'gyur/ zhes dang /de yis rnam par smin pas na/ /gnas gtsang lha yi bdag por 'gyur/935

zhes so/ /khyad par drug pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang / sa so so'i rmi —ltas gnyis ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ chos gyi don du srog gtong ba/ /sogs dang / gser 'od sogs ltar/ sa dang po la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten 'di gter bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis yongs su gang ba rmi ba sogs yin la de yang phar phyin bcu'i rmi ltas yin te/ gser phreng las/ ltas 'di dag kyang sa bcu la phar phyin shes che ba dang / bstu na pa'i ltas su shes par bya/ zhes so/ /khyad par bdun pa spang bya spangs ba'i khyad par ni mthong spang la dbye na gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba ltar na go bzhi dang / mdzod ltar na gya brgyad dang / sgom spang rtsa nyon lhan skyes drug la/ khams kyi sgo nas bcu drug dang / sa so so'i sgo nas zhe drug dang / de la che chung gis phye na khong khro ma gtogs pa'i gzhan lnga la sa dgu re re la dgu dgu ste gya gcig pa lnga yod cing khong khro dgur phye bas bzhi brgya dang bcu bzhi yod pa dag dang / shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog tu grags pa'i gzung ba dang 'dzin pa bden 'dzin brgya rtsa brgyad rnams sa brgyad pa'i thog ma'i bar chad med lam gyis dngos gnyen byas nas spong zhing bag chags shes sgrib dag pa sa gsum gyis spong ba yin te/ de ltar du sa bcu ba dang 'jug pa rtsa 'grel gyis bshad pa'i phyir/ khyad par brgyad pa gnyen po yongs sbyong gi khyad par yod de/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/yongs su sbyong ba rnem bcu yis/ /sa ni dang po 'thob 'gyur te/ sogs dang / sher mdo ltar ro/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la mnyam bzhag mthar phyin ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / ye shes gnyis kyis gzigs tshul dang / sku yi 936

dbye ba 'khrul spong dang bcas pa dang / sku bzhi khyad par du bshad pa dang / gsang gsum sogs kyi khyad par dang / stobs yon tan mtha' yas pa'i tshul dang / 'phrin las bsam yas rgyun mi 'chad pa dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ 'bras bu mnyam rjes res min ngo bo gcig /sems kyi rgyu ba rnam rtog kun zhi bas/ /gnas brtan bzhengs min rjes thob bya ba'ang mdzad/ ces smras te/ de yang chos dbyings bstod pa las/ /sa bon gyur pa khams de nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi rten du 'dod/ /rim gyis sbyangs par gyur ba las/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'gyur/zhes pa'i khams rang ba'i/na gnas rigs sbyong byed drug cus sbyangs pa la sa 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'thob dgos tshul ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'di dag rang mtshan nyid kyi rjes su 'brel/ /ngo/ rim ji bzhin gzungs kyi rgyal bo'i mdor/ zhes sogs kyi thogs 'grel las/ de yongs su dag pa'i yon tan gyi yongs su sbyong pa rnam pa drug cu bstan nas sangs rgyas kyi khams gsal bar mdzad de/ yongs su dag par byed pari yon tan dang ldan no/ de yongs su dag pa'i yongs su sbyong ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byang chub sems kyi bslab pa gsum gzung ste rgyan bzhi dang / dran pa blo gros dang rtogs pa sogs snang ba brgyad dang / lta ba sna tshogs 'khrugs pa la brtse ba dang / phyin ci log bzhis g.yeng bar brtse ba sogs snying rje chen po bcu drug dang / gti mug/ gi gnyid sad byed dang / mos pa dman pa rgya chen por sbyor ba sogs byange sems kyi lam rnam pa sum cu gnyis te drug cu po de thogs 'grel las/ don gyi dbang 'di 937

nye bar bzung nas byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu bo dag la yang sa le sbram yongs su sbyong ba dper brjod pa dang / zhes pa ltar sa bcu la sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu ji lta bu zhig 'thob ce na/ sku bzhi dang gsang ba gsum dang stobs bcu sogs yon tan drug cu dang / 'phrin las so gnyis rnams 'byung ba las bod dag gis sangs rgyas kyi mnyam rjes ngo bo gcig pa'i don mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas smra brjod sogs thub pa la 'dod pa ni —'jug pa 'dir sa bcu pa pa la yon tan ci 'dra zhig gsungs pa bltas na shes nus par ma zad ting nge 'dzin gyi rdzu 'phrul gzhan nas kyang shes par 'gyur zhing / 'dir mnyam bzhag de bzhin nyid la snang ba zad pa dang rjes thob ji snyed pa kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes mkhyen pa skad cig ma la tshogs pa ni mnyam rjes ngo bo gcig nga/ dang / de ltar gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan sangs ma rgyas bar du sems skad cig ma gcig gis shes bya yongs su gcod pa'i 5shes sgrib dang de'i rten rnam rtog dang de'i rten dang skyed byed las rlung ma log pa'i dbang gis yin par gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par bltas na rnam rtog med pa'i rgyu mtshan du rlung gi rgyu ba med par bshad pas shes dgos la de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rnam rtog zhi ba na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad 'bad med tsu na grub tu 'byung ba dang ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas pa brtan po mthar phyin pa 'thob pa'i phyir dang 'dus ma byas pa sogs kyi yon tan brgyad kyapreng 'thob pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ /gang zhig thog ma dbus mtha' med zhi sangs rgyas nyid rang rnam sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nas ni ma rtogs rtogs phyir 'jigs med rtag pa'i lam ston pa/ /938

mkhyen brtse'i ral gri sdo rje mchog bsnams sdug bsngal myu gu sa/cod mdzad cing ’/ /sna tshogs lta thib/sa kyis bskor the tshon rtsib/ pa 'jig mdzad de la 'dud/ ces dang / thogs 'grel las/ spros pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phyir lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /sogs dang / ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ 'jam dpal skye ba med cing 'gas/ pa med/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sogs kyi 'dus ma byas pa dang /yang de nyid las/ 'jam dpal de de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang g.yo bar mi mdzad/ sems par mi mdzad spro bar mi mdzad rtog par mi mdzad rnam par rtog par mi mdzad sacing / rtog pa med pa rnam par rtog pa med pa/ sems pa med pa yid la byed pa med pa/ bsil bar gyur pa/ skye ba med pa/ 'gag pa med pa/bltar med pa/ mnyam/ du med pa/ snam du med pa/ myang du med pa /reg tu med pa/ mtshan ma med pa/ rnam par rig pa med pa sogs gsungs pa dang / dkon mchob/ sprin las/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa rgyun mi 'chad par mnyam par bzhag/ pa'o/ /zhes dang / skyabs gsum las/ sangs rgyas nam mkha' ji bzhin du/ de ltar chos nyid la rab bzhugs/ /yid bzhin nor bu ci yid ni// /mi rtog rtog pa med na yang / /'akro ba'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ tshim par byed pa yin par bshad/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas thugs rin ni/ /rang gi mos bzhin dgongs mdzad pas/ /'gro ba bya ba de dong de/ /de bzhin mdzad pa go ba yin/ zhes dang / bden gnyis dang sngar gyi mdo 939

de dag tu rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos dbyings gzigs —/ngor spros pa kun log kyang / /ma brtags ji snyed sgyu ru ra bzhin mkhyen/zhes smras te/ chos dbyings la gzigs ngor gzugs kyi spros pa kun log tshul ni/ 'jug par sems 'gag pas de sku yis mngon sum mdzad/ ces dang / de ltar na yang ye shes des ji snyed pa sogs la ltos nas thams cad gzigs tshul ni phyag gi skyu ru ra bzhin du ma 'dres par gzigs pa ste/ 'jug par stobs bcu sogs dang / de'i mdo dag dang / dkon mchog sprin las/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i lto'i spyan gyi yul tshad med de/ nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ma lus pa kun de 'drar gyur kyang da bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil na skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu ltar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs so/ zhes sogs lta bu shim/ tu mang ngo / /gsum pa ni/ sku gcig sku gnyis gsum bzhi lngar bzhed phyir/ /thub la rgya che mi mnga' gzhan ngor 'khrul/ nas smras te/rigs ldan grags pas lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa las/ sangs rgyas shākya seng ge yis/ /serna sa can bsam pa'i dbang dag gis/ /sku ni gcig gnyis gsum dang ni/ /bzhi dang lnga ru gsungs pa ste/ zhes ga/sungs pa ltar lnga las/ dang po ni/ de nyid las/ sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ris med pa/ zhes pa ltar na/ dza bo nyid sku dang / yang na 'bras bu chos kyi sku ste sku gcig dang / de nyid 'a sa/ ji ltar gzugs kyi sku dang ni/ /de ltar sangs rgyas chos sku ste/zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ rang don gzhan don don dmyo/ sku dang 940

ni/ /sogs ltar rang don chos sku dang gzhan don gzus/sa sku ste gnyis dang / legs ldan gyis kyang ye shes dang gzugs dang gsung gi sku gsum po de dag ni/ zhes dang / de nyid las/ thugs gsung sku yi dbye ba yis/ /sku gsum du ni rab tu bsgrags/ /chos dang longs spyod spru la ba rnams/ zhes pa ltar na/ thugs chos sku dang / gsung longs sku dang / sku sprul sku 'am/ yang na skyabs gsum las/ thub dbang rnams kyi sku gsum ste/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa/ zhes pa ltar ngo bo nyid sku dang longs sku dang sprul sku ste/ sku gsum dang / rgyan las/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul ba ni/ /chos sku mdzad par bcas pa ste/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ ces pa ltar ngo bo nyid sku dang ye shes chos sku dang longs sku dang sprul sku ste sku bzhi dang / mtshan brjod las/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ zhes pa ltar ye shes lnga'i sku ste sku lnga sogs dus 'khor 'grel chen sogs mdo sngags so so nas bshad pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na rgya che ba gzugs sku gnyis sogs mi mnga' bar gdul bya'i gzhan ngor skyel dgos snyam zhing bris ba dang smras ba ni khyi zhar char drag gis brdungs pas changan skad bton pa yin no/ /bzhi ba la/ ngo bo nyid sku dang / ye shes chos sku dang / longs sku dang / sprul sku bzhi las/ dang po ni/ blo bur rang bzhin rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ ces smras te/ sangs rgyas sa'i dbyingaṭa/ rnam dag de gdod ma nas bden grub kyi mya ngan gyis dag pas na rang bzhin rnam dag dang gnyen pos glo bur gyi dri ma dag par byas pas na gro 941

bur rnam dag dang ngo bo nyid sku dang 'gog bdecha/ sogs yin te/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de nyid sbyangs pa byas pa las/ /dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku ya nga de nyid do/ /zhes dang / ngo bo nyid sku de 'du sa ma byas pa dang rnam dbyer med pa dang / mtha' gnyis spangs ba dang / sgrib gsum las grol ba dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa ni/rgyud bla ma las/ de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyin lnga/ zhes dang / 'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /nas/dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ zhes dang / ngo bo nyid sku de yon tan rgya che bas gzhal du med pa dang / yon tan grangs 'di tsaza zhes bgrang du med pa dang / rtog ge'i yul ma yin pas bsam du med pa dang / de 'ba' zhig la yon tan de yod pas mnyam pa med pa dang / sgrib pa'i bag chags dang bcas/ pa spangs pas dag pa'i yon tan te/ yon tan lnga dang ldan te/ rgyud bla ma las/ mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du rig par bya/ zhes dang / gzhar med grangs med bsam med pa/ /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa/ zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes chos sku sde tshan nyer gcig sogs/ zhes smras te/ de yang chos dbyings bstod pa las/ dri ma med pa'i chos sku la/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gnas gyur nas/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du/ /de bas sems can don rnams mdzad/ cesaphi ltar ye shes dang ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i rdul ltar yod kyang gdul bya'i rigs mthun sgom ched du mngon rtogs rgyan las/ byang chub 942

phyogs mthun tshad med dang / /nas/ chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/zhes gsungs pa ltar zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig dang thugs rje bcu drug sogs yod de/ /de dag sher mdo dang sa/zungs rgyal gyi mdo sogs su lta'o/ /gsum pa ni/ lnga ldan snang ba mi sdud longs spyod rdzogs/ zhes smras te/ 'di mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gyi steng na gnas rigs bco brgyad pa dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya bar tshogs mtha' yas pas bskyed pa'i rgya dpangs legs ldan ltar nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i theg chen gyi mdo dang theg bsdus ltar rgya ris su ma chad pa rin po che'i rgyan dadh+ra 'phyang 'phrul sna tsho gas dang ka ba 'bar ba stong phrag du mas btegs pa'i rin po che'i thog phub pa'i dbus su/ 'khor sa bcu'i rgyal sraṭa/ mtha' yas pa dang bcas te/ skyabs gsum las/ 'og min gzhal yas khang du ni/ /ji nga dag mngon sum mdzad par 'dod/ ces dang / sangs rgyas kyi ni gzugs kyi sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad dag gis 'bar/ /'akro ba rang gi mos pa yis/ /dbang gis sna tshogs skur 'dzin gang / /bsod nams tshogs ni tshad med las/ /'khrungs pa de ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /sa bcu la ni gnas rnams kyis/ /mthong bar gyur nas sku de ni/ /chos gyis rdzogs longs spyo da 'di ni/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa yin/ zhes gsungs la/ 'phags pa'i sku gsum la bstod pa las/ rang gi 'byor pa 'jig rten las 'das pas/ bsam gyis mi khyab legs mdzad brgya yi 'bras bu ni/ sogs dang / 'jug pa sogs mang la gnas dang gzhal yas khang 943

sogs kyang shin tu gsal bar bshad de/ rtog ge 'bar ba las yang na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi steng na 'og min zhes bya ba'i gzhal med khang sogs dang / mdo las/ rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams 'og min gyi/ /pho brang rgyas par sdig pa kun/ /rnam spangs der ni 'tshang rgya zhing / /sprul ba dag gis 'dir 'tshang rgya/ zhes dang /yum 'bum pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi stobs ni dbang phyug chen po'i lha'i 'jig rten du skyes shing gnas pa mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'o/ /shes rab kyi khyad par ni byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba nyid do/ zhes krong / chos dbyings bstod pa las kyang / so so rang rig rnam dag na/ /sa rnams de yi bdag nyid gnas/ /dbang phyug chen po'i gnas mchog dang / /'og min nyid de rnam mdzes pa/ zhes dang /dbu ma snying bo las kyang / steng g.yogs ka ba 'bar bas dga'/ /mu tig 'phreng ba 'phyang ba dang / /rin chen sna tshogs du ma las/ /sna tshogs las kyis bzo sbyar ba/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /'od zer sgron ma brgya snyed 'bar/ shin tu mtho ba mkha' mnyam pa/ /rin chen 'od kyis phyogs khyab byed/ zhes longs sku de yang gang dang lhan cig spyod pa 'khor dang gang du longs spyod pa zhing dang / gang gis spyod pa'i sku dang / gang la longs spyod pa'i chos dang / gang gis mdzad pa'i khyad par lnga dang ldan te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ longs spyod rdzogs pa khams kun tu/ /'khor yongs sdud dang zhing dang mtshan/ /sku dang chos rdzogs longs spyod dang / /mdzad pa dag gis tha dad do/ /zhes dang /944

yang na sku ston pa dang / gsung brjod pa dang / thugs 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / 'bad med lhun grub dang / sna tshogs su bstan kyangañcadabyer med pa nor bu rin po che lta bu lnga dang ldan te/ rgyud bla ma las/sna tshogs chos kyis rdzogs longs spyod sogs so/ /rgyas par mdo dang bstan bcos de dag sogs su blta'o/ /bzhi ba ni/ bzo dang skye ba byang chub sprul sku gsum/ /snyan 'jebs drug cu'i gsung gis mkha' kun 'gengs/ zhes smras te/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba'i ched du pi wang rdung mkhan lta bu dang mgar ba dang yi ge pa sogs su sprul pa ni bzo bo sprul sku dang / dkon mchog tā la las/ de dag dgon par ljon shing chen por 'gyur/ /zhes sogs ltar ljon shing du sprul ba dang ri dwags ru ru sogs su sprul ba ni skye ba sprul sku dang / rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul ba'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /sogs ltar mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i byang chub chen po'i sprul sku dang gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan—las/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dpag med pa/ /sprul pa'i sku ni 'dod pa ste/zhes dang / bzo dang skye ba byang chub che/ /sogs dang dbu ma snying po—las/ gdul bya ji bzhin sprul pa yi/ /sprul pa yis ni phyogs bkang nas/ /bstan pa rin chen char 'beb pas/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i bde ba bskyed/ /sogs ltar nyan rang brgya byin tshangs sogs sna tshogs su sprul nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i 'od zer yang mi 'dra ba du ma gtong 945

tshul dkon mchog tā la dang / dbu ma snying po sogs su shes phar bya/lo ngas sku dang mchog gi sprul sku gnyis la mtshan dpe dang gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu gsang ba bsam mi khyab dang / rtog ge 'bar ba dang /mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba rnam bshad rigs pa byang sa nyi khri snang ba sogs ltar dang / rgyud bla ma las/ mthong na tshim mdzad yon tan gang / /sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes bya ba/ /sprul ba chos la rdzogs par ni/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku gnyis la brten/ zhes pa ltar de gnyis la ldan pas 'dir bshad la 'di ni gsung gi gsang ba yang yin no//lnga ba ni/ gsang gsum rol ba kun khyab skal bas mthong / /skad cig bskal bar bzlog dang ba spu rer/ /brtan g.yo bkod kyang mkha' bzhin che chung min/ zhes smras te/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam mi khyab kyi le'u gsum las shes dgos la kun la khyab kyang skal bas mthong tshul sogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dang ye shes yul la 'jug pa sogs dang rgyud du ma dang dbu ma snying po rtsa 'grel sogs du ma las bshad mod/ /dpe tsam byas na rgyud bla ma las/ brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang / /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /zhes brgya byin sa gzhi dwangs par mthong nas smon sogs ltar thub sku yang gdul bya'i las sgrib bral ba'i dang ba'i ngor shar nas smon pa sogs dang rgyas par bshad pa lta bu gdul bya rang rang gi skal bas de tsam mthong gi sangs rgyas byang sems mthong ba de yis ma bstan pa min la de bzhin du skad cig bskal bar byin gyis 946

rlobs pa dang bskal ba skad cig du dang / rdul phra rab gcig dang ba spu'i khung bu cig tu 'jig rten thams cad bkod kyang phan tshun che chung du mi 'gyur la mi dogs pa nam mkha' lta bu ste/ 'jug pa las/ thub dbang skad cig kho nar de'i rgyu mthun/ zhes pa nas/ dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yis/ /rdul gcig yul la mkha' gtugs 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khyab rdul ston mod/ /rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phra mi 'gyur/ zhes sogs ltar rgyas par 'jug pa rtsa 'grel dang mdo du ma sogs ltar ro/ /drug pa ni/ stobs bcu gzhan dang ma 'dres bco brgyad sogs/ /rmad byung yon tan ma lus rgyal rnams kyis/ /brjod la zhugs kyang mi rdzogs mkha'i mtha' bzhin/ zhes smras te/ 'dir dpal ldan zla ba dang thogs med kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel ba dgongs pa gcig ste rgyud bla mar yang rin po che'i rgyal po bkru ba gsum dper mdzad nas/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu mdzad la zla bas kyang sprul sku'i skabs su bshad cing thogs 'grel las bdag med gnyis yang 'jug pa ltar bshad cing /gzungs rgyal gyi mdo la brten nas stobs sogs 'phrin las so gnyis bshad pa 'jug 'grel du stobs dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ma 'dres/ pa bco brgyad la mdo de drangs nas bshad pas rgyas par der shes dgos shing 'dir khyad par 'ga' smras na/ rgyud bla ma las/ gnas dang gnas min las rnams kyi/ /rnam smin dang ni dbang po dang / /khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang / /kun 'gro'i lam dang bsam gtan sogs/ /nyon mo ngas dri ma med pa dang / /gnas ni nges su dran pa dang / /lha yi mig 947

dang zhi ba dag /mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rnam pa bcu zhes gsungs te/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / dbang po mchog dman mkhyen pa'i dang / khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i dang / mos pa sna sogs mkhyen pa'i dang / kun tu 'akro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i dang / bsam gtan sogs dang dri ma med pa mkhyen pa'i dang / sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i dang / /'chi 'pho dang skye sogs mkhyen pa'i dang / zag pa ma lus pa zhi ba mkhyen pa'i stobs te stobs bcu'i gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa nas thams cad du 'am kun tu 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs dang po drug gis nyon mongs can min pa'i mi shes pa shes sgrib go cha lta bu 'bigs par byed pa'i sdo rje lta bu dang /bsam gtan rnam thar sogs dri med mkhyen pa'i dang / sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i dang / 'chi 'pho sogs mkhyen pa'i stobs gsum ni snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa rtsig pa lta bu 'jig pa'i rdo rje lta bu dang / zag zad mkhyen pa'i stobs ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i shing rnams gcod pa'i rdo rje lta bu yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ stobs sogs rnams las stobs drug dang / /gsum dang gcig gis rim pa bzhin/ /shes bya snyoms par 'jug pa dang / /bag chags bcas pa kun bsal bas/ /go cha rtsig pa shing bzhin du/ /phug dang gzhig dang bcad phyir ro/ zhes so/ /de bzhin du mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyan rang sogs gzhan dang ma 'dres pa bco brgyad de bral ba'i yon tan so gnyis dang rnam smin gyi yon tan mtshan bzang so gnyis te ldan chos drug cu rtsa bzhi rgyud bla 948

'dir dngos su bshad la der ma zad sogs sgras dpe byad brgyad cu dang yang sogs sgras sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i tha snyad bco brgyad kho nar zad dam zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan sems can dang ma 'dres pa sum brgya sogs kyang yod la de re re'i yon tan yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa mdo so so nas shes dgos te/ 'jug 'grel las/ de la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ni bco brgyad de/ zhes pa nas/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad gang yin pa de dag ni/ zhes sogs kyis gzungs rgyal gyi mdo drangs nas bshad la rtog ge 'bar ba las/ grangs med pa dang / dpag tu med pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i yon tan gyi bdag nyid chen po bstan pa ni mdo sde du ma las snang ste/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku mtha' dang dbus med pa yongs su dag pa zhes pa nas/ de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' dang dbus med pa bcu yin no/ /de bzhin du skad cig ma la sangs rgyas rnams kyis ye shes bcu mngon par bsgrub pa ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi dus las mi 'da' ba bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlab mngon par sgrub pa'i ye shes bcu dang / gzhal du med pa'i khongs su gtogs pa nyid bcu dang /shes rab 'chal bas bsnyen par dka' ba che zhing rgyas pa'i chos bcu dang /bdag nyid che ba nyid bcu dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa bcu dang /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa bcu dang / ye shes rgya mtsho'i rigs pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'dren pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan 949

pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa bcu dang / sems can gyi snying po'i chos bcu dang /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ma chags par gnas pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi rgyan bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang phyug la dbang ba bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa bcu dang /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi stobs bcu dang / chos gyis phyug pa'i chos bcu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas pa bcu dang /chos thams cad ma lus par mkhyen pa nyid bcu dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas pa bcu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran pa rnam par dag pa bcu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa myur du mthong ba'i chos bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin bcu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par bzhag pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar ba bcu ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa sum brgya po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa bcu ba'i mdo las bstan to/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dang thun mong ma yin pa nyid yin no/ /gang yang gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / dkon mchog sprin dang / sa bcu ba la sogs pa'i mdo de las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba'i bdag nyid nye bar bstan pa rnak+ka sa khyad par du shes par 'dod na/ mdo de dag nyid kun tu blta bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyud bla ma las/ yon tani drug cu rtsa bzhi po/ 'di dag so sor rgyur bcas/ te/ /go rim ji bzhin rin chen gyi/ /mdo yi rjes 'brang shes par bya/ zhes dang / de'i snga 'grel las/ de 950

ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag rnam pa gcig tu mngon par bsdus te drug cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur ro/ zhes dang / des na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gcig gi yang yon tan ma lus par sangs rgyas thams cad kyis brjod kyang mthar gtugs par mi 'gyur te/ nam mkha'i mtha' bzhin no/ /ji skad du 'jug pa las/ nam mkha' med pas 'dab chags ldog par mi 'gyur gyi/ /sogs dang / de'i rang 'grel las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gzugs sku'i ba spu'i bu ga re re dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la sogs pa yon tan gyi khyad par yongs su gcod par ni sangs rgyas kho nas spyod la/ gal te gsungs na ni rang nyid kyi ye shes kyi yul du gyur pa bskal ba grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab par sku tshe'i tshad byin gyis brlab cing 'phrin las gzhan mi mnga' bar skyen pa skyen par gsungs pa de lta na yang yon tan dag yongs su rdzogs par mi 'gyur na byang chub sems dpas lta ci smos te/ zhes so/ /bdun pa ni/ gang 'dul lhun grub 'phrin las rtag tu ston/ zhes smras te/ de la spyir sangs dzā rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad la 'phrin las re yod pa dang / gtso bo ni stobs bcu'i 'phrin las dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i 'phrin las dang /ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi 'phrin las te 'phrin las so gnyis yod kyang de tsam du ma zad de gdul bya re 'dul ba'i 'phrin las re ston pas bsam gyis 951

mi khyab pa mnga' la de thams cad 'bad med lhun grub dang phyogs thams cad khyab par dus thams cad du 'jug ste/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu de la de bzhin game+egs pa'i las gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i las ni sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag go /zhes pa nas/ rigs kyi bu gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las gang yin pa de ni tshad med pa'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /'jig rten thams cad kyis rnam par shes par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /yi ge rnams kyis brjod par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /gzhan dag gis thob par /dka' ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rgyun chad pa med pa'o/ / / sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du rjes su song ba'o/ /zhes sogasau dang / yang mdo de nyid las/ de'i phyir rigs gyi bu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun gyi rjes su song ba dang thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / dus gsum gyi rjes su song ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi gcod par rnam grangs 'dis rig par bya ste/ nas/ rigs kyi bu gang rgyun chad med pa rgyun chags pa/ rgyun mi gcod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i lung bstan pa'i gtam rgyun mi gcod pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'phrin las yang dag pa'o/ /zhes dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gang gi srid pa ji srid par/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun chad med par 'dod/ ces pa lta bu mang ngo / 'dir smras 952

pa/ gang gi zegs ma the tshom gyis spyad kyang / /'khor ba'i rgud pa kun 'phrog 'chi med zas/ /ci dgar spyod pa'i grags snyan 'byor ba'i tshogs/ /rnam sad tshal bzhin mig yid rna ba'i gsos/ /ming rtog tsam las nam yang chos gang yang / /med kyang srid zhi 'byor rgud thos bsam bsgom/ /'bras bus mi slu ngo mtshar ri mo 'bum/ byed po med kyang rab bkra e ma mtshar/ /gdod nas dag kyang rmongs 'khrul sgyu ma yi/ /chos brgyad 'dod pa'i yul lngas ches rmongs pa/ /rnam bdun sngags kyis bshig tshe ming tsam yang / /ma rnyed sa gsum 'gro rnams ci yis bslus/ brdzun snang tsam dang dman pa'i stong pa la/ /dbu mar 'khrul min ming tsam rten 'byung gi /dbu ma'i srol 'byed 'phags pa yab sras dang / /gangs can rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras rmad/ zab rgyas gang la thub dbang dgongs pa'i gnad/ /rdul tsam ma 'khrul dbu ma chen po'i lugs/ /lung rigs rin chen bye bas 'og min che'i/ /gzhal yas khang bzhin srid zhi'i bla na 'bar/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /zhes grub mtha'i rnam bzhag 'khrul spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kyi rnam bshad las mtha' thams cad bkag pa'i dbu ma chen po thal 'gyur ba'i lugs te skabs bcu gnyis pa'i rnam bshad byas zin to// 953

rigrub mtha'i rnam bshad le'u bcu gsum pa 'azas bu rdo rje theg pa'i dogs gcod/gsum pa zhar byung 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i dogs gcod la/ mdo sngags kyis sgrib gnyis spong tshul 'khrul spong dang bcas pa dang / lam myur bul gyi khyad par dang / lus ngag yid gsum shin tu phra ba bla med las gzhan du sbas tshul dang / de'i don gyis bla med spyi dang khyad par du gsang gsum ston pa'i rgyud rgyal mchog tu grub pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ mdo sngags gnyis kas nyon sgrib kun zad nus/ /yul mchog bstan kyang yul can mchog sbas bzhin/ /dri gtso bstan kyang gnyen po ma chog sbas phyir/ /shes sgrib chung phra sngags las mdos mi nus/ /de phyir spang gnyen sbas pa mgo mtshungs 'khrul/ zhes smras te/ 'di dag rgyas par bshad na gsang sgrogs su'ang 'gro la skabs su yang cher ma babs pas rgyu mtshan thun mong ba cung zad re bstan na/ sngags kyi rgyud sde 'og ma gsum du ma zad phar phyin theg pa'i gdul bya dma' ba nyan rang gis kyang nyon sgrib dang bden 'dzin kun zad nus te/ bden 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir dang / de'i dngos gnyen bden med phra ba'i lam sgom thub pa'i phyir dang / de la the tshom don 'gyur skyes na'ang thar ba'i sa bon 'jog thub pa'i phyir te/ bzhi brgya ba las/ bsod nams chung ngus chos 954

'di la/ /the tshom za bar yang mi 'gyur/ /the tshom zos pa tsam gyis kyang / /srid pa hrul por byed par 'gyur/ zhes dang / de nyid shes pas gal te 'dir/ /mya ngan 'das pa ma thob kyang / /tshe rabs gzhan du 'bad med par/ /grol 'gyur nges pa'i las bzhin no/ zhes dang /dbu ma las/ rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams ma byung zhing / /nyan thos rnams kyang zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni/ /brten pa med pa rab tu 'byung / zhes so/ des na yul mchog bden med phar phyin theg par bstan kyang / shes rab de gcig pus shes sgrib kyi 'ching ba las mi grol bas/ dri ma med par grags pas zhus pa las/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab ni 'ching ba sogs dang / sa ra has/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs pa/ /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ zhes sogs bshad la/ des na yul stong pa mchog bstan kyang yul can bla med kyi bde chen ni sngags kyi rgyud sde 'og ma gsum du yang ma bstan na/ de'i rnam bzhag de man chad du ci'i phyir ston pas sbas la/ de bzhin du spang bya dug gsu ma gyi dri ma'i gtso bo shes sgrib skor dgu bstan zhing / de'i gnyen po bar chad med lam gsum sogs bstan kyang snga ma rnams la rnam rtog dang las rlung gtan log mi dgos par spang rung la/ shes sgrib chung ngu'i chung ngu spong ba la de gnyis gtan log dgos shing / de tshog byed kyi gnyen po bla med kyi bde chen ma bstan pa'i phyir/ shes sgrib chung shos phra shos sngags las mdo rkyang pas mi nus so/ /do ha las/ bde ba'i de nyid dang ni cibral gyur cing / /lus kyi dka' thub 'ba' zhig tsam bstan pa/ /nas/ 955

phal cher mi mthun phyogs la zhugs pa yin/ zhes dang / ye shes grub pa las/ ma lus sbyong rgyud las gsungs pa'i/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams/zhes so/ rgyu mtshan de lta bu la sogs pa dang sngar bshad pa ltar 'pho chags ni phar phyin theg par yang nyon sgrib yin la/ de'i bag chags shes sgrib tu 'jug 'grel rgyud bla rtsa 'grel gzungs rgyal gyi mdo sogs du ma las bshad pas/ gnyen po bla med kyi bde chen dang spang bya shes sgrib sbas pa mgo mtshungs su stag los smra ba yang 'khrul lo/ /stag lo na re/ 'di ba'i lugs la bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi las rlung stong brgyad brgya ba bcu 'am bcu gnyis 'gag dgos pas/ de dag sgrib pa sbas bar 'jog ste/ de ma zad bar du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'thob pa'i phyir zer na/'o na/ slob pa'i byams snying rje sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi tha ma gnyis ma gtogs pa'i rnam rtog gi lam thams cad kyang der gyur par thal/ rnam rtog ma zad bar du de mi 'thob pa'i phyir/ de dag ldog dgos kyang spang bya'i sgrib pa min snyam na/ cig shos kyang de kho na yin no/ /spros pas chog /gnyis pa ni/ thabs zab mang phyir lam la'ang myur bul che/ zhes smras te/ phar phyin theg par gdul bya theg chen gyi gang zag la lam myur bul lnga yod pa yang thabs sems bskyed dang snying rje sogs kyi dbang gis nges pa dang ma nges pa'i phyag rgya'i mdos bshad la/ sngags la de bas kyang /tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / zhes sogs ltar thabs zab mo dam tshig dang sdo ma pa'i khyad par dang sangs rgyas rjes su—956

dran tshul dang mchod sogs kyi bsam pa khyad par can mang zhing bla med la shin tu nas sku gsum la dmar 'jus su sgrub lugs gcig yod pas snyigs dus kyi mi lo nyung shos la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub pa sogs yin pa'i phyir te/ kha sbyor rgyud las/ de'i phyir de rgyas ci zhig bya/ /mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bskal ba bye ba grangs med pas/ /ji srid sangs rgyas gang thob pa/ /gang gi dam pa'i bde bas khyod/ /skye ba 'dir ni thob par 'gyur/ zhes dang / ye shes grub pa las/ gang zhig rtog pa kun spangs pa'i/ de nyid la ni yang dag gnas/ /sgrub pa bo de tshe de yi/ /byang chub dam par zhugs par 'gyur/ zhes so/ gsum pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum rags phra shin tu phra/ /sbyangs phyir theg dang mdo rgyud gong nas gong / /'og mar gzhan gnyis bshad kyang gsum pa ni/ /dgongs gzhir rung yang mdo rgyud 'og mar min/ zhes smras te/grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal nā ro zhabs kyis/ /lus dang sems kyi gnas thabs las/ /rags dang phra dang shin tu phra/ zhes gsungs pa 'dis lus sems gnyis la rags pa dang phra ba dang shin tu phra ba gsum bshad cing lus kyi des ngag la yang gsum yod par shes dgos shing / de dag sbyangs pa'i phyir nyan rang dang phar phyin theg pa dang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyis rags pa dang phra ba sbyong la/ shin tu phra ba ni gzhi dus la de 'dra yod pa/rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi dgongs gzhir rung yang dngos su ma gsungs la/ de yang bla med du gsal ba tsam gang na'ang med pa'i phyir te/ rgyud no rje phreng ba las/ de nas gzhan yang sdom pa'i don/ /de kho na nyid 957

brtsa/da kyi nyon/ /sdom pa srung bar byed pa gang / /de ni byang chub sems zhes brjod/ /ces dang / de'i don lus ngag yid gsum sdom tshul yang zhal lung las/ de bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /sdom pa mchog la gnas byas nas/ /nga'o snyam pa'i gzi bajid bskyed/ /sogs dang /rgyud rdo rje phring ba las/ bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud rnams dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud ni gang du yang / /mchog tu gsang ba ma gsungs pa/ zhes so/ /bzhi ba ni bla med spyi dang rgyud rgyal dag na gsal/ /skal ldan grub dbang bye bas rtser gshegs shul/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang lam mchog tu grub/ ces smras te/ de 'dra'i gsang gsum gyi khyad par zab mo gzhi lam 'bras bu gsurma gyi skabs su rgyud chags par yod par gsang sngags bla med spyi na phyogs mtshon re mang mod rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyud na mchog tu gsal bas de nyid ston mkhan la sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang 'di ni bdag cag gi pha'o/ zhes sogs kyis bsngags shing mdo sde thams cad kyi snod dang / rgyud sde thams cad kyi yang rtse dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad gshebanas shing gshegs la gshegs par 'gyur ba'i lam chen yin par 'grub ste/ rgyud rdo rje phring ba las/de nyid mchog tu gsang ba ni/ /gang du'ang nga yis ma bshad pa/ /skal ba med pa'i bsam pa'i rgyus/ /rgyud rnams kun du sbas byas pa/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ zhes dang / mi shes pa yi mi 'ga' zhig/ rgya mtsho bzhi yi pha mtha' yi/ /sa la shin tu 'akro 'dod pa/ /lam ni gang yin mi 'dri gang / /ji ltar bdag nyid 'gro bar byed/ /de bzhin 958

—dka' ba cher byed pa'i/ /man ngag dang bral sgrub pa po/ /'bras bu med phyir mkhas pa yang / /sgrub pa po ni khong khro skye/ /khong khro skyes pa'i skad cig la/ /'bras bu med cing ngu 'bod 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /dad pas bla ma brgyud pa las/ /man ngag dag ni shes par bya/ /zhes dang / gsang ba grub par/ de yang de nyid rgyud gnas par/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus par gsal/ /spros pa du cha/ rgyas gyur pa/ /gzhan du sbas nas bstan pa yin/ /bya ba spyod pa'i dbye ba yang / /mdo sde'i sde snod la sogs su/ /mchog tu dga' ba gcig pu nyid/ /rnam pa du mar rnam par gnas/ /phung po rin chen snod nyid du/ /sems can bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /de nyid 'bad pas sbas mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas mgon pos rnam par bzhag /ces dang /grub dbang klu'i byang chub kyis kyang / sems can bag la nyal dbye bas/ /yang dag mgon pos de nyid ni/ /'bad pa'i sbas nas phung bo yi/ /rin chen za ma tog tu bzhag /ces dang / sgron gsal las/ thub pa chen pos chos phung po/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs de dag /dpal ldan 'dus 'di snod yin te/ /de bas de ni rgyud kyi rtse/ zhes pa lta bu rgyud dang paṇa grub kyis bsngags pa'i rgya mtsho'o/ /'dir smras pa/ mchog tu rmad byung gsang las ches gsang theg nyon mongs lam byed myur du kun 'od sar/ /'jug byed gsang sngags spyi dang bla med la/ /rnam dag yid ches de yang rgyal kun yab/ ces grub mtha'i rnam bzhag 'khrul spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kyi mdo sngags lam mthar thug gi khyad par phye myo/sa 959

gsang lam mchog tu grub pa'i skabs kyi rnam bshad byas zin to/ / / / gsum pa mjug gi don la lnga las/ dang po bstan bcos kyi khyad par gzugs rgyan dang / dpe rgyan sgos smras pa ni/ 'jam mgon mkhyen gzi las 'ongs 'khrul mun bral/ /dbyangs can lha mos smras bzhin snyan 'jeb 'gris/sa/ thub dbang gsung bzhin thog mtha' bar du'ang dge /'dzam gling rgyan mchog lugs kun 'dus bzhin brling / zhes so/ /bod 'dir gsung rab mi lta mi slob par sgom chen b.raspyarlodza pa dang / blo kros dman pa dang than thun re sbyangs tsam dang thub bstan mtha' dag la sbyangs pa'i khyad par ni/ 'ga' zhig ma bslab long bas mthar bgrod 'dod/ /la la blo dman byi bas glang khur len/ /phal cher sbyangs tsam ri phran btegs pas snyems/ /thub bstan nor 'dzim/ kun 'degs kurma su/ zhes so/ /zab rgyas kyi khyad par phra mo gnyis tshogs rtogs pa rgya bod gnyis ka na'ang sngar bshad ltar dkon pa ni/ mkhas las ches mkhas 'phags bod mang pos kyang / /thugs ngor zab rgyas thags mkhan rkang pa bzhi na/ /res kyis ma bde snang stong zung 'brel lam/ /ma rnyed lung rigs 'khar bas ci yang btsal/ zhes so/ /rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i khyad par tshol ba la rgya bod dang phyi nang gi paṇa chen kun kyang 'bad pa/chos grags dang dpal lha gcig a ti sha'i rnam thar lta bu ste de bstan pa'i phyir/ rang gzhan mkhas mang klu dbang stong gis rol/ /phan dang bde ba'i rin chen 'phyur bus gang / /dgag sgrub rlabs 'khrug grub mtha'i cari/rngo+or bgrod slad/ /ded dpon mkhas rnams gru rdzings ci yang 'jug / 960

ces so/ grub mtha'i mthar ma son pa'i stag tshang pa sngon 'byung gi rabs dang sbyar zhing khong la ltas te rang gis grub mtha'i mthar son pa'i khengs gtam cung zad brjod pa ni/ rigs pa'i gru rdzings dman 'khrul dang po'i rgyud/ /brdungs pas tshul zhig 'gas kyang grub mtha'i mtshor/ /phyin snyems dregs skyungs lugs gnyis kun mthong phyir/ /grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol kho bos phyin/ zhes so/ de nas smon lam gyi khyad par tshigs bcad gsum ste/ blo bzang mes byin rang lugs lam gsum 'babs/ /rnam dpyod lha chen ral 'ongs rtog ge yis/ /bshung bslad nor lha'i rkang dri bkrus chab kyis/ /rmongs 'khrul dug can rgyud tshogs dag gyur cig /rin chen khur lci mtsho chen ska rags g.yo/ /nyi zla'i sgron 'degs lhun po gnas de srid/ /'dis kyang gsar bshad khur lci grags snyan g.yo/ /legs bshad sgron mes sa gsum snang byed shog /chos dbyings gshis dang dkon mchog gsum gyi mthus/ /'gro rnams rdzu 'phrul bzhin du sa rim bgrod/ /nya rgyas zla ltar yon tan kun rdzogs nas/ /nyi ma brgyas gsal kun mkhyen myur thob shog ces so/ /sbyar byang gzhan go sla la/ 'jam mgon bla ma khri rin po che ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho'i sras kyi thu bo theg chen sbyor lam par gsungs pa'i rgyal sras chen po mdo sngags gnyis dang lung gi gter drin can bla ma don grub rgya mtsho dang / mdo sngags kun dang 'u nga rtogs gnyis ka'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dgon lung sprul sku blo bzang chos ldan dang / dka' chen lnga sogs rigs pa smra ba la deng dus kyi sa'i steng na 'gran bla bral ba rigs pa'i dbang phyug shes rab sbyin pa ste yab 961

sras bzhi'o/ /de yang rtsa ba 'di byed pa'i bskul ba po de dag dang rang blo legs bshad la goms pa 'phel ba sogs dgos pa shin tu che la/ rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gi bka' rtsom dbu ma'i bstan bcos theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings las/ 'di dag gi skabs nas bzung ste sems bskyed drug pa'i skabs kyi bar du rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa 'ga' zhig la stag tshang lo tsā pas/ nas/ 'gal ba'i khur chen bco brgyad btang 'dug pa 'di la zhib mor dpyad tshe gnod byed ltar snang tsam ma gtogs yang dag ma mchis bas dgag lan gcig byas na yongs par 'dug kyang / nas/ skabs brgyad pa'i nang du rjes 'jug mkhas pa 'i skye bor rlom pa'i 'gying bag can yod na lam/ gdab par rigs so/ /zhes bskul ma zhig byas yod kyang bye ma btsir ba la mar nag yongs rigs su mi 'dug pas/ tha snyad rigs pa'i thugs khur bzhes mi dgos pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dras lan 'debs mdzad na legs par sems so / /zhes bka' stsal ba'i thugs bzhed bskang ba'i ched dang / phyogs lhung dang rmongs zhen tsam ma yin par sher mdo sogs zab mo'i bstan bcos rnams dang / sngags la'ang gsal sgron las bshad pa 'di ni sa/nga las khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam dang grub mtha' 'og ma rnams legs par mi shes na/ de las khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam dang grub pa'i mtha' gong ma'i khyad par gyi chos thun mong ma yin pa phra mo rnams mi shes shing /nas// de la mos kyang dad pa tsam du zad par mthong nas/ rang gzhan gyi sde pa dang / rang sde theg pa che chung dang / sngags dang phar phyin gyi thagal962

pa gnyis dang / rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sdi bzhi'i gzhung rnams la sbyangs shing /zhes gsungs pa ltar dgos shing / rang yang de ltar cung zad sbyangs nas/rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i dka' gnas rnams la gtso bor rnam par bshad pa re byas shing / mkhas pa stag tshang ba'i lan yang cung zad phye ba 'dis mtshungs med rgyal ba'i dbang po yab sras sogs phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang / rang gzhan gyi dam pa che phra mtha' dag mnyes bar gyur cig gu snyam du bris te/ skyes rabs las/ ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar byed/ ces dang / dris lan rin chen phreng ba las/ dri med dris lan rin chen phreng ba 'di/ /gang gi mgul na legs par yod gyur pa/ /de ni skyes bu mkhas pa 'dus nang du/ /mgul gyi mu tig rgyan bzhin mdzes pa yin/zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ mthong ba'i dbang gis mi rnams rab tu diga' ba'i mchog skyed pa/ /cha/sa/ chos kyang don rnams phye bas mkhasasarnams 'di na dga' mchog skyed/ ces gsungs so/ /smras pa/ gang zhig gzhan gyis ma smras 'dir med kyang / /ljongs 'di la ltos sngon med legs bshad mchog /yin phyir 'khrul dang rang bzos ma bslad pas/ /blo ba dag pa bzhin du dbyangs can smras/ /blo gros mthar son bye bas/ ma thon pas/ /mdo sngags grub mtha'i dka' gnad ches gsal ba'i/ /lha rdzas dwangs shel mchog 'di mkhas pa brgya'i/ /thugs ka gsal byed rgyan du bdag gis 'bul/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung bzhin sbyang bzhin legs bsatshobazhin / /rtse gci ga dran pa mngon byas legs sbyar mod/ /legs par 963

bshad pa bla ma lha yis drin/ /nyes par nongs gang 'phags dang mkhas la 'chags/ /'di ni kun bzang dag zhing nyi ma bzhin/ /rang gzhan gzhung lugs dpag yas don gsal zhing / /theg gsum gdul bya'i dge tshogs 'dab brgyar bzhad/ /srid pa ji srid 'gro rnamaca/ mig gyur cig /slu med dkon mchog rnam gsum byin rlabs dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'phrul/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi nus mthu yis/ /dge legs char gyis khams gsum khyab gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis legs smon ltar/ /lhag bsam zla rgyas dag pa'i bdud rtsi spros/ /dad pa kun+ta'i mig phye legs smon pas/ /dag pa'i zhing 'khor mdzad pa lhun grub shog /ces grub mtha'i rnam bshad rang gzhan grub mtha' kun dang zab don mchog tu gsal ba kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma lung rigs rgya mtsho skye dgu'i re ba kun skongs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khams rgyal ba 'phags pa lha'i sku mdun mdzis par byed pa'i chos rje lcang ra dpon slob lung rtogs gnyis/ kas byug pa des slar yang rang 'grel gcig dgos zhes ja g.yu gser bcas gcig dang yang nan bskyar gyis ja gser byu ru sogs dang bcas lan gnyis bskul zhing / mkhas mang gzhung brgya smra ba'i 'dus sde blo gsal gling gi bu 'bor rab 'byams smra ba dbang lung bka' 'gyur sogs thob pa'i ngag dbang dpal ldan gyis me shel ma rig gnyid sangs kyis spras/ te bskul ba mkhas pa'i mkhas pa nges par gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po nam mkha' lhun grub kyis nyin bde che legs bris shog sum brgya di nga bcas rgyu mtshan snyan tshig gis drangs pa'i bskul ba dang / gzhan 964

yang mtho dman du mas ngag gis kyang bskul ba las sa mo yos kyi lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la gzhon nu'i dus nas chos la spro ba'i mang thos spong ba pa shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes rdzogs par bris pa 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che sgo thams cad nas phyogs dus/ thams cad du rgyas par gyur cig me /bskal brgyar bsags pa'i bsod nams ye shes gangs/ /thugs rje nyin byed drod kyis bzhus pa las/ grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i klung rgyun 'phyur ba'i sgras/ /mu stegs thar mdzad thub pa'i dbang por 'dud/ /de yi sras kyi tshul bzung 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes su sa gsum na/ /rnam par grags ldan de yi gsung gi mdzod/ /grub pa'i mtha' kun gsal byed legs bshad gter/ /'di ko blo ldan mig gi bdud rtsi dang / /rna bar sngon med legs par bshad pa'i skyes/ /snying gi bum par mi zad 'dod 'jo'i dpyid/ /skal bzang skye bo'i bsod nams gshis las grub/ /tshul 'dir dpar gyi 'du byed bsgrubs pa yi/ /dge bas mthun rkyen byed pa'i skye bo rnams/ /tshe rabs kun tu dam pa'i zhabs bsten te/ /thos bsam bsgom pas shes rgyud smin par shog /ku sha'i rtse ltar zhib pa'i blo gros kyis/ /phyi nang grub mtha'i khyad par phra rags kun/ /ma 'dres so sor 'byed pa'i dpal thob nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la yid ches rnyed par shog /sde 'dir kun mkhyen 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i sde'i/ /zhabs pad rdo rje'i khams su rtag brtan cing / /mdzad 'phrin 'od brgya'i snang bas sa gsum kyi/ / skye 'gro dga' bde'i dpal la rtag rol shog /gser sbyangs btso ma 965

lta bu'i rang lugs 'di/ rme /'dzin skyong spel nus dge 'dun 'dus ba'i sdes/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun yongs gang ste/ /dge legasasnang bas sa gsum kun khyab shog ces gangs can mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i grub mtha' chen mo 'di nyid dpar khang bkra shis mthong smon nas rgyu rkyen skyisbyar te/ dpar du bsgrubs pa'i tshe smon tshig dgos tshul/ do dam pa dang / bu dag pa so so nas bskul ba ltar/ me /btsun pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi mas chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba'o// 5shu bham sna sab dza ga ti// —//

'brug rgyal mkhar gyis dpe sgrig gi 'gan khur/grags pas mtshan byang bris/ma dbyi chin gyis mdun shog gi ri mo bris/ sa / /grub mtha'i rnam bshad kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blos zhu dag byas/kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe khang gis bkrams/mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang gis dpar/1994lo'i zla8par par thog mar bton/sdu994lo'i zla8par dpar thengs gnyis par btab/dpar grangs2 001da 4 550(58glu 7—5421—0081—572 6(zla4)deb reng sgor 16 50
